body.text:
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya
naraṃ caiva narottamam
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva
tato jayam udīrayet

dvaipāyanauṣṭhapuṭaniḥsṛtam aprameyaṃ
puṇyaṃ pavitram atha pāpaharaṃ śubhaṃ ca
yo bhārataṃ samadhigacchati vācyamānaṃ
kiṃ tasya puṣkarajalair abhiṣecanena

namo vyāsāya gurave
sarvajñāya maharṣaye
pārāśaryāya śāntāya
namo nārāyaṇāya te

kṛtābhiṣekaṃ tanayam
rājñaḥ pārīkṣitasya ha
draṣṭum abhyāyayuḥ prītyā
śaunakādyā maharṣayaḥ

tān āgatān sa rājarṣiḥ
pādyārghyādibhir arcitān
sukhopaviṣṭān viśrāntān
kṛtasaṃpraśnasatkathān

tatkathābhiḥ kṛtāhlādaḥ
praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ
śatānīko 'tha papraccha
nārāyaṇakathāṃ parām

yam āśritya jagannātham
mama pūrvapitāmahāḥ
vipakṣāpahṛtaṃ rājyam
avāpuḥ puruṣottamāḥ

drauṇibrahmāstranirdagdho
mama yena pitāmahaḥ
parīkṣit prāṇasaṃyogaṃ
devadevena lambhitaḥ

tasya devasya māhātmyaṃ
devarṣisiddhamanujaiḥ
śrutaṃ subahuśo mayā
stutasyāśeṣajanmanaḥ

kaḥ stotum īśas tam ajaṃ
yasyaitat sacarācaram
avyayasyāprameyasya
brahmāṇḍam udare śayam

rudraḥ krodhodbhavo yasya
prasādāc ca pitāmahaḥ
tasya devasya kaḥ śaktaḥ
pravaktuṃ vā vibhūtayaḥ

so 'ham icchāmi devasya
tasya sarvātmanaḥ prabhoḥ
śrotum ārādhanaṃ yena
nistareyaṃ bhavārṇavam

kenopāyena mantrair vā
rahasyaiḥ paricaryayā
dānair vratopavāsair vā
japyair homair athāpi vā

ārādhitaḥ samastānāṃ
kleśānāṃ hānido hariḥ
śakyaḥ samārādhayituṃ
tan naḥ śaṃsata sattamāḥ

vidyānām api sā vidyā
śrutānām api tac chrutam
rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ tad
yena viṣṇuḥ prasīdati

mantrāṇāṃ paramo mantro
vratānāṃ tan mahāvratam
upoṣitaṃ hi tac chreṣṭhaṃ
yena tuṣyati keśavaḥ

sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti
tac cittaṃ yat tadarpaṇam
tāv eva kevalau ślāghyau
yau tatpūjākarau karau

sujanma deham atyantaṃ
tad evāśeṣajanmasu
yad eva pulakodbhāsi
viṣṇor nāmābhikīrtanāt

sā hānis tan mahac chidraṃ
sā cāndhajaḍamūkatā
yan muhūrtaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vāpi
vāsudevo na cintyate

nūnaṃ tat kaṇṭhaśālūkam
athavā pratijihvikā
rogo vānyo na sā jihvā
yā na vakti harer guṇān

santy anekā bilās tadvac
śrotram apy alpamedhasām
dattvāvadhānaṃ yac chabde
vinaiva harisaṃstutim

dharmārthakāmasaṃprāptau
puruṣāṇāṃ viceṣṭitam
janmany aviphalā saikā
yā govindāśrayā kriyā

durgasaṃsārakāntāram
apāram abhidhāvatām
ekaḥ kṛṣṇanamaskāro
muktitīrasya deśikaḥ

sarvaratnamayo meruḥ
sarvāścaryamayaṃ nabhaḥ
sarvatīrthamayī gaṅgā
sarvadevamayo hariḥ

evam ādiguṇo bhogaḥ
kṛṣṇasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ
śruto me bahuśo siddhaiḥ
gīyamānas tathāparaiḥ

so 'ham icchāmi taṃ devaṃ
sarvalokaparāyaṇam
nārāyaṇam aśeṣasya
jagato hṛdy avasthitam

ārādhayitum īśānam
anantam amitaujasam
śaṃkaraṃ jagataḥ prāṇaṃ
smṛtamātrāghahāriṇam

tan mamādya muniśreṣṭhāḥ
prasādayitum icchataḥ
upadeśapradānena
prasādaṃ kartum arhata

tasyaitad vacanaṃ śrutvā
bhaktim udvahato hareḥ
paritoṣaṃ paraṃ jagmur
munayaḥ sarva eva te

sarve ca te muniśreṣṭhā
bhṛguśreṣṭhaṃ ca śaunakam
yathārthaṃ bhagavaṃs tasmai
kathyatām ity acodayan

sarvajñānanidhiḥ sphītas
tvam atra bhṛgunandana
trailokyasarvasaṃdeha-
tamodīpas tapodhana

evam ukto munivaraiḥ
prītyā tasya ca bhūpateḥ
bhaktyā ca devadevasya
pravaṇīkṛtamānasaḥ

kṛtvottarīyaparyaṅkaṃ
śithilaṃ bhagavān atha
pratyuvāca mahābhāgaḥ
śaunakas taṃ mahīpatim

yat pṛcchasi mahīpāla
kṛṣṇasyārādhanaṃ prati
vratopavāsajapyādi
tad ihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu

anādimat paraṃ brahma
sarvaheyavivarjitam
vyāpi yat sarvabhūteṣu
sthitaṃ sadasataḥ param

pradhānapuṃsor ajayor
yataḥ kṣobhaḥ pravartate
nityayor vyāpinoś caiva
jagadādau mahātmanoḥ

tatkṣobhakatvād brahmāṇḍa-
sṛṣṭihetur nirañjanaḥ
ahetur api sarvātmanaḥ
jāyate parameśvaraḥ

pradhānapuruṣatvaṃ ca
tathaiveśvaralīlayā
samupaiti tataś caiva
brahmatvaṃ chandataḥ prabhuḥ

tataḥ sthitau pālayitā
viṣṇutvaṃ jagataḥ kṣaye
rudratvaṃ ca jagannāthaḥ
svecchayā kurute 'vyayaḥ

tad ekam akṣaraṃ dhāma
paraṃ sadasator mahat
bhedābhedasvarūpasthaṃ
praṇipatya paraṃ padam

pravakṣyāmi yathā pūrvaṃ
matpitrā kathitaṃ mama
tasyāpi kila tatpitrā
tasmai cāha kilośanāḥ

tenāpi bhṛgum ārādhya
prāptam ārādhanaṃ hareḥ
sakāśād brahmaṇaḥ prāptaṃ
bhṛguṇāpi mahātmanā

marīcimiśraiś ca purā
param etan maharṣibhiḥ
prāptaṃ sakāśād devasya
brahmaṇo vyaktajanmanaḥ

yogaṃ brahmā paraṃ prāha
maharṣīṇāṃ yadā prabhuḥ
samastavṛttisaṃrodhāt
kaivalyapratipādakam

tadā jagatpatir brahmā
praṇipatya maharṣibhiḥ
sarvaiḥ kilokto bhagavān
ātmayoniḥ prajāhitam

yo yogo bhavatā prokto
manovṛttinirodhajaḥ
prāptuṃ śakyaḥ sa tv anekaiḥ
janmabhir jagataḥ pate

viṣayā durjayā nṝṇām
indriyākarṣaṇāḥ prabho
vṛttayaś cetasaś cāpi
capalā cātidurdharāḥ

rāgādayaḥ kathaṃ jetuṃ
śakyā varṣaśatair api
na yogayogyaṃ hi mano
bhavaty ebhir anirjitaiḥ

alpāyuṣaś ca puruṣā
brahman kṛtayuge 'py amī
tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva
kimu prāpte kalau yuge

bhagavaṃs tvam upāyajñaḥ
prasanno vaktum arhasi
anāyāsena yenemam
uttarema bhavārṇavam

duḥkhāmbumagnāḥ puruṣāḥ
prāpya brahma mahāplavam
uttareyur bhavāmbhodhiṃ
tathā tvam anucintaya

evam uktas tadā brahmā
kriyāyogaṃ mahātmanām
teṣām ṛṣīṇām ācaṣṭa
narāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā

ārādhayata viśveśam
nārāyaṇam atandritāḥ
bāhyālambanasāpekṣās
tam ajaṃ jagataḥ patim

ijyāpūjānamaskāra-
śuśrūṣābhir aharniśam
vratopavāsair vividhair
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ

tais taiś cābhimataiḥ kāmair
ye ca cetasi tuṣṭidāḥ
aparicchedyamāhātmyam
ārādhayata keśavam

tanniṣṭhās tadgatadhiyas
tatkarmāṇas tadāśrayāḥ
taddṛṣṭayas tanmanasaḥ
sarvasmin sa iti sthitaḥ

samastāny atha karmāṇi
tatra sarvātmanātmani
saṃnyasyadhvaṃ sa vaḥ kartā
samastāvaraṇakṣayam

etat tad akṣaraṃ brahma
pradhānapuruṣāv ubhau
yato yasmin yathā cobhau
sarvavyāpiny avasthitau

paraḥ parāṇāṃ paramaḥ
sa ekaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
yasyābhinnam idaṃ sarvam
yac ceṅgaṃ yac ca neṅgati

tam ārādhya jagannāthaṃ
mokṣakāraṇam avyaktam
acintyam aparigraham
kriyāyogena mucyate

iti te brahmaṇaḥ śrutvā
rahasyam ṛṣisattamāḥ
narāṇām upakārāya
yogaśāstrāṇi cakrire
kriyāyogaparāṇīha
muktikāryāṇy anekaśaḥ

ārādhyate jagannātho
yadanuṣṭhānatatparaiḥ
paramātmā hṛṣīkeśaḥ
sarveśaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ

tāni te nṛpaśārdūla
sarvapāpaharāṇy aham
vakṣyāmi śrūyatām anyad
rahasyam idam uttamam

saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ
viṣayākrāntacetasām
uttāram icchatāṃ tasmād
bhṛśaṃ yan nāntarair api
viṣṇupotaṃ vinā nānyat
kiṃcid asti parāyaṇam

uttiṣṭhaṃś cintaya hariṃ
vrajaṃś cintaya keśavam
bhuñjaṃś cintaya govindam
svapaṃś cintaya mādhavam

evam ekāgracittas tvaṃ
saṃśrito madhusūdanam
janmamṛtyujarāgrāhaṃ
saṃsārāmbhas tariṣyasi

anantam īḍyaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ
jagadvidhātāram ajaṃ janitryam
samāśritā ye harim īśitāraṃ
teṣāṃ bhavo nāsti hi muktibhājām

śrūyatāṃ kuruśārdūla
saṃvādo 'yam anuttamaḥ
ambarīṣasya rājarṣeḥ
saha devena cakriṇā

ambarīṣo mahīpālaḥ
pālayann eva medinīm
udvigna eva dvandvāntam
abhīpsuḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ

devadevāt sa govindād
abhīpsur dvandvasaṃkṣayam
tapas tepe nirāhāro
gṛṇan brahma sanātanam

tasya kālena mahatā
bhaktim udvahataḥ parām
tutoṣa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ
sarvalokapatiḥ prabhuḥ

sa rūpam aindram āsthāya
tam uvāca mahīpatim
meghagambhīranirghoṣo
vāraṇendragatis tadā

rājarṣe vada yat kāryaṃ
tava cetasy avasthitam
varado 'ham anuprāpto
varaṃ varaya suvrata

evam uktas tato rājā
vilokya ca puraṃdaraṃ
pratyuvācārghyam udyamya
svāgataṃ te 'stv iti prabho

nāham ārādhayāmi tvāṃ
tava baddho 'yam añjaliḥ
varārthināṃ tvaṃ varadaḥ
prayacchābhimatān varān

varārthāya tvayānyaiś ca
kriyate nṛpate tapaḥ
sa kim arthaṃ tvam asmatto
na gṛhṇāsy abhivāṃchitam

na varārtham ayaṃ yatnas
tvatto devapate mama
viṣṇor ārādhanārthāya
viddhi māṃ tvaṃ kṛtodyamam

ahaṃ hi sarvadevānāṃ
trailokyasya tatheśvaraḥ
pālayanti mamaivājñām
ādityādyāḥ sadā surāḥ

ādityā vasavo rudrā
nāsatyau marutāṃ gaṇāḥ
prajānāṃ patayaḥ sādhyā
viśvedevā maharṣayaḥ

kurvanty ete mamaivājñāṃ
siddhagandharvapannagāḥ
matto hi ko 'nyo varadaḥ
pratigṛhṇīṣva vāñchitam

tvam indraḥ satyam evaitad
devas tribhuvaneśvaraḥ
tvayāpi prāptam aiśvaryaṃ
yatas taṃ toṣayāmy aham

trailokyaṃ tava deveśa
vaśe yasya mahātmanaḥ

saptodare śayā lokās
tam īśaṃ toṣayāmy aham

yasya tvam amaraiḥ sarvaiḥ
samavetāḥ sureśvara
dehaprāpto 'ntarastho vai
taṃ namāmi janārdanam

nimeṣo brahmaṇo rātrir
unmeṣo yasya vāsaraḥ
tam īḍyam īśam ajaraṃ
praṇato 'smi janārdanam

yo hartā jagato devaḥ
kartā pālāyitā ca yaḥ
trayasyāsya ca yo yonis
taṃ viṣṇuṃ toṣayāmy aham

hiraṇyakaśipuḥ pūrvaṃ
hiraṇyākṣaś ca te ripuḥ
tavānukampayā yena
hatau daityau nato 'smi tam

balināpahṛtaṃ śakra
dattaṃ yena purā tava
trailokyarājyaṃ taṃ baddhvā
taṃ namāmi janārdanam

prasīda śakra gaccha tvam
aham apy atra saṃsthitaḥ
tapas tapsye jagannāthaṃ
draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim

evam uktas tatas tena
śakrarūpī janārdanaḥ
punar apy āha taṃ kopāt
pārthivaṃ tapasi sthitam

yadi madvacanād adya
na bhavāṃs tyakṣyate tapaḥ
vajraṃ te prahariṣyāmi
budhyasvaitad yadīcchasi

nāpy alpam aparādhaṃ te
karomi tridaśeśvara
tathāpi vadhayogyaṃ māṃ
manyase cet kṣipāyudham

śrūyate kila govinde
bhaktim udvahatāṃ nṛṇām
saṃsārārṇāvabhītānāṃ
tridaśāḥ paripanthinaḥ

tāpaso 'haṃ kva niḥsaṅgaḥ
kva ca kopas tavedṛśaḥ
vijñātam etad govinda-
bhaktivighnopapāditam

bhavanti bahavo vighnā
nare śreyaḥparāyaṇe
govindabhaktyabhyadhikaṃ
śreyaś cānyan na vidyate

sa tvaṃ prahara vā mā vā
mayi vajraṃ puraṃdara
nāham utsṛjya govindam
anyam ārādhayāmi bhoḥ

na cāpi vajraṃ vajrī vā
tvaṃ ca nānye surāsurāḥ
śaktā nihantum īśāne
hṛdayasthe janārdane

kiṃ ca no bahunoktena
nāhaṃ vakṣyāmy ataḥ paraṃ
yathepsitaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ
kariṣye 'ham abhīpsitam

evam uktvā surapatiṃ
pārthivaḥ sa punas tapaḥ
cacāra maunam āsthāya
tenātuṣyata keśavaḥ

saṃdarśayām āsa tataḥ
svaṃ vapuḥ kaiṭabhārdanaḥ
caturbhujam udārāṅgaṃ
śaṅkhacakragadādharam

kirīṭasragdharaṃ spaṣṭaṃ
nīlotpaladalacchavim
airāvataś ca garuḍas
tatkṣaṇāt samadṛśyata

sa ca rājavaro devaṃ
pītavāsasam acyutam
vilokya bhaktiśirasā
sahasaiva mahīṃ yayau

pratyuvāca ca bhūpālaḥ
praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ
romāñcitatanuḥ stotram
padmanābhaṃ tato 'stuvat

ādideva jayājeya
jaya sargādikāraka
jayāspaṣṭaprakāśāṇḍa
bṛhanmūrte jayākṣara

jaya sarvagatācintya
jaya janmajarāpaha
jaya vyāpiñ jayābheda
sarvabhūteṣv avasthita

jaya yajñapate nātha
havyakavyāśanāvyaya
jaya vijñātasiddhānta
māyāmohaka keśava

lokasthityartham anagha
varāha jaya bhūdhara
nṛsiṃha jaya devāri-
vakṣaḥsthalavidāraṇa

devānām aribhītānām
ārtināśana vāmana
jaya krāntasamastorvī-
nabhaḥsvarlokabhāvana

jitaṃ te jagatām īśa
jitaṃ te sarva sarvada

jitaṃ te sarvabhūteśa
yogidhyeya namo 'stu te

namo 'stv avyapadeśyāya
namaḥ sūkṣmasvarūpiṇe
namas trimūrtaye tubhyaṃ
viśvamūrte namo 'stu te

brahmādyaiś cintyate rūpaṃ
yat tat sadasataḥ paraṃ
viśeṣair aviśeṣyāya
tasmai tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ

puruṣākhyaṃ tato rūpaṃ
nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca
prakṛteḥ parataḥ sūkṣmaṃ
tan namasyāmi te hare

avyaktādiviśeṣāntam
atisūkṣmatamaṃ mahat
prākṛtaṃ tava tad rūpaṃ
tasmai deva namāmy aham

rūpair nānāvidhair yaś ca
tadrūpāntaragocaram
līlayā vyavahāras te
tasmai devātmane namaḥ

prasīda viṣṇo govinda
śaṅkhacakragadādhara
dharādharāravindākṣa
vāsudeva maheśvara

itthaṃ stuto jagannāthaḥ
proktavān iti keśavaḥ
ambarīṣaṃ pṛthivīśaṃ
jagat saṃnādayan girā

ambarīṣa prasanno 'smi
bhaktyā stotreṇa cānagha
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva dharmajña
yat te manasi vartate

eṣa eva varaḥ ślāghyo
yad dṛṣṭo 'si jagatpate
tvaddarśanam apuṇyānāṃ
svapneṣv api hi durlabham

bālyāt prabhṛti yā deva
tvayi bhaktir mamācyuta
vetti tāṃ bhagavān eva
hṛdisthaḥ sarvadehinām

tvatprasādān mameśāna
rājyam avyāhataṃ bhuvi
kośadaṇḍau tathātīva
śarīrārogyam uttamam

striyo 'nnapānasāmarthyā
hāniḥ svalpāpi nāsti me
balaṃ nāgasahasrasya
dhārayāmy arisūdana

saṃtatir nibhṛtā bhṛtyā
sānurāgāś ca me janāḥ
dharmahāniś ca deveśa
na hi me pālane bhuvaḥ

yad yad icchāmy ahaṃ tat tat
sarvam asti jagatpate
etenaivānumānena
prasanno bhagavān iti

jñātaṃ mayā hi govinde
nāprasanne vibhūtayaḥ
evaṃ sarvasukhāhlāda-
madhyastho 'pi ca keśava

punarāvṛttiduḥkhānāṃ
trāsād udvignamānasaḥ
mayi prasādābhimukhaṃ
manas te yadi keśava
tan mām agādhe saṃsāre
magnam uddhartum arhasi

sukhāni tāni naivānte
yeṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ na tat sukham
yad ante duḥkham āgāmi
kiṃpākasyaiva bhakṣaṇam

sa prasādaṃ kuru guro
jagatām tvaṃ janārdana
jñānadānena yenemāṃ
vāgurān nistaremahi

ity uktas tasya govindaḥ
kathayām āsa yogavit
yogaṃ nirbījam atyanta-
duḥkhasaṃyogabheṣajam

upadiṣṭe tato yoge
praṇipatyācyutaṃ nṛpaḥ
punaḥ prāha mahābāhur
vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ

devadeva tvayā yogo
yaḥ prokto madhusūdana
naiṣa prāpyo mayā nānyair
mānavair ajitendriyaiḥ

viṣayā durjayāḥ puṃbhir
indriyākarṣiṇaḥ sadā
indriyāṇāṃ jayaṃ teṣu
kaḥ śaktānāṃ kariṣyati

ahaṃ mameti cākhyāti
durjayaṃ cañcalaṃ manaḥ
rāgādayaḥ kathaṃ jetuṃ
śakyā janmāntarair api

so 'ham icchāmi deveśa
tvatprasādād anirjitaiḥ
rāgādibhir amartyatvaṃ
prāptuṃ prakṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ

yady evaṃ muktikāmas tvaṃ
naranātha śṛṇuṣva tat
kriyāyogaṃ samastānāṃ
kleśānāṃ hānikārakam

manmanā bhava madbhakto
madyājī māṃ namaskuru
mām evaiṣyasi yuktvaivam
ātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ

madbhāvanā madyajanā
madbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ
mama pūjāparāś caiva
mayi yānti layaṃ narāḥ

sarvabhūteṣu māṃ paśya
samavasthitam īśvaram
kartāsi kena vairatvaṃ
evaṃ doṣān prahāsyasi

jaṅgamājaṅgame jñāte
mayy ātmani tathā tava
rāgalobhādināśena
bhavitrī kṛtakṛtyatā

bhaktyātipravaṇasyāpi
cañcalatvān mano yadi
mayy anāsādavad bhūpa
kuru madrūpiṇīṃ tanum

suvarṇarajatādyais tvaṃ
śailamṛddārulekhajām
pūjāmaharhair vividhaiḥ
saṃpūjaya ca pārthiva

tasyāṃ cittaṃ samāveśya
tyājayānyān vyapāśrayān
pūjitā saiva te bhaktyā
dhyātā caivopakāriṇī

gacchaṃs tiṣṭhan svapan bhuñjaṃs
tām evāgre ca pṛṣṭhataḥ
upary adhas tathā pārśve
cintayāntas tathātmanaḥ

snānais tīrthodakair hṛdyaiḥ
puṣpagandhānulepanaiḥ
vāsobhir bhūṣaṇair bhakṣyair
gītavādyair manoharaiḥ

yac ca yac ca nṛpeṣṭaṃ te
kiṃcid bhojyādi tena tām
bhaktinamro naraśreṣṭha
prīṇayārcāṃ kṛtāṃ mama

rāgeṇākṛṣyate ceto
gandharvābhimukhaṃ yadi
mayi buddhiṃ samāveśya
gāyethā mama tāṃ kathām

kathāyāṃ ramate ceto
yadi tatbhāvanā mama
śrotavyā prītiyuktena
avatāreṣu yā kathā

evaṃ mayy arpitamanāś
cetaso ye vyapāśrayāḥ
heyās tān akhilān bhūpa
parityakṣyasy abhīr bhava

akṣīṇarāgadoṣo 'pi
matkriyā paramaḥ param
padam āpsyasi mā bhais tvaṃ
mayy arpitamanā bhava

mayi saṃnyasya sarvaṃ tvam
ātmānaṃ yat tavāsti ca
madarthaṃ kuru karmāṇi
mā ca dharmavyatikramam

rājyaṃ kuru naraśreṣṭha
nivedya pṛthivīṃ mama
tadvyāghātaparā ye ca
jahi tān avanīpate

etenaivopadeśena
vyākhyātam akhilaṃ tava
kriyāyogaṃ samāsthāya
mayy arpitamanā bhava

maddhitāya jagannātha
kriyāyogāśritaṃ mama
vistareṇedam ākhyāhi
prasannas tvaṃ hi duḥkhahā

tvām ṛtena hi no vaktuṃ
samartho 'nyo jagadguro
guhyam etat pavitraṃ ca
tad ācakṣya prasīda me

ākhyāsyaty etad akhilaṃ
vasiṣṭhas te purohitaḥ
matprasādād avikalaṃ
sa ca vetsyaty aśeṣataḥ

ity uktvāntardadhe devaḥ
sarvalokeśvaro hariḥ
sa ca rājā vanād bhūyo
nijam abhyāgamat puram

rājyasthas tu mahīpālaḥ
praṇipatya purohitam
vasiṣṭhaṃ paripapraccha
viṣṇor ārādhanaṃ prati

devadevena bhagavann
ādiṣṭo 'si mahātmanā
kriyāyogāśritaṃ sarvaṃ
vyākhyāsyati bhavān kila

sa tvāṃ pṛcchāmy ahaṃ sarvaṃ
kriyāyogena keśavam
saṃtoṣayitum īśānaṃ
yathā śakṣyāmi tad vada

devaprasādād akhilā
mamāpi smṛtir āgatā
jñānam etad aśeṣaṃ te
kathayāmi nibodha tat

bhaktimān abhavad daityo
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ
nārāyaṇe mahāprajñaḥ
sarvalokaparāyaṇe
sa papraccha bhṛguśreṣṭhaṃ
śukram ātmapurohitam

bhagavan nṛsiṃharūpasya
viṣṇos tātaṃ jighāṃsataḥ
dṛṣṭaṃ dehe mayā sarvaṃ
trailokyaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam

brahmā prajāpatiś cendro
rudraiḥ paśupatiḥ saha
vasavo 'ṣṭau tathādityā
dvādaśāhaḥkṣapā mahī

diśo nabhas tārakaughaṃ
nakṣatragrahasaṃkulam
aśvinau marutaḥ sādhyā
viśvedevās tatha rṣayaḥ

varṣācalās tathā nadyaḥ
sapta sapta kulācalāḥ
samudrāḥ sapta ṛtavaḥ
kāntārāṇi vanāni ca
nagaragrāmatarubhiḥ
samāvetaṃ ca bhūtalam

etac cānyac ca yat kiṃcid
devarṣipitṛmānavam
satiryagūrdhvapātālaṃ
tasya dṛṣṭaṃ tanau mayā

so 'haṃ tam ajaraṃ devaṃ
duṣṭadaityanivarhaṇam
ārādhayitum icchāmi
bhagavaṃs tvadanujñayā

anugrāhyo 'smi yadi te
mamāyaṃ bhaktimān iti
tan mamopadiśādya tvaṃ
mahad ārādhanaṃ hareḥ

anugrāhyo 'si devasya
nūnam avyaktajanmanaḥ
ārādhanāya daityendra
yat te tatpravaṇaṃ manaḥ

yadi devapatiṃ viṣṇum
ārādhayitum icchasi
bhagavantam anādyantaṃ
bhava bhāgavato 'sura

na hy abhāgavatair viṣṇur
jñātuṃ stotuṃ ca tattvataḥ
draṣṭuṃ vā śakyate martyaiḥ
praveṣṭuṃ kuta eva hi

janmabhir bahubhiḥ pūtā
narās tadgatacetasaḥ
bhavanti vai bhāgavatās
te viṣṇuṃ praviśanti ca

anekajanmasaṃsāra-
cite pāpasamuccaye
nākṣīṇe jāyate puṃsāṃ
govindābhimukhī matiḥ

pradveṣaṃ yāti govinde
dvijān vedāṃś ca nindati
yo naras taṃ vijānīyād
asurāṃśasamudbhavam

pāṣaṇḍeṣu ratiḥ puṃsāṃ
hetuvādānukūlatā
jāyate viṣṇumāyāmbhaḥ-
patitānāṃ durātmanām

yadā pāpakṣayaḥ puṃsāṃ
tadā vedadvijātiṣu
viṣṇau ca yajñapuruṣe
śraddhā bhavati te yathā

yadā svalpāvaśeṣas tu
narāṇāṃ pāpasaṃcayaḥ
bhavanti te bhāgavatās
tadā daityapate narāḥ

bhrāmyatām atra saṃsāre
narāṇāṃ karmadurgame
hastāvalambado hy eko
bhaktiprīto janārdanaḥ

sa tvaṃ bhāgavato bhūtvā
sarvapāpaharaṃ harim
ārādhaya paraṃ bhaktyā
prītim eṣyati keśavaḥ

kiṃlakṣaṇā bhāgavatā
bhavanti puruṣā guro
yac ca bhāgavataiḥ kāryaṃ
tan me kathaya bhārgava

karmaṇā manasā vācā
prāṇināṃ yo na hiṃsakaḥ
bhāvabhaktaś ca govinde
daitya bhāgavato hi saḥ

yo brāhmaṇāṃś ca vedāṃś ca
nityam envānumaṃsyati
na ca drogdhā paraṃ vāde
daitya bhāgavato hi saḥ

sarvān devān hariṃ vetti
sarvalokāṃś ca keśavam
tebhyaś ca nānyam ātmānaṃ
daitya bhāgavato hi saḥ

devaṃ manuṣyam anyaṃ vā
paśupakṣipipīlikān
tarupāṣāṇakaṣṭhādi
bhūmyambhogaganaṃ diśaḥ

ātmānaṃ vāpi deveśān
nātiriktaṃ janārdanāt
yo bhajeta vijānīṣva
taṃ vai bhāgavataṃ naram

sarvaṃ bhagavato bhāvo
yad bhūtaṃ bhavasaṃsthitam
iti yo vai vijānāti
sa tu bhāgavato naraḥ

bhavabhītiṃ haraty eṣa
bhaktibhāvena bhāvitaḥ
bhagavān iti bhāvo yaḥ
sa tu bhāgavato naraḥ

bhāvaṃ na kurute yas tu
sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam
karmaṇā manasā vācā
sa tu bhāgavato naraḥ

bāhyārthanirapekṣo yo
bhakto bhagavataḥ kriyām
bhāvena niṣpādayati
jñeyo bhāgavatas tu saḥ

nārayo yasya na snigdhā
na codāsī na vṛttayaḥ
paśyataḥ sarvam evedaṃ
viṣṇuṃ bhāgavato hi saḥ

sutapteneha tapasā
yajñair vā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ
tāṃ gatiṃ na narā yānti
yāṃ vai bhāgavatā gatāḥ

yogacyutair bhāgavatair
devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ
arvāṅ nirīkṣyate yajñī
kimu ye yogapāragāḥ

yajñaniṣpattaye vedā
yajño yajñapateḥ kṛte
tattoṣaṇāya bhāvena
tasmād bhāgavato bhava

yena sarvātmanā viṣṇau
bhaktyā bhāvo niveśitaḥ
daityeśvara kṛtārthatvāc
ślāghyo bhāgavato hi saḥ

api naḥ sa kule dhanyo
jāyate kulapāvanaḥ
bhagavān bhaktibhāvena
yena viṣṇur upāsitaḥ

yaḥ kārayati devārcāṃ
hṛdayālambanaṃ hareḥ
sa naro viṣṇusālokyam
upaiti dhūtakalmaṣaḥ

yaś ca devālayaṃ bhaktyā
viṣṇoḥ kārayati svayam
sa saptapuruṣāṃl lokān
viṣṇor nayati mānavaḥ

yāvanty abdāni devārcā
hares tiṣṭhati mandire
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi
viṣṇuloke sa modate

devārcā lakṣaṇopetā
tadgṛhaṃ satataṃ divi
niṣkāmaṃ ca mano yasya
sa yāty akṣarasātmyatām

puṣpāṇy atisugandhīni
manojñāni ca yaḥ pumān
prayacchati hṛṣīkeśe
tadbhāvagatamānasaḥ

dhūpāṃś ca vividhāṃs tāṃs tān
gandhāḍhyaṃ cānulepanam
dīpāvalyupahārāṃś ca
yac cābhīṣṭam athātmanaḥ

naraḥ so 'nudinaṃ yajñaṃ
karoty ārādhanaṃ hareḥ
yajñeśo bhagavān viṣṇur
makhair api hi toṣyate

bahūpakaraṇā yajñā
nānāsaṃbhāravistarāḥ
prāpyante te dhanayutair
manuṣyair nālpasaṃcayaiḥ

bhaktyā ca puruṣaiḥ pūjā
kṛtā dūrvāṅkurair api
harer dadāti hi phalaṃ
sarvayajñaiḥ sudurlabham

yāni puṣpāṇi hṛdyāni
dhūpagandhānulepanam
dayitaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ yac ca
ye ca kauśeyavāsasī

yāni cābhyavahārāṇi
bhakṣyāṇi ca phalāni ca
prayaccha tāni govinde
bhavethāś caiva tanmanāḥ

ādyantaṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ
yathāśaktyā prasādaya
ārādhya yāti taṃ devaṃ
tasminn eva naro layam

puṇyais tīrthodakair gandhair
madhunā sarpiṣā tathā
kṣīreṇa snāpayed īśam
acyutaṃ jagataḥ patim

dadhikṣīrahradān puṇyāṃs
tato lokān madhucyutaḥ
prayāsyasy asuraśreṣṭha
nirvṛtiṃ cāpi śāśvatīm

stotrair gītais tathā vādyair
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ
manasaś caikatāyogād
ārādhaya janārdanam

ārādhya taṃ videhānāṃ
puruṣāḥ saptasaptatiḥ
haihayāḥ pañcapañcāśad
amṛtatvam upāgatāḥ

sa tvam ebhiḥ prakārais tam
upavāsaiś ca keśavam
toṣayādyo hi tuṣṭo 'sau
viṣṇur dvandvapraśāntidaḥ

upavāsair hṛṣīkeśaḥ
kathaṃ tuṣyati bhārgava
parihārāṃs tathācakṣva
ye tyājyāś copavāsinām

yad yat kāryaṃ yathā caiva
keśavārādhane naraiḥ
tat sarvaṃ vistarād brahman
yathāvad vaktum arhasi

smṛtaḥ saṃpūjito dhūpa-
puṣpādyair dayitair hariḥ
bhoginām upakārāya
kiṃ punaś copavāsinām

upāvṛttas tu pāpebhyo
yas tu vāso guṇaiḥ saha
upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ
sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ

ekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ vā
trirātram athavāparam
upavāsī hariṃ yas tu
bhaktyā dhyāyati mānavaḥ

tannāmajāpī tatkarma-
ratis tadgatamānasaḥ
niṣkāmo daitya sa brahma
param āpnoty asaṃśayam

yaṃ ca kāmam abhidhyāyan
keśavārpitamānasaḥ
upoṣyati tam āpnoti
prasanne garuḍadhvaje

kathyate ca purā vipraḥ
pulastyo brahmavādinā
dālbhyena pṛṣṭo 'kathayad
yathaitad arisūdana

brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ
śūdraiḥ strībhis tathā mune
saṃsāragartapaṅkasthaiḥ
sugatiḥ prāpyate katham

anārādhya jagannāthaṃ
sarvadhātāram acyutam
nirvyalīkena cittena
kaḥ prayāsyati sadgatim

viṣayagrāhi vai yasya
na cittaṃ keśavārpitam
sa kathaṃ pāpapaṅkāṅkī
naro yāsyati sadgatim

yadi saṃsāraduḥkhārtaḥ
sugatiṃ gantum icchasi
tadārādhaya sarveśaṃ
jagaddhātāram acyutam

puṣpaiḥ sugandhair hṛdyaiś ca
dhūpaiḥ sāgarucandanaiḥ
vāsobhir bhūṣaṇair bhakṣyair
upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ

yadi saṃsāranirvedād
abhivāñchasi sadgatim
tadārādhaya govindaṃ
yac ceṣṭaṃ tava cetasi

puṣpāṇi yadi te na syuḥ
śastaṃ pādapapallavaiḥ
dūrvāṅkurair api brahmaṃs
tadabhāve 'rcayācyutam

sugandhipuṣpadīpādyair
yaḥ kuryāt keśavālaye
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tasya
saṃbhavet keśavārcayā
sabāhyābhyantaraṃ yas tu
mārjayed acyutālayam
sabāhyābhyantaraṃ tasya
kāyo niṣkalmaṣo bhavet

puṣpapatrāmbubhir dhūpair
yathāvibhavam acyutaḥ
pūjitas tuṣṭim atulāṃ
bhaktyāyāty ekacetasām

yaḥ sadāyatane viṣṇoḥ
kurute mārjanakriyām
sa pāṃsubhūmer dehāc ca
sarvapāpaṃ vyapohati

yāvantyaḥ pāṃsukaṇikā
mārjyante keśavālaye
dināni divi tāvanti
tiṣṭhaty astamalo naraḥ

ahany ahani yat pāpaṃ
kurute dvijasattama
gocarmamātraṃ saṃmārjya
hanti tat keśavālaye

yaś copalepanaṃ kuryād
viṣṇor āyatane naraḥ
so 'pi lokaṃ samāsādya
modate ca śatakratoḥ

mṛdā dhātuvikārair vā
varṇakair gomayena vā
upalepanakṛd yāti
vimānaṃ maṇicitritam

udakābhyukṣaṇaṃ viṣṇor
yaḥ karoti tathā gṛhe
so 'pi gacchati yatrāste
bhagavān yādasāṃ patiḥ

puṣpaprakaram atyarthaṃ
sugandhaṃ keśavālaye
upalipte naro dattvā
na durgatim avāpnuyāt

vimānam atividyoti
sarvaratnamayaṃ divi
samāpnoti naro dattvā
dīpakaṃ keśavālaye

yas tu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ
tilapātraprado naraḥ
dhvajaṃ tu viṣṇave dadyāt
samam etat phalaṃ dvija

vidhunvan hanti vātena
dātur ajñānataḥ kṛtam
pāpaṃ ketur gṛhe viṣṇor
divārātram asaṃśayam

gītavādyādibhir devaṃ
ya upāste janārdanam
gāndharvair gītanṛtyaiḥ sa
vimānastho niṣevyate

jātismaratvaṃ medhāṃ ca
tathaivoparame smṛtim
prāpnoti viṣṇvāyatane
puṇyākhyānakathākaraḥ

upoṣitaḥ pūjito vā
dṛṣṭo vā namito 'pi vā
pradambha harate (?) pāpaṃ
ko na seved dhariṃ tataḥ
vedavādakriyāyajña-
snānatīrthaphalaṃ param
aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena
praṇipatya hariṃ labhet
pragamya hṛdā śirasā
pādapadme mahītale
niṣkalmaṣo bhavet sadyo
na nāṭī pādapāṃsunā
ekasya kṛṣṇasya krājataḥ praṇāmo
daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthena tulyaḥ
daśāśvamedhaiḥ punar eti janma
kṛṣṇapraṇāmī na punarbhavāya

evaṃ deveśvaro bhaktyā
yena viṣṇur upāsitaḥ
sa prāpnoti gatiṃ ślāghyāṃ
yāṃ yām icchati cetasā

devatvaṃ manujaiḥ kaiścid
gandharvatvaṃ tathāparaiḥ
vidyādharatvam aparair
ārādhyāptaṃ janārdanam

śakraḥ kratuśateneśam
ārādhya garuḍadhvajam
devendratvaṃ gatas tasmān
nānyaḥ pūjyatamaḥ kvacit

devebhyo 'pi hi pūjyas tu
svagurur brahmacāriṇaḥ
tasyāpi yajñapuruṣo
viṣṇuḥ pūjyo dvijottama

striyaś ca bhartāram ṛte
pūjyam anyan na daivatam
bhartur gṛhasthasya sataḥ
pūjyo yajñapatir hariḥ

vaikhānasānām ārādhyas
tapobhir madhusūdanaḥ
dhyeyaḥ parivrājakānāṃ
vāsudevo mahātmanām

evaṃ sarvāśramāṇāṃ hi
vāsudevaḥ parāyaṇam
sarveṣāṃ caiva varṇānāṃ
tam ārādhyāpnuyād gatim

śṛṇuṣva gadataḥ kāmyām
upavāsāṃs tathāparān
tat tam āśritya yān kāmān
kurvītepsitam ātmanaḥ

ekādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe
phālgune māsi yo naraḥ
japet kṛṣṇeti devasya
nāma bhaktyā punaḥpunaḥ

devārcane cāṣṭaśataṃ
kṛtvaitat tu japec chuciḥ
prātaḥ prasthānakāle ca
utthāne skhalite kṣute

pāṣaṇḍapatitāṃś caiva
tathaivāntyāvasāyinaḥ
nālapeta tathā kṛṣṇam
arcayec chraddhayānvitaḥ
idaṃ codāharet kṛṣṇe
manaḥ saṃdhāya tatparaḥ

kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛpālus tvam
agatīnāṃ gatir bhava
saṃsārāntarnimagnānāṃ
prasīda madhusūdana

evaṃ prasādyopāvāsaṃ
kṛtvā niyatamānasaḥ
pūrvāhna eva cānyedyur
gavyaṃ saṃprāsya vai sakṛt
snāto 'rcayitvā kṛṣṇeti
punar nāma prakīrtayet

vāridhārātrayaṃ caiva
vikṣiped devapādayoḥ
caitravaiśākhayoś caiva
tadvaj jyeṣṭhe tu pūjayet

martyaloke gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ
dālbhya prāpnoti vai naraḥ
utkrāntikāle kṛṣṇasya
smaraṇaṃ ca tathāpnute

āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe caiva
māse bhādrapade tathā
tathaivāśvayuje devam
anena vidhinā naraḥ

upoṣya saṃpūjya tathā
keśaveti ca kīrtayet
gomūtraprāśanāt pūrvaṃ
svargalokagatiṃ vrajet

ārādhitasya jagatām
īśvarasyāvyāyātmanaḥ
utkrāntikāle smaraṇaṃ
keśavasya tathāpnuyāt

kṣīrasya prāśanaṃ yas tu
vidhiṃ cemaṃ yathoditam
kārttikādi yathānyāyaṃ
kuryān māsacatuṣṭayam

tenaiva vidhinā brahman
viṣṇor nāma prakīrtayet
sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ
viṣṇuṃ smarati ca kṣaye

pratimāsaṃ dvijātibhyo
dadyād dānaṃ yathecchayā
cāturmāsye ca saṃpūrṇe
puṇyaṃ śravaṇakīrtanam

kathāṃ vā vāsudevasya
tadgītīr vāpi kārayet
evam etāṃ gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ
devanāmānukīrtanāt

kathitaṃ pāraṇaṃ yat te

ādhipatyaṃ tathā bhogāṃs
tena prāpnoti mānuṣān

dvitīyena tathā bhogān
aindrān prāpnoti mānavaḥ
viṣṇor lokaṃ tṛtīyena
pāraṇena tathāpnuyāt

evam etat samākhyātaṃ
gatiprāpakam uttamam

kṛṣṇatuṣṭipradaṃ nṛṇām

sugatidvādaśīm etāṃ

prāpnoti trividhāṃ gatim

tiṣṭhan vrajan praskhalite
kṣute vāpi janārdanam
kīrtayet tatkriyākāle
saptakṛtvaḥ prakīrtayet

tailakṣāravivarjitam

tathaiva caitravaiśākha-
jyeṣṭheṣu munisattama
arcayīta yathāproktaṃ
prāpte prāpte tu taddine

dvitīyaṃ cāpi vakṣyāmi
pāraṇaṃ dvijasattama

āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi
prāpte bhādrapade tathā
tathaivāśvayuje 'bhyarcya
śrīdharaṃ ca śriyā saha

samyak candramase dattvā
bhuñjītārghyaṃ yathāvidhi
dvitīyam etad ākhyātaṃ
tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ śṛṇu

kārttikādiṣu māseṣu
tathaivābhyarcya keśavam
bhūtyā samanvitaṃ dadyāc
śaśāṅkāyārhanaṃ niśi

bhuñjīta ca tathā proktaṃ
tṛtīyam iti pāraṇam
pratipūjāsu dadyāc ca
brāhmaṇebhyaś ca dakṣiṇām

pratimāsaṃ ca vakṣyāmi
prāśanaṃ kāyaśodhanam
caturaḥ prathamān māsān
pañcagavyam udāhṛtam

kuśodakaṃ tathaivānyad
uktaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam
sūryāṃśutaptaṃ tadvac ca
jalaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam

gītavādyādikaṃ pāṭhyaṃ
tathā kṛṣṇasya vā kathān
kāriyīta ca devasya
pāraṇe pāraṇe gate

evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat
sapatnīkaṃ janārdanam
nāpnotīṣtaviyogādīn
pumān yoṣid athāpi vā

janārdanaṃ salakṣmīkam
arcayet prathamaṃ tataḥ
saśrīkaṃ śrīdharaṃ bhaktyā
tṛtīye bhūtikeśavau

yāvanty etadvidhānena
pāraṇenārcati prabhum
tāvanti janmāny asukhaṃ
nāpnotīṣṭaviyogajam

devasya ca prasādena
maraṇe prāpya tatsmṛtim

kule satāṃ sphītadhane
bhogabhuj jāyate naraḥ

nāriṃ prāpnoti na vyādhiṃ
narakaṃ ca na paśyati
durgamaṃ yamamārgaṃ ca
nekṣate dvijasattama

śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ tāta
yamamārgaṃ sudurgamam
yathā sukhena saṃyānti
mānavās tad vadasva me

pratimāsaṃ tu nāmāni
kṛṣṇasyaitāni dvādaśa
kṛtopavāsaḥ susnātaḥ
pūjayitvā janārdanam
uccārayan naro 'bhyeti
susukhenaiva tatpatham

tato viprāya vai dadyād
udakumbhaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ
upānadvastrayugmaṃ ca
chattraṃ kanakam eva ca

yad vai māsagataṃ nāma
tatprītiś cāpi saṃvadet
saṃvatsarānte 'py athavā
pratimāsaṃ dvijān budhaḥ
vācayed udakumbhādyair
dānaiḥ sarvān anukramāt

keśavaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu
pauṣe nārāyaṇaṃ tathā
mādhavaṃ māghamāse tu
govindaṃ phālgune tathā

viṣṇuṃ caitre 'tha vaiśākhe
tathaiva madhusūdanam
jyeṣṭhe trivikramaṃ devam
āṣāḍhe vāmanaṃ tathā

śrāvaṇe śrīdharaṃ caiva
hṛṣīkeśeti cāparam
nāma bhādrapade māsi
gīyate puṇyakāṅkṣibhiḥ

padmanābhaṃ cāśvayuje
dāmodaram ataḥ param
kārttike devadeveśaṃ
stuvaṃs tarati durgatim

iha vai svasthatāṃ prāpya
maraṇe smaraṇaṃ tataḥ
yāmyakleśam asaṃprāpya
svargaloke mahīyate

tato mānuṣyam āsādya
nirātaṅko gatajvaraḥ
dhanadhānyavati sphīte
janma sādhukule 'rhati

upavāsavratānīha
keśavārādhanaṃ prati
mamācakṣva mahābhāga
paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me

kāmān yān yān naro bhakto
manasecchati keśavāt
vratopavāsanāt prītas
tāṃs tān viṣṇuḥ prayacchati

ratnaparvatam āruhya
yathā ratnaṃ mahāmune
sattvānurūpam adatte
tathā kṛtsnān manorathān

mārgaśīrṣaṃ tu yo māsam
ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet
kurvan vai viṣṇuśuśrūṣāṃ
sa deśe jāyate śubhe

pauṣamāsaṃ tathā dālbhya
ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet
śuśrūṣaṇaparaḥ śaurer
na rogī sa ca jāyate

māghamāsaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha
ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet
viṣṇuśuśrūṣaṇaparaḥ
sa kule jāyate satām

kṣapayed ekabhaktena
śuśrūṣur yaś ca phālgunam
saubhāgyaṃ svajanānāṃ sa
sarveṣām eti sonnatim

caitraṃ viṣṇuparo māsam
ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet
suvarṇamaṇimuktāḍhyaṃ
sa gārhasthyam avāpnuyāt

yaḥ kṣaped ekabhaktena
vaiśākhaṃ pūjayan harim
naro vā yadi vā nārī
jñātīnāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ vrajet

kṛṣṇārpitamanā jyeṣṭham
ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet
aiśvaryam atulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ
pumān strī vābhijāyate

āṣāḍham ekabhaktena
yo nayed viṣṇutanmanāḥ
bahudhānyo bahudhano
bahuputraś ca jāyate

kṣapayed ekabhaktena
śrāvaṇaṃ viṣṇutatparaḥ
dhanadhānyahiraṇyāḍhye
kule sa jñātivardhanaḥ

ekāhāro bhādrapadaṃ
yaś ca kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ
dhanāḍhyaṃ sphītam acalam
aiśvaryaṃ pratipadyate

nayaṃś cāśvayujaṃ viṣṇuṃ
pūjayed ekabhojanaḥ
dhanavān vāhanāḍhyaś ca
bahuputraś ca jāyate

kārttike caikadā bhuṅkte
yaś ca viṣṇuparo naraḥ
śūraś ca kṛtavidyaś ca
bahuputraś ca jāyate

yas tu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇam
ekabhakto bhaven naraḥ
ahiṃsaḥ sarvabhūteṣu
vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ

namo 'stu vāsudevāyety
ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet
atirātrasya yajñasya
tataḥ phalam avāpnuyāt

daśa varṣasahasrāṇi
svargaloke mahīyate
tatkṣayād iha cāgatya
māhātmyaṃ pratipadyate

brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ
strī śūdro vā yathoditān
upavāsān imān kurvan
phalāny etāny avāpnuyāt

jagatpatiṃ jagadyoniṃ
jaganniṣṭhaṃ jagadgurum
jayaṃ śaraṇam abhyetya
na janaiḥ śocyate janaḥ

yasya nāmni smṛte martyaḥ
samutkrānter anantaram
prāpnoti śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ
tataḥ pūjyataro hi saḥ

nādir na madhyaṃ naivānto
yasya devasya vidyate
anāditvād amadhyatvād
anantatvāc ca so 'vyayaḥ

parāparaṃ sukṛtavatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ
svayaṃbhuvaṃ prabhavan nidhānam avyayam
sanātanaṃ yad amṛtam acyutaṃ dhruvaṃ
praviśya taṃ harim amaratvam aśnute

śṛṇu dālbhya paraṃ kāmyaṃ
vrataṃ saṃtatidaṃ nṛṇām
yam upoṣya na vicchedaḥ
pitṛpiṇḍasya jāyate

kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caitramāse
snāto niyatamānasaḥ
kṛṣṇam abhyarcya pūjāṃ ca
devakyāḥ kurute tu yaḥ

nirāhāro japan nāma
kṛṣṇasya jagataḥ pateḥ
upaviṣṭo japasnāna-
kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu

pūjāyāṃ cāpi kṛṣṇasya
sapta vārān prakīrtayet
pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthān
nālapec caiva nāstikān

prabhāte tu punaḥ snāto
dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām
bhuñjīta kṛtapūjas tu
kṛṣṇasyaiva jagatpateḥ

vaiśākhajyeṣṭhayoś caiva
pāraṇaṃ hi trimāsikam
upoṣya devadeveśaṃ
ghṛtena snāpayed dharim

āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe caiva
māse bhādrapade tathā
upoṣite dvitīyaṃ vai
pāraṇaṃ pūrvavat tu tat

tathaivāśvayujaṃ cādiṃ
kṛtvā māsatrayaṃ budhaḥ
upoṣya snāpayed devaṃ
haviṣā pāraṇe gate

pauṣe māghe phālgune ca
naras tadvad upoṣitaḥ
caturthe pāraṇe pūrṇe
ghṛtena snāpayed dharim

evaṃ kṛtopavāsasya
puruṣasya tathā striyaḥ
na saṃtateḥ paricchedaḥ
kadācid abhijāyate

kṛṣṇāṣṭamīm imāṃ yas tu
naro yoṣid athāpi vā
upoṣyatīha sāhlādaṃ
nṛloke prāpya nirvṛttim

putrapautrasamṛddhiṃ ca
mṛtaḥ svarge mahīyate
ity etat kathitaṃ dālbhya
mayā kṛṣṇāṣṭaṃīvratam

prāvṛṭkāle tu niyamāñ
śṛṇu kāmyān imān mama

prāvṛṭkāle yadā śete
vāsudevaḥ payonidhau
bhogibhoge nijāṃ māyāṃ
yoganidrāṃ ca mānayan

viśiṣṭā na pravartante
tadā yajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ
devānāṃ sā bhaved rātrir
dakṣiṇāyanasaṃjñitā

yadā svapiti govindo
yas tu māsaṃ catuṣṭayam
adhaḥśāyī brahmacārī
keśavārpitamānasaḥ

namo namo 'stu kṛṣṇāya
keśavāya namo namaḥ
namo 'stu narasiṃhāya
viṣṇave ca namo namaḥ

iti prātas tathā sāyaṃ
japed devakriyāparaḥ
śamayaty atiduṣpāraṃ
duritaṃ janmasaṃcitam

madhu māṃsaṃ ca yo māsāñ
caturas tān nirasyati
devakriyāratir viṣṇor
anusmaraṇatatparaḥ

so 'pi svargaṃ samabhyeti
cyutas tasmāt tu jāyate
arogī dhanadhānyāḍhyaḥ
kulasaṃtatimān naraḥ

samastamandirāṇāṃ ca
yaḥ supte madhusūdane
nirvṛttiṃ kurute so 'pi
devo vaimāniko bhavet

anenaiva vidhānena
naro viṣṇukriyāparaḥ
ekāhāro bhaved yas tu
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

supte ca sarvalokeśe
naktabhojī bhavet tu yaḥ
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ
svargaloke 'maro bhavet

śastaṃ tv anantaraṃ puṃsāṃ
tataś caivekabhojanam
naktabhojanatulyaṃ tu
nopavāsaphalaṃ kvacit

tailābhaṅgaṃ ca yo māsāṃś
caturas tān nirasyati
so 'py aṅgalāvaṇyaguṇam
ārogyaṃ ca naro labhet

yas tv etāni samastāni
māsān etān naraś caret
sa viṣṇulokam āsādya
viṣṇor anucaro bhavet

caturbhiḥ pāraṇaṃ māsair
niṣpādyaṃ haritatparaiḥ
brāhmaṇān bhojayed dadyāt
tatas tebhyaś ca dakṣiṇām

pūjayec ca jagannāthaṃ
sarvapāpaharaṃ harim
prīyasva deva govindety
evaṃ caiva prasādayet

iti dālbhya samākhyātaṃ
cāturmāsye hi yad vratam
devadevasya suptasya
dvādaśīṃ śṛṇu cāparām
yasyām anantasmaraṇād
anantaphalabhāg bhavet

māsi proṣṭhapade śukle
dvādaśyāṃ jalaśāyinam
praṇamyānantam abhyarcya
puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ śuciḥ

pāṣaṇḍādibhir ālāpam
akurvan niyatātmavān
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā
naktaṃ bhuṅkte tu yo naraḥ

tiṣṭhan vrajan svapaṃś caiva
kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu
anantanāmasmaraṇaṃ
kurvann uccāraṇaṃ tathā

anenaiva vidhānena
māsān dvādaśa vai kramāt
upoṣya pāraṇe pūrṇe
samabhyarcya jagadgurum
gītavādyena hṛdyena
prīṇayan vyuṣṭim aśnute

anantaṃ gītavādyena
yataḥ phalam udāhṛtam
tenānantaṃ samabhyarcya
tad eva labhate phalam

evaṃ yaḥ puruṣaḥ kuryād
anantārādhanaṃ śuciḥ
nārī vā svargam abhyetya
so 'anantaphalam aśnute

evaṃ dālbhya hṛṣīkeśo
narair bhaktyā yathāvidhi
phalaṃ dadāty asulabhaṃ
salilenāpi pūjitaḥ

na viṣṇur vittadānena
puṣpair vā na phalais tathā
ārādhyate suśuddhena
hṛdayenaiva kevalam

rāgādyapetaṃ hṛdayaṃ
vāg duṣṭā nānṛtādinā
hiṃsādirahitaḥ kāyaḥ
keśavārādhanatrayam

rāgādidūṣite citte
nāspadī madhusūdanaḥ
karoti na ratiṃ haṃsaḥ
kadācit kardamāmbhasi

na yogyā keśavastutyai
vāg duṣṭā cānṛtādinā
tamaso nāśanāyālaṃ
nendor lekhā ghanāvṛtā

hiṃsādidūṣitaḥ kāyaḥ
keśavārādhane kutaḥ
janacittaprasādāya
na nabhas timirāvṛtam

tasmāc chraddhasva bhāvena
satyabhāvena ca dvija
ahiṃsakena govindo
nisargād eva toṣitaḥ

sarvasvam api kṛṣṇāya
yo dadyāt kuṭilāśayaḥ
sa naivārādhayaty enaṃ
sadbhāvenārcayācyutam

rāgādyapetaṃ hṛdayaṃ
kuru tvaṃ keśavārpitam
tataḥ prāpsyasi duḥprāpyam
ayatnenaiva keśavam

bhagavan kathitaḥ samyak
kāmyo 'yaṃ keśavaṃ prati
ārādhanavidhiḥ sarvo
bhūyaḥ pṛcchāmi tad vada

kule janma tathārogyaṃ
dhanarddhiś ceha durlabhā
tritayaṃ prāpyate yena
tan me vada mahāmune

mātāmahaṃ kāṇvam udāravīryaṃ
maharṣim abhyarcya kulaprasūtim
papraccha puṃsām atha yoṣitāṃ ca
duṣvantaputro bharataḥ praṇamya

yathāvad ācaṣṭa tato mahātmā
sa rājavaryāya yathā kuleṣu
prayānti sūtiṃ puruṣāḥ striyaś ca
yathā ca samyak sukhino bhavanti

pauṣe site dvādaśame 'hni sārke
tathārkṣayoge jagataḥ prasūtim
saṃpūjya viṣṇuṃ vidhinopavāsī
sraggandhadhūpānnavaropahāraiḥ

gṛhṇīta māsaṃ pratimāsapūjām
dānādiyuktaṃ vratam abdam ekam
dadyāc ca dānaṃ dvijapuṅgavebhyas
tad ucyamānaṃ vinibodha bhūpa

ghṛtaṃ tilān vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ
yavānnam ambhaḥkarakānnapānam
chattraṃ payo 'nnaṃ guḍaphāṇitāḍhyaṃ
srakcandanaṃ vastram anukrameṇa

māse ca māse vidhinoditena
tasyāṃ tithau lokaguruṃ prapūjya
aśnīta yāny ātmaviśuddhihetoḥ
saṃprāśanānīha nibodha tāni

gomūtram ambho ghṛtam āmaśākaṃ
dūrvā dadhi vrīhiyavāṃs tilāṃś ca
sūryāṃśutaptaṃ jalam ambu dārbhaṃ
kṣīraṃ ca māsakramaśopayuñjyāt

kule pradhāne dhanadhānyapūrṇe
vivekavaty astasamastaduḥkhe
prāpnoti janmāvikalendriyaś ca
bhavaty arogo matimān sukhī ca

tasmāt tvam apy etad amoghavid yo
nārāyaṇārādhanam apramattaḥ
kuruṣva viṣṇuṃ bhagavantam īśam
ārādhya kāmān akhilān upaiti

yadā ca śukladvādaśyāṃ
nakṣatraṃ śravaṇaṃ bhavet
tadā sā tu mahāpuṇyā
dvādaśī vijayā smṛtā

tasyāṃ snātaḥ sarvatīrthaiḥ
snāto bhavati mānavaḥ
saṃpūjya varṣapūjāyāḥ
sakalaṃ phalam aśnute

ekaṃ japtvā sahasrasya
japtasyāpnoti yat phalam
dānaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ
tathā vai vipra bhojanam

yat kṣemam api vai tasyāṃ
sahasraṃ śrāvaṇe tu tat
anyasyām eva tithyāṃ
śubhāyāṃ śrāvaṇaṃ yadā

rohiṇyāś ca yadā kṛṣṇa-
pakṣe 'ṣṭamyāṃ dvijottama
jayantī nāma sā proktā
sarvapāpaharā tithiḥ

yad bālye yac ca kaumāre
yauvane vārddhike ca yat
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ
svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu

tat kṣālayati govindaṃ
tasyām abhyarcya bhaktitaḥ
homajapyādidānānāṃ
phalaṃ ca śatasaṃmitam

saṃprāpnoti na saṃdeho
yac cānyan manasecchati
upavāsaś ca tatrokto
mahāpātakanāśanaḥ

ekadaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe
yadā rkṣaṃ vai punarvasuḥ
nāmnā sātijayākhyātā
tithīnām uttamā tithiḥ

yo dadāti tilaprasthaṃ
tṛṣkālaṃ vatsaraṃ naraḥ
upavāsaṃ ca tasyāṃ yaḥ
karoty etat samaṃ smṛtam

tasyāṃ jagatpatir devaḥ
sarvaḥ sarveśvaro hariḥ
pratyakṣatāṃ prayāty alpaṃ
tadānantaphalaṃ smṛtam

sagareṇa kakutsthena
duṃdhumāreṇa gādhinā
tasyām ārādhitaḥ kṛṣṇo
dattavān nikhilāṃ bhuvam

ayane cottare prāpte
yaḥ snāpayati keśavam
ghṛtaprasthena pāpaṃ saḥ
sakalaṃ vai vyapohati

kapilāṃ vipramukhyāya
dadāty anudinaṃ hi yaḥ
ghṛtasnānaṃ ca devasya
tasmin kāle samaṃ hi tat

maitreyī brāhmaṇī pūrvaṃ
yājñavalkyam apṛcchata
praṇipatya mahābhāgaṃ
yogeśvaram akalmaṣam

pāpapraśamanāyālaṃ
yat puṇyasyopavṛṃhakam
manorathapradaṃ yac ca
tad vrataṃ kathyatāṃ mama

kāni dānāni śastāni
snānāni ca yatavrata
praśastās tithayaḥ kāś ca
prāśanāni ca śaṃsa me

sarvadānāni śastāni
yāny uddiśya janārdanam
dīyante vipramukhyebhyaḥ
śraddhāpūtena cetasā

tā eva tithayaḥ śastā
yāsv abhyarcya janārdanam
kriyante śradhayā samyag
upavāsavratāḥ sadā

prāpyate vividhair yajñair
yat phalaṃ sādhvasādhubhiḥ
upavāsais tad āpnoti
samabhyarcya janārdanam

manorathānāṃ saṃprāpti-
kārakaṃ pāpanāśanam
śrūyatāṃ mama dharmajñe
vratānām uttamaṃ vratam

yat kṛtvā na jaḍo nāndho
badhiro na ca duḥkhitaḥ
na caiveṣṭaviyogārtiṃ
kaścit prāpnoti mānavaḥ

na cāpriyo 'sya lokasya
na daridro na durgatiḥ
sapta janmāni bhavati
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

viṣṇuvratam idaṃ khyātaṃ
bhāṣitaṃ viṣṇunā svayam

pauṣaśukladvitīyādi
kṛtvā dinacatuṣṭayam
ṣaṇmāsapāraṇaprāyaṃ
gṛhṇīyāt paramaṃ vratam

pūrvaṃ siddhārthakaiḥ snānaṃ
tataḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ smṛtam
vacayā ca tṛtīye 'hni
sarvauṣadhyā tataḥ param

nāmnā kṛṣṇācyutākhyena
tathānantena pūjayet
tathaiva ca caturthe 'hni
hṛṣīkeśena keśavam
devam abhyarcya puṣpaiś ca
pattrair dhūpānulepanaiḥ

udgacchataś ca bālendor
dadyād arghyaṃ samāhitaḥ
puṣpaiḥ pattraiḥ phalaiś caiva
sarvadhānyaiś ca bhaktitaḥ

dinakrameṇa caitāni
candranāmāni kīrtayet
śaśicandraśaśāṅkendu-
saṃjñāni brahmavādini

naktaṃ bhuñjīta matimān
yāvat tiṣṭhati candramāḥ
astaṃgate na bhuñjīta
vratabhaṅgabhayāc chubhe

evaṃ sarveṣu māseṣu
jyeṣṭhānteṣu yaśasvini
kartavyaṃ vai vrataśreṣṭhaṃ
dvitīyādicaturdinam

viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt
pañcamyāṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ
evaṃ samāpayen māsaiḥ
ṣaḍbhiḥ prathamapāraṇam

pāraṇante ca devasya
prīṇanaṃ bhaktitaḥ śubhe
yathāśaktyā tu kartavyaṃ
vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet

āṣāḍhādidvitīyaṃ tu
ṣaṇmāsena tapodhane
pāraṇaṃ vai samākhyātaṃ
vratasyāsya śubhapradam

vratam etad dilīpena
duṣvantena yayātinā
tathānyaiḥ pṛthivīpālair
upavāsavidhānataḥ
caritaṃ munimukhyaiś ca
ṛcīkacyavanādibhiḥ

surambhayā sukaikeyyā
śāṇḍilyā dhūmrapiṅgayā
sudeṣṇayāthavā riṇyā
matimatyā kṛtāśayā

sāvitryā paurṇamāsyā ca
vairiṇyā ca subhadrayā
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśām
iti strībhir anuṣṭhitam

urvaśyā rambhayā caiva
saurabheyyā tathā vratam
varāpsarobhir dharmajñe
caritaṃ dharmavāṃchayā

prathame pādapūjā syād
dvitīye nābhipūjanam
tṛtīye vakṣasaḥ pūjā
caturthe śiraso hareḥ

etac cīrtvā samastebhyaḥ
pāpebhyaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ
mucyate sakalāṃś caiva
saṃprāpnoti manorathān

vratānām uttamaṃ hy etat
svayaṃ devena bhāṣitam
pāpapraśamanaṃ śastaṃ
manorathaphalapradam

yaṃ ca kāmam abhidhyāyan
kriyate niyatavrataiḥ
vratam etan mahābhāge
taṃ tu pūrayate nṛṇām

manorathān pūrayati
sarvapāpaṃ vyapohati
avyāhatendriyatvaṃ ca
sapta janmāni yacchati

māghe snātasya yat puṇyaṃ
prayāge pāpanāśanam
sakalaṃ tad avāpnoti
śrutvā viṣṇuvrataṃ tv idam

śuklapakṣe tu pauṣasya
saṃprāptidvādaśīṃ śṛṇu
yām upoṣya samāpnoti
sarvān eva manorathān

pāṣaṇḍādibhir ālāpam
akurvan viṣṇutatparaḥ
pūjayet praṇato devam
ekāgramatir acyutam

pauṣādipāraṇaṃ māsaiḥ
ṣaḍbhir jyeṣṭhāntakaṃ smṛtam
prathame puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ
nāma devasya gīyate

dvitīye mādhavākhyaṃ tu
viśvarūpaṃ tu phālgune
puruṣottamākhyaṃ ca tataḥ
pañcame cācyuteti ca

ṣaṣṭhe jayeti devasya
guhyaṃ nāma prakīrtyate
pūrveṣu ṣaṭsu māseṣu
snānaprāśanayos tilāḥ

āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu
pañcagavyam udāhṛtam
snāne ca prāśane caiva
praśastaṃ pāpanāśanam

pratimāsaṃ ca devasya
kṛtvā pūjāṃ yathāvidhi
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāc
śraddadhānaḥ svaśaktitaḥ

pāraṇānte ca devasya
prīṇanaṃ bhaktipūrvakam
kruvīta śaktyā govinde
sadbhāvābhyarcano yataḥ

naktaṃ bhuñjīta ca tatas
tailakṣāravivarjitaṃ
ekādaśyām uṣitvaivaṃ
dvādaśyām athavā dine

etām uṣitvā dharmajñe
prīṇanaṃ devatatparaḥ
sarvakāmān avāpnoti
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

yataḥ sarvam avāpnoti
yad yad icchati cetasā
tato lokeṣu vikhyātā
saṃprāptidvādaśīti vai

kṛtābhilaṣitā hy eṣā
prārabdhā dharmatatparaiḥ
pūrayaty akhilān kāmān
saṃśrutā ca dine dine

tasminn eva dine puṇye
govindadvādaśīṃ śṛṇu
yasyāṃ samyag anuṣṭhānāt
prāpnoty abhimataṃ phalam

pauṣamāse site pakṣe
dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ
saṃyak saṃpūjya govindaṃ
nāmnā devam adhokṣajam
puṣpadhūpopahārādyair
upavāsaiḥ samāhitaḥ

govindeti japan nāma
punas tadgatamānasaḥ
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād
yathāśakti tapodhane

svapan vibuddhaḥ skhalito
govindeti ca kīrtayet
pāṣaṇḍādivikarmasthair
ālāpaṃ ca vivarjayet

gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ vāpi
dadhi kṣīram athāpi vā
godehataḥ samutpannaṃ
saṃprāśnītātmaśuddhaye

dvitīye 'hni punaḥ snātas
tathaivābhyarcya taṃ prabhum
tenaiva nāmnā saṃstūya
dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām
tato bhuñjīta godeha-
saṃbhūtena samanvitam

evam evākhilān māsān
upoṣya prayataḥ śuciḥ
dadyād gavāhnikaṃ bhaktyā
pratimāsaṃ svaśaktitaḥ

pārite ca punar varṣe
yathāśakti gavāhnikam
dattvā paragave bhūyaḥ
śṛṇu yat phalam aśnute

suvarṇaśṛṅgāḥ pañca gāḥ
ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ naraḥ
pratimāsaṃ dvijāgrebhyo
yad dattvā phalam aśnute

tad āpnoty akhilaṃ samyag
vratam etad upoṣitaḥ
taṃ ca lokam avāpnoti
govindo yatra tiṣṭhati

govindadvādaśīm etām
upoṣya divi tārakāḥ
vidyotamānā dṛśyante
lokair adyāpi śobhane

upavāsavratānāṃ tu
vaikalyaṃ yan mahāmune
dānakarmakṛtaṃ tasya
vipāko vada yādṛśaḥ

yajñānām upavāsānāṃ
vratānāṃ ca yatavrate
vaikalyāt phalavaikalyaṃ
yādṛśaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva me

upavāsādinā rājyaṃ
saṃprāpyaṃ te tathā vasu
bhraṣṭaiśvaryā nirdhanāś ca
bhavanti puruṣāḥ punaḥ

rūpaṃ tathottamaṃ prāpya
vratavaikalyadoṣataḥ
kāṇāḥ kuṇṭhāś ca bhūyas te
bhavanty andhāś ca mānavāḥ

upavāsān naraḥ patnīṃ
nārī prāpya tathā patim
viyogaṃ vratavaikalyād
ubhayaṃ tad avāpnute

ye dravye saty adātāras
tathānyenāhitāgnayaḥ
kule ca sati duḥśīlā
dauṣkulāḥ śīlinaś ca ye

vastrānulepanair hīnā
bhūṣaṇaiś cātirūpiṇaḥ
virūparūpāś ca tathā
prasādhanaguṇānvitāḥ

te sarve vratavaikalyāt
phalavaikalyam āgatāḥ
guṇino 'pi hi doṣeṇa
saṃyuktāḥ saṃbhavanti te

tasmān na vratavaikalyaṃ
yajñavaikalyam eva vā
upavāse ca kartavyaṃ
vaikalyād vikalaṃ phalam

kathaṃcid yadi vaikalyam
upavāsādike bhavet
kiṃ tatra vada kartavyam
acchidraṃ yena jāyate

akhaṇḍadvādaśīm etām
aśeṣeṣv eva karmasu
vaikalyapraśamāyālaṃ
śṛṇuṣva gadato mama

mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe
dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ
kṛtopavāso deveśaṃ
samabhyarcya janārdanam

pañcagavyajalasnātaḥ
pañcagavyakṛtāśanaḥ
yavavrīhibhṛtaṃ pātraṃ
dadyād viprāya bhaktitaḥ
idaṃ coccārayed bhaktyā
devasya purato hareḥ

sapta janmāni yat kiṃcid
mayā khaṇḍavrataṃ kṛtam
bhagavaṃs tvatprasādena
tad akhaṇḍam ihāstu me

yathākhaṇḍaṃ jagat sarvam
tvam eva puruṣottama
tathākhilāny akhaṇḍāni
vratāni mama santu vai

caturbhir eva māsais tu
pāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam
prīṇanaṃ ca hareḥ kuryāt
pārite pāraṇe tataḥ

caitrādiṣu ca māseṣu
caturṣv anyaṃ tu pāraṇam
tatrāpi saktupātrāṇi
dadyāc chraddhāsamanvitaḥ

śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu
kārttikānteṣu pāraṇam
yatnāt tu ghṛtapātrāṇi
dadyād viprāya bhaktitaḥ

evaṃ samyag yathānyāyam
akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ naraḥ
yad upoṣyaty akhaṇḍaṃ sa
vratasya phalam aśnute

sapta janmasu vaikalyam
yad vratasya kvacit kṛtam
karoty avikalaṃ sarvam
akhaṇḍadvādaśīvratam

tasmād eṣātiyatnena
naraiḥ strībhiś ca suvrate
akhaṇḍadvādaśī samyag
upoṣyā phalakāṃkṣibhiḥ

evaṃ purā yājñavalkyaḥ
pṛṣṭaḥ patnyā mahāmuniḥ
ācaṣṭa puṇyaphaladam
upavāsavidhiṃ param

tathā tvam api viprarṣe
keśavārādhane rataḥ
vratopavāsaparamo
bhavethā nānyamānasaḥ

punaś caitan mahābhāga
śrūyatāṃ gadato mama
proktaṃ nareṇa devānāṃ
tithimāhātmyam uttamam

vijayātijayā caiva
jayantī pāpanāśanī
tathottarāyaṇaṃ śastaṃ
sarvadā keśavārcane

yad anyakāle varṣeṇa
keśavāl labhyate phalam
sakṛd evārcite kṛṣṇe
tad etāsv api labhyate

vijayātijayā caiva
jayantī pāpanāśanī
tathottarāyaṇaṃ caiva
yac chastaṃ keśavārcane

tat sarvaṃ kathayehādya
tithimāhātmyam uttamam
yatra saṃpūjitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ
sarvapāpaṃ vyapohati

ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe
puṣyarkṣaṃ yatra sattama
tithau bhavati sā proktā
viṣṇunā pāpanāśanī

tasyāṃ saṃpūjya govindaṃ
jagatām īśvareśvaram
saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān
mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

yaś copavāsaṃ kurute
tasyāṃ snāto dvijottama
sarvapāpavinirmukto
viṣṇuloke mahīyate

dānaṃ yad dīyate kiṃcit
samuddiśya janārdanam
homo vā kriyate tasyām
akṣayaṃ labhate phalam

ekā ṛg devapurato
japtā śraddhāvatā tathā
ṛgvedasya samastasya
japatā yacchate phalam

sāmavedaphalaṃ sāma
yajurvedaphalaṃ yajuḥ
japtam ekaṃ muniśreṣṭha
dadāty atra na saṃśayaḥ

tārakā divi rājante
dyotamānā dvijottama
samabhyarcya tithāv asyāṃ
devadevaṃ janārdanam

yataḥ pāpam aśeṣaṃ vai
nāśayaty atra keśavaḥ
puṣyarkṣaikādaśī brahmaṃs
tenoktā pāpanāśanī

tathānyad api dharmajña
śrūyatāṃ gadato mama
padadvayaṃ jagaddhātur
devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ

saṃvatsaraḥ pādapīṭhaṃ
tatra nyastaṃ padadvayam
vāsudevena viprendra
bhūtānāṃ hitakāmyayā

vāmam asya padaṃ brahman
uttarāyaṇasaṃjñitam
devādyaiḥ sakalair vandyaṃ
dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam

tasmin yaḥ prayataḥ samyag
devadevasya mānavaḥ
karoty ārādhanaṃ tasya
toṣam āyāti keśavaḥ

katham ārādhanaṃ tasya
devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ
kriyate muniśārdūla
tan mamākhyātum arhasi

uttare tv ayane dālbhya
snāto niyatamānasaḥ
ghṛtakṣīrādinā devaṃ
snāpayed dharaṇīdharam

cāruvastropahāraiś ca
puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ
samabhyarcya tataḥ samyag
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ
padadvayavrataṃ samyag
gṛhṇīyād viṣṇutatparaḥ

snāto nārāyaṇaṃ vakṣye
bhuñjan nārāyaṇaṃ tathā
bhuṅktvā nārāyaṇaṃ cāhaṃ
gacchan nārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ

svapan vibuddhaḥ praṇaman
homaṃ kurvaṃs tathārcanam
nārāyaṇasyānudinaṃ
kariṣye nāmakīrtanam

yāvad adyadināt prāptaṃ
kramaśo dakṣiṇāyanam
skhalite 'haṃ kṣute caiva
vedanārto 'thavā sadā
tāvan nārāyaṇaṃ vakṣye
sarvam evottarāyaṇam

yāvaj jīvavadhaṃ kiṃcid
jñānato 'jñānato 'pi vā
kariṣye 'haṃ tathā caiva
kīrtayiṣyāmi taṃ prabhum

yadā tadānṛtaṃ kiṃcid
atha vakṣyāmi durvacaḥ
ajñānād athavā jñānāt
kīrtayiṣyāmi taṃ prabhum

ṣaṇmāsam eṣa me jāpo
nārāyaṇamayaḥ paraḥ
taṃ smaran maraṇe yāti
yāṃ gatiṃ sāstu me gatiḥ

ṣaṇmāsābhyantare mṛtyur
yady akasmād bhaven mama
tan mayā vāsudevāya
svayam ātmā niveditaḥ

paramārthamayaṃ brahma
vāsudevamayaṃ param
yam ante saṃsmaran yāti
sa me viṣṇuḥ parā gatiḥ

yadā prātas tadā sāyaṃ
madhyāhne vā mriye hy aham
ṣaṇmāsābhyantare nyāsaḥ
kṛto vratamayo mayā

tathā kuru jagannātha
sarvalokaparāyaṇa
nārāyaṇa yathā nānyaṃ
tvatto yāmi mṛte gatim

evam uccārya ṣaṇmāsa-
pāraṇaṃ pravaraṃ vratam
tāvan niṣpādayed yāvat
saṃprāptaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam

tataś ca prīṇanaṃ kuryād
yathāśaktyā jagadguroḥ
bhojayed brāhmaṇān samyag
dadyāt tebhyaś ca dakṣiṇām

evaṃ vratam idaṃ dālbhya
yaḥ pārayati mānavaḥ
nārī vā sarvapāpebhyaḥ
ṣaṇmāsād vipra mucyate

ṣaṇmāsābhyantare cāsya
maraṇaṃ yadi jāyate
prāpnoty anaśanasyoktaṃ
yat phalaṃ tad asaṃśayam

padadvayaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya
samyak tena tathārcitam

bhagavān ujjagau viṣṇuḥ
purā gārgyāya pṛcchate

phālgunāmalapakṣasya
ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ
naro vā yadi vā nārī
samabhyarcya jagadgurum

harer nāma japed bhaktyā
sapta vārān nareśvara
uttiṣṭhan prasvapaṃś caiva
harim evānukīrtayet

tato 'nyadivase prāpte
dvādaśyāṃ prayato harim
snātvā samyak tam abhyarcya
dadyād viprāya dakṣiṇām

harim uddiśya caivāgnau
ghṛtahomakṛtakriyaḥ
praṇipatya jagannātham
iti vāṇīm udīrayet

pātālasaṃsthā vasudhā
yaṃ prasādya manorathān
avāpa vāsudevo 'sau
pradadātu manorathān

yam abhyarcyāditiḥ prāptā
sakalāṃś ca manorathān
putrāṃś caivepsitān devaḥ
pradadātu manorathān

bhraṣṭarājyaś ca devendro
yam abhyarcya jagatpatim
manorathān avāpāgryān
sa dadātu manorathān

evam abhyarcya pūjāṃ ca
niṣpādya haraye tataḥ
bhuñjīta prayataḥ samyag
haviṣyaṃ manujarṣabha

phālgunaṃ caitravaiśākhau
jyeṣṭhamāsaṃ ca pārthiva
caturbhiḥ pāraṇaṃ māsair
ebhir niṣpāditaṃ bhavet

raktapuṣpais tu caturo
māsān kurvīta cārcanam
dahec ca guggulaṃ prāśya
gośṛṅgakṣālanaṃ jalam

haviṣyānnaṃ ca naivedyam
ātmanaś caiva bhojanam
tataś ca śrūyatām anyad
āṣāḍhādau tu yā kriyā

jātīpuṣpāṇi dhūpaś ca
śastaḥ sarjaraso nṛpa
prāśya darbhodakaṃ cātra
śālyannaṃ ca nivedanam

svayaṃ tad eva cāśnīyāc
śeṣaṃ pūrvavad ācaret
kārttikādiṣu māseṣu
gomūtraṃ kāyaśodhanam

sugandhaṃ cecchayā dhūpaṃ
pūjābhṛṅgārakeṇa ca
kāsāraṃ cātra naivedyam
aśnīyāt tac ca vai svayam

pratimāsaṃ ca viprāya
dātavyā dakṣiṇā tathā
prīṇanaṃ cecchayā viṣṇoḥ
pāraṇe pāraṇe gate

yathāśakti yathāprīti
vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet
sadbhāvenaiva govindaḥ
pūjitaḥ prīyate yataḥ

pāraṇānte yathāśaktyā
snāpitaḥ pūjito hariḥ
prīṇitaś cepsitān kāmān
dadāty avyāhatān nṛpa

eṣā dhanyā pāpaharā
dvādaśī phalam icchatām
yathābhilaṣitān kāmān
dadāti manujeśvara

pūrayaty akhilān bhaktyā
yataś caiṣā manorathān
manorathadvādaśīyaṃ
tato lokeṣu viśrutā

upoṣyaitāṃ tribhuvanaṃ
prāptam indreṇa vai purā
adityā cepsitāḥ putrā
dhanaṃ cośanasā nṛpa

dhaumyena cāpy adhyayanam
anyaiś cābhimataṃ phalam
rājarṣibhis tathā vipraiḥ
strībhiḥ śūdraiś ca bhūpate

yaṃ yaṃ kāmam abhidhyāyed
vratam etad upoṣitaḥ
taṃ tam āpnoty asaṃdigdhaṃ
viṣṇor ārādhanodyataḥ

aputro labhate putram
adhano labhate dhanam
rogābhibhūtaś cārogyaṃ
kanyā prāpnoti satpatim

samāgamaṃ pravasitair
upoṣyaitām avāpnute
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti
mṛtaḥ svarge ca modate

nāputro nādhano neṣṭa-
viyogī na ca nirguṇaḥ
upoṣyaitad vrataṃ martyaḥ
strī jano vāpi jāyate

svargaloke sahasrāṇi
varṣāṇāṃ manujādhipa
bhogān abhimatān bhuktvā
svargaloke 'bhikāṅkṣitān

iha puṇyavatāṃ nṝṇāṃ
dhanināṃ sādhuśīlinām
gṛheṣu jāyate rājan
sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ

aśokapūrṇimāṃ cānyāṃ
śṛṇuśva vadato mama
yām upoṣya naraḥ śokaṃ
nāpnoti strī tathāpi vā

phālgunāmalapakṣasya
pūrṇimāsyāṃ nareśvara
mṛjjalena naraḥ snātvā
dattvā śirasi vai mṛdam

mṛtprāśanaṃ tathā kṛtvā
kṛtvā ca sthaṇḍilaṃ mṛdā
puṣpaiḥ patrais tathābhyarcya
bhūdharaṃ nānyamānasaḥ
dharaṇīṃ ca tathā devīm
aśokety abhidhīyate

yathā viśokāṃ dharaṇīṃ
kṛtavāṃs tvaṃ janārdanaḥ
tathā māṃ sarvapāpebhyo
mocayāśeṣadhāriṇi

yathā samastabhūtānāṃ
dhāraṇaṃ tvayy avasthitam
tathā viśokaṃ kuru māṃ
sakalecchāvibhūtibhiḥ

dhyātamātre yathā viṣṇau
svāsthyaṃ yātāsi medini
tathā manaḥ svasthatāṃ me
kuru tvaṃ bhūtadhāriṇi

evaṃ stutvā tathābhyarcya
candrāyārghyaṃ nivedya ca
upoṣitavyaṃ naktaṃ vā
bhoktavyaṃ tailavarjitam

anenaiva prakāreṇa
catvāraḥ phālgunādayaḥ
upoṣyā nṛpate māsāḥ
prathamaṃ tat tu pāraṇam

āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu
tadvat snānaṃ mṛdambunā
tad eva prāśanaṃ pūjā
tathaivendos tathārhaṇam

caturṣv anyeṣu caivoktaṃ
tathā vai kārttikādiṣu
pāraṇaṃ tritayaṃ caiva
cāturmāsikam ucyate

prathamaṃ dharaṇī nāma
stutyai māsacatuṣṭayam
dvitīye medinī vācyā
tṛtīye ca vasuṃdharā

pāraṇe pāraṇe vastra-
pūjayā pūjayen nṛpa
dharaṇīṃ devadevaṃ ca
ghṛtasnānena keśavam

vastrābhāve tu sūtreṇa
pūjayed dharaṇīṃ tathā
ghṛtābhāve tathā kṣīraṃ
śastaṃ vā salilaṃ hareḥ

pātālamūlagatayā
cīrṇam etan mahāvratam
dharaṇyā keśavaprītyai
tataḥ prāptā samunnatiḥ

devena coktā dharaṇī
varāhavapuṣā tadā
upavāsaprasannena
samuddhṛtya rasātalāt

tasya prasādam apy aham
karomi tava medini
tathaiva kurute pūjāṃ
bhaktyā mama śubho janaḥ
tathaiva tava kalyāṇi
praṇato yaḥ kariṣyati

vratam etad upāśritya
pāraṇaṃ ca yathāvidhi

sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ
sapta janmāntarāṇy asau
viśokaḥ sarvakalyāṇa-
bhājano matimāñ janaḥ

sarvatra pūjyaḥ satataṃ
sarveṣām aparājitaḥ
yathāham evaṃ vasudhe
bhavitā nirvṛteḥ padam

tathā tvam api kalyāṇi
bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ

evam etan mahāpuṇyaṃ
sarvapāpopaśāntidam
viśokākhyaṃ vrataṃ dhanyaṃ
tat kuruṣva mahīpate

strīṇāṃ dharmaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha
upavāsaṃ bhavan mama
kathayeha yathātattvam
upavāsavidhiś ca yaḥ

kaumārake gṛhasthāyā
vidhavāyāś ca sattama
dharmaṃ prabrūhy aśeṣeṇa
bhagavan prītikārakam

śrūyatām akhilaṃ brahman
yady etad anupṛcchasi
upakārāya ca strīṇāṃ
triṣu lokeṣv anuttamam

praśnam etat purā devī
śailarājasutā patim
papraccha śaṅkaraṃ brahman
kailāsaśikhare sthitam

kumārikābhir deveśa
gṛhasthābhiś ca keśavaḥ
vidhavābhis tathā strībhiḥ
katham ārādhyate vada

sādhu sādhvi tvayā pṛṣṭam
etan nārāyaṇāśritam
upavāsādi yat tattvaṃ
śrūyatām asya yo vidhiḥ

yogyaṃ patiṃ samāsādya
nārī dharmam avāpnute
duḥśīle 'pi hi kāmārte
nārī prāpnoti bhartari

anārādhya jagannāthaṃ
sarvalokeśvaraṃ harim
katham āpnoti vai nārī
patiṃ śīlaguṇānvitam

sukalatrapradaṃ tasmād
vratam acyutatuṣṭidam
kartavyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tasya
śrūyatāṃ varavarṇini

yac cīrtvā sarvanārīṇāṃ
śreṣṭham āpnoty asaṃśayam
aihikaṃ ca sukhaṃ prāpya
svarge bhuṅkte sukhāny api

anujñāṃ prāpya pitṛto
mātṛtaś ca kumārikā
pūjayec ca jagannāthaṃ
bhaktyā pāpaharaṃ harim

triṣūttareṣu svṛkṣeṣu
patikāmā kumārikā
mādhavākhyaṃ tu vai nāma
japen nityam atandritā

priyaṅguṇā raktapuṣpair
bandhūkakusumais tathā
samabhyarcya tato dadyād
raktam evānulepanam

sarvauṣadhyā svayaṃ snātvā
samabhyarcya jagatpatim
namo 'stu mādhavāyeti
homayen madhusarpiṣī

sa devam uttarāyoge
samabhyarcya janārdanam
śobhanaṃ patim āpnoti
pretya svargaṃ ca gacchati

atibālye ca yat kiṃcit
tayā pāpam anuṣṭhitam
tasmāc ca mucyate devi
sukhinī caiva jāyate

abdenaikena tanvaṅgi
dhūtapāpā yad icchati
tad eva prāpnuyād bhadre
nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā

ṣaṇmāsaṃ prīṇanaṃ kāryaṃ
bhaktyā śaktyā ca vai hareḥ
pāraṇānte mahābhage
tathā brāhmaṇatarpaṇam

gārhasthye 'vasthitā nārī
bhaktyā saṃpūjayet patim
sa eva devatā tasyāḥ
pūjyaḥ pūjyataraś ca saḥ

tasmiṃs tuṣṭe paro dharmas
tasyaiva paricaryayā
toṣam āyāti sarvātmā
paramātmā janārdanaḥ

naiva tasyāḥ pṛthag yajño
na śrāddhaṃ nāpy upoṣitam
bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇenaiva
prāpnoti strī yathepsitam

tenaiva sāpy anujñātā
tasya śuśrūṣaṇād anu
toṣayej jagatām īśam
anantam aparājitam

vratair nānāvidhair devi
aihikāmuṣmikāptaye
viṣṇuvratādibhir divyais
tathā dānair mano'nugaiḥ

ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekaiś ca
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ
manojñair vividhair dhūpaiḥ
puṣpavastrānulepanaiḥ

gītavādyais tathā hṛdyair
upavāsaiś ca bhāmini
evam ārādhya govindam
anujñātā yathāvidhi
patinā sakalān kāmān
avāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ

patinā tv ananujñātā
kiṃcit puṇyaṃ karoti yā
viphalaṃ tad aśeṣaṃ vai
tasyāḥ śailavarātmaje

na ca prasādaṃ kurute
bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ
nānujñātā tu yā nārī
patinārcati keśavam

yā tu bhartṛparā nārī
nārāyaṇam atandritā
bhaktyā saṃpūjayed devaṃ
toṣam āyāti keśavaḥ

yā tu bhartrā parityaktā
tathā yā mṛtabhartṛkā
pāṣaṇḍānugato vāpi
yasyā bhartā maheśvara

prāyo dadāti nānujñāṃ
viṣṇor ārādhane tadā
katham ārādhanaṃ kāryaṃ
viṣṇos tad vada śaṃkara

yā tu bhartrā parityaktā
sā saṃpūjya nijaṃ patim
manasā tanmanaskā ca
tasyaiva hitakāriṇī

na nindākaraṇī tasya
śreyo'bhidhyāyinī tathā
tasyaiva sarvakāleṣu
sarvakalyāṇam icchati

ārādhayej jagannāthaṃ
sarvadhātāram acyutam
kṛtopavāsā puṣpādi
nivedya sakalaṃ tataḥ

bhartur manorathāvāptiṃ
prārthayet prathamaṃ varam
svayaṃ yathābhilaṣitaṃ
prārthayet taṃ varaṃ tataḥ

evaṃ bhartṛparityaktā
yoṣid ārādhanaṃ hareḥ
kurvāṇā sakalān kāmān
avāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ

bhartā karoti yac casyāḥ
kiṃcit puṇyam aharniśam
tasya puṇyasya saṃpūrṇam
ardhaṃ prāpnoti sā śubhe

yat tu sā kurute puṇyaṃ
vinā doṣeṇa yojjhitā
tat tasyāḥ sakalaṃ devi
tasyārdhaṃ na labhet patiḥ

bhartary evaṃ pravasite
tyaktā ca patinā śubhe
kurvītārādhanaṃ nārī
upavāsādinā hareḥ

etat tavoktaṃ yat pṛṣṭaṃ
tvayāhaṃ girinandini
vidhavānām ato dharmaṃ
śrūyatāṃ viṣṇutuṣṭidam

mṛte bhartari sādhvī strī
brahmacaryavratoditā
snātā pratidinaṃ dadyāt
svabhartṛsalilāñjalim

kuryād yānudinaṃ bhaktyā
devānām api pūjanam
atithes tarpaṇaṃ tadvad
agnihotram amantrakam

pūrtadharmāśritaṃ cānyat
kuryān nityam atandritā
nityakarma ṛte cāsyā
neṣṭaṃ karma vidhīyate

viṣṇor ārādhanaṃ caiva
kuryān nityam upoṣitā
dānādi vipramukhyebhyo
dadyāt puṇyavivṛddhaye
upavāsāṃś ca vividhān
kuryāc chāstroditān śubhe

lokāntarasthaṃ bhartāram
ātmānaṃ ca varānane
tārayaty ubhayaṃ nārī
yetthaṃ dharmaparāyaṇā

putraiśvaryasthitā nārī
upavāsādinā harim
yā toṣayati siddhiṃ sā
putrebhyo 'pi prayacchati

śubhāṃl lokāṃs tathā bhartur
ātmanaś ca yathepsitān
sakalaṃ pūrayaty astaṃ
pāpaṃ nayati cākhilam

ātmanaś caiva bhartuś ca
nārī paramikāṃ gatim
dadāty ārādhya govindaṃ
saputrā vidhavā ca yā

tasmād ebhir vidhānais tu
sarvakālaṃ tu yoṣitaḥ
keśavārādhanaṃ kāryaṃ
lokadvayaphalapradam

ye narā mṛtapatnikās
tair apy etad aśeṣataḥ
pūrtadharmāśritaṃ kāryaṃ
nityakarma ca kevalam

putraiśvaryasthitaiḥ samyag
brahmacaryaguṇānvitaiḥ
viṣṇor ārādhanaṃ kāryaṃ
tīrthasthair athavā gṛhe

brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ
strī śūdraś ca varānane
anārādhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ
nāpnoti paramāṃ gatim

aiśvaryaṃ saṃtatiṃ śreṣṭhām
ārogyaṃ dravyasaṃpadam
dadāti bhagavān viṣṇur
gatim agryāṃ sutoṣitaḥ

evaṃ śailasutā proktā
svayaṃ devena śaṃbhunā
pṛṣṭena samyak kathitaṃ
bhavato 'pi mahāmune

sarvavarṇais tathā strībhir
anyair api janair hariḥ
ārādhanīyo nātuṣṭe
viṣṇau saṃprāpyate gatiḥ

na durgatiṃ rauravādīn
narakāṃś ca na gacchati
yam ārādhyeśvaraṃ vandyaṃ
kas taṃ viṣṇuṃ na pūjayet

tasmād amuṣmikān kleśān
narake yāś ca yātanāḥ
sadaivodvijatā dālbhya
samārādhyo janārdanaḥ

bhagavan yātanā ghorāḥ
śrūyante narakeṣu yāḥ
tāsāṃ svarūpam atyugraṃ
yathāvad vaktum arhasi

śṛṇu dālbhyātighorāṇāṃ
yātanānāṃ mayoditam
svarūpaṃ nārakair yat tu
narakeṣv anubhūyate

yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi
rauravo narako dvija
aṅgārapūrṇamadhyo 'sau
jvālāmālāpariṣkṛtaḥ

tanmadhye patito yāti
yojanāni sahasraśaḥ
satyahānyānṛtī yāti
tatra pāparatir naraḥ

rauravād dviguṇaś caiva
mahārauvarasaṃjñitaḥ
taptatāmrapuṭāṅgāra-
jvalatpāvakasaṃvṛtaḥ

paropatāpinas tatra
patanti narake narāḥ
nāścaryaṃ dvijaśārdūla
varṣalakṣayutāni ca

kālasūtreṇa cchidyante
cakrārūḍhāś ca mānavāḥ
kālāṅgulisthena sadā
āpādatalamastakāt

kālasūtra iti khyāto
ghoraḥ sa narakottamaḥ
tatrāpi vañcakā yānti
ye caivotkocajīvinaḥ

taptakumbhas tathaivānyo
narako bhṛśadāruṇaḥ
tailakumbheṣu pacyante
tatrāpy agnibhṛteṣu te

devavedadvijātīnāṃ
ye nindāṃ kurvate sadā
saṃśṛṇvanti ca ye mūḍhā
ye ca matsariṇo 'dhamāḥ

karambhavālukākumbha-
saṃjñaṃ ca narakaṃ śṛṇu
paradāraratā ye tu
patanti narake 'dhamāḥ

hṛtaṃ yaiś ca jalaṃ te 'pi
tasmin yānti narādhamāḥ
gonipāneṣu vighnāni
mūḍhā ye cāpi kurvate
karambhavālukākumbha-
narake te patanti vai

andhe tamasi duṣpāre
śītārtiparikampitāḥ
bhrāmyante mānavā gātraiḥ
samastaiḥ sphuṭitāsthibhiḥ

govadhaḥ strīvadhaḥ pāpaiḥ
kṛtaṃ yaiś ca gavānṛtam
te tatrātimahābhīme
patanti narake narāḥ

utpāṭyate tathā jihvā
saṃdaṃśair bhṛśadāruṇaiḥ
ākriśakānāṃ duṣṭānāṃ
sadaivābaddhabhāṣiṇām

karapatraiś ca pāṭyante
yamasya puruṣais tathā
paradāraparadravya-
hiṃsakāḥ puruṣādhamāḥ

āyasīṃ ca śilāṃ taptām
aśeṣāṅgais tathā narāḥ
paradāraratā evaṃ
samāliṅganti pāpinaḥ

sarvāṅgair vikṛtair raktam
udgiranto 'tipīḍitāḥ
yantreṣv anyeṣu pīḍyante
jantupīḍākarā narāḥ

vṛkaiḥ saṃbhakṣyate pṛṣṭhaṃ
narāṇāṃ pāpakāriṇām
janasya pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ yair
bhakṣitaṃ pāpakāribhiḥ

asipatravanair ghoraiś
chidyante pāpakarmiṇaḥ
sadbhāvapravaṇā yais tu
bhagnā viśrambhino janāḥ

ayomukhaiḥ khagair bhagnāḥ
khaṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ tathāparaiḥ
vrajanti pāpakarmāṇaḥ
śvaśṛgālais tathāparaiḥ

sūṣāyām api dhāsyante
jvaladagnicayāvṛtāḥ
pāṣāṇapeṣyaṃ piṣyante
tathānye pāpakarmiṇaḥ

devatātithibhṛtyāṇām
adattvā bhuñjate tu ye
mṛṣāgatās tathāivaikyaṃ
trapuṣā sīsakena ca
prayānti puruṣās tailaiḥ
kvāthyante 'nye punaḥ punaḥ

varṇadharmaparityāge
naikyaṃ ye puruṣā gatāḥ
te 'pi pāpasamācārā
varṇasaṃkarakāriṇaḥ

svarūpaṃ nārakasyāgneḥ
śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te
muktas tato 'nyavahnishtaḥ
śete saṃprāpya nirvṛtim

śastradhārās tathaivaitā
mṛṇālaprastaraṃ naraḥ
manyate nārakaiḥ śastrair
vikṣato dvijasattama

himakhaṇḍacayāchanno
nivātaṃ manyate naraḥ
vimukto nārakāc chītāt
prakāśaṃ tamasas tamaḥ

protā gudeṣu bhinnāṅgā
ārtā rāvavirāviṇaḥ
śūleṣu loheṣv apare
triśūleṣu tathāpare

yājyopādhyāyadāmpatya-
suhṛnmitrasutādiṣu
kṛto bhedo durācārair
yair alīkoktibhāṣibhiḥ

āyasāḥ kaṇṭakās tīkṣṇā
narake kūṭaśālmalau
teṣu protā durātmānaḥ
paradārabhujo narāḥ

kṛmikīṭajalaukādi-
tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāsyavikṣatāḥ
bhrāmyante cāndhatāmisre
vṛthāmāṃsāśino hi ye

etāṃś cānyāṃś ca narakāñ
śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
karmāntaraṃ jano bhuṅkte
pariṇāmāṃś ca cetasaḥ

yādṛk karma manuṣyāṇāṃ
tādṛg viṣayarūpavat
pariṇāmaṃ mano yāti
śubhāśubhamayaṃ dvija

atīvabhīṣaṇān itthaṃ
śastrāgnibhayadān naraḥ
kathaṃ na gacchen narakān
etan me vaktum arhasi

aho 'tikaṣṭapāpānāṃ
vipāko narakasthitaiḥ
puruṣair bhujyate brahmaṃs
tanmokṣaṃ vada sattama

puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ pākaḥ
puṇya eva dvijottama
cetasaḥ pariṇāmottaḥ
svargasthair bhujyate naraiḥ

tathaiva pākaḥ pāpānāṃ
puruṣair narakasthitaiḥ
bhujyate tāvad akhilaṃ
yāvat pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam

yadā tu pāpasya jayaḥ
kṣīyate sukṛtaṃ tadā
śubhasya karmaṇo vṛddhau
kṣayam āyāty aśobhanam

jaye yateta puruṣas
tasmāt sukṛtakarmaṇaḥ
pāpaṃ karma vinā naiva
narakaprāptir iṣyate

jayāya dvādaśī śastā
nṝṇāṃ sukṛtakarmaṇām
yām upoṣya dvijaśreṣṭha
na yāti narakaṃ naraḥ

phālgunāmalapakṣasya
ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ
dvādaśyāṃ tu dvijaśreṣṭha
pūjayen madhusūdanam

ekādaśyāṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ
viṣṇor nāmānukīrtanam
pūjāyāṃ vāsudevasya
kurvīta susamāhitaḥ

namo nārāyaṇāyeti
vācyaṃ ca svapatā niśi

krodhaḥ prapañca īrṣyā ca
dambho lobhaś ca varjitaḥ

kāmo droho madaś cāpi
mānamātsaryam eva ca
sarvam etat parityajya
viṣṇubhaktena cetasā

asāratāṃ ca loke 'smin
saṃsāre bhāvayen matim

kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca
dambham īrṣyāṃ ca varjayet
mānadrohādidoṣāṃś ca
sarvān dhanamadodbhūtān
bhāvayed viṣṇubhaktāṃś ca
saṃsārāsāratāṃ tathā
evaṃ bhāvitacittena
prāṇināṃ hitam icchatā

tathaiva kuryād dvādaśyāṃ
nāmnām uccāraṇaṃ dvija

yavapātrāṇi pūrvaṃ tu
dadyān māsacatuṣṭayam
āṣāḍhādidvitīyaṃ tu
pāraṇaṃ yan mahāmate
tatrāpi ghṛtapātrāṇi
dadyāc chraddhāsamanvitaḥ

kārttikādiṣu māseṣu
māghanteṣu tathā tilān
viprāya dadyāt pātrashtān
pratimāsam upoṣitaḥ

nāmatrayam aśeṣeṣu
māsi māsi dinadvayam
tathaivoccārayed dadyād
dvādaśyāṃ ca yavādikam
praṇamya ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ
kṛtapūjaḥ prasādayet

viṣṇo namas te jagataḥ prasūte
oṃ vāsudevāya namo namas te
nārāyaṇa tvāṃ praṇato 'smy acintya
jayo 'stu me śāśvatapuṇyarāśeḥ

prasīda puṇyaṃ jayam etu viṣṇo
oṃ vāsudeva rddhim upaitu puṇyam
nārāyaṇoṃ bhūtim upaitu puṇyam
prayātu cāśeṣam aghaṃ vināśam

viṣṇo puṇyodbhavo me 'stu
vāsudevāstu me śubham
nārāyaṇāstu dharmo me
jahi pāpam aśeṣataḥ

anekajanmajanitaṃ
bālyayauvanavārddhike
puṇyaṃ vivṛddhim āyātu
yātu pāpaṃ tu saṃkṣayam

ākāśādiṣu śabdādau
śrotrādau mahadādiṣu
prakṛtau puruṣe caiva
brahmaṇy api ca sa prabhuḥ
yathaika eva sarvātmā
vāsudevo vyavasthitaḥ

tena satyena me pāpaṃ
narakārtipradaṃ kṣayam
prayātu sukṛtasyāstu
mamānudivasaṃ jayaḥ
pāpasya hāniḥ puṇyaṃ ca
vṛddhim abhyety anuttamām

evam uccārya viprāya
dattvā yat kathitaṃ tava
bhuñjīta kṛtakṛtyas tu
pāraṇe pāraṇe gate

pāraṇānte ca devasya
prīṇanaṃ śaktito dvija
kurvītākhilapāṣaṇḍair
ālāpaṃ ca vivarjayet

ity etat kathitaṃ dālbhya
sukṛtasya jayāvahā
dvādaśī narakaṃ mṛtyo
yām upoṣya na paśyati

nāgnayo na ca śastrāṇi
na ca lohamūkhāḥ khagāḥ
nārakās taṃ prabādhante
matir yasya janārdane

nāmoccāraṇamātreṇa
viṣṇoḥ kṣīṇo 'ghasaṃcayaḥ
bhavaty apāstapāpasya
narake gamanaṃ kutaḥ

namo nārāyaṇa hare
vāsudeveti kīrtayet
na yāti narakaṃ martyaḥ
saṃkṣīṇāśeṣapātakaḥ

tasmāt pāṣaṇḍisaṃsargam
akurvan dvādaśīm imām
upoṣya puṇyopacayī
na yāti narakaṃ naraḥ

pāṣaṇḍibhir asaṃsparśam
asaṃbhāṣaṇam eva ca
viṣṇor ārādhanaparair
naraiḥ kāryam upoṣitaiḥ

kiṃ brūhi lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ
yādṛśān varjayed vratī
kathaṃcid yadi saṃlāpa-
darśanasparśanādikam

upoṣitānāṃ pāṣaṇḍair
narāṇāṃ vipra jāyate
kiṃ tatra vada kartavyaṃ
yenākhaṇḍaṃ vrataṃ bhavet

śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ
varṇāśramavibhāgajam
ullaṅghya ye pravartante
svecchayā kūṭayuktibhiḥ

vikarmābhiratā mūḍhā
yuktiprāgalbhyadurmadāḥ
pāṣaṇḍinas te duḥśīlā
narakārhā narādhamāḥ

tāṃs tu pāṣaṇḍinaḥ pāpān
vikarmasthāṃś ca mānavān
vaiḍālavratikāṃś caiva
nityam eva tu nālapet

saṃbhāṣyaitāñ śuciṣadaṃ
cintayed acyutaṃ budhaḥ
idaṃ codāharet samyak
kṛtvā tatpravaṇaṃ manaḥ

śārīram antaḥkaraṇopaghātaṃ
vācaś ca viṣṇur bhagavān aśeṣam
śamaṃ nayatv astu mameha śarma
pāpād anante hṛdi saṃniviṣṭe

antaḥśuddhiṃ bahiḥśuddhiṃ
śuddho 'ntar mama yo 'cyutaḥ
sa karotv amale tasmiñ
śucir evāsmi sarvadā

bāhyopaghātād anagho
boddhā ca bhagavān ajaḥ
śuddhiṃ nayatv anantātmā
viṣṇuś cetasi saṃsthitaḥ

etat saṃbhāṣya japtavyaṃ
pāṣaṇḍibhir upoṣitaiḥ
namaḥ śuciṣadety uktvā
sūryaṃ paśyeta vīkṣitaiḥ

śrūyate ca purā martyāḥ
svecchayā svargagāminaḥ
babhūvur anaghāḥ sarve
svadharmaparipālanāt

devāś ca balino martyair
varṇakarmaṇy anuvrataiḥ
yajñādhyayanadāneṣu
vartamānaiś ca mānavaiḥ

daiteyāś ca parābhāvam
atuṣṭāv asurā yayuḥ
tataś ca ṣaṇḍo markaś ca
daityendrāṇāṃ purohitau
cakratuḥ karma devānāṃ
vināśāyātibhīṣaṇam

tatrotpanno 'tikṛṣṇāṅgas
tamaḥprāyo 'tidāruṇaḥ
dambhādhāraḥ śāṭhyasāro
nidrāprakṛtir ulvaṇaḥ

mahāmoha iti khyātaḥ
kṛtyarūpo vibhīṣaṇaḥ
caturdhā sa vibhaktaś ca
tābhām atra mahīyate

vedadevadvijātīnām
ekāṃśena sa nindanam
karoty anyena na ratiṃ
yogakarmasu vindati

vikarmaṇy apareṇāpi
saṃyojayati mānavān
jñānāpahāram anyena
karoti dvijasattama

jñānabuddhyā tathājñānaṃ
gṛhṇāty ajñānamohitaḥ
vedavādavirodhena
yā kathā sāsya rocate

evaṃ sa tu mahāmohaḥ
ṣaṇḍamarkopapāditaḥ
dambhādidūṣito 'dharma-
svarūpo 'tibhayaṃkara

sa lokān vividhopāyair
lokeṣv eva vyavasthitaḥ
mohābhibhavaniḥsārāṇ
karoti dvijasattama

tanmohitānām acirād
viveko yāti saṃkṣayam
kṣīṇajñānā vikarmāṇi
kurvanty aharaho dvija

nijavarṇātmakaṃ dharmaṃ
parityajya vimohitāḥ
dharmabuddhyā tataḥ pāpaṃ
kurvanty ajñānadurmadāḥ

jñānāvalepas tatraiva
tatas teṣāṃ prajāyate
suhṛdbhir vāryamāṇās te
paṇḍitaiś ca dayālubhiḥ
prayacchanty uttaraṃ ṃūḍhāḥ
kūṭayuktisamanvitam

tatas te svayam ātmānam
anyaṃ cālpamatiṃ naram
vikarmaṇā yojayantaś
cyavayanti svadharmataḥ

pāṣaṇḍino durācārāḥ
parānnaguṇavādinaḥ
asaṃskṛtānnabhoktāro
vrātyāḥ saṃskāravarjitāḥ

pāṣaṇḍāḥ pāpasaṃkalpā
dāmbhikāḥ śaṭhabuddhayaḥ
varṇasaṃkarakartāro
māyāvyājopajīvinaḥ
niḥśaucā vakramatayo
nānyadastītivādinaḥ

evaṃvidhās te sanmārgād
vedaproktād bahiḥsthitāḥ
kriyākalāpaṃ nindanta
ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñitam
ātmānaṃ ca parāṃś caiva
kurvanti narakasthitān

teṣāṃ darśanasaṃbhāṣa-
sparśanāni naraiḥ sadā
parityājyāni dṛṣṭe ca
proktaḥ saṃbhāṣaṇe ca yaḥ
saṃsparśe ca budhaḥ snātvā
śuciḥ śuciṣadaṃ smaret

bhavaty ataḥ sadaivaiṣām
ālāpaspar1śanaṃ tyajet
puṇyakāmo mahābhāgaḥ
kiṃ punar yad upoṣitaḥ

yato hi nindite karmaṇy
abhyāso ratir eva ca
pāṣaṇḍinām aśeṣāṇām
aprītir vedakarmaṇi
te hy adhogāminaḥ proktā
āsuraṃ bhāvam āśritāḥ

aprāptir na tathā duḥkham
aiśvaryāder dvijottama
yathā manorathair labdhair
vicyutir dharmahānijā

aiśvaryād vittato vāpi
saṃtater devalokataḥ
abhīṣṭād anyato vāpi
padād yena na vicyutim

prāpnoti puruṣo brahman
nārī vāpuṇyasaṃkṣayāt
tan mamācakṣva viprarṣe
duḥkham ebhyo hi vicyutiḥ

satyam etan mahābhāga
duḥkhaṃ prāptasya saṃkṣayaḥ
aiśvaryād atha vittasya
bandhuvargasukhasya vā

tad etac chrūyatāṃ dālbhya
yathā neṣṭāt paricyutiḥ
sargāder jāyate samyag
upavāsavatāṃ satām

dvādaśarkṣāṇi viprarṣe
pratimāsaṃ tu yāni vai
tannāmāny acyutaṃ teṣu
samyak saṃpūjayed budhaḥ

puṣpair dhūpais tathāmbhobhir
abhīṣṭair aparais tathā
āditaḥ kṛttikāṃ kṛtvā
kārttike munipuṅgava

naivedyaṃ kṛsaraṃ pūrvam
annaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam
nivedayet kārttikādi
saṃyāvaṃ ca tataḥ param

āṣāḍhādau ca devāya
pāyasaṃ vai nivedayet
tenaivānnena viprarṣe
brāhmaṇān bhojayed budhaḥ

pañcagavyajalasnātas
tasyaiva prāśanāc chuciḥ
naivedyaṃ svayam aśnīyān
naktaṃ saṃpūjite 'cyute

evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte
tataḥ suptotthite 'cyute
saṃyak saṃpūjya viprarṣe
tam eva puruṣottamam
praṇamya prārthayed vidvāñ
śuciḥ snāto yathāvidhi

namo namas te 'cyuta saṃkṣayo 'stu
pāpasya vṛddhiṃ samupaitu puṇyam
aiśvaryavittādi sadākṣayaṃ me
'kṣayā ca me saṃtatir acyutāstu

yathācyutas tvaṃ parataḥ parasmāt
sa brahmabhūtāt parataḥ parātman
tathācyutaṃ me kuru vāñchitaṃ yan
mayā padaṃ pāpaharāprameya

acyutānanta govinda
prasīda yad abhīpsitam
tad akṣayam ameyātman
kuruṣva puruṣottama

evam ante samabhyarcya
prārthayitvā tathāśiṣaḥ
yathāvan muniśārdūla
cyutiṃ nāpnoti mānavaḥ

saṃtateḥ svargavittāder
aiśvaryasya tathā mune
yad vābhimatam atyantaṃ
tato na cyavate naraḥ

tasmāt sarvaprayatnena
māsanakṣatrapūjane
yatetākṣayakāmas tu
sadaiva munipuṅgava

atrāpi śrūyate siddhā
kācit svarge mahāvratā
nārī tapodhanā bhūtvā
prakhyātā śāmbharāyaṇī
samastasaṃdehaharā
sadā svargaukasāṃ hi sā

kasyacit tv atha kālasya
devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ
pūrvendracaritaṃ brahman
papracchedaṃ bṛhaspatim

pūrvendrā parataḥ pūrve
ye babhūvuḥ sureśvarāḥ
teṣāṃ caritam icchāmi
śrotum āṅgirasāṃ vara

evam uktas tadā tena
devendreṇāmaladyutiḥ
prāha dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ
paramarṣir bṛhaspatiḥ

nāhaṃ cirantanān vedmi
devarāja sureśvarān
ātmanaḥ samakālīnaṃ
mām avaihi sureśvara

tataḥ papraccha devendraḥ
ko 'smābhir munipuṅgava
praṣṭavyo 'tra mahābhāga
kṛtādivasatir divi

bṛhaspatiś ciraṃ dhyātvā
punar āha śacīpatim
tapasvinīṃ mahābhāgāṃ
smṛtvāsau śāmbharāyaṇīm

na devā na ca gandharvā
na cānye cirasaṃsthitāḥ
cirantanānāṃ cariteṣv
abhijñā tridaśeśvara

ekaiva cirakālajñā
dharmajñā śakra kevalam
jānāty akhiladevendra-
caritaṃ śāmbharāyaṇī

ity uktas tena devendraḥ
kautūhalasamanvitaḥ
yayau yatra mahābhāgā
tāpasī śāmbharāyaṇī

sā tau dṛṣṭvā samāyātau
devarājabṛhaspatī
samyag arghyena saṃpūjya
praṇipatya śubhavratā

namo 'stu devarājāya
tathaivāṅgirase namaḥ
yad vāṃ kāryaṃ mahābhāgau
sakalaṃ tad ihocyatām

āvām abhyāgatau praṣṭuṃ
tvām atrātivivekinīm
yac ca kāryaṃ mahābhāge
tat pṛṣṭā kathayeha nau

yadi smarasi kalyāṇi
pūrvendracaritāni nau
tadākhyāhi mahābhāge
devendrasya kutūhalāt

yadi śakyaṃ mayā kartuṃ
tat kariṣye vimṛṣyatu

yo vai pūrvaḥ surendrasya
tataś ca prathamo hi yaḥ
tasmāt pūrvataro yaś ca
tasyāpi prathamāś ca ye

teṣāṃ pūrvatarā ye ca
vedmi tān akhilān aham
teṣāṃ ca caritaṃ kṛtsnaṃ
jānāmy āṅgirasāṃ vara

manvantarāṇy anekāni
sṛṣṭiṃ ca tridivaukasām
saptarṣīn subahūn deva
manūnāṃ ca sutān nṛpa
tat pṛccha tvaṃ vadāmy eṣā
pūrvendracaritaṃ mune

evam ukte tatas tābhyāṃ
pṛṣṭā sā śāmbharāyaṇī
yathāvad ācaṣṭa tayoḥ
pūrvendracaritaṃ dvija

svāyambhuve yas tu manau
manau svārociṣe tu yaḥ
uttame tāmase caiva
raivate cākṣuṣe tathā

yo yo babhūva devendras
tasya tasya tapasvinī
tayor jagāda caritaṃ
yathāvac chāmbharāyaṇī

tataḥ kautūhalaparo
devarāṭ tāṃ tapasvinīm
uvāca jānāsi kathaṃ
tvam etac chāmbharāyaṇi

sarva eva hi devendrāḥ
svargasthā ye manīṣiṇaḥ
babhūvur etac caritam
eteṣāṃ vedmi tena vai

kiṃ kṛtaṃ vada dharmajñe
tvayā yeneyam akṣayā
svarloke vasatiḥ prāptā
yathā nānyena kenacit

aho sarvavratānāṃ tad
upoṣitaṃ mahad vratam
pradhānataram atyarthaṃ
svargasaṃvāsadaṃ matam

caritaṃ ca mayā teṣāṃ
śrutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca

evam uktā tatas tena
devendreṇa yaśasvinī
pratyuvāca mahābhāgā
yathāvac chāmbharāyaṇī

māsarkṣeṣv acyuto devaḥ
pratimāsaṃ sureśvara
yathoktavratayā samyak
sapta varṣāṇi pūjitaḥ

tasyeyaṃ karmaṇo vyuṣṭir
acyutārādhanasya me
devalokād abhimatā
devarāja yad acyutiḥ

svargaṃ dravyamayaiśvaryaṃ
saṃtatiṃ vāpi yo 'cyutām
naro vāñchati tenetthaṃ
toṣaṇīyo 'cyutaḥ prabhuḥ

etat te pūrvadevendra-
caritaṃ sakalaṃ mayā
svargavāsākṣayatvaṃ ca
māsarkṣācyutapūjanāt

yathāvat kathitaṃ deva
pṛcchatas tridaśeśvara
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃs tu
vāñchatāṃ vibudhādhipa
viṣṇor ārādhanān nānyat
paramaṃ siddhikāraṇam

tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā
devarājabṛhaspatī
tāṃ tathety ūcatuḥ sādhvīṃ
ceratuś cāpi tad vratam

tasmād dālbhya prayatnena
pratimāsaṃ samāhitaḥ
māsarkṣācyutapūjāyāṃ
bhavethās tanmanāḥ sadā

bhagavan prāṇinaḥ sarve
viṣarogādyupadravaiḥ
duṣṭagrahopaghātaiś ca
sarvakālam upadrutāḥ

ābhicārukakṛtyābhiḥ
sparṣarogaiś ca dāruṇaiḥ
sadā saṃpīḍyamānās te
tiṣṭhanti munisattama

yena karmavipākena
viṣarogādyupadravāḥ
na bhavanti nṛṇāṃ tan me
yathāvad vaktum arhasi

vratopavāsair yair viṣṇur
nānyajanmani pūjitaḥ
te narā muniśārdūla
graharogādibhāginaḥ

yair na tatpravaṇaṃ cittaṃ
sarvadaiva naraiḥ kṛtam
viṣagrahajvarāṇāṃ te
manuṣyā dālbhya bhājanāḥ

ārogyaṃ paramām ṛddhiṃ
manasā yad yad icchati
tat tad āpnoty asaṃdigdhaṃ
paratrācyutatoṣakṛt

nādhīn prāpnoti na vyādhīn
na viṣagrahabandhanam
kṛtyāsparśabhayaṃ vāpi
toṣite madhusūdane

sarvaduṣṭaśamas tasya
saumyās tasya sadā grahāḥ
devānām apradhṛṣyo 'sau
tuṣṭo yasya janārdanaḥ

yaḥ samaḥ sarvabhūteṣu
yathātmani tathāpare
upavādādinā tena
toṣyate madhusūdanaḥ

toṣite tatra jāyante
narāḥ pūṛṇamanorathāḥ
arogāḥ sukhino bhoga-
bhoktāro munisattama

na teṣāṃ śatravo naiva
sparśarogābhicārukāḥ
graharogādikaṃ vāpi
pāpakāryaṃ na jāyate

avyāhatāni kṛṣṇasya
cakrādīny ātmayudhāni tam
rakṣanti sakalāpadbhyo
yena viṣṇur upāsitaḥ

anārādhitagovindā
ye narā duḥkhabhāginaḥ
teṣāṃ duḥkhābhibhūtānāṃ
kartavyaṃ yad dayālubhiḥ

paśyadbhiḥ sarvabhūtasthaṃ
vāsudevaṃ mahāmune
samadṛṣṭibhir īśeśaṃ
tan mama brūhy aśeṣataḥ

kuśāgre śaṃkaraṃ vidyāt
trayo devā vyavasthitāḥ

gṛhītvā ca sa mūlāgrān
kuśāñ śuddhān upaspṛśet

mantrair etair yathā liṅgaṃ
kuryād digbandham ātmanaḥ

vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ ca
vāmanaṃ viṣṇum eva ca

dhyātvā samāhito bhūtvā
dikṣu nāmāni vinyāset

pūrve nārāyaṇaḥ pātu
vārijākṣas tu dakṣiṇe

īśānyām avatād viṣṇur
āgneyyāṃ ca janārdanaḥ

nairṛtyāṃ padmanābhaś ca
vāyavyāṃ caiva mādhavaḥ

etābhyo daśadigbhyas tu
sarvataḥ pātu keśavaḥ

aṅguṣṭhāgre tu govindaṃ
tarjanyāṃs tu mahīdharam

kaṇiṣṭhāyāṃ nyased viṣṇuṃ
karamadhye tu mādhavam

evaṃ nyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā
paścād aṅgeṣu vinyaset

śikhāyāṃ keśavaṃ nyasya
mūrdhni nārāyaṇaṃ nyaset

dakṣiṇe tu bhuje vipra
vinyaset puruṣottamam

pītāmbaraṃ sarvatanau
hariṃ nābhau tu vinyaset

kare tu dakṣiṇe vipra
tataḥ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ nyaset

pṛṣṭhe kṣitidharaṃ vidyād
acyutaṃ skandhayor api

mādhavaṃ bāhu kukṣau tu
dakṣiṇe yogaśāyinam

cakriṇaṃ jānumadhye tu
jaṅghayor acyutaṃ nyaset

evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā
sākṣān nārāyaṇo bhavet

tanur viṣṇumayī tasya
yāvat kiṃcin na bhāṣate

evaṃ nyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā
yat kāryaṃ śṛṇu tad dvija

pādamūle tu devasya
śaṅkhaṃ tatraiva vinyaset

gadāṃ vakṣaḥsthale caiva
cakraṃ caiva tu pṛṣṭhataḥ

viṣṇur ūrdhvam adho rakṣed
vaikuṇṭho vidiśo diśaḥ

pātu māṃ sarvato rāmo
dhanvī cakrī ca keśavaḥ

pūjākāle tu devasya
japakāle tathaiva ca

āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ
jñānaṃ vittaṃ phalaṃ bhavet

yad yat sukhakaraṃ proktaṃ

acyutānantagovinda-
nāmoccāraṇabhīṣitāḥ

grahān pretagrahāṃś caiva

mukhamaṇḍinikāṃ krūrāṃ

tathā mātṛgrahān api
bālasya viṣṇoḥ caritaṃ

vṛddhānāṃ ye grahāḥ kecid
ye ca bālagrahāḥ kvacit
narasiṃhasya te dṛṣṭyā
dagdhā ye cāpi yauvane

saṭākarālavadano
narasiṃho mahāravaḥ
grahān aśeṣān niḥśeṣān
karotu jagato hitam

narasiṃha mahāsiṃha
jvālāmālojjvalānana
grahān aśeṣān sarveśa
khāda khādāgnilocana

ye rogā ye mahotpātā
yad viṣaṃ ye mahāgrahāḥ
yāni ca krūrabhūtāni
grahapīḍāś ca dāruṇāḥ
śastrakṣateṣu ye doṣā
jvālāgardabhakādayaḥ

tāni sarvāṇi sarvātman
paramātmañ janārdana
kiṃcid rūpaṃ samāsthāya
vāsudeva vināśaya

kṣiptvā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ
jvālāmālāvibhīṣaṇam
sarvaduṣṭopaśamanaṃ
kuru devavarācyuta

chindhi cchindhi mahāvyādhiṃ
chindhi cchindhi mahāgrahān

chindhi vātaṃ ca dhūtaṃ ca
chindhi ghoraṃ mahāviṣam

sudarśana mahājvāla
chindhi cchindhi mamārayaḥ
sarvaduṣṭāni rakṣāṃsi
kṣapayātivibhīṣaṇa

hāṃ hāṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭkāreṇa
ṭhadvayena hatadviṣaḥ

sudarśanasya mantreṇa
grahā yānti diśo diśaḥ

prācyāṃ pratīcyāṃ ca diśi
dakṣiṇottaratas tathā
rakṣāṃ karotu sarvātmā
narasiṃhaḥ svagarjitaiḥ

yathā viṣṇuṛ jagat sarvaṃ
sadevāsuramānavam
tena satyena duṣṭāni
śamam asya vrajantu vai

yathā viṣṇau smṛte samyak
saṃkṣayaṃ yāti pātakam
satyena tena sakalaṃ
duṣṭam asya praśāmyatu

paramātmā yathā viṣṇur
vedānteṣv abhidhīyate
tena satyena sakalaṃ
duṣṭam asya praśāmyatu

yathā yajñeṣvaro viṣṇur
vedeṣv api tu gīyate
tena satyena sakalaṃ
yan mayoktaṃ tathāstu tat

yathā yajñeśvaro viṣṇur
yajñānte api gīyate
tena satyena sakalaṃ
yan mayoktaṃ tathāstu tat

śāntir astu śivaṃ cāstu
praśāmyatv asukhaṃ ca yat
vāsudevaśarīrotthaiḥ
kuśair nirmārjitaṃ mayā

apāmārjati govindo
naro nārāyaṇas tathā
tavāstu sarvaduḥkhānāṃ
praśamo vacanād dhareḥ

idaṃ śāstraṃ paṭhed yas tu
saptāhan niyataḥ śuciḥ

śāntiṃ samastarogās te
grahāḥ sarve viṣāni ca
bhūtāni ca prayāntv īśe
saṃsmṛte madhusūdane

etat samastarogeṣu
bhūtagrahabhayeṣu ca
apamārjanakaṃ śastaṃ
viṣṇunāmābhimantritam

ete kuśā viṣṇuśarīrasaṃbhavā
janārdano 'haṃ svayaṃ eva cāgataḥ
hataṃ mayā duṣṭam aśeṣam asya
svastho bhavaty eṣa vaco yathā hareḥ

śāntir astu śivaṃ cāstu
duṣṭam asya praśāmyatu
yad asya duritaṃ kiṃcit
tat kṣiptaṃ lavaṇārṇave

svāsthyam asya sadaivāstu

yata evāgataṃ pāpaṃ
tatraiva pratigacchatu

etad rogādipīḍāsu
jantūnāṃ hitam icchatā
viṣṇubhaktena kartavyam
