anena sarvaduṣṭāni
praśamaṃ yānty asaṃśayam
sarvabhūtahitārthāya
kuryāt tasmāt sadaiva hi

etat stotram idaṃ puṇyaṃ
paṭhed āyuṣyavardhanam

tasya pārśvaṃ na gacchanti
stotram etad yathā paṭhet

paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nityaṃ
viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati

surūpatā manuṣyāṇāṃ
strīṇāṃ ca dvijasattama
karmaṇā jāyate yena
tan mamākhyātum arhasi

surūpāṇāṃ sugātrāṇāṃ
suveṣāṇāṃ tathā mune
nyūnaṃ tathādhikaṃ vāpi
kiṃcid aṅgaṃ prajāyate

samastaiḥ śobhanair aṅgair
narāḥ kecit tathā dvija
kāṇāḥ kubjāś ca jāyante
truṭitaśravaṇās tathā

narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ caiva
samastāṅgsurūpatā
karmaṇā yena bhavati
tat sarvaṃ kathayāmala

lāvaṇyagativākyāni
sati rūpe mahāmate
prayānti cārutāṃ rūpaṃ
tenoktaḥ paramo guṇaḥ

vākyalāvaṇyasaṃskāra-
vilāsalalitā gatiḥ
viḍambanā kurūpāṇāṃ
strīpuṃsām abhijāyate

rūpakāraṇabhūtāya
yateta matimāṃs tataḥ
karmaṇā tan mamācakṣva
karma yac cārurūpadam

samyak pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā hīdam
upavāsāśritaṃ dvija
kathayāmi yathā proktaṃ
vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā

vasiṣṭham ṛṣim āsīnaṃ
saptarṣipravaraṃ patim
papracchārundhatī praśnaṃ
yad etad bhavatā vayam

tasyāḥ sa paripṛcchantyā
jagāda munisattamaḥ
yat tac chṛṇuṣva dharmajña
mameha vadato 'khilam

śrūyatāṃ mama yat pṛṣṭas
tvayāhaṃ brahmavādini
surūpatā nṛṇāṃ yena
yoṣitāṃ copajāyate

anabhyarcya yathānyāyam
anārādhya ca keśavam
rūpādikā guṇāḥ kena
prāpyante 'nyena karmaṇā

tasmād ārādhanīyo vai
viṣṇur eva yaśasvini
paratra prāptukāmena
rūpasaṃpatsutādikam

yas tu vāñchati dharmajñe
rūpaṃ sarvāṅgaśobhanam
nakṣatrapuruṣas tena
saṃpūjyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ

nakṣatrāṅgaṃ yathāhāraḥ
samupoṣyati yo harim
surūpair akhilāṅgaiś ca
rūpavān abhijāyate

yoṣitā ca paraṃ rūpam
icchantyā jagataḥ patiḥ
sa evārādhanīyo 'tra
nakṣatrāṅgo janārdanaḥ

nakṣatrarūpī bhagavān
pūjyate puruṣottamaḥ
mune yena vidhānena
tan mamākhyātum arhasi

caitramāsaṃ samārabhya
viṣṇoḥ pādādipūjanam
yathā kurvīta rūpārthī
tan niśāmaya tattvataḥ

nakṣatram ekam ekaṃ vai
snātaḥ samyag upoṣitaḥ
nakṣatrapuruṣasyāṅgaṃ
pūjayet sādhvī cakriṇaḥ

mūle pādau tathā jaṅghe
rohiṇīṣv arcayec chubhe
jānunī cāśvinīyoga
āṣāḍhe corusaṃjñite

phālgunīdvitaye guhyaṃ
kṛttikāsu tathā kaṭim
pārśve bhadrapadāyugme
dve kukṣī revatīṣu ca

anurādha uraḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ
śraviṣṭhāsv abhipūjayet
bhujayugmaṃ viśākhāsu
haste caiva karadvayam

punarvasāv aṅgulīṃś ca
āśleṣāsu tathā nakhān
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ pūjayed grīvaṃ
śravaṇe śravaṇe tathā

puṣye mukhaṃ tathā svātau
daśanān abhipūjayet
hanvau śatabhiṣāyoge
maghāyoge ca nāsikām

mṛgottamāṅge nayane
pūjayed bhaktitaḥ śubhe
citrāyoge lalāṭaṃ ca
bharaṇyāṃ ca tathā śiraḥ
saṃpūjanīyā vidvadbhiś
cādrāsu ca śiroruhāḥ

nakṣatrayogeṣv eteṣu
pūjito jagataḥ patiḥ
nakṣatrapuruṣākhyo 'yaṃ
yathāvat puruṣottamaḥ

pāpāpahāraṃ kurute
samyac chraddhāvatāṃ satām
aṅgopāṅgāni caivāsya
pāpādīni yaśasvini

surūpāny abhijāyante
sapta janmāntarāṇi vai
sarvāṇi caiva bhadrāṇi
śarīrārogyam uttamam

saṃtatiṃ manasaḥ prītiṃ
rūpaṃ cātīvaśobhanam
vāṅmādhūryaṃ tathā kāntiṃ
yac cānyad abhivāñchitam

dadāti nakṣatrapumān
pūjitaś ca janārdanaḥ
upoṣya samyag eteṣu
krameṇa rkṣeṣu śobhane

gandhapuṣpādisaṃyuktaṃ
pūjayitvā yadāvidhi
jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatvā
idaṃ codāharet tataḥ
svarūpam ārogyam atīva varcasaṃ
susaṃtatiṃ tv asthitabhaktim acyutām
api sarvam etaṃ protaṃ
sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
ekapuruṣa mahāpuruṣa
ṛkṣapuruṣa namo 'stu te

nakṣatrajñāya viprāya
dadyād dānaṃ ca śaktitaḥ
pārite ca punar dadyāt
strīpūṃsāṃ cāruhāsini

chattropānadyugaṃ caiva
saptadhānyaṃ sakāñcanam
ghṛtapātraṃ ca dharmajñe
yac cānyad ativallabham

strī vā sādhvī sadā viṣṇor
ārādhanaparāyaṇā
anenaiva vidhānena
saṃpūjyaitad avāpnuyāt

sarvakāmān avāpnoti
samārādhya janārdanam
prakārair bahubhir brahman
yān yān icchati cetasā

nṝṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca viprarṣe
nānyac chokasya kāraṇam
apatyād adhikaṃ kiṃcid
vidyate hy atra janmani

aputratā mahad duḥkham
atiduḥkhaṃ kuputratā
aputraḥ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ
hetubhūto mato mama

dhanyās te ye sutaṃ prāpya
sarvaduḥkhavivarjitam
śastaṃ praśāntaṃ balinaṃ
parāṃ nirvṛtim āgatāḥ

svakarmanirataṃ nityaṃ
devadvijaparāyaṇam
śāstrajñaṃ dharmatattvajñaṃ
dīnānāthajanāśrayam

vinirjitāriṃ sarvasya
manohṛdayanandanam
devānukūlatāyuktaṃ
yuktaṃ samyag guṇena ca

mitrasvajanasammāna-
labdhanirvāṇam uttamam
yaḥ prāpnoti sutaṃ tasmān
nānyo dhanyataro bhuvi

so 'ham icchāmi tac chrotuṃ
tvattaḥ karma mahāmune
yenedṛglakṣaṇaḥ putraḥ
prāpyate bhuvi mānavaiḥ

evam etan mahābhāga
pitroḥ putrasamudbhavam
duḥkhaṃ prayāty upaśamaṃ
tena yeneha kenacit

atrāpi śrūyatāṃ vṛttaṃ
yat pūrvam abhavan mune
utpattau kārtavīryasya
haihayasya mahātmanaḥ

kṛtavīryo mahīpālo
haihayānām abhūt purā
tasya śīladhanā nāma
babhūva varavarṇinī
patnī sahasrapravarā
mahiṣī śīlamaṇḍanā

sā tv aputrā mahābhāgā
maitreyīṃ paryapṛcchata
guṇavatputralābhāya
kṛtāsanaparigrahām

tayā ca pṛṣṭā vai samyag
maitreyī brahmavādinī
kathayām āsa paramaṃ
nāmnānantavrataṃ vratam

sarvakāmaphalāvāpti-
kārakaṃ pāpanāśanam
tasyāḥ sā putralābhāya
rājaputrās tapasvinī

yo 'yam icchen naraḥ kāmaṃ
nārī vā varavarṇini
sa taṃ samārādhya vibhuṃ
samāpnoti janārdanam

mārgaśīrṣe mṛgaśiro
bhīru yasmin dine bhavet
tasmin saṃprāśya gomūtraṃ
snāto niyatamānasaḥ

puṣpair dhūpais tathā gandhair
upahāraiḥ svaśaktitaḥ
vāmapādam anantasya
pūjayed varavarṇini

anantaḥ sarvakāmānām
anantaṃ bhagavān phalam
dadātv anantaṃ ca punas
tad evāstv anyajanmani

anantapuṇyopacayaṃ
karoty etan mahāvratam
yathābhilaṣitāvāptiṃ
kurvan mā kṣayam etu ca

ity uccāryābhipūjyainaṃ
yathāvad vidhinā naraḥ
samāhitamanā bhūtvā
praṇipātapuraḥsaram

viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād
anantaḥ prīyatām iti
samuccārya tato naktaṃ
bhuñjīyāt tailavarjitam

tataś ca pauṣe puṣyarkṣe
tathaiva bhagavatkaṭim
vāmām abhyarcayet kṛtvā
gomūtraprāśanaṃ budhaḥ

anantaḥ sarvakāmānām
iti coccārayed budhaḥ
bhuñjīta ca tathā vipraṃ
vācayitvā yathāvidhi

māghe maghāsu tadvac ca
bāhuṃ devasya pūjayet
skandhaṃ ca phalgunīyoge
phālgune māsi bhāmini

brāhmaṇāya tathā dadyāt
tilān kanakam eva ca

devasya dakṣiṇaskandhaṃ
caitre citrāsu pūjayet
tathaiva prāśanaṃ cātra
pañcagavyam udāhṛtam

vipre vācanake dadyād
yāvan māsacatuṣṭayam
vaiśākhe ca viśākhāsu
bāhuṃ saṃpūjya dakṣiṇam

tathaivoktayavān dadyāt
tadvan naktaṃ bhujikriyā
kaṭipūjāṃ ca jyeṣṭhāsu
jyeṣṭhamūle śubhavrate

āṣāḍhāsu tathāṣāḍhe
kuryāt pādārcanaṃ śubhe
padadvayaṃ ca śravaṇe
śrāvaṇe subhru pūjayet

ghṛtaṃ viprāya dātavyaṃ
prāśanīyaṃ tathā dadhi
kārttikānteṣu māseṣu
prāśanaṃ dānam eva ca

etad eva samākhyātaṃ
devaṃ tadvac ca pūjayet

guhyaṃ proṣṭhapadāyoge
māsi bhādrapade 'rcayet
tadvad āśvayuje pūjyaṃ
hṛdayaṃ cāśvinīṣu vai

kuryāt samāhitamanāḥ
snānaprāśanaśaucavān
anantaśirasaḥ pūjāṃ
kārttike kṛttikāsu ca

yasmin yasmin dine pūjā
tatra tatra tadā dine
nāmānantasya japtavyaṃ
kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu

ghṛtenānantam uddiśya
pūrvamāsacatuṣṭayam
kurvīta homaṃ caitrādau
śālinā kulanandini

kṣīreṇa śrāvaṇādau tu
homaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam
śastaṃ tu sarvamāseṣu
haviṣyānnaṃ ca bhojanam

evaṃ dvādaśabhir māsaiḥ
pāraṇaṃ tritayaṃ śubhe
pārite samavāpnoti
sarvān eva manorathān

putrārthibhir vittakāmair
bhṛtyadārān abhīpsubhiḥ
prārthayadbhiś ca kartavyam
ārogyabalasaṃpadam

etad vrataṃ mahābhāge
puṇyaṃ svastyayanapradam
anantavratasaṃjñaṃ vai
sarvapāpapraṇāśanam

tat kuruṣvaiva devi tvaṃ
vrataṃ śīladhane varam
viśiṣṭaṃ sarvalokasya
yadi putram abhīpsasi

iti śīladhanā śrutvā
maitreyīvacanaṃ śubham
cacāraitad vratavaraṃ
susamāhitamānasā

putrārthinyās tatas tasyā
vratenānena suvrata
viṣṇus tutoṣa tuṣṭe ca
viṣṇau sā suṣuve sutam

tasya vai jātamātrasya
pravavāv anilaḥ śivaḥ
nīrajaskam abhūd vyoma
mudaṃ prāpākhilaṃ jagat

devadundubhayo neduḥ
puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca
prajagur divi gandharvā
nanṛtuś cāpsarogaṇāḥ
dharme manaḥ samastasya
dālbhya lokasya cābhavat

tasya nāma pitā cakre
tanayasyārjuneti vai
kṛtavīryasutatvāc ca
kārtavīryo babhūva saḥ

tenāpi bhagavān viṣṇur
dattātreyasvarūpavān
ārādhito 'timahatā
tapasā dālbhya bhūbhṛtā

tasya tuṣṭo jagannāthaś
cakravartitvam uttamam
dadau śauryabale cāti-
sakalāny āyudhāni ca

sa ca vavre varaṃ deva
vadhas tvatto bhaved iti
purānusmaraṇaṃ jñānaṃ
bhītānāṃ cārtināśanam
smaraṇād upakāritvaṃ
jagato 'sya jagatpate

tam āha devadeveśaḥ
puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ
sarvam etan mahābhāga
tava bhūpa bhaviṣyati

yaś ca prabhāte rātrau ca
tvāṃ naraḥ kīrtayiṣyati
namo 'stu kārtavīryāyety
abhidhāsyati caiva yaḥ
tilaprasthapradānasya
sa naraḥ puṇyam āpsyati

anaṣṭadravyatā caiva
tava nāmābhikīrtanaiḥ
bhaviṣyati mahīpālety
uktvā taṃ prayayau hariḥ

sa cāpi varam āsādya
prasannād garuḍadhvajāt
pālayām āsa bhūpālaḥ
saptadvīpāṃ vasuṃdharām

teneṣṭaṃ vividhair yajñaiḥ
samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ
jitvārivargam akhilaṃ
dharmataḥ pālitāḥ prajāḥ

anantavratamāhātmyād
āsādya tanayaṃ ca tam
pitroḥ putrodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ
nāsīt svalpam api dvija

evam etat samākhyātam
anantākhyaṃ vrataṃ tava
yac cīrtvā rājapatnī sā
kārtavīryam asūyata

yaś caitac chṛṇuyāj janma
kārtavīryasya mānavaḥ
strī vā duḥkham apatyotthaṃ
sapta janmāni nāśnute

rūpasaṃpat samākhyātā
strīpuṃsāṃ jāyate śubhā
samupoṣya jagannāthaṃ
nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ harim

vāso'tiśobhanaṃ cāru-
vastrādyābharaṇojjvalam
gṛhaṃ sarvaguṇopetam
aśeṣopaskarānvitam

karmaṇā yena viprarṣe
toṣito madhusūdanaḥ
dadāti bhagavān karma
tan no vistarato vada

yan māṃ pṛcchasi dālbhya tvaṃ
gṛhopaskarabhūṣaṇam
narāṇāṃ jāyate yena
tat sarvaṃ kathayāmi te

nandā bhadrā jayā riktā
pūrṇā ca dvijasattama
tithayo vai samākhyātāḥ
pratipatkramasaṃjñayā

pañcamī daśamī caiva
tathā pañcadaśī tithiḥ
pūrṇā etāḥ samākhyātāṣ
tithayo munisattama

mṛdā dhātuvikārair vā
varṇakair gomayena vā
viṣṇor āyatane tāsu
yaḥ karoty upalepanam

pravātāvātaguṇavad
varṣāsv atimanoramam
anuliptaṃ śubhākāraṃ
sugṛhaṃ labhate mune

pūrṇaṃ dhānyahiraṇyādyair
maṇimuktāphalojjvalam
pratyāsannajalābhogaṃ
gṛham āpnoti śobhanam

sāmnatasvajanānāṃ yat
sarveṣām uttamottamam
tad āpnoti gṛhaṃ brahmann
anulepanakṛn naraḥ

yenānulipte tiṣṭhanti
viṣṇvāyatanabhūtale
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśaḥ
śūdrāḥ sādhvyas tathā striyaḥ
tasya pūṇyaphalaṃ dālbhya
śrūyatāṃ yat prajāyate

apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ
muktāhāragaṇojjvalam
śreṣṭhaṃ sarvavimānānāṃ
svarge dhiṣṇyam avāpnute

yāvatyas tithayo liptaṃ
divyābdāṃs tāvato dvija
tasmin vimāne sa naraḥ
strī vā tiṣṭhati sattama

sugandhagandhasadvastra-
sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ
gandharvāpsarasāṃ saṃbhaiḥ
pūjyamānaḥ sa tiṣṭhati

liptaṃ ca yāvato hastān
viṣṇor āyatanaṃ dvija
tāvadyojanavistīrṇa-
svargasthānādhipo hi saḥ

pūjyamānaḥ suragaṇaiḥ
śītoṣṇādivivarjitaḥ
manojñagātro viprendras
tiṣṭhaty astāghasaṃhatiḥ

cyutas tasmād ihāgamya
viśiṣṭe jāyate kule
tato 'sya sadgṛhavaraṃ
martyaloke 'bhijāyate

na tatra tāvad dāridryaṃ
nopasargā na vā kaliḥ
na cāpi mṛtaniṣkrāntir
yāvaj jīvaty asau dvija

viṣṇuḥ samastabhūtāni
sasarjaitāni yāni vai
teṣāṃ madhye jagaddhātur
atīveṣṭā vasuṃdharā

kṛte saṃmārjane tasyās
tathaivoparilepane
prayāti paramaṃ toṣaṃ
vaiṣṇavīyaṃ mahī yataḥ

brahman yena vidhānena
devāgāropalepalam
kartavyaṃ puruṣaiḥ samyak
strībhir vā tad udīraya

riktāyās tu tither madhye
kuryāt saṃkalpam ātmanaḥ
upalepanakṛd vipro
viṣṇor āyatane bhuvi

dvitīye 'hni tato devaṃ
praṇamya yatamānasaḥ
dharaṇīpitaraṃ viṣṇum
idaṃ vākyam udīrayet

tvaṃ sarvabhūtaprabhavo jagatpate
tvayy etad īśeśa jagat pratiṣṭhitam
tvam eva bhūtāni yatas tato 'haṃ
tvām pūjayāmy adya mahīsvarūpam

tvaṃ mahī jagatāṃ nātha
sarvanātha namo 'stu te
śuśrūṣitaḥ prasīdeśa
bhuvo lepanakarmaṇā

ity uccārya kṣitau kṣiptvā
prathamaṃ dhāranītale
puṣpāṇi vā dvijaśreṣṭha
yaḥ karoty anulepanam
na tasya jāyate bhaṅgo
gārhasthyasya kadācana

yā ca nārī karoty evaṃ
yathāvad anulepanam
nāpnoti sā ca vaidhavyaṃ
gṛhabhaṅgaṃ kadācana

kṛtvopalepanaṃ bhūyaḥ
praṇipatya janārdanam
snāto viṣṇuṃ samabhyarcya
idaṃ vākyam udīrayet

prasīda bhūdharānanta
mayā yad upalepanam
kṛtaṃ tena samastaṃ me
nāśam abhyetu pātakam

evaṃ saṃpūjya bhuñjīyād
aparāhne dvijottama
svanulipte mahābhāge
bhuktvā limpec ca tat punaḥ

pakṣe pakṣe trirātraṃ tu
yaḥ karoty upalepanam
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ
svargaṃ gacchaty asaṃśayam

tatkṣayāt svargeloke tu
jāto gṛhavaraṃ yathā
samāpnoti yathākhyātaṃ
tat sarvaṃ tava sattama

sarvābharaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ
sarvopaskaradhānyavat
gomahiṣyādisaṃbhogaṃ
gṛham āpnoti mānavaḥ

tasmād abhīpsatā samyag
gārhasthyam avikhaṇḍitam
viṣṇor āyatane kāryaṃ
sarvadaivopalepanam

alpopalepanād yasya
māndhātā sakalāṃ mahīm
avāpa viṣṇvāyatanaṃ
nopalimpeta ko hi tat

dīpaṃ prayacchati naro
viṣṇor āyatane hi yaḥ
sadakṣiṇasya yajñasya
phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam

kārttike tu viśeṣeṇa
kaumude māsi dīpakam
dattvā yat phalam āpnoti
dālbhya tat kena labhyate

dālbhyānyad api vakṣyāmi
purāvṛttam idaṃ śṛṇu
vidarbharājatanayā
lalitā yad uvāca ha

vidarbharāṭ citraratho
babhūvāstraviśāradaḥ
tasya putraśataṃ rājño
jajñe pañcadaśottaram

ekaiva kanyā dālbhyāsīl
lalitā nāmanāmataḥ
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇā
bhrātṝṇāṃ pitur eva ca

samastabhṛtyavargasya
mātṝṇāṃ svajanasya ca
tathaiva pauravargasya
yaś cānyo dadṛśe śubhām
tasya tasyāticārvaṅgī
babhūveṣṭā dvijottama

tāṃ dadau kāśirājāya
sa pitā cāruvarmane
upayeme ca tāṃ subhrūṃ
cāruvarmā mahīpatiḥ

śatāny anyāni bhāryāṇāṃ
trīṇy āsaṃś cāruvarmaṇaḥ
tāsāṃ madhye 'gramahiṣī
lalitā tasya cābhavat

sā ca nityaṃ jagaddhātur
devadevasya cakriṇaḥ
dīpavartiparā tadvat
tailasyāharaṇodyatā

viṣṇor āyatane tasyāḥ
sahasraṃ dvijasattama
dīpānāṃ vai prajajvāla
divārātram atandritam

tasyā dyutiparābhūtās
tasyā lāvaṇyanirjitāḥ
sarvāḥ sapatnyo lalitāṃ
papracchur idam āditaḥ

lalite vada bhadraṃ te
bhadraṃ te lalite vada
kautūhalaparāḥ sarvā
yat pṛcchāmas tad ucyatām

viṣaye sati vaktavyaṃ
yan mayā tad ihocyatām
nāhaṃ matsariṇī bhadrā
na ca rāgādidūṣitā

bhavatyo mama sarvāsāṃ
bhavatīnām ahaṃ tathā
apṛthagbhartṛsāmanyā
devalokābhikāmukāḥ

pūrvaṃ yūyam ahaṃ caiva
bhavatīnāṃ sadharmiṇī

na tathā puṣpadhūpeṣu
na tathā dvijapūjane
prayatnaṃ tava paśyāmo
viṣṇor āyatane śubhe

yathāhani tathā rātrau
yathā rātrau tathāhani
tava dīpapradānāya
yathā subhru sadodyamaḥ

tad etat kathayāsmākaṃ
lalite kautukaṃ param
manyāmo dīpadānasya
bhavatyā viditaṃ phalam

evam uktā tatas tābhir
lalitā lalitaṃ vacaḥ
vyājahāra sapatnīs tā
na kiṃcid api bhāminī

punaḥ punaś ca sā tābhir
bahuṣo dālbhya coditā
dākṣiṇyasārā lalitā
kathāyām āsa bhāminī

kautukaṃ bhavatīnāṃ ced
atīvālpe 'pi vastuni
tad eṣā kathayāmy etad
yad vṛttaṃ mama śobhanāḥ

sauvīrarājasya purā
maitreyo 'bhūt purohitaḥ
tena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ
kāritaṃ devikātaṭe

ahany ahani śuśrūṣāṃ
puṣpadhūpopalepanaiḥ
dīpadānādibhiś caiva
cakre tatra sa vai dvijaḥ

kārttike dīpako brahman
pradattas tena vai tadā
āsīn nirvāṇabhūyiṣṭho
devārcāpurato niśi

devatāyatane cāsaṃ
tatrāham api mūṣikā
pradīpavartiharaṇe
kṛtabuddhir varānanāḥ

gṛhītā ca mayā vartir
vṛṣadaṃśo nanāda ca
naṣṭā cāhaṃ tadā tasya
mārjārasya bhayāturā

vartiprāntena naśyantyā
sa dīpaḥ prerito mayā
jajvāla pūrvavad dīptyā
tasminn āyatane punaḥ

mṛtāhaṃ ca tato jātā
vaidarbhī rājakanyakā
jātismarā kāntimatī
bhavatīnāṃ samā guṇaiḥ

eṣa prabhāvo dīpasya
kārttike māsi śobhanāḥ
dattasya viṣṇvāyatane
yasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭir uttamā

asaṃkalpitam apy asya
preraṇaṃ yat kṛtaṃ mayā
viṣṇvāyatanadīpasya
yasyedaṃ bhujyate phalam

lobhābhibhūtā hartuṃ taṃ
pradīpam aham āgatā
avaśenaiva tadvartyā
preraṇaṃ tatra me kṛtam

tato jātismṛtir janma
mānuṣyaṃ śobhanaṃ vapuḥ
vaśyaḥ patiḥ pṛthivīśaḥ
kiṃ punar dīpadāyinām

etasmāt kāraṇād dīpān
aham etān aharniśam
prayacchāmi harer dhāmni
jñātam asya hi yat phalam

bhavatīnām idaṃ satyaṃ
mayoktaṃ keśavālaye
mūṣikatvād ahaṃ yena
karmaṇā siddhim āgatā

eṣa prabhāvo dīpasya
kārttike māsi sattama
viṣṇvāyatanadattasya
jagāda lalitā yathā

dine dine jagannātha
keśaveti samāhitaḥ
dadāti kārttike yas tu
viṣṇvāyatanadīpakam

jātismaratvaṃ prajñāṃ ca
prākāśyaṃ sarvavastuṣu
avyāhatendriyatvaṃ ca
saṃprāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ

śeṣakāle ca cakṣuṣmān
medhāvī dīpado naraḥ
jāyate narakaṃ vāpi
tamaḥsaṃjñaṃ na paśyati

ekādaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ vā
pratipakṣaṃ ca yo naraḥ
dīpaṃ dadāti kṛṣṇāya
tasyāpi śṛṇu yat phalam

suvarṇamaṇimuktāḍhyaṃ
manojñam atiśobhanam
dīpamālākulaṃ divyaṃ
vimānaṃ so 'dhirohati

tasmād āyatane viṣṇor
dadyād dīpaṃ dvijottama
tāṃś ca dattān na hiṃseta
na ca tailaviyojitān
kurvīta dīpahartā tu
mūko 'ndho jāyate yataḥ

jāyate narakaṃ cāpi
tapaḥsaṃjñaṃ sa paśyati

andhe tāmasi duṣpāre
narake patitān kila
vikrośamānān kṣutkṣāmāñ
jagāda yamakiṃkaraḥ

vilāpair alam atrāpi
kiṃ vo vilapite phalam
yadā pramādibhiḥ pūrvam
ātmātyantam upekṣitaḥ

pūrvam ālocitaṃ naitat
kim apy ante bhaviṣyati
idānīṃ yātanābhogaḥ
kiṃ vilāpaḥ kariṣyati

deho dināni svalpāni
viṣayāś cātidurdharāḥ
etat ko na vijānāti
yena yūyaṃ pramādinaḥ

jantujanmasahasrebhya
etasmin mānuṣyo yadi
tatrāpy ativimūḍhatvāt
kiṃ bhogān abhidhāvati

viruddhaviṣayāsvāda-
muditair hasitaṃ ca yat
bhavadbhir āgataṃ duḥkhaṃ
vilāpapariṇāmikam

adyakālikayā buddhyā
yad āgāmi na cintitam
paritāpāya taj jātaṃ
duḥkhaṃ karmavipākajam

svalpam āyur manuṣyāṇāṃ
tadante paratantratā
bhujyate ca kṛtaṃ pūrvam
etat kiṃ vo na cintitam

yad abhūt paradāreṣu
prītaye 'ṅgakucādikam
yātanāduḥkharūpāya
narake ca tad āgatam

paradāramanohāri
yad bhavadbhir agīyata
hā māta ityādi rutaṃ
tad idānīṃ vilapyate

saṃdigdhaparalokānām
aihike nihatātmanām
mṛtānāṃ svakṛtaṃ karma
paścāttāpāya kevalam

muhūrtārdhasukhāsvāda-
lubdhānām akṛtātmanām
anekavarṣakoṭiṣu
duḥkhadaṃ karma jāyate

hā mātas tāta tāteti
bhavadbhiḥ kiṃ vilapyate
śubhāśubhaṃ nijaṃ karma
tad adya hy atra bhujyate

putradāragṛhakṣetra-
hitāya satatodyatāḥ
na kurvatni kathaṃ mūḍhāḥ
svalpam apy ātmano hitam

vañcito 'sau mayā labdham
idam asmād upāyataḥ

na vetti kaścid ātmārthaṃ
vetti prakramato naraḥ

na vetti sūryacandrādīn
kālam ātmānam eva ca
sākṣibhūtān aśeṣasya
śubhasyehāśubhasya ca

janmāny anyāni jāyante
putradārādidehinām
tadarthaṃ yat kṛtaṃ karma
tasya janmaśatāni tat

aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ
mamatvaṃ narakeṣv api
krandate mātaraṃ tātaṃ
pīḍyamāno 'pi yat svayam

evam ākṛṣṭacittānāṃ
viṣayāsvādatarṣulaiḥ
nṝṇāṃ na jāyate buddhiḥ
paramārthāvalokinī
tathā ca viṣayāsaktiṃ
karoty avirataṃ manaḥ

vartitaile 'lpamaulye 'pi
yad agnir labhyate mudhā
ato 'dhikataro lobhaḥ
ko vaś citte 'bhavat tadā

yeneyaṃ teṣu hasteṣu
svātantrye sati dīpakaḥ
mahāphalo viṣṇugṛhe
na datto narakāpahaḥ

na vo vilapite kiṃcid
idānīṃ dṛśyate phalam
asvātantrye vilapatāṃ
svātantrye 'tipramādinām

avaśyaṃpātinaḥ prāṇā
bhoktā jīvo hy aharniśam
dattaṃ ca labhate bhoktā
samaye viṣayān iti

etat svātantryavadbhir vo
yuktam āsīt parīkṣitum
idānīṃ kiṃ vilāpena
sahadhvaṃ yad upāgatam

yady etad anabhīṣṭaṃ vo
yad duḥkhaṃ samupasthitam
tad bhūyo 'pi matiḥ pāpe
na kartavyā kathaṃcana

kṛte 'pi pāpake karmaṇy
ajñānād aghanāśanam
kartavyam avyavasthitaṃ
smaradbhir madhusūdanam

nārakās tadvacaḥ śrutvā
tām ūcur atiduḥkhitāḥ
kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhās tṛṣayā
parisphuṭitatālukāḥ

bho bho sādho kṛtaṃ karma
yad asmābhis tad ucyatām
narakasthair vipāko 'yaṃ
bhujyate yasya dāruṇaḥ

yuṣmābhir yauvanonmāda-
muditair avivekibhiḥ
dyūtodyotāya govinda-
gṛhād dīpaḥ purā hṛtaḥ

tenāsmin narake ghore
kṣuttṛṣṇāparipīḍitāḥ
bhavantaḥ patitās tīvra-
śītavātavidāritāḥ

etat te dīpadānasya
pradīpaharaṇasya ca
puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ ca kathitaṃ
keśavāyatane dvija

sarvatraiva hi dīpasya
pradānaṃ dvija śasyate
viśeṣeṇa jagaddhātuḥ
keśavasya niveśane

ye 'ndhā mūkā niḥśrutā nirvivekā
hīnās tais taiḥ sādhanair vipravarya
tais tair dīpāḥ sādhulokapradattā
devāgārād anyato vipraṇītāḥ

āhlādaṃ cakṣuṣaḥ prītiṃ
karoti manasas tathā
keṣāṃcid darśanaṃ brahman
manuṣyāṇām aharniśam

udvejanīyā bhūtānām
animittaṃ tathāpare
vadante vipriyaṃ naiva
prītiṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ

etad yasya phalaṃ brahman
dānasya tapaso 'thavā
upavāsasya vā tan me
yathāvad vaktum arhasi

aprītidasya viprarṣe
vipāko yasya karmaṇaḥ
manuṣyāṇām aśeṣaṃ vai
tan mamācakṣva sattama

devabrāhmaṇavedeṣu
yajñeṣu ca narādhamaiḥ
yair jugupsā kṛtā dālbhya
manasāpy atimānibhiḥ

teṣāṃ saṃdarśanāt sarvo
na sukhaṃ vindate dvija
vadanty apy anukūlāni
na teṣu prīyate janaḥ

sparśād udvijate lokaḥ
kaṭu teṣāṃ ca darśanam
saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ ca nindā vai
kṛtā vedadvijātike

tasmān na nindāṃ vedādau
na jugupsāṃ ca paṇḍitaḥ
yajñādau ca naraḥ kuryād
ya icchec chreya ātmanaḥ

yais tu prītiḥ samasteṣu
vedadevadvijātiṣu
yajñādike caiva kṛtā
dālbhya taddarśanaṃ nṛṇām

āhlādaś cakṣuṣaḥ prītir
manaso nirvṛtiḥ parā
saṃbhāṣaṇe tathāhlādaḥ
sarvalokasya jāyate

stutāḥ praśastāḥ saṃprītyā
pūjitā bahumānataḥ
śreyaḥ paraṃ prayacchanti
devā vedā makhā dvijāḥ

lokadvaye 'pi cāprītiṃ
paśuputradhanakṣayam
kurvanti dvijaśārdūla
eta eva vininditāḥ

eta eva samākhyātāḥ
stavādigrahaṇe guṇāh
nindāyāḥ śravaṇe doṣa
eteṣām evam eva hi

tasmāt stavyāḥ praśaṃsyāś ca
devā vedā dvijātayaḥ
yajñāś ca manasāpy eṣāṃ
na nindām ācared budhaḥ

anāyāsena bhagavan
dānenānyena kenacit
pāpaṃ praśamam āyāti
yena tad vaktum arhasi

śṛṇu dālbhya mahāpuṇyāṃ
dvādaśīṃ pāpanāśanīm
yām upoṣya paraṃ puṇyaṃ
prāpnute śraddhayānvitaḥ

māghamāse tu saṃprāpta
āṣāḍhārkṣaṃ bhaved yadi
mūlaṃ vā kṛṣṇapakṣasya
dvādaśyāṃ niyatas tadā

gṛhṇīyāt puṇyaphaladaṃ
vidhānaṃ tasya me śṛṇu
devadevaṃ samabhyarcya
susnātaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ

kṛṣṇanāmnā ca saṃstūya
ekādaśyāṃ mahāmate
upoṣito dvitīye 'hni
punaḥ saṃpūjya keśavam

saṃstūya nāmnā ca tataḥ
kṛṣṇākhyena punaḥ punaḥ
dadyāt tilāṃs tu viprāya
kṛṣṇo me prīyatām iti
snānaprāśanayoḥ śastās
tathā kṛṣṇatilā mune

tilaprarohe jāyante
yāvatsaṃkhyās tilā dvija
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi
svargaloke mahīyate

jātaś cehāpy arogo 'sau
naro janmani janmani
nāndho na badhiraś ceha
na kuṣṭhī na jugupsitaḥ
bhavaty etām uṣitvā tu
tilākhyāṃ dvādaśīṃ naraḥ

viṣṇoḥ prīṇanam atroktaṃ
samāpte varṣapāraṇe
pūjāṃ ca kuryād viprāya
bhūyo dadyāt tathā tilān

anena dālbhya vidhinā
tiladānād asaṃśayam
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvair
nirāyāsena mānavaḥ

dānavidhis tathā śraddhā
sarvapātakaśāntaye
nārthaḥ prabhūto nāyāsaḥ
śārīro munisattama

anantasyāprameyasya
vyāpinaḥ paramātmanaḥ
nāmnāṃ nakṣatrabhedena
tithibhedena vā dvija

dānabhedena cākhyāto
vibhinnaphaladas tvayā
viśeṣaḥ kṣetrabhedena
kathyatāṃ yadi vidyate

yatha rkṣatithibhedena
teṣām eva punaḥ punaḥ
viśeṣaḥ kathito nāmnāṃ
viśeṣaphaladāyakaḥ
tathā kṣetraviśeṣeṇa
bhedaṃ nāmakṛtaṃ vada

śṛṇu dālbhya yathākhyātam
arjunāya mahātmane
praṇipātaprasannena
viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā

kṛte bhārāvataraṇe
nivṛtte bhārate raṇe
āgamya śibiraṃ viṣṇū
rathasthaḥ prāha phālgunam

iṣudhīgāṇḍivaṃ caiva
samādāya tvarānvitaḥ
avatīrya rathād vīra
dūre tiṣṭḥa dhanaṃjaya

avarokṣyāmy ahaṃ paścād
avatīrṇe tatas tvayi
etat kuru mahābāho
mā vilambasva phālguna

evam uktas tathā cakre
vākyaṃ pārtho gadādhṛtaḥ
avārohat tataḥ paścāt
svayam eva janārdanaḥ

avatīrṇe jagannāthe
svasamutthena vahninā
jajvāla sa rathaḥ sadyo
bhasmībhūtaś ca tatkṣaṇāt
sopaskarapatāko 'tha
sadhvajaḥ saha vājibhiḥ

sacchattro vahninā sadyo
ratho bhasmalavīkṛtaḥ
vahninā ca yathā kāṣṭhaṃ
sadyo bhasmalavīkṛtam

tad adbhutaṃ mahad dṛṣṭvā
pārthaḥ papraccha keśavam
hṛṣṭaromā dvijaśreṣṭha
bhayavismayagadgadaḥ

āścaryaṃ puruṣavyāghra
kim etan madhusūdana
vināgninā ratho 'yaṃ me
dagdhas tṛṇacayo yathā

bhīṣmadroṇakṛpādīnāṃ
karṇādīnāṃ ca phālguna
dagdho 'strair vividhair eṣa
pūrvam eva rathas tava

madadhiṣṭhitatvāt kaunteya
na śīrṇo 'yaṃ tadābhavat
pratyahan niśi cakreṇa
mayā nyastena rakṣitaḥ

so 'yaṃ dagdho mahābāho
tvayy adya kṛtakarmaṇi
mayāvatārite cakre
mā pārtha kuru vismayam

kaṃ bhavantam ahaṃ vidyām
atimānuṣaceṣṭitam
karmaṇātyadbhutenāgnir
dhūmenaiveha sūcitaḥ

pūrvam eva yathākhyātaṃ
raṇārambhe tavārjuna
kālo 'smi lokanāśāya
pravṛtto 'haṃ yathādhunā

tan mayā sādhitaṃ kāryaṃ
tridaśānāṃ tathā bhuvaḥ
bhārāvataraṇārthāya
mama janma mahītale

evam ukto 'rjunaḥ samyak
praṇipatya janārdanam
tuṣṭāva vāgbhir iṣṭābhir
udbhūtapulakas tataḥ

namo 'stu te cakradharograrūpa
namo 'stu te śārṅgadharāruṇākṣa
namo 'stu te 'bhyudyatakhaḍga raudra
namo 'stu vibhrāntagadāntakārin

bhayena sanno 'smi savepathena
nāṅgāni me deva vaśaṃ prayānti
vācaḥ samuccārayataḥ skhalanti
keśā hṛṣīkeśa samucchvasanti

kālo bhavān kālakarālakarmā
yenaitad evaṃ kṣayam akṣayātman
kṣatraṃ samudbhūtaruṣā samastam
nītaṃ bhuvo bhāravirecanāya

prasīda kartar jaya lokanātha
prasīda sarvasya ca pālanāya
sthitau samastasya ca kālarūpa
kṛtodyameśāna jayāvyayātman

na me dṛg eṣā tava rūpam etad
draṣṭuṃ samarthā kṣubhito 'smi cāntaḥ
pūrvasvabhāvasthitavigraho 'pi
saṃlakṣyase 'tyantam asaumyarūpa

smarāmi rūpaṃ tava viśvarūpaṃ
yad darśitaṃ pūrvam abhūn mamaiva
yasmin mayā viśvam aśeṣam āsīd
dṛṣṭaṃ sayakṣoragadevadaityam

sā me smṛtir darśanabhāṣanādi-
prakurvato nātha gatā praṇāśam
kālo 'ham asmīty udite tvayā tu
samāgateyaṃ punar apy ananta

kartā bhavān kāraṇam apy aśeṣam
kāryaṃ ca niṣkāraṇa kartṛrūpa
ādau sthitau saṃharaṇe ca deva
viśvasya viśvaṃ svayam eva ca tvam

brahmā bhavān viśvasṛg ādikāle
viśvasya rūpo 'si tathā visṛṣṭau
viṣṇuḥ sthitau pālanabaddhakakṣo
rudro bhavān saṃharaṇe prajānām

ebhis tribhir nātha vibhūtibhedair
yaś cintyate kāraṇam ātmano 'pi
vedāntavedoditam asti viṣṇoḥ
padaṃ dhruvaṃ tat paramaṃ tvam eva

yan nirguṇaṃ sarvavikalpahīnam
anantam asthūlam arūpagandham
paraṃ padaṃ vedavido vadanti
tvam eva tac chabdarasādihīnam

yathā hi mūle viṭapī mahādrumaḥ
pratiṣṭhitaskandhavarograśākhaḥ
tathā samastāmaramartyatiryag-
vyomādiśabdādimayaṃ tvayīdam

muñcāmi yāvat paramāyudhāni
vairiṣv anantāhavadurmadeṣu
dṛṣṭvā hi tāvat sahasā patanto
nūnaṃ tavaivācyuta sa prabhāvaḥ

hatā hatās te bhavato dṛśaiva
mayā punaḥ keśava śastrapūgaiḥ
kāh karṇabhīṣmapramukhān vijetuṃ
yuṣmatprasādena vinā samarthaḥ

triśūlapāṇir mama yaḥ purastān
niṣūdayan vairibalaṃ jagāma
jñātaṃ mayā sāṃpratam etad īśa
tava prasādasya hi sā vibhūtiḥ

yamendravitteśajaleśavahni-
sūryātmako yaś ca mamāstrapūgaḥ
nāśāya nābhūt patito 'pi kāye
tvatsaṃnidhānasya hi so 'nubhāvaḥ

bālye bhavān yāni cakāra deva
karmāṇy asahyāni surāsurāṇām
tair eva jānīma na yat paraṃ tvāṃ
doṣaḥ sa nirdoṣo manuṣyatāyāḥ

tālocchritāgraṃ gurubhārasāram
āyāmavistāravad adyajātaḥ
pādāgravikṣepavibhinnabhāṇḍaṃ
cikṣepa ko 'nyaḥ śakaṭaṃ yathā tvam

anyena kenācyuta pūtanāyāḥ
prāṇaiḥ samaṃ pītam asṛgvimiśram
tvayā yathā stanyam atīvabālye
goṣṭhe ca bhagnau yamalārjunau tau

viṣānaloṣṇāmbunipātabhīmam
āsphoṭya ko vā bhuvi manuṣo 'nyaḥ
nanarta pādābjanipīḍitasya
phaṇaṃ samāruhya ca kāliyasya

sureśasaṃdeśavirodhavatsu
varṣatsu megheṣu gavān nimittam
dināni saptāsti ca kasya śaktir
govardhanaṃ dhārayituṃ kareṇa

pralambacāṇūramukhān nihatya
kaṃsāsuraṃ yasya bibheti śakraḥ
tam aṣṭavarṣo nijaghāna ko 'nyo
nirāyodho nātha manuṣyajanmā

bāṇārtham abhyudyatam ugraśūlaṃ
nirjitya saṃkhye tripurārim ekaḥ
sakārttikeyajvaram astrabāhuṃ
karoti ko bāṇam anacyuto 'nyaḥ

kaḥ pārijātaṃ surasundarīṇāṃ
sadopabhogyaṃ vijitendrasainyaḥ
svargān mahīm ucchritavīryadhairyaḥ
samānayām āsa yathā prabho tvam

hatvā hayagrīvam udāravīryaṃ
niśumbhaśumbhau narakaṃ ca ko 'nyaḥ
jagrāha kanyāpuram ātmano 'rthaṃ
prāgjyotiṣākhye nagare mahātman

sthitau sthitas tvaṃ paripāsi viśvaṃ
tais tair upāyair avinītabhītaiḥ
maitrī na yeṣāṃ vinayāya tāṃs tān
sarvān bhavān saṃharate 'vyayātman

hitāya teṣāṃ kapilādirūpiṇā
tvayānuśastā bahavo 'nujīvāḥ
yeṣāṃ na maitrī hṛdi te na neyā
viśvopakārī vadha eva teṣām

itthaṃ bhavān duṣṭavadhena nūnaṃ
viśvopakārāya vibho pravṛttaḥ
sthitau sthitaṃ pālanam eva viṣṇuḥ
karoti hanty antagato 'ntarudraḥ

etāni cānyāni ca duṣkarāṇi
dṛṣṭāni karmāṇi tathāpi satyam
manyāmahe tvāṃ jagataḥ prasūtiṃ
kiṃ kurma māyā tava mohanīyam

tvaṃ sarvam etat tvayi sarvam etat
tvattas tathaitat tava caitad īśa
etat svarūpaṃ tava sarvabhūtaṃ
vibhūtibhedair bahubhiḥ sthitasya

prasīda kṛṣṇācyuta vāsudeva
janārdanānanta nṛsiṃha viṣṇo
manuṣyasāmānyadhiyā yadīśa
dṛṣṭo mayā tat kṣamasvādideva

na vedmi sadbhāvam ahaṃ tavādya
sadbhāvabhūtasya carācarasya
yo vai bhavān ko 'pi nato 'smi tasmai
manuṣyarūpāya caturbhujāya

devadeva jagannātha
sarvapāpaharo bhava
hetumātras tv ahaṃ tatra
tvayaitad upasaṃhṛtam

prasīdeśa hṛṣīkeśa
akṣauhiṇyā daśāṣṭa ca
tvayā grastā bhuvo bhūtyai
hetubhūtā hi madvidhāḥ

vayam anye ca govinda
narāḥ krīḍanakās tava
madvidhaiḥ karaṇair deva
karoṣi sthitipālanam

yad atra sad asad vāpi
kiṃcid uccāritaṃ mayā
bhaktimān iti tat sarvaṃ
kṣantavyaṃ mama keśava

evaṃ stutas tataḥ prāha
prītimāṃs taṃ janārdanaḥ
pariṣvajya mahābāhuṃ
samāśvāsya ca phālgunam

yas tvāṃ vetti sa māṃ vetti
yas tvām anu sa mām anu
abhedenātmanā vedmī
tvām ahaṃ pāṇḍunandana

mamāṃśatvaṃ mahābāho
jagataḥ pālanecchayā
bhuvo bhārāvatārārthaṃ
pṛthak pārtha mayā kṛtam

devadaityoragā yakṣā
gandharvāḥ kiṃnarāpsarāḥ
rākṣasāś ca piśācāś ca
paśupakṣisarīsṛpāḥ

vṛkṣagulmādayaḥ śailāḥ
sarvabhūtāni cārjuna
mamaivāṃśāni bhūtāni
viddhi sarvāṇy ariṃdama

bhagavan sarvabhūtātman
sarvabhūteṣu vai bhavān
paramātmasvarūpeṇa
sthitaṃ vedmi tad avyayam

kṣetreṣu yeṣu yeṣu tvaṃ
cintanīyo mayācyuta
cetasaḥ praṇidhānārthaṃ
tan mamākhyātum arhasi

yatra yatra ca yan nāma
prītaye bhavataḥ stutau
prasādasumukho nātha
tan mamāśeṣato vada

sarvagaḥ sarvabhūto 'haṃ
na hi kiṃcid mayā vinā
carācare jagaty asmin
vidyate kurusattama

tathāpi yeṣu sthāneṣu
cintanīyo 'ham arjuna
stotavyo nāmabhir yais tu
śrūyatāṃ tad vadāmi te

puṣkare puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ
gayāyāṃ ca gadādharam
lohadaṇḍe tathā viṣṇuṃ
stuvaṃs tarati duṣkṛtam

rāghavaṃ citrakūṭe tu
prabhāse daityasūdanam
vṛndāvane ca govindaṃ
mā stuvan puṇyabhāg bhavet

jayaṃ jayantyāṃ tadvac ca
jayantaṃ hastināpure
vārāhaṃ kardamāle tu
kāśmīre cakrapāṇinam

janārdanaṃ ca kubjāmre
mathurāyāṃ ca keśavam
kubjake śrīdharaṃ tadvad
gaṅgādvāre surottamam

śālagrāme mahāyogiṃ
hariṃ govardhanācale
piṇḍārake caturbāhuṃ
śaṅkhoddhāre ca śaṅkhinam

vanamālaṃ ca kiṣkindhāyāṃ
devaṃ raivatake dvija
kāśījale mahāyogaṃ
devaṃ cāmitatejasam
vaiśākhayūpe ajitaṃ
virajāyāṃ viprakṣayam

śvetadvīpapatiṃ cāpi
gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame
bhūdharaṃ devikānadyāṃ
prayāge caiva mādhavam

naranārāyaṇākhyaṃ ca
tathā badarikāśrame
samudre dakṣiṇe stavyaṃ
padmanābheti phālguna

dvārakāyāṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ
stuvaṃs tarati durgatim
rāmaṃ nāma mahendrādrau
hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathārbude

aśvatīrthe hayagrīvaṃ
viśvarūpaṃ himācale
nṛsiṃhaṃ kṛtasauce ca
vipāśāyāṃ dvijapriyam

naimiṣe yajñapuruṣaṃ
jambūmārge tathācyutam
anantaṃ saindhavāraṇye
daṇḍake śāṅgadhāriṇam

utpalāvartake śauriṃ
narmadāyāṃ śriyaḥ patim
dāmodaraṃ raivatake
nandāyāṃ jalaśāyinam

sarvayogeśvaraṃ caiva
sindhusāgarasaṃgame
sahyādrau devadeveśaṃ
vaikuṇṭhaṃ māgadhe vane

sarvapāpaharaṃ vindhye
uḍreṣu puruṣottamam
hṛdaye cāpi kaunteya
paramātmānam ātmanaḥ

vaṭe vaṭe vaiśravaṇaṃ
catvare catvare śivam
parvate parvate rāmaṃ
sarvatra madhusūdanam

naraṃ bhūmau tathā vyomni
kaunteya garuḍadhvajam
vāsudevaṃ ca sarvatra
saṃsmarañ jyotiṣāṃ patim

arcayan praṇamaṃs tu tvaṃ
saṃsmaraṃś ca dhanaṃjaya
eteṣv etāni nāmāni
naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate

sthāneṣv eteṣu mannāmnām
eteṣāṃ prīṇanaṃ naraḥ
dvijānāṃ prīṇanaṃ kṛtvā
svargaloke 'bhijāyate

nāmāny etāni kaunteya
sthānāny etāni cātmavān
jayaṃ vai pañcapañcāśat
trisandhyaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ

trīṇi janmāni yat pāpam
avasthātritaye kṛtam
tat kṣālayaty asaṃdigdhaṃ
jāyate ca satāṃ kule

dviṣkālaṃ vā japann eva
divārātrau ca yat kṛtam
tasmād vimucyate pāpāt
sadbhāvaparamo naraḥ

japtāny etāni kaunteya
sakṛcchraddhāsamanvitam
mocayante naraṃ pāpād
yat tatraiva dine kṛtam

dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ
jayaṃ kuru kulodvaha
grahānukūlatāṃ caiva
karoty āśu na saṃśayaḥ

upoṣito matparamaḥ
sthāneṣv eteṣu mānavaḥ
kṛtāyatanavāsaś ca
prāpnoty abhimataṃ phalam

utkrāntir apy aśeṣeṣu
sthāneṣv eteṣu śasyate
anyasthānāc chataguṇam
eteṣv anaśanādikam

yas tu matparamaḥ kālaṃ
karoty eteṣu mānavaḥ
devānām api pūjyo 'sau
mama loke mahīyate

yan na tāpāya vai puṃsāṃ
bhavaty āmuṣmikaṃ kṛtam
tāpāya yac ca bhavati
tad ācakṣva mahāmune

upavāsaprabhāvaṃ ca
kṛṣṇārādhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
kathayeha mama brahman
na ca tṛpyāmi kathyate

śrūyatāṃ dālbhya yat pṛṣṭāḥ
kautukād bhavatā vayam
āmuṣmikaṃ na tāpāya
yac ca tāpāya jāyate

upoṣitaprabhāvaṃ ca
kṛṣṇārādhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
kathayāmi yathāvṛttaṃ
pūrvam eva mahāmate

vaidiśaṃ nāma nagaraṃ
prakhyātam iha sattama
tatra vaiśyo 'bhavat pūrvaṃ
vīrabhadra iti śrutaḥ

putrapautrādibharaṇa-
vyāsaktamatir eva ca
paralokaṃ prati matis
tasya cātyantadurmukhā

cakārānudinaṃ so 'tha
nyāyānyāyair dhanārjanam
sarvatrānyatra niḥsnehaḥ
parasve cātitarṣulaḥ

na juhoty udite kāle
na dadāty atitṛṣṇayā
babhūva codyamas tasya
putrādibharaṇe paraḥ

nityanaimittikānāṃ ca
hāniṃ cakre svakarmaṇām
tṛṣṇābhibhūto viprarṣe
svavargabharaṇādhṛtaḥ

kālena gacchatā so 'tha
mṛto vindhyāṭavītaṭe
yātanādehabhṛt preto
grīṣmakāle 'bhavan mune

taṃ dadarśa mahābhāgo
divyajñānasamanvitaḥ
vedavedāntavid vidvān
pipīto nāma vai dvijaḥ

bhāskarasyāṃśubhir dīptair
dahyantam anivāraṇaiḥ
prataptavālukāmadhye
tṛṣā cātyantapīḍitam

kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhaṃ śuṣkāsyaṃ
stabdhodvṛttavilocanam
niṣkrāntajihvam aṅgeṣu
visphoṭaiḥ sarvataś citam

taṃ tādṛśam atho dṛṣṭvā
gārdabheyo mahāmuniḥ
pipītaḥ prāha viprarṣiḥ
kāruṇyastimitaṃ vacaḥ

jānann api tathā prāptaṃ
tadanuṣṭhānajaṃ phalam
jantos tasyopakārāya
sarvato hlādayann iva

adhaḥ sūryāṃśubhis taptair
bahubhir yānapāṃsubhiḥ
upary arkakarair ugrais
tṛṣā cārtas tathā kṣudhā

anyais tathādhibhir ghorair
aviṣahyair avāraṇaiḥ
kathayeha yathātattvam
ekākī dahyase katham

tasyaitad vacanaṃ śrutvā
pipītasya savedanam
yātanāstha uvācedaṃ
kṛcchrād ucchvāsya mastakam

brahman nālocitaṃ pūrvaṃ
katham ante bhaviṣyati
aśāśvate śāśvatadhīs
tena dahyāmi durmatiḥ

dhanāpaṇagṛhakṣetra-
putradārahite rataḥ
nātmano 'haṃ hitārambhī
tena dahyāmi durmatiḥ

idaṃ kariṣye kṛtvedaṃ
kariṣyāmy aparaṃ tv idam
itīcchāśatasaro 'haṃ
tena dahyāmi durmatiḥ

juhomi yadi tan nāsti
dadāmi yadi sīdati
kuṭumbam iti mūḍho 'ham
tena dahyāmi durmatiḥ

śītoṣṇavarṣābhibhavaṃ
lobhāt soḍḥaṃ mayāśubham
tad eva hi na dharmārthaṃ
tena dahyāmi durmatiḥ

pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇām
adattvāpoṣitā hi ye
te 'nyatra kvāpi vartante
dahyāmy eko 'tra durmatiḥ

putrabhṛtyakalatreṣu
mama tv ādṛtamānasaḥ
kṛtvā karmāṇy asādhūni
dahyāmy eko 'tra durmatiḥ

mṛte mayi dhane tasminn
anyāyopārjite mayā
nūnaṃ mameti vartante
dahyāmy eko 'tra durmatiḥ

na hi naḥ pūjitā gehān
nirgatā dvijasattamāḥ
svavargahitakāmasya
tena dahyāmy aharniśam

yan me na pūjitā devāḥ
kuṭumbaṃ poṣītaṃ param
ekākī tena dahyāmi
ye puṣṭās te 'nyato gatāḥ

nityanaimittikaṃ karma
kṛte yeṣāṃ na ma kṛtam
ekākī tena dahyāmi
tair manye kvāpi ramyate

yan me parijanasyārthe
kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham
ekākī tena dahyāmi
gatās te phalabhoginaḥ

dārāḥ putrāś ca bhṛtyāś ca
pāpavyāptyā mayaidhitāḥ
ekākī tena dahyāmi
gatās te phalabhoginaḥ

putradārādibhṛtyārthe
mayānyāyārthasaṃcayāḥ
kṛtās tenātra dahyāmi
bhuñjate 'py anyato gatāḥ

kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mayā bhuktam
anyais tatkarmasaṃcitam
dahyāmy eko 'ham atyantaṃ
tyaktas taiḥ phalabhogibhiḥ

yan mamatvābhibhūtena
mayā dhanam upārjitam
anyasya te 'dya kasyāpi
kevalaṃ mama duṣkṛtam

antarduḥkhena dagdho 'ntar
bahir dahyāmi bhānunā
nāntarduḥkhaṃ na vā bhānuḥ
pāpam eva dvidhā sthitam

kaṃcit karmasamuddhāraṃ
paśyasy asukhasāgarāt
mama yenāham āhlādam
āpnuyāṃ munisattama

alpakālikam uddhāraṃ
tava paśyāmy asaṃśayam
prakṣīṇaprāyam etat te
sukṛtaṃ cāsti te param

atīte daśame janmany
acyutārādhanecchayā
sukarmajayadāṃ bhadra
dvādaśīṃ tvam upoṣitaḥ

tava tasyāḥ prabhāveṇa
pāpam atyantadurjayam
alpair ahobhiḥ saṃkṣīṇaṃ
navapātre yathā jalam

yad anyaḥ kṣapayed varṣais
tad dinair bhavataḥ kṣayam
gataṃ pāpam ayaṃ tasyāḥ
prabhāvo 'tyantadurlabhaḥ

śamaṃ pāpasya kurute
jayaṃ sukṛtakarmaṇaḥ
satkarmajayadā hy eṣā
tato vai dvādaśī smṛtā

yac caitad vedanārtena
bhavatā paridevitam
tat tathā nātra saṃdeho
mamatā pāpahetukī

pāpam atra kṛtaṃ pretya
bhadra tāpāya jāyate
āhlādāya tathā puṇyam
iha puṇyakṛtāṃ nṛṇām

vīrabhadraṃ samāśvāsya
yayāv itthaṃ mahāmuniḥ
so 'py alpenaiva kālena
tato mokṣam avāptavān

evaṃ dālbhya pare loke
yad atrāsukṛtaṃ kṛtam
tat tāpāya sukhāyoktaṃ
yad atraiva śubhaṃ kṛtam

upavāsaprabhāvaś ca
kathitas te mahāmune
yenālpair eva divasair
bhūri pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam

tasmān nareṇa puṇyāya
patitavyaṃ na pātake
upavāsāś ca kartavyāḥ
sadaivātmahitaiṣiṇā

saṃsārāsāratāṃ jñātvā
viṣayāṃś cātitarṣulān
kartavyaṃ yan mahābhāga
puruṣeṇa tad ucyatām

saṃsārāsāratāṃ jñātvā
viṣayāṃś cātitarṣulān
gṛddhis teṣv eva saṃtyājyā
tattyāgo guṇavān nṛṇām

yeṣām abdasahasrāṇāṃ
sahasrair api no naraḥ
bhogāt tṛptiṃ samāpnoti
kas tair bhogair virajyate

yāvato vāñchate bhogān
ahany ahani mānavaḥ
teṣāṃ sahasrabhāge 'pi
dālbhya prāptiṃ na vindati

atha cet tan avāpnoti
sahasraguṇitān naraḥ
tathāpy atṛpta evāntam
antakāle gamiṣyati

tṛptaye ye na saṃprāptāḥ
prāpyante ye na vāñchitāḥ
buddhimān indriyārtheṣu
teṣv asaṅgī sadā bhavet

yeṣāṃ tṛptir na bhogena
tyāgaś caivopakārakaḥ
upoṣitavidhānena
bhogāntyāgas tato varaḥ

kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādīni
narais tasmān mumukṣubhiḥ
niṣkāmair dālbhya kāryāṇi
phalāya ca phalepsubhiḥ

atrāpy udāharantīmaṃ
munayo munisattama
dasrābhyāṃ saha saṃvādam
ailasya ca mahātmanaḥ

ailaḥ purūravāḥ pūrvaṃ
babhūva manujeśvaraḥ
cakame yaṃ mahābhāgam
urvaśī surasundarī

saṃtyajya tridaśāvāsaṃ
rūpaudāryaguṇānvitam
bheje tam urvaśī dālbhya
budhasya tanayaṃ nṛpam

nāsatyadasrau rūpeṇa
devānām adhikau tataḥ
urvaśīlobhanaṃ tasya
rūpaṃ draṣṭuṃ samutsukau

pratiṣṭhānaṃ puraṃ tasya
budhaputrasya dhīmataḥ
jagmatuḥ sumahābhāgau
tasya dvāstham athocatuḥ

kṣatto 'smadvacanād ailaṃ
brūhi tvaṃ vasudhādhipam
draṣṭuṃ tavāśvinau prāptau
rūpasaṃpadguṇaṃ ṇrpa
tadehy atra mahābhāga
ihāsmān saṃpraveśaya

āścaryabhūtaṃ lokeṣu
urvaśīlobhanaṃ vapuḥ
tat kautukaṃ na kurute
kasya pārthivapuṅgava

āvāṃ samāgatau tasmāt
tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ manujottama

dvāsthas tatheti tāv āha
praviveśa ca satvaram
ācacakṣe ca tad rājñe
nāsatyavacanaṃ dvija

tac chrutvā vacanaṃ rājā
dvāstham āha muhūrtakam
vilambyatāṃ mahābhāgau
tau brūhi vacanān mama

vyāyāmatailasaṃsarga-
malino na vibhūṣitaḥ
prasādhanaṃ ca kṛtvāhaṃ
niṣkramāmi tvarānvitaḥ

niṣkramya sa tato dvāstho
yathoktaṃ bhūbhṛtakhilam
samācaṣṭa tato dālbhya
tau ca bhūyas tam ūcatuḥ

aprasādhitam evāśu
bhavantaṃ vasudhādhipa
paśyāvas tava bhūyo 'pi
tvāṃ drakṣyāvaḥ prasādhitam

ity ukto nirgatas tūrṇaṃ
bhavanād avanīpatiḥ
tailābhyaktatanur dālbhya
vyāyāmaparidhānadhṛk

sa praṇāmaṃ tayoḥ kṛtvā
kiṃcin nataśirā nṛpaḥ
provāca yan mayā kāryaṃ
bhavatos tad ihocyatām

saptadvīpavatī pṛthvī
putradārabalaṃ dhanam
yac cānyad api tat sarvaṃ
yuvayor me niveditam

ity udāhṛtam ākarṇya
nṛpater aśvināv api
aṅgopāṅgādikaṃ sarvaṃ
śanakais tāv apaśyatām

śirolalāṭabāhuṃ sa-
nayanādivilokanam
kṛtvā ca taṃ mahīpālam
ūcatus tāv idaṃ surau

praviśya snāhi bhūpāla
yathārthaiś ca vibhūṣaṇaiḥ
vibhūṣitaṃ tu bhūyas tvāṃ
drakṣyāvo 'vāṃ nareśvara

tatheti coktvā sa nṛpaḥ
praviveśa mahāmune
cakre ca sakalaṃ samyak
snātvā dehaprasādhanam

snāto 'nuliptaḥ sragdhārī
suvastraḥ suvibhūṣitaḥ
nāsatyadasrayoḥ pārśvam
iyāya vasudhādhipaḥ

bhūyo 'pi tau yathā pūrvam
aṅgopāṅgavilokanam
cakratur nṛpates tasya
smitabhinnauṣṭhasaṃpuṭau

tau sahāsau samālakṣya
sa tadā vasudhādhipaḥ
hāsasya kāraṇaṃ deva-
bhiṣajau tāv apṛcchata

pṛcchantaṃ na tato dālbhya
nṛpatiṃ hāsyakāraṇam
yad ūcatur mahābhāgau
tac chṛṇuṣva vadāmi te

śṛṇu bhūpāla sakalaṃ
hāsakāraṇam āvayoḥ
yuṣmaddarśanasaṃbhūtaṃ
kṣaṇāpacayahetukam

asnātasyābhavad bhūpa
yādṛśī te surūpatā
sāṃprataṃ tādṛśī neyaṃ
bhūṣitasyāpi bhūṣaṇaiḥ

snātaḥ sragdāmadhārī tvaṃ
svanuliptaḥ subhūṣitaḥ
tathāpy asnāta eva prāc
śobhano 'bhūn na sāṃpratam

kiṃtu tatkāraṇaṃ yena
vyāyāmamalināmbaraḥ
śobhano 'ham abhūt pūrvam
idānīṃ na vibhūṣitaḥ

divyena cakṣuṣā bhūpa
kālasyāsya ca tasya ca
vayaḥpariṇatiṃ sūkṣmāṃ
paśyāvo 'pacayapradām

yathā hi nāḍikā pūrṇā
galaty avirataṃ nṛpa
nṝṇāṃ pariṇatas tadvac
śarīragrahaṇād anu

janmato 'nantaraṃ bālyaṃ
paugaṇḍatvaṃ tataḥ param
yauvanaṃ madhyadehitvaṃ
vārddhakaṃ ca jarā nṛṇām
sthūladṛṣṭyā tu paśyanti
na tu te sūkṣmadarśinaḥ

nimeṣaśatabhāgasya
sahasrāṃśaḥ kṣaṇo nṛpa
tasyāpy ayutabhāgāṃśo
bhavaty apacayo nṛṇām

sūkṣmātisūkṣmāpacayī
bhavaty eṣa pumān nṛpa
pariṇāmaṃ kramād yāti
tṛptiṃ vāri pibann iva

tad ahar jātabālyasya
bālasyāpacayo hi saḥ
pratikṣaṇāṃśayā vṛddhir
bālatvaṃ hīyate tayā

paugaṇḍe yauvane caiva
vārddhake ca mahāmate
hānikramaḥ sa evokto
yo bālye kathitas tava

kāntir yā nṛpa bālasya
pogaṇḍasya hi sā kutaḥ
tatkāntisaukumāryādyaiḥ
śūnyam eva hi yauvanam

kāntyādisaṃpado hāniḥ
paramā nṛpa vārddhake
tatrāpy anukṣaṇaṃ hānir
hānir ā mṛtyuto nṛpa

evaṃ pratikṣaṇāṃśāṃśo
nṝṇām apacayapradaḥ
kurvataḥ kimu kālas te
mahāsnānaprasādhanam

asmaddṛṣṭo bhavān yāvat
praviṣṭo nijamandiram
tāvad dhānim anuprāptaḥ
kimu yāmārdhasaṃsthitaḥ

yādṛśo 'dya bhavāṃs tādṛk
tvaṃ na rūpī nareśvara
paraśvaḥ śastanaṃ naiva

evaṃ samastabhūtāni
sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
pratikṣaṇāṃśāpacayaṃ
prāpnuvanti mahītale

tasmān na kautukaṃ kāryaṃ
bhavatā tu nareśvara
yat te rūpam abhūt pūrvam
aprasādhitaśobhanam

rājā purūravā bhūyaḥ
śrutvā vākyam idaṃ tayoḥ
cintayitvā vacaḥ prāha
saṃvegotkampimānasaḥ

aho bhavadbhyāṃ kathitam
anavasthitasaṃsthitam
svarūpaṃ jagato devau
yena trasto 'smi sāṃpratam

ajñānatimirāndhānāṃ
madvidhānāṃ bhavadvidhāḥ
pradīpabhūtāḥ saṃdeho
vidyate nātra kaścana

sadāpacayadoṣeṇa
duṣṭakāyaiḥ surottamau
yat kāryaṃ puruṣais tac ca
kathyatāṃ hitakāmyayā

atimūḍho 'dhruve kāye
sadāpacayadharmiṇi
naras tadupabhogyāni
dhruvāṇi parimārgati

āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ
paridhānaṃ gṛhādikam
vāñchaty aho 'timohena
susthiraṃ svayam asthiraḥ

mūḍho 'dhruvaṃ dhruvamatiḥ
kim ātmānaṃ na budhyate

bālyāt paugaṇḍatāṃ gatvā
yaḥ punar yauvanaṃ gataḥ

bhuvaḥ śailaṃ samārūḍhaḥ
samārūḍhas tato drumam
ārohaṇaṃ sa kim anyad
ṛkṣabhītaḥ kariṣyati

bālyāt paugaṇḍatāṃ yāto
yauvanād vṛddhatāṃ gataḥ
vayo'vasthā tataḥ kānyā
yad bhogāya sthirecchakaḥ

tasmād etan manuṣyeṇa
vicāryātmahitaiṣiṇā
śreyasy āmuṣmike yatnaḥ
kartavyo 'harniśaṃ nṛpa

bhogeṣv asaktiḥ satataṃ
tathaivātmāvalokanam
śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ
kapilaḥ prāha pārthivaḥ

sarvatra samadarśitvaṃ
nirmamatvam asaṅgitā
śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ
prāha pañcaśikho muniḥ

āgarbhajanmabālyādi-
vayo'vasthādivedanam
śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyāṇām
aṅgāriṣṭho 'bravīn nṛpaḥ

adhyātmikādiduḥkhānām
atyantādipratikriyā
śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ
janako hy āha mokṣavit

abhinnayor bhedakaraḥ
pratyayo yaḥ parātmanoḥ
hiraṇyagarbhas tacchāntiṃ
śreyaḥ paramam abravīt

kartavyam iti yat karma
ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñitam
kriyate tat paraṃ śreyo
jaigīṣavyo 'bravīn muniḥ

hāniṃ sarvavidhitsānām
ātmanaḥ sukhahetukīm
śreyaḥ paraṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ
devalo 'py āha tattvavit

yad yat tyajati kāmānāṃ
tat sukhasyābhipūryate
etad eva paraṃ śreyo
vijñānaṃ hitakāminām

kāmānusārī puruṣaḥ
kāmān anu vinaśyati
aśreyasaṃ paraṃ caitad
yad bhūpālātikāmitā

evaṃ vijñātatattvārthaḥ
sanako yogināṃ varaḥ
narendra prāha viprāṇāṃ
paramārthaparaṃparam

kriyākalāpaphaladam
ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñitam
amuṣmin madhyamaṃ śreyaḥ
prāhuḥ sapta rṣayo nṛpa

ihaiva phaladaṃ kāmyaṃ
karma yat kriyate naraiḥ
tad āhur aparaṃ śreyo
ṛcīkacyavanādayaḥ

dve karmaṇī naraśreṣṭha
brahmaṇā samudāhṛte
pravṛttākhyaṃ nivṛttaṃ ca
svargamuktiphale hi te

pravṛttam api mokṣāya
karma pārthiva jāyate
karma svarūpato bhraṣṭam
anākāṅkṣya phalaṃ kṛtam

sāmānyaṃ cāparaṃ śreyaḥ
sarvavarṇāśrameṣu yat
tac chṛṇuṣva mahīpāla
vadato mama tattvataḥ

satyaṃ vaktavyaṃ nityaṃ maitreṇa bhāvyaṃ
kāryaṃ ca tyājyaṃ nityam āyāsakāri
loke 'muṣmin yad dhitaṃ ca tathāsmiṃs
tasminn ātmā yojanīyo 'nudhīraiḥ

tīrthasnānaiḥ sopavāsair ajasraṃ
pātre dānair homajāpaiś ca nityam
śuddhir neyo devatābhyarcanaiś ca
śuddho 'py ātmā saṅgadoṣād aśuddhaḥ

śuddhaṃ vastraṃ saṅgadoṣād aśuddhaṃ
bhūyaḥ śuddhiṃ śodhyamānaṃ paryāti
etaj jñātvā na pramādo manuṣyaiḥ
śuddhe hy ātmany ātmavidbhir vidheyaḥ

ity uktvā tau narendraṃ tau
tena cārghyādinā pṛthak
samyak saṃpūjitau yātau
nāka pṛṣṭham athāśvinau

sa cāpy anityatām evam
avagamya nareśvaraḥ
niṣkāmo 'nudinam eva
avagamya nareśvaraḥ
niṣkāmo 'nudinaṃ yajñair
iyāja puruṣottamam

bhogāsaṅgi mano dālbhya
yadāsīt tasya bhūpateḥ
tad eva bhagavaddhyāna-
paraṃ cakre mahāmune

tatyājārtheṣu mamatām
ahaṃkāraṃ tathātmani
samatāṃ sarvabhūteṣu
saṃprāpa pṛthivīpatiḥ

yasyātmany api viprarṣe
nāhaṃmāno 'sti kutracit
madāvalepo pūpādau
tasya syād iti kā kathā

evaṃ dālbhya manuṣyeṇa
samatām anutiṣṭhatā
sarvabhogeṣu saṃtyājyo
dhyeyaś ca puruṣottamaḥ

kutra tiṣṭhati govindo
bāhyanivṛtacetasi
tasmān niḥsaṅgacittena
śakyaś cintayituṃ hariḥ

prītidveṣādayas tyaktvā
maharṣe yasya cetasā
priyātithis taddhṛdaye
viṣṇur mokṣaphalapradaḥ

kāryārambheṣu sarveṣu
duḥsvapneṣu ca sattama
amaṅgalyeṣu sarveṣu
yaj japtavyaṃ tad ucyatām

yenārambhāś ca sidhhyanti
duḥsvapnaṃ copaśāmyati
amaṅgalānāṃ sarveṣāṃ
pratighātaś ca jāyate

janārdanaṃ bhūtapatiṃ jagadguruṃ
smaran manuṣyaḥ satataṃ mahāmune
duṣṭāny aśeṣāṇy apahanti sādhayaty
aśeṣakāryāṇi tathā yadīcchati

śṛṇuṣva cānyad vadato mamākhilaṃ
vadāmi yat te dvijavarya maṅgalam
sarvārthasiddhiṃ pradadāti yaḥ sadā
nihanty aśeṣāṇi ca pātakāni

pratiṣṭhitaṃ yatra jagac carācaraṃ
jagac ca yo yo jagataś ca hetuḥ
jagac ca pāty atti ca yaḥ sa sarvadā

vyomāmbuvāyvagnimahīsvarūpair
vistāravān yo 'ṇutaro 'ṇubhāgāt
sa sthūlasūkṣmaḥ satateśvareśvaro

yasmāt parastāt puruṣād anantād
anādimadhyād akhilaṃ na kiṃcit
sa hetuhetuḥ parameśvareśvaro

hiraṇyagarbhācyutarudrarūpī
sṛjaty aśeṣaṃ paripāti hanti
guṇāśrayī yo bhagavān sa sarvadā

paraḥ surāṇāṃ paramo 'surāṇāṃ
paro munīnāṃ paramo yatīnām
paraḥ samastasya ca yaḥ sa devo

dhyāto yatīnām apakalmaṣair yo
dadāti muktiṃ parameśvareśvaraḥ
manobhir ādyaḥ puruṣaḥ sa sarvadā

surendravaivasvatavittapāmbupa-
svarūparūpī paripāti yo jagat
sa śuddhasattvaḥ parameśvareśvaro

yannāmakīrtanato vimucyate
anekajanmārjitapāpasaṃcayaiḥ
pāpendhanāgniḥ sa sadaiva nirmalo

yenoddhṛteyaṃ dharaṇī rasātalād
aśeṣasattvasthitikāraṇād idam
bibharti viśvaṃ jagataḥ sa mūlavān

pādeṣu vedā jaṭhare carācaraṃ
romasv aśeṣā munayo mukhe makhāḥ
yasyeśvareśasya sa sarvadā prabhur

samastayajñāṅgamayaṃ vapur vibhor
yasyāṅgam īśeśvarasaṃstutasya
varāharūpo bhagavān sa sarvadā

vikṣobhya sarvodadhitoyasaṃpadaṃ
dadhāra dhātrīṃ jagataś ca yodbhavaḥ
yajñeśvaro yajñapumān sa sarvadā

pātālamūleśvarabhogisaṃhatau
vinyasya pādau pṛthivīṃ ca bibhrataḥ
yasyopamānaṃ na babhūva so 'cyuto

vighargharaṃ yasya ca bṛṃhato muhuḥ
sanandanādyair janalokasaṃsthitaiḥ
śrutaṃ jayetyuktiparaiḥ sa sarvadā

ekārṇavād yasya mahīyaso mahīm
ādāya vegena samutpatiṣyataḥ
nutaṃ vapur yogivaraiḥ sa sarvadā

hato hiraṇyākṣamahāsuraḥ purā
purāṇapuṃsā parameṇa yena
varāharūpaḥ sa patiḥ prajāpater

daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ surabhītināśanaṃ
kṛtvā vapur divyanṛsiṃharūpiṇaṃ
trātaṃ jagad yena sa sarvadā prabhur

daityendravakṣaḥsthaladāradāruṇaiḥ
karoruhaiḥ śatrurujānukāribhiḥ
ciccheda lokasya bhayāni cāvyayo

dantāntadīptidyutinirmalāṇi
cakāra sarvāṇi diśaṃ mukhāni
ninādavitrāsitadānavo hy asau

yannāmasaṃkīrtanato mahābhayād
vimokṣam āpnoti na saṃśayaṃ naraḥ
samastalokārtiharo nṛkesarī

saṭākalāpabhramaṇānilahatāḥ
sphuṭanti yasyāmbudharāḥ samantataḥ
sa divyasiṃhaḥ sphuritākulekṣaṇo

yadīkṣaṇajyotiṣi raśmimaṇḍalaṃ
pralīnam eva na rarāja bhāsvataḥ
kutaḥ śaśāṅkasya sa siṃharūpadhṛṅ

dravanti daityāḥ praṇamanti devatā
naśyanti rakṣāṃsy apayānti cārayaḥ
yatkīrtanāt so 'dbhutarūpakesarī

aśeṣadeveśanareśvareśvaraiḥ
sadā stutaṃ yac caritaṃ mahādbhutam
sa sarvalokārtiharo mahāharir

ṛkkāritaṃ yo yajuṣātiśāntimat
sāmadhvanidhvastasamastapātakam
cakre jagad vāmanakaḥ sa sarvadā

yatpādavinyāsapavitratāṃ mahī
yayau viyad ṛgyajuṣām udīraṇāt
sa vāmano divyaśarīradhṛk sadā

yasmin prayāte surabhūbhṛto 'dhvaraṃ
nanāma khedād avaniḥ sasāgarā
sa vāmanaḥ sarvajaganmayaḥ sadā

mahādyutau daityapater mahādhvaraṃ
yasmin praviṣṭe kṣubhitaṃ mahāsuraiḥ
sa vāmano 'ntasthitasaptalokadhṛṅ

samastadeveṣṭimayaṃ mahādyutir
dadhāra yo rūpam atīndriyaṃ prabhuḥ
trivikramākrāntajagattrayaḥ sadā

saṅghaiḥ surāṇāṃ divi bhūtale sthitais
tathā manuṣyair gagane sa sarvadā
stutaḥ kramād yaḥ pradade sa sarvadā

krāntvā dharitrīṃ gaganaṃ tathā divaṃ
marutpater yaḥ pradadau triviṣṭapam
sa devadevo bhuvaneśvareśvaro

anugrahaṃ cāpi baler anuttamaṃ
cakāra yaś cendrapadopalakṣaṇaṃ
surāṃś ca yajñasya bhujaḥ sa sarvadā

rasātalād yena purā samāhṛtāḥ
samastavedā varavājirūpiṇā
sa kaiṭabhārir madhusūdano mahān

niḥkṣatriyāṃ yaś ca cakāra medinīm
anekaśo bāhuvanaṃ tathāchinat
yaḥ kārtavīryasya sa bhārgavottamo

nihatya vāliṃ ca kapīśvaraṃ hi yo
nibadhya setuṃ jaladhau daśānanam
jaghāna cānyān rajanīcarān asau

cikṣepa bālaḥ śakaṭaṃ babhañja yo
yamalārjunau kaṃsam ariṃ jaghāna
mamarda cāṇūramukhaṃ sa sarvadā

prātaḥ sahasrāṃśumarīcinirmalaṃ
kareṇa bibhrad bhagavān sudarśanam
kaumodakīṃ cāpi gadām anuttamāṃ

himendukundasphaṭikābhrakomalaṃ
mukhānilāpūritam īśvareśvaraḥ
madhyāhnakāle ca sa śaṅkham uttamam

tathāparāhne pravikāsipaṅkajaṃ
vakṣaḥsthalena śriyam udvahad vibhuḥ
vistāripadmotpalapatralocano

sarveṣu kāleṣu samastadeśeṣv
aśeṣakāryeṣu tatheśvareśvaraḥ
sarvaiḥ svarūpair bhagavān anādimān

etat paṭhan dālbhya samastapāpair
vimucyate viṣṇuparo manuṣyaḥ
sidhyanti kāryāṇi tathāsya sarvāṇy
arthān avāpnoti tathā yatheṣṭam

duḥsvapnaṃ praśamam upaiti paṭhyamāne
stotre 'smiñ śravaṇavidhau sadotthitasya
prārambho drutam upayāti siddhim īśaḥ
pāpāni kṣapayati cāsya vāsudevaḥ

maṅgalyaṃ paramam idaṃ sadārthasiddhiṃ
nirvighna tv adhikaphalaṃ sadā dadāti
kiṃ loke tad iha paratra cāsti puṃsām
yad viṣṇupravaṇadhiyā na dālbhya sādhyam

devendras tribhuvanam artham ekapiṅgaḥ
sarvarddhiṃ tribhuvanagāṃ ca kārtavīryaḥ
vaidehaḥ paramapadaṃ prasādya viṣṇuṃ
saṃprāptaḥ sakalaphalaprado hi viṣṇuḥ

sarvārambheṣu dālbhyaitad
duḥsvapneṣu ca paṇḍitaḥ
japed ekamatir viṣṇau
tathāmaṅgalyadarśane

śamaṃ prayānti duṣṭāni
grahapīḍāś ca dāruṇāḥ
karmārambhāś ca sidhyanti
puṇyam āpnoti cottamam

harir dadāti bhadrāṇi
maṅgalyastutisaṃstutaḥ
karoty akhilarūpaiś ca
rakṣām akṣataśaktidhṛk

kurvīta kiṃ pumān sthānaṃ
kaḥ pumān brahmaṇo balam
brahmaṇaś ca kathaṃ bhedo
jñeyo 'bhinnaphalapradaḥ

svakarmaṇā dhanaṃ labdhvā
nityanaimittikāḥ kriyāḥ
kurvīta śuddhim āsthāya
svecchayā ca tathā paraḥ

tyaktvā rāgādikān doṣān
samaḥ sarvatra vai bhavet
sarvatra maitrīṃ kurvīta
dadyād iṣṭāni cārthinām

kuryād dīneṣu karuṇāṃ
duḥśīlān parivarjayet
muditāṃ dharmaśīleṣu
bhāvanāṃ munisattama

śarīrabāhyatāṃ śaśvad
dhiṃsāṃ kurvīta na kvacit
nindāvamānam anyeṣāṃ
yac cānyad upaghātakam

śarīravāṅmanaḥśuddhiṃ
kurvīta ca sadātmanaḥ
bhūtānām upakāraś ca
tapobhiś cātmakarṣaṇam

eṣa dharmaḥ samāsena
dālbhyākhyāto mayā tava
adharmaś cāyam evokto
viparīto manīṣibhiḥ

ete yatra guṇāḥ pūrvaṃ
kathitā jñānasaṃyutāḥ
brahmaṇaḥ sāśrayaḥ śuddha
upacārāt tad eva saḥ

ekasyaiva satas tasya
brahmaṇo dvijasattama
nāmnāṃ bahutvaṃ lokānām
upakārakaraṃ śṛṇu

nimittaśaktayo nāmno
bhedatas tadudīraṇāt
vibhinnāny eva sādhyante
phalāni kurunandana

yacchakti nāma tat tasya
tat tasminn eva vastuni
sādhakaṃ puruṣavyāghra
saumyakrūreṣu vastuṣu

vāsudevācyutānanta-
satyājyapuruṣottamaiḥ
paramātmeśvarādyaiś ca
stuto nāmabhir avyayaḥ

nimittabhāvaṃ bhagavān
vimukter yāty adhokṣajaḥ
tathānyakāryasaṃsiddhau
yad yat tat tan niśāmaya

dhanakṛd dharmakṛd dharmī
dharmātmā viśvakṛc chuciḥ
śuciṣad viṣṇur abjākṣaḥ
puṣkarākṣo hy adhokṣayaḥ
śuciśravāḥ śipiviṣṭo
yajñeśo yajñabhāvanaḥ

nāmnām ity evam ādīnāṃ
samuccāraṇato naraḥ
dharmaṃ mahāntam āpnoti
pāpabandhakṣayaṃ tathā

tathārthaprāptaye brahman
devanāmāni me śṛṇu
yeṣāṃ samuccāraṇato
vittam āpnoti bhaktimān

śrīdaḥ śrīśaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ
śrīdharaḥ śrīniketanaḥ
śriyaḥ patiḥ śrīparamaḥ
śrīmāñ śrīvatsalāñcchanaḥ

nṛsiṃho duṣṭadāmano
jayo viṣṇus trivikramaḥ
stutaḥ prayacchate cārtham
evam ādibhir acyutaḥ

kāmyaḥ kāmapradaḥ kāntaḥ
kāmapālas tathā hariḥ
ānando mādhavaś caiva
kāmasaṃsiddhaye nṛpa

rāmaḥ paraśurāmaś ca
nṛsiṃho viṣṇur eva ca
vikramaś caivam ādīni
japyāny arijigīṣubhiḥ

vidyām abhyasatā nityaṃ
japtavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
dāmodaraṃ bandhagato
nityam eva japan naraḥ

keśavaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ
puṣkarākṣaṃ tathā japet
netrabādhāsu sarvāsu
hṛṣīkeśaṃ bhayeṣu ca

acyutaṃ cāmṛtaṃ caiva
japed auṣadhakarmaṇi
bhrājiṣṇum agnihānau ca
japed ālambane sthitam

saṃgrāmābhimukhaṃ gacchan
saṃsmared aparājitam
pātālanarasiṃhaṃ ca
jalaprataraṇe smaret

cakriṇaṃ gadinaṃ caiva
śārṅginaṃ khaḍginaṃ tathā
kṣemārthe prasavan rājan
dikṣu prācyādiṣu smaret

ajitaṃ cādhikaṃ caiva
sarvaṃ sarvaśvaraṃ tathā
saṃsmaret puruṣo bhaktyā
vyavahāreṣu sarvadā

nārāyaṇaṃ sarvakālaṃ
kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu
grahanakṣatrapīḍāsu
devabādhāṭavīṣu ca

asyuvairinirodheṣu
vyāghrasiṃhādisaṃkaṭe
andhakāre ca tīvre ca
narasiṃham anusmaret
taraty akhiladurgāṇi
tāpārto jalaśāyinam

snāne devārcane home
praṇipāte pradakṣiṇe
kīrtayed bhagavannāma
vāsudeveti tatparaḥ

sthagane vittadhānyāder
apadhyāne ca duṣṭaje
kurvīta tanmanā bhūtvā
anantācyutakīrtanam

nārāyaṇaṃ śārṅgadharaṃ
śrīdharaṃ puruṣottamam
vāmanaṃ khaḍginaṃ caiva
duḥsvapneṣu ca saṃsmaret

ekārṇavāhiparyaṅka-
śāyinaṃ ca naraḥ smaret
vāyvagnīgṛhadāhāya
pravṛddhāv upalakṣya ca

vidyārthī mohavibhrānti-
vegāghūrṇitamānasaḥ
manuṣyo muniśārdūla
sadāśvaśirasaṃ smaret

balabhadraṃ samṛddhyarthī
sīrakarmaṇi kīrtayet
jagatsūtim apatyārthī
stuvan bhaktyā na sīdati

japtavyaṃ suprajākhyaṃ tu
devadevasya sattama
dampatyor ātmasaṃbandhe
vivāhākhye punaḥ punaḥ

śrīśaṃ sarvābhyudayike
karmaṇi saṃprakīrtayet
ariṣṭānteṣv aśeṣeṣu
viśokaṃ ca sadā japet

marutpratāpāgnijala-
bandhanādiṣu mṛtyuṣu
svātantryaparatantreṣu
vāsudevaṃ japed budhaḥ

sarvārthaśaktiyuktasya
devadevasya cakriṇaḥ
yad vābhirocate nāma
tat sarvārtheṣu kīrtayet

sarvārthasiddhim āpnoti
nāmnām ekārthatā yataḥ
sarvāṇy etāni nāmāni
parasya brahmaṇo 'nagha

evam etāni nāmāni
devadevasya kīrtayet
yaṃ yaṃ kāmam abhidhyāyet
taṃ tam āpnoty asaṃśayam
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti
samārādhya jagadgurum

tanmayatvena govindam
ity etad dālbhya nānyathā
tanmayo vāñchitān kāmān
yad avāpnoti mānavaḥ

nimittaśaktiḥ sā tasya
na bhedo dālbhya mānasaḥ
vāṅmanaḥkāyikaṃ dveṣaṃ
yac ca kurvan prayāty adhaḥ

svarūpaśaktiḥ sā tasya
matibhedakṛtaṃ na tad
sa śākto nirguṇaḥ śuddho
brahmabhūto jagadguruḥ

karmabhir nāmabhir jīvo
dṛśyate dālbhya naikadhā
yathā ca gaṅgāsalilaṃ
sitam atyantanirmalam

ekasvarūpam adhyātmaṃ
puṇyāpuṇyavibhedibhiḥ
bhrāntijñānānvitair miśraṃ
sitāsitaviceṣṭitaiḥ
dṛśyate naikadhā dālbhya
prāṇibhir bhinnabuddhibhiḥ

tāpārtās tāpaśamanam
atiprītyatiśītalam
kaphadoṣānvitair nāti-
prītiyuktair niraṃśubhiḥ

strīyogyam etan netīti
prītyaprītisamanvitaiḥ
madhyasthabuddhyā caivānye
nātiśītātitāpibhiḥ

pavitram ity etad iti
puṇyabuddhyā tathāparaiḥ
mṛṣṭam etad itīty anyair
matsyāḍhyam iti cāparaiḥ

tulyabuddhyāpi caivānyair
heyabuddhyā tathāparaiḥ
nātivegātivegaṃ ca
hṛṣṭodvignais tathāparaiḥ

kim eteneti caivānyaiḥ
paradārābhilāṣibhiḥ
dālbhya saṃdṛśyate cānyair
jantubhir bhāyakātaraiḥ
tad eva pūyaṃ paśyanti
pretādyā hṛtipāpinaḥ

etaiś cānyaiś ca bahubhir
viśeṣair bahujantubhiḥ
viśeṣavat karmabhedād
ekam eva hi dṛśyate

naite gaṅgāmbhaso bhedāḥ
prītyaprītipradāyinaḥ
prāṇināṃ cetaso bhedād
dālbhyaite karmayonayaḥ

samastakarmaṇā dālbhya
saṃkṣaye bhayam ety asau
viśeṣakāraṇābhāvād
viśeṣābhāva eva hi

viṣṇvākhyam evaṃ tad brahma
śuddham atyantanirmalam
abhedaṃ bahudhā bhinnaṃ
dṛśyate karmabhedibhiḥ

yogibhir dṛśyate śuddhaṃ
rāgādyupaśamāmalaiḥ
rāgibhir viṣayākāraṃ
tad eva brahma dṛśyate

karmamārgāśritaiḥ karma-
bhoktṛtve ca tatheṣyate
kim apy astīti caivānyair
avivekibhir ucyate

sarvam etat tad eveti
vadanty advaitavādinaḥ
pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyam eveti
vadanty anye duruktibhiḥ

vadanty anye tad evāhaṃ
nāstīty anye vadanti tat
tiryaṅmanuṣyadevākhyaṃ
tad anyair abhidhīyate

vandyabuddhyā tu tat kaiścid
dhyeyabuddhyā tathāparaiḥ
gamyabuddhyā tathānyaiś ca
labhyabuddhyā ca jantubhiḥ

gṛhyate tat paraṃ brahma
ripubuddhyā tathāparaiḥ

prāṇibhiḥ karmavaiṣamya-
bhinnabuddhibhir avyayam
tad brahma gṛhyate dālbhya
paramārthaṃ nibodha me

bhūtendriyāntaḥkaraṇa-
pradhānapuruṣātmakam
aparaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ
paraṃ dālbhya niśāmaya

aheyam akṣaraṃ śuddham
asaṃbhūtinirañjanam
viṣṇvākhyaṃ paramaṃ brahma
yad vai paśyanti sūrayaḥ

yathaitad bhavatā proktaṃ
dharmārthādes tu sādhanam
patnī nṝṇāṃ muniśreṣṭha
yoṣitas ca tathā naraḥ

tac chrotum icche viprarṣe
vidhavā strī na jāyate
upoṣītena yenāgryā
patnyā ca rahito naraḥ

aśūnyaśayanā nāma
dvitīyāṃ śṛṇu tāṃ mama
yām upoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ
prayāti strī dvijottama

patnīviyuktaś ca naro
na kadācit prajāyate
śete jagatpatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ
śriyā sārdhaṃ yadā dvija

aśūnyaśayanā nāma
tadā grāhyā hi sā tithiḥ
kṛṣṇapakṣadvitīyāyāṃ
śrāvaṇe dvijasattama

idam uccārayen nāma
praṇamya jagataḥ patim
śrīvatsadhāriṇaṃ śrīśaṃ
bhaktyābhyarcya śriyā saha

śrīvatsadhāriñ śrīkānta
śrīdhāma śrīpate 'cyuta
gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me
yātu dharmārthakāmadam

agnayo mā praṇaśyantu
mā praṇaśyantu devatāḥ
pitaro mā praṇaśyantu
matto dāmpatyabhedataḥ

lakṣmyā prayujyate deva
na kadācid yathā bhavān
tathā kalatrasaṃbandho
deva mā me vibhidyatām

lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada
yathā te śayanaṃ sadā
śayyā mamāpy aśūnyāstu
tathaiva madhusūdana

evaṃ prasādya pūjāṃ ca
kṛtvā lakṣmyās tathā hareḥ
phalāni dadyāc chayyāyām
abhīṣṭāni jagatpateḥ

naktaṃ praṇamyāyatane
havir bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ
brāhmaṇāya dvitīye 'hni
śaktyā dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām

evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyag
naro māsacatuṣṭayam
tasya janmatrayaṃ dālbhya
gṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate

aśūnyaśayanaś cāsau
dharmakarmārthasādhakaḥ
bhavaty avyāhataiśvaryaḥ
puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ

nārī ca dālbhya dharmajñā
vratam etad yathāvidhi
yā karoti na sā śocyā
bandhuvargasya jāyate

vaidhavyaṃ durbhagatvaṃ vā
bhartṛtyāgaṃ ca sattama
nāpnoti janmatritayam
etac cīrtvā pativratā

upavāsāśritaṃ samyag
lokadvayaphalapradam
kathitaṃ bhavatā sarvaṃ
yat pṛṣṭo 'si mayā dvija

anyad icchāmy ahaṃ śrotuṃ
tad bhavān prabravītu me
saṃsārahetuṃ muktiṃ ca
saṃsārān munisattama

avidyāprabhavaṃ karma
hetubhūtaṃ dvijottama
saṃsārasyāsya tanmuktiḥ
saṃkṣepāc chrūyatāṃ mama

svajātivihitaṃ karma
lobhadveṣavivarjitam
kurvataḥ kṣīyate pūrvaṃ
manyubandhaś ca neṣyate

apūrvasaṃbhavābhavāt
kṣayaṃ yāty ādikarmaṇi
dālbhya saṃsāravicchedaḥ
kāraṇābhāvasaṃbhavaḥ

bhavaty asaṃśayaṃ cānyac
śrūyatām atra kāraṇam
saṃsārān mucyate dālbhya
samāsād vadato mama

brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ
śūdrāntyānāṃ ca sattama
svajātivihitaṃ karma
rāgadveṣādivarjitam

jātipradasya kṣayadaṃ
tad evādyasya karmaṇaḥ
jñānakāraṇabhāvaṃ ca
tad eva pratipadyate

pumāṃś cādhigatajñāno
bhedaṃ nāpnoti sattama
brahmaṇā viṣṇusaṃjñena
parameṇāvyayātmanā

etat te kathitaṃ dālbhya
saṃsārasya samāsataḥ
kāraṇaṃ bhavamuktiś ca
jāyate yogino yathā

iti dālbhyaḥ pulastyena
yathāvat pratibodhitaḥ
ārādhayām āsa hariṃ
lebhe kāmāṃś ca vāñchitān

tathā tvam api daityendra
keśavārādhanaṃ kuru
ārādhya taṃ jagannāthaṃ
na kaścid avasīdati

iti śukravacaḥ śrutvā
prahlādo madhusūdanam
ārādhya prāptavān kṛtsnaṃ
trailokaiśvaryam ūrjitam

etan mayoktaṃ sakalaṃ
tava bhūmipa pṛcchataḥ
anārādhyācyutaṃ devaṃ
kaḥ kāmān prāpnute naraḥ

ambarīso narapatir
viṣṇor māhātmyam uttamam
śrutvā babhūva satataṃ
keśavārpitamānasaḥ

evaṃ tvam api kauravya
yadi muktim abhīṣyasi
bhogān vā vilupān devāt
tasmād ārādhayācyutam

dadāti vāñchitān kāmān
sakāmair arcito hariḥ
muktiṃ dadāti govindo
niṣkāmair abhipūjitaḥ

bhagavān avatīrṇo 'bhūn
martyalokaṃ janārdanaḥ
bhārāvataraṇārthāya
bhuvo bhūtapatir hariḥ

mānuṣatve ca govindo
mama pūrvapitāmahaiḥ
cakāra prītim atulāṃ
sāmānyapuruṣo yathā

sārathyaṃ kṛtavāṃś caiva
teṣāṃ sarveśvaro hariḥ
nistīrṇo yena bhīṣmaugho
kurusainyamahodadhiḥ

upakārī mahābhāgaḥ
sa teṣāṃ sarvavastuṣu
keśavaḥ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ
sutānāṃ janako yathā

dhanyās te kṛtapuṇyāś ca
mama pāṇḍusutā matāḥ
viviśur ye pariṣvaṅge
govindabhujapañjaram

rājyahetor arīñ jaghnur
akasmāt pāṇḍunandanāḥ
saptalokaikanāthena
ye 'bhavann ekaśāyinaḥ

ātmānam avagacchāmi
bhagavan dhūtakalmaṣam
jātaṃ nirdhūtapāpe 'smin
kule viṣṇuparigrahe

evaṃ devavaras teṣāṃ
prasādasumukho hariḥ
pṛcchatāṃ kaccid ācaṣṭe
kiṃcid guhyaṃ mahātmanām

guhyaṃ janārdanaṃ yāṃs tu
dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
papraccha dharmān akhilāṃs
tan mamākhyātum arhasi

dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu
yad guhyaṃ madhusūdanaḥ
teṣām avocad bhagavāñ
śrotum icchāmi tat tv aham

bahūni dharmaguhyāni
dharmaputrāya keśavaḥ
purā provāca rājendra
prasādasumukho hariḥ

śaratalpagatād bhīṣmād
dharmāñ śrutvā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
pṛṣṭavān yaj jagannāthaṃ
tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu

pañcamenāśvamedhena
yadā snāto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
tadā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ
praśnam etam apṛcchata

bhagavan vaiṣṇavā dharmāḥ
kiṃphalāḥ kiṃparāyaṇāḥ
kiṃ kṛtyam adhikṛtyaite
bhavatotpāditāḥ purā

yadi te pāṇḍuṣu sneho
vidyate madhusūdana
śrotavyāś cen mayā dharmās
tatas tān kathayākhilān

pavitrāś caiva ye dharmāḥ
sarvapāpapraṇāśanāḥ
tava vaktracyutā deva
sarvadharmeṣv anuttamāḥ

yāñ śrutvā brahmahā goghnaḥ
pitṛghno gurutalpagaḥ
surāpo vā kṛtaghnaś ca
mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ

etan me kathitaṃ sarvaṃ
sabhāmadhye 'risūdana
vasiṣṭhādyair mahābhāgair
munibhir bhāvitātmabhiḥ

tato 'haṃ tava deveśa
pādamūlam upāgataḥ
dharmān kathaya tān deva
yady ahaṃ bhavataḥ priyaḥ

śrutā me mānavā dharmā
vāsiṣṭhāś ca mahāmate
parāśarakṛtāś caiva
tathātreyasya dhīmataḥ

śrutā gārgyasya śaṅkhasya
likhitasya yamasya ca
jāpāleś ca mahābāho
muner dvaipāyanasya ca

umāmaheśvarāś caiva
jātidharmāś ca pāvanāḥ
guṇeś ca guṇabāhoś ca
kāśyapeyās tathaiva ca

bahvāyanakṛtāś caiva
śākuneyās tathaiva ca
agastyagītā maudgalyāḥ
śāṇḍilyāḥ saurabhās tathā

bhṛgor aṅgirasaś caiva
kaśyapoddālakās tathā
saumantūgrāyaṇāgrāś ca
pailasya ca mahātmanaḥ

vaiśampāyanagītāś ca
piśaṅgamakṛtāś ca ye
aindrāś ca vāruṇāś caiva
kauberā vātsyapauṇakāḥ

āpastambāḥ śrutā dharmās
tathā gopālakasya ca
bhṛgvaṅgiraḥkṛtāś caiva
sauryā hārītakās tathā
yājñavalkyakṛtāś caiva
tathā saptarṣayaś ca ye

etāś cānyāś ca vividhāḥ
śrutā me dharmasaṃhitāḥ
bhagavañ śrotum icchāmi
tava vaktrād viniḥsṛtān

evam uktaḥ sa pārthena
pratyuvāca janārdanaḥ
bahumānāc ca prītyā ca
dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram

iṣṭas tvaṃ hi mahābāho
sadā mama yudhiṣṭhira
paramārthaṃ tava brūyāṃ
kiṃ punar dharmasaṃhitām

paramajñānibhiḥ siddhair
yuñjadbhir api nityaśaḥ
praśāntasyeva dīpasya
gatir mama duratyayā

sarvavedamayaṃ brahma
pavitram ṛṣibhiḥ stutam
kathayiṣyāmi te rājan
dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtām vara

evam ukte tu kṛṣṇena
ṛṣayo 'mitatejasaḥ
samājagmuḥ sabhāmadhye
śrotukāmā harer giram

devagandharvaṛṣayo
guhyakāś ca mahāyaśāḥ
vālakhilyā mahātmāno
munayaḥ saṃmitavratāḥ
pāvanān sarvadharmebhyo
rahasyān dvijasattama

vaiṣṇavān akhilān dharmān
yaḥ paṭhet pāpanāśanān
bhaveyur akṣayās tasya
lokāḥ satpuṇyabhāginaḥ

kṛṣṇadṛṣṭihataṃ cāsya
kilbiṣaṃ saṃpraṇaśyati
vaiṣṇavasya ca yajñasya
phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ

kautūhalasamāviṣṭaḥ
papracchedaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
yamalokasya cādhvānam
antaraṃ mānuṣasya ca

kīdṛśaṃ kiṃpramāṇaṃ vā
kathaṃ vāntaṃ janārdana
taranti puruṣāḥ kṛṣṇa
kenopāyena saṃśame

tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā
vismito madhusūdanaḥ
pratyuvāca mahātmānaṃ
dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram

sādhu sādhur ayaṃ praśnaḥ
śrūyatāṃ bho yudhiṣṭhira
ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi
yojanānāṃ narādhipa

yamalokasya cādhvānam
antaraṃ mānuṣasya ca
tāmrapātram ivātaptaṃ
śūlavyāmiśrakaṇṭakam

dvādaśādityasaṃkāśaṃ
bhairavaṃ duratikramam
na tatra vṛkṣā na cchāyā
pānīyaṃ ketanāni ca

yatra viśramate śrāntaḥ
puruṣo 'dhvānako nṛpa
yāmyair dūtair nīyamāno
yamasyājñākarair balāt

avaśyaṃ ca mahārāja
sa gantavyo mahāpathaḥ
naraiḥ strībhis tathā tiryaiḥ
pṛthivyāṃ jīvasaṃjñakaiḥ

ekaviṃśac ca narakā
yamasya viṣaye smṛtāḥ
ye tu duṣkṛtakarmāṇas
te patanti pṛthak pṛthak

narako rauravo nāma
mahāraurava eva ca
kṣuradhārā mahāraudraḥ
sūkaras tāla eva ca

vajrakumbho mahāghoraḥ
śālmalo 'tha vimohanaḥ
kīṭādaḥ kṛmibhakṣaś ca
śālmaliś ca mahādrumaḥ

tathā pūyavahaḥ pāpā
rudhirāndho mahattamaḥ
agnijvālo mahānādaḥ
saṃdāmśaḥ śunabhojanaḥ
tathā vaitaraṇī coṣṇā
asipattravanaṃ tathā

viṣṇos tad vacanaṃ śrutvā
papāta bhuvi pāṇḍavaḥ
sa saṃjñaś ca muhūrtena
bhūyaḥ keśavam abravīt

bhītaś cāsmi mahābāho
śrutvā mārgasya vistaram
kenopāyena taṃ mārgaṃ
taranti puruṣāḥ sukham

brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradānāni
nānārūpāṇi pārthiva
yo dadyāc chraddhayā yuktaḥ
sukhaṃ yāti mahāpatham

upānahapradā yānti
sukhaṃ chāyāsu cchattradāḥ
na teṣām aśubhaṃ kiṃcic
śūlādi na ca kaṇṭakāḥ

upānahau yo dadāti
pātrabhūte dvijottame
aśvataryaḥ pradātāram
upatiṣṭhanti taṃ naram

vitṛṣṇāś cāmbudātāras
tarpitāś cānnadās tathā
auprāvṛtā vastradāś ca
nagnā vai yānty avastradāḥ

hiraṇyadāḥ sukhaṃ yānti
puruṣāḥ svābhyalaṃkṛtāḥ
gopradā yānti ca sukhaṃ
vimuktāḥ sarvakilbiṣaiḥ

bhūmidāḥ sukham adhante
sarvakāmaiḥ sutarpitāḥ
yānti caivāparikliṣṭā
narāḥ śayyāsanapradāḥ

tataḥ sukhataraṃ yānti
vimāneṣu gṛhapradāḥ
kṣīrapradā hi divyābhiḥ
sasarpibhis tathaiva ca

gopradātā labhet tṛptiṃ
tasmin deśe sudurlabhām
ārāmaropī cchāyāsu
śītalāsu sukhaṃ vrajet

sugandhigandhino yānti
gandhamālyapradā naraḥ
adattadānā gacchanti
padbhyāṃ yānena yānadāḥ
dīpapradāḥ sukhaṃ yānti
dīpayantaś ca tatpatham

vimānair haṃsayuktais tu
yānti māsopavāsinaḥ
cakravākaprayuktena
pañcarātropavāsinaḥ
tato barhiṇayuktena
ṣaḍrātram upavāsinaḥ

trirātram ekabhaktena
kṣapayed yas tu pāṇḍava
anantaraṃ ca yo 'śnīyāt
tasya lokā yathā mama

panīyaṃ paralokeṣu
pāvanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam
pānīyasya pradānena
tṛptir bhavati śāśvatī
pānīyasya guṇā divyāḥ
pretaloke sukhāvahāḥ

tatra puṇyodakā nāma
nadī teṣāṃ pravartate
śītalaṃ salilaṃ tatra
pibanti hy amṛtopamam

ye ca duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ
pūyaṃ teṣāṃ pravartate
eṣā nadī mahārāja
sarvakāmadughā śubhā

adhvani khinnagātras tu
dvijo yaḥ kṣuttṛṣṇānvitaḥ
pṛcchan sadānnadātāram
abhyeti gṛham āśayā
taṃ pūjaya prayatnena
so 'tithir brāhmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ

pitaro devatāś caiva
ṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ
pūjitāḥ pūjite tasmin
nirāśe tu nirāśakāḥ

tam eva gacchantam anuvrajanti
devāś ca sarve pitaras tathaiva
tasmin dvije pūjite pūjitās te
gate nirāśe pratiyānti nāśam

ahany ahani dātavyaṃ
brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira
āgamiṣyati yat pātraṃ
tat pātraṃ tārayiṣyati

na tathā haviṣo homair
na puṣpair nānulepanaiḥ
agnau vā suhute rājan
yathā hy atithipūjane

kapilāyāṃ tu dattāyāṃ
yat phalaṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare
tat phalaṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha
viprāṇāṃ pādaśaucane

dvijapādodakaklinnā
yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī
tāvat puṣkarapātreṣu
pibanti pitaro jalam

devamālyāpanayanaṃ
dvijocchiṣṭāpamārjanam
śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ caiva
dīnasya paripālanam
ekaikaṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha
gopradānād viśiṣyate

pādaśaucaṃ tathābhyaṅgaṃ
dīpam annaṃ pratiśrayam
dadanti ye mahārāja
nopasarpanti te yamam

svāgatenāgnayaḥ prītā
āsanena śatakratuḥ
pitaraḥ pādaśaucena
annādyena prajāpatiḥ

yeṣāṃ taḍāgāni bahūdakāni
prapāś ca kūpāś ca pratiśrayāś ca
annapradānaṃ madhurā ca vāṇī
yamasya te nirvacanā bhavanti

savṛṣaṃ gośataṃ tena
dattaṃ bhavati śāśvatam

pāpaṃ karma ca yat kiṃcid
brahmahatyāsamaṃ bhavet
śochayet kapilāṃ dattvā
etad vai nātra saṃśayaḥ

prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā
vasordhārā ca syandate
gandharvāpsaraso yatra
tatra gacchanti gopradāḥ

prayacchate yaḥ kapilāṃ savatsāṃ
kāṃsyopadohāṃ kanakāgraśṛṅgīm
yān yān hi kāmān abhivāñchate 'sau
tāṃs tān avāpnoty amalāṃś ca lokān

yāvad vatsasya dvau pādau
śiraś caiva pradṛśyate
tāvad gauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā
yāvad garbhaṃ na muñcati
tasmin kāle pradātavyā
vidhinā yā mayoditā

antarikṣagato vatso
yāvad yonyāṃ pradṛśyate
tāvad gauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā
yāvad garbhaṃ na muñcati

tiladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi
yaś cāsyā vidhir uttamaḥ
suvarṇanābhiṃ yaḥ kṛtvā
sukhūraṃ kṛṣṇamārgaṇām

kutapaprastarasthāṃ tu
tilāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ
tilaiḥ prasthādi tāṃ dadyāt
sarvaratnair alaṃkṛtām

sasamudradrumā caiva
saśailavanakānanā
caturantā bhaved dattā
pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ

kṛṣṇājine tilāṃ kṛtvā
kṛṣṇāṃ vā yadi vetarām

prīyatāṃ dharmarājeti
yad vā manasi vartate
yāvaj jīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ
tena dānena pūyate

dhanaṃ prāpnoti puṇyena
maunenājñāṃ prayacchati
upabhogaṃ tu dānena
jīvitaṃ brahmacaryayā

ahiṃsayā paraṃ rūpam
dīkṣayā kulajanma ca
phalamūlāśanād rājyaṃ
svargaḥ parṇāśano bhavet

payobhakṣa divaṃ yānti
snānena draviṇādhikāḥ
śākaṃ sādhayato rājyaṃ
nākapṛṣṭham anāśanāt

sthaṇḍile ca śayānasya
gṛhāṇi śayanāni ca
cīravalkaladhāriṇāṃ
vastrāṇy ābharaṇāni ca

śayanāsanayānāni
ye gatā hi tapovanam
agnipraveśī niyataṃ
brahmaloke mahīyate

rasānāṃ pratisaṃhārāt
saubhāgyam abhijāyate
āmiṣapratiṣedhāt tu
bhavaty āyuṣmatī prajā

udavāsaṃ vased yas tu
nāgānām adhipo bhavet
satyavādī naraśreṣṭha
devataih saha modate

kīrtir bhavati dānena
ārogyaṃ cāpy ahiṃsayā

annapānapradānena
kāmabhogais tu tṛpyate
dīpālokapradānena
cakṣuṣmāñ jāyate naraḥ

gandhamālyapradānena
tuṣṭir bhavati puṣkalā
keśaśmaśrūn dhārayato hy
agrā bhavati saṃtatiḥ

vākśaucaṃ manasaḥ śaucaṃ
yac ca śaucaṃ jalāśrayam
tribhiḥ śaucair upeto yaḥ
sa svargī nātra saṃśayaḥ

tāmrāyasānāṃ bhaṇḍānāṃ
dātā ratnādhipo bhavet
labhate tu paraṃ sthānaṃ
balavān puṣyate sadā

dhānyaṃ krameṇārjitavittasaṃcayaṃ
vipre suśīle te prayacchate yaḥ
vasuṃdharā tasya bhavet sutuṣṭā
dhārā vasūnāṃ pratimuñcatīha

puṣpopabhogaṃ ca phalopabhogaṃ
yaḥ pādapaṃ sparśayate dvijāya
sa śrīsamṛddhaṃ bahuratnapūrṇaṃ
labhaty adhiṣṭhānavaraṃ samṛddham

indhanāni ca yo dadyād
dvijebhyaḥ śiśirāgame
kāyāgnidīptiṃ saubhāgyam
aiśvaryaṃ cādhigacchati

chattrapradānena gṛhaṃ variṣṭhaṃ
rathaṃ tathopānahasaṃpradānāt
dhuryapradānena gavām tathaiva
lokān avāpnoti puraṃdarasya
svargīyam apy āha hiraṇyadānam
tathā variṣṭhaṃ kanakapradānam

naiveśikaṃ sarvaguṇopapannaṃ
prayacchate yaḥ puruṣo dvijāya
svādhyāyacāritraguṇānvitāya
tasyāpi lokāḥ pravarā bhavanti

yo brahmadeyāṃ pradadāti kanyāṃ
bhūmipradānaṃ ca karoti vipre
hiraṇyadānaṃ ca tathā viśiṣṭaṃ
sa śakro lokaṃ labhate durāpam

sucitravastrābharaṇopadhānaṃ
dadyān naro yaḥ śayanaṃ dvijāya
rūpānvitāṃ dakṣavatīṃ manojñāṃ
bhāryām ayatnopacitāṃ labhet saḥ

lavaṇasya tu dātāras
tilānāṃ sarpiṣas tathā
tejasvino 'bhijāyante
bhoginaṣ cirajīvinaḥ

svarge 'psarobhiḥ saha bhuktabhogas
tataś cyutaḥ śīlavatīṃ sa bhāryām
rūpānvitāṃ dakṣavatīṃ suraktāṃ
sukhena dharmeṇa tathāpi kāle
tasyaiva sārdhaṃ suralokam eti
tasyaiva cānyat punar eti janma

kīdṛgvidhāsv avasthāsu
dattaṃ dānaṃ janārdana
ihalokeṣv anubhavet
puruṣas tad bravīhi me

garbhasthāsyāthavā bālye
yauvane vārddhake 'pi vā
avasthāṃ kṛṣṇa kathaya
paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me

vṛthājanmāni catvāri
vṛthādānāni ṣoḍaśa
aputrāṇāṃ vṛthā janma
ye ca dharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ
parapākaṃ ca ye 'śnanti
paradāraratāś ca ye

pary asthānaṃ vṛthā dānaṃ
sadoṣaṃ parikīrtitam
ārūḍhapatite caiva
anyāyopārjitaṃ ca yat

vyarthaṃ cābrāhmaṇe dānaṃ
patite taskare tathā
guroś cāprītijanake
kṛtaghne grāmayājake

brahmabandhau ca yad dattaṃ
yad dattaṃ vṛṣalīpatau
vedavikrayiṇe caiva
yasya copapatir gṛhe

strīnirjiteṣu yad dattaṃ
vyālagrāhe tathaiva ca
paricārake ca yad dattaṃ
vṛthādānāni ṣoḍaśa

tamovṛtas tu yo dadyād
bhayāt krodhāt tathaiva ca
vṛthā dānaṃ tu tat sarvaṃ
bhuṅkte garbhastha eva tu

serṣyāmanyumanāś caiva
dambhārthaṃ cārthakāraṇāt
yo dadāti dvijātibhyaḥ
sa bālatve tad aśnute

yaḥ śuddhiḥ prayato bhūtvā
prasannamānasendriyaḥ
pradadāti dvijātibhyo
yauvanasthas tad aśnute

deśe deśe ca pātre ca
yo dadāti dvijātiṣu
manasā parituṣṭena
yauvanasthas tad aśnute

tasmāt sarvāsv avasthāsu
sarvadānāni pārthiva
dātavyāni dvijātibhyaḥ
svargamargam abhīpsatā

trailokya kṛṣṇa bhūtānāṃ
sarvalokātmako hy asi
nṝṇāṃ yaduvaraśreṣṭha
tuṣyase kena karmaṇā

brāhmaṇaiḥ pūjitair nityaṃ
pūjito 'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ
nirbhartsitaiś ca nirbhagnas
tasyāhaṃ sarvakarmasu

viprāparā gatir mahyaṃ
yas tān pūjayate nṛpa
tam ahaṃ tena rūpeṇa
prapaśyāmi yudhiṣṭhira

kāṇāḥ kubjāś ca khañjāś ca
daridrā vyādhitāś ca ye
nāvamanyed dvijān prājño
mama rūpaṃ hitaṃ tathā

bahavo 'pi na jānante
narā jñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ
yathāhaṃ dvijarūpeṇa

tadrūpān ghnanti ye viprān

apreṣaṇe preṣayanto

yāvanti romakūpāni
tasya gātreṣu bhārata
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi
divyāni divi modate

nāsti vedāt paraṃ śāstraṃ
nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ
na dharmāt paramo lābhas
tapo nānaśanāt param

brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti
divi ceha ca pāvanam
upavāsais tathā tulyaṃ
tapo hy anyan na vidyate

upoṣya vidhivad devās
tridivaṃ pratipedire
munayaś ca parāṃ siddhim
upavāsair avāpnuvan

divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu
viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā
kṣāntam ekena bhaktena
yena vipratvam āgataḥ

cyavano jamadagniś ca
vasiṣṭho gautamo bhṛguḥ
sarve hy ete divaṃ prāptāḥ
kṣamāvanto bahuśrutāḥ
vidhinānena rājendra
yo mayā parikīrtitaḥ

paṭheta yo vai śṛṇuyāc ca bhaktyā
na vidyate tasya narasya pāpam
upadravair mucyate sarvāṅgikair
na cāpi pāpair abhibhūyate naraḥ

brāhmaṇatvaṃ suduṣprāpaṃ
nisargād brāhmaṇo bhavet
kṣatriyo vāthavā vaiśyo
nisargād eva jāyate

duṣkṛtena tu duṣṭātmā
sthānād bhraśyati mānavaḥ
śreṣṭhaṃ sthānaṃ samāsādya
tasmād rakṣeta paṇḍitaḥ

yas tu vipratvam utsṛjya
kṣatriyatvaṃ niṣevate
brāhmaṇyāt sa paribhraṣṭaḥ
kṣatrayonyāṃ prasūyate

vaiśyakarmāṇi vā kurvan
vaiśyayonau prajāyate
śūdrakarmāṇi kurvāṇaḥ
śūdratvam upapadyate

sa tatra durgatiṃ prāpya
sthānād bhraṣṭo yudhiṣṭhira
śūdrayonim anuprāpto
yadi dharmaṃ na sevate

mānuṣyāt sa paribhraṣṭas
tiryagyonau prajāyate
adharmasevanān mūḍhas
tamopahatacetanaḥ

jātyantarasahasrāṇi
tatraiva parivartate
tasmāt prāpya śubhaṃ sthānaṃ
pramādān na tu nāśayet

śūdrānnenāvaśeṣeṇa
yo mriyej jaṭhare dvijaḥ
āhitāgnis tathā yajvā
sa śūdragatibhāg bhavet

kṣatrānnenāvaśeṣeṇa
kṣatratvam upapadyate
vaiśyānnenāvaśeṣeṇa
vaiśyatvam upapadyate
tāṃ yoniṃ labhate vipro
bhuktvānnaṃ yasya vai mṛtaḥ

brāhmaṇatvaṃ śubhaṃ prāpya
durlabhaṃ yo 'vamanyate
bhojyābhojyaṃ na jānāti
sa bhavet kṣatriyo dvijaḥ

karmaṇā yena medhāvī
śūdro vaiśyo 'bhijāyate
tat te vakṣyāmi nikhilaṃ
yena varṇottamo bhavet

śūdrakarma yathoddiṣṭaṃ
śūdro bhūtvā samācaret
yathāvat paricaryāṃ tu
triṣu varṇeṣu nityadā
kurute 'vimanā yas tu
sa śūdro vaiśyatāṃ vrajet

kṣatriyatvaṃ yathā vaiśyas
tad vakṣyāmy anupūrvaśaḥ
caukṣaḥ pāpajanadveṣṭā
śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ

agnihotram upādāya
juhvānaś ca yathāvidhi
sa vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyakule
jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

kṣatriyo brahmayonyāṃ tu
jāyate śṛṇu tad yathā
dadāti yajate yajñair
vidhivac cāptadakṣiṇaiḥ
adhīte svargam anvicchaṃs
tretāgniśaraṇaḥ sadā

ārtahastaprado nityaṃ
prajā dharmeṇa pālayan
ṛtukāle tu svāṃ bhāryām
abhigacchan vidhānataḥ

sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya
dīyatāṃ bhujyatām iti
śūdrāṇāṃ yācakānāṃ ca
nityaṃ siddhim iti bruvan

gobrāhmaṇasya cārthāya
raṇe cābhimukho hataḥ
tretāgnimantrapūtātmā
kṣatriyo brāhmaṇo bhavet
vidhijñaḥ kṣatriyakule
yājakaḥ sa tu jāyate

prāpyate 'vikalaḥ svargo
varṇaiḥ satpatham āsthitaiḥ
brāhmaṇatvaṃ suduṣprāpaṃ
kṛcchreṇāsādyate naraiḥ
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena
rakṣed brāhmaṇyam uttamam

suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ
suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā parā
etat pavitraṃ paramam
etat svastyayanaṃ mahat

daśa pūrvāparān vaṃśān
ātmānaṃ ca viśāmyate
api pāpaśataṃ kṛtvā
dattvā vipreṣu tārayet

suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti
narāḥ śuddhena cetasā
devatās te prayacchanti
samastā iti naḥ śrutam

agnir hi devatāḥ sarvāḥ
suvarṇaṃ ca hutāśanaḥ
tasmāt suvarṇaṃ dadatā
dattāḥ sarvāś ca devatāḥ

agnyabhāve ca kurvanti
vahnisthāneṣu kāñcanam
sarvavedapramāṇajñā
vedaśrutinidarśanāt

ye tv enaṃ jvālayitvāgnim
ādityodayanaṃ prati
dadyur vai vratam uddiśya
sarvān kāmān avāpnuyuḥ

suvarṇadaḥ svargaloke
kāmān iṣṭān upāśnute
virajāmbarasaṃvītaḥ
pariyāti yatas tataḥ

vimānenārkavarṇena
bhāsvareṇa virājatā
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe
bhāsvatā svena tejasā

haṃsabarhiṇayuktena
kāmagena narottamaḥ
divyagandhavahaḥ svarge
parigacched itas tataḥ

tasmāt svaśaktyā dātavyaṃ
kāñcanaṃ mānavair bhuvi
na hy ataḥ paramaṃ loke
sadyaḥ pāpavimocanam

suvarṇasya tu śuddhasya
suvarṇaṃ yaḥ prayacchati
bahūny abdasahasrāṇi
svargaloke mahīyate

lokāṃs tu sṛjatā pūrvaṃ
gāvaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃbhuvā
prītyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ
tasmāt tā mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ

tās tu dattvā saurabheyīḥ
svargaloke mahīyate
tasmāt tā varṇayiṣyāmi
dānaṃ cāsāṃ yathāvidhi

yādṛśī vidhinā yena
dātavyā yādṛśāya ca
dvijāya poṣaṇārthaṃ tu
homadhenukṛte na vai

prathamā gaurakapilā
dvitīyā gaurapiṅgalā
tṛtīyā raktakapilā
caturthī nīlapiṅgalā
pañcamī śuklapiṅgākṣī
ṣaṣṭhī tu śuklapiṅgalā
saptamī citrapiṅgākṣī
aṣṭamī babhrurohiṇī
navamī śvetapiṅgākṣī
daśamī śvetapiṅgalā
tādṛśā ye 'py anaḍvāhaḥ
kapilās te prakīrtitāḥ
brāhmaṇo vāhayet tāṃs tu
nānyo varṇaḥ kadācana

dhenuṃ dattvā suvratāṃ sopadhānāṃ
kalyāṇavatsāṃ ca payasvinīṃ ca
yāvanti romāṇi bhavanti dhenvā
duhyeta kāmān nṛpa varṣāṇi tāvat

prayacchate yaḥ kapilāṃ savatsāṃ
kāṃsyopadohāṃ kanakāgraśṛṅgīm
tais tair guṇaiḥ kāmdughā hi bhūtvā
naraṃ pradātāram upaiti sā gauḥ

gosahasraṃ tu yo dadyāt
sarvakāmair alaṃkṛtam
parāṃ vṛddhiṃ śriyaṃ prāpya
svargaloke mahīyate

daśa cobhayataḥ pretya
mātāmahapitāmahaiḥ
gacchet sukṛtināṃ lokān
gāvo dattvā yathāvidhi

dāyādalabdhair arthair yo
gavāḥ krītvā prayacchati
tasyāpi cākṣayā lokā
bhavantīha paratra ca

yo dyūtena dhanaṃ jitvā
krītvā gāvaḥ prayacchati
sa gacched virajāṃl lokān
gopradānaphalārjitān

pratigṛhya tu yo dadyād
gāvaḥ śuddhena cetasā
sa gatvā durgamaṃ sthānam
amaraiḥ saha modate

yaś cātmavikrayaṃ kṛtvā
gāvo dadyād yathāvidhi
sa gatvā virajāṃl lokān
sukhaṃ vasati devavat

saṃgrāme yas tanuṃ tyaktvā
gāvaḥ krītvā prayacchati
dehavikrayamūlyas tāḥ
śāśvatāḥ kāmadohanāḥ

rūpānvitāḥ śīlavayopapannāḥ
sarvāḥ praśastā hi sugandhavatyaḥ
yathā hi gaṅgā saritāṃ variṣṭhā
tathārjunīnāṃ kapilā variṣṭhā

antarjātāḥ sukrayajñānalabdhāḥ
prāṇāṃs tyaktvā sodakāḥ sodvahāś ca
kṛcchrotsṛṣṭāḥ poṣaṇāyābhyupetā
dvārair etair goviśeṣā variṣṭhāḥ

tisro rātryaś cāpy upoṣyeha dātā
tṛptā gā vai tarpitebhyaḥ prayacchet
vatsaiḥ pītāḥ sopadhānās tryahaṃ ca
dattvā gā vai gorasair vartitavyam

loke jyeṣṭhā lokavṛttāntavṛttā
vedair gītāḥ somaniṣyandabhūtāḥ
saumyāḥ puṇyāḥ kāmadāḥ prāṇadāś ca
gāvo dattvā sarvadā santi santaḥ

na caivāsāṃ dānamātraṃ praśastaṃ
pātraṃ kālo goviśeṣo vidhiś ca
dṛṣṭvā gāvaḥ pāvakādityabhūtāḥ
svādhyāyāḍhye pātravarye viśiṣṭe

vaitānasthaṃ satyavākyaṃ kṛtajñaṃ
goṣu kṣāntaṃ gośaraṇyaṃ suvṛttaṃ
śastaṃ pātraṃ gopradānasya bhūmes
tathā suvarṇasya ca sarvakālam

bhikṣādānaṃ cādhikaṃ saṃpraśastaṃ
pāthodānaṃ cānnadānaṃ tathā ca

bhikṣate bahubhṛtyāya
śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye
dātavyā gauḥ prayatnena
ekāpy atiphalā hi sā

tāṃ ced vikrīṇate rājan
vacasā kaluṣīkṛtām
nāsau praśasyate vipro
brāhmaṇo naiva sa smṛtaḥ

tasyādharmapravṛttasya
lubdhasyānṛtavādinaḥ
havyakavyavyapetasya
na deyā gauḥ kathaṃcana

jīrṇāṃ caivopabhuktāṃ ca
jaratkūpam ivāphalām
tamaḥ praviśate dātā
dvijaṃ kleśena yojayan

duṣṭāḥ kṛśāś caiva pālayatīś ca
naitādṛśā dānayogyā bhavanti
kleśair vipraṃ yo 'phalaiḥ saṃyunakti
gacchet sa tiryag viphalāṃś ca lokān

anaḍvāhaṃ suvrataṃ yo dadāti
halasya voḍhāram anantavīryam
yugaṃdharaṃ balavantaṃ yuvānaṃ
prāpnoti lokān daśadhenudasya

prayacchate yaḥ puruṣo dvijāya
svādhyāyacāritraguṇānvitāya
balena yuktaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tu nīlaṃ
ṣaḍāṅgavaṃ prītikaraṃ surūpam

yuvānaṃ balinaṃ śyāmaṃ
śatena saha yūthapam
gavendraṃ brāhmaṇendrāya
bhūriśṛṅgam alaṃkṛtam

te gatvā tadgavāṃ lokaṃ
devalokān mahattaram
tatra sthitvā tu suciraṃ
sarvakāmaiḥ sutarpitāḥ

sadakṣiṇāṃ kāñcanarūpyaśṛṅgīṃ
kāṃsyopadohāṃ kanakottarīyām
dhenuṃ tilānāṃ kanakottarīyām
lokā vasūnām acalā bhavanti

tilālābhe tu yo dadyād
ghṛtadhenuṃ yatavrataḥ
sa durgāt tārito dhenvā
brahmaloke mahīyate

ghṛtālābhe tu yo dadyāj
jaladhenuṃ yatavrataḥ
sa sarvaṃ tarate durgaṃ
jalaṃ divyaṃ samaśnute

brāhmaṇāś caiva gāvaś ca
kulam ekaṃ dvidhākṛtam
ekatra mantrās tiṣṭhanti
havir ekatra tiṣṭhati

upagamya tu yo dadyād
gāvaḥ śuddhena cetasā
yāvanti tāsāṃ romāṇi
tāvat svarge mahīyate

śṛṇu tvaṃ me gavāṃ lokā
yādṛśā yatra vā sthitāḥ
manojñā ramaṇīyāś ca
sarvakāmadughāḥ sadā

puṇyāḥ pāpaharāś caiva
gavāṃ lokā na saṃśayaḥ
atyantasukhinas tatra
sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ

pramodante mahāsthāne
narā vigatakalmaṣāḥ
te vrajante vimāneṣu
grahā divi gatā iva

evaṃ yair dattasatkārāḥ
surabhyaś cārcitāḥ sadā
kāmarūpā mahātmānaḥ
pūtā vigatakilbiṣāḥ

tulyaprabhāvā devais te
modante 'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ
gandharvair upagīyante
gośaraṇyā na saṃśayaḥ

brahmaṇyāḥ sādhuvṛttāś ca
dayāvanto 'nukampinaḥ
ghṛṇinaḥ śubhakarmāṇo
modante te 'maraiḥ saha

yathaiva salile matsyaḥ
salilena sahohyate
gobhiḥ pāpakṛtaṃ karma
dṛḍham eva mayohyate

mātaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ
prajāsaṃrakṣaṇe smṛtāḥ
brahmaṇā lokasāreṇa
gāvaḥ pāpabhayāpahāḥ

tāsu dattāsu rājendra
kiṃ na dattaṃ bhaved iha
kṛśāya tu viśeṣeṇa
vṛttiglānāya sīdate

bhūdānena samaṃ dānaṃ
na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
iti dharmavidaḥ prāhus
tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu

ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇi
svarge vasati bhūmidaḥ
ācchettā cānumantā ca
tāny eva narake vaset

atidānaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ
bhūmidānam ihocyate
acalā hy akṣayā bhūmiḥ
sarvān kāmān prayacchati

bhūmidaḥ svargam āruhya
śāśvatīr edhati samāḥ
punaś ca janma saṃprāpya
bhaved bhūmipatir dhruvam

yathā bhūmiḥ sadā devī
dātāraṃ kurute patim
evaṃ sadakṣiṇā dattā
kurute gaur janādhipam

api pāpakṛtaṃ prāpya
pratigṛhṇīta bhūmidam
mahīṃ dadan pavitrī syāt
puṇyā hi jagatī yataḥ

nāma vai priyadatteti
guhyam etat sanātanam
tad asyāḥ satataṃ prītyai
kīrtanīyaṃ prayacchatā

yat kiṃcit kurute pāpaṃ
puruṣo vṛttikarṣitaḥ
api gocarmamātreṇa
bhūmidānena śudhyati

suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ
maṇimuktāvasūni ca
sarvān etān mahāprājña
dadāti vasudhāṃ dadan

tapo yajñāḥ śrutaṃ śīlam
alobhaḥ satyavāditā
gurudaivatapūjā ca
nātikramanti bhūmidam

bhartur niḥśreyase yuktās
tyaktātmāno raṇe hatāḥ
brahmalokagatāḥ santo
nātikrāmanti bhūmidam

phalakṛṣṭāṃ mahīṃ dattvā
sodakāṃ saphalānvitām
sodakaṃ vāpi śaraṇaṃ
prāpnoti mama saṃpadam

ratnopakīṛṇāṃ vasudhāṃ
yo dadāti dvijātaye
muktaḥ sa kaluṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ
svargaloke mahīyate

ikṣubhiḥ saṃtatāṃ bhūmiṃ
yavagodhūmaśāḍbalām
ye prayacchanti viprebhyo
nopasarpanti te yamam

sarvakāmadughāṃ dhenuṃ
sarvasasyasamudbhavām
yo dadāti dvijendrāya
brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati

bhūmidānaṃ naraḥ kurvan
mucyate mahato bhayāt
na bhūyo bhūmidānād dhi
dānam anyad viśiṣyate

puṇyāṃ sarvarasāṃ bhūmiṃ
yo dadāti nararṣabha
na tasya lokāḥ kṣīyante
bhūmidasya mahātmanaḥ

yathā janitrī puṣṇāti
kṣīreṇa svasutaṃ nṛpa
evaṃ sarvaguṇā bhūmir
dātāram anupuṣyati

agniṣṭomādibhir yajñair
iṣṭvā vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ
na tat phalaṃ avāpnoti
yad dattvā vasudhāṃ nṛpa

mṛtyor hi kiṃkarā daṇḍā hy
agnitāpāḥ sudāruṇāḥ
ghorāś ca vāruṇāḥ pāśā
nopasarpanti bhūmidam

pitaraḥ pitṛlokasthā
devaloke divaukasaḥ
saṃtarpayanti dātāraṃ
bhūmeḥ prabhavatāṃ vara

kṛśāya kṛśabhṛtyāya
