vṛttikṣīṇāya sīdate
bhūmiṃ vṛttikārīṃ dattvā
sattrī bhavati mānavaḥ

siṃhāsanaṃ tathā cchattraṃ
varāśvā varavāraṇāḥ
bhūmidānasya puṣpāṇi
phalaṃ svargaṃ tathaiva ca

ādityā iva dīpyante
tejasā divi mānavāḥ
ye prayacchanti vasudhāṃ
brāhmaṇāyāhitāgnaye

yathā bījāni rohanti
prakīrṇāni mahītale
tathā kāmādhirohanti
bhūmidānaguṇārjitāḥ

āsphoṭayanti pitaraḥ
pravalganti pitāmahāḥ
bhūmido naḥ kule jātaḥ
sa naḥ saṃtārayiṣyati

ādityā vasavo rudrā hy
aśvinau vasubhiḥ saha
śūlapāṇiś ca bhagavān
abhinandanti bhūmidam

sa naḥ kulasya puruṣaḥ
sa no bandhuḥ sa no gatiḥ
sa dātā sa ca vikrānto
yo dadāti vasuṃdharām

dātāram anugṛhṇāti
yathā dattena rocate
pūrvadattāṃ haran bhūmiṃ
narakāyopapadyate

vindhyāṭavīṣv atoyāsu
śuṣkakoṭaravāsinaḥ
kṛṣṇasarpā hi jāyante
ye haranti vasuṃdharām

patanty aśrūṇi rudatāṃ
dīnānām avasīdatām
brāhmaṇānāṃ hṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ
hanyāt tripuruṣaṃ kulam

sādhubhyo bhūmim ākṣipya
na bhūtiṃ vindate kvacit
dattvā hi bhūmiṃ sādhubhyo
vindate bhūtim uttamām

pūrvadattāṃ dvijātibhyo
yatnād rakṣa yudhiṣṭhira
mahīṃ mahībhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha
dānāc chreyo 'nupālanam

yatraiṣaḥ paṭhyate śrāddhe
bhūmidānasya saṃstavaḥ
na tatra rakṣasāṃ bhāgo
nāsurāṇāṃ kathaṃcana

akṣayaṃ tu bhavec chrāddhaṃ
pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
tasmād viśrāvayed enaṃ
śrāddheṣu brāhmaṇān sadā

evam etad yathoddiṣṭaṃ
pitṝṇāṃ dattam akṣayam
bhūmidānaṃ mahārāja
sarvapāpāpahaṃ śubham

agniṣṭomādibhir yajñair
iṣṭvā vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ
na tat phalam avāpnoti
saṃgrāme yad avāpnuyāt

iti yajñavidaḥ prāhur
yajñakarmaviśāradāḥ
tasmāt tat te pravakṣyāmi
yat phalaṃ śastrajīvinām

dharmalābho 'rthalābhaś ca
yaśolābhas tathaiva ca
yaḥ śūro vadhyate yuddhe
vimṛdan paravāhinīm
tasya dharmārthakāmāś ca
yajñāś caivāptadakṣiṇāḥ

paraṃ hy abhimukhaṃ hatvā
tadyānaṃ yo 'dhirohati
viṣṇukrāntaṃ sa yajata
evaṃ yudhyan raṇājire
aśvamedhān avāpnoti
caturas tena karmaṇā

yas tu śastram anutsṛjya
vīryavān vāhinīmukhe
saṃmukho vartate śūraḥ
sa svargān na vivartate

rājānaṃ rājaputraṃ vā
senāpatim athāpi vā
hanyāt kṣatreṇa yaḥ śūras
tasya loko 'kṣayo dhruvaḥ

yāvanti tasya śastrāṇi
bhindanti tvacam āhave
tāvato labhate lokān
sarvakāmadugho 'kṣayān

vīrāsanaṃ vīraśayyā
vīrasthānasthitiḥ sthirā
gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā
svāmyarthe tu kṛtaṃ ca yaiḥ
te gacchanty amalaṃ sthānaṃ
yathā sukṛtinas tathā

abhagnaṃ yaḥ paraṃ hanyād
bhagnaṃ ca parirakṣati
yasmin sthite palāyanti
so 'pi prāpnoti svargatim

ūrdhvaṃ tiryak ca yaś cārvāk
prāṇān saṃtyajate yudhi
hatāśvaś ca pated yuddhe
sa svargān na nivartate

yasya cihnīkṛtaṃ gātraṃ
śaraśaktyṛṣṭitomaraiḥ
devakanyās tu taṃ vīraṃ
ramayanti ramanti ca

varāpsaraḥsahasrāṇi
śūram āyodhane hatam
tvaritāny abhidhāvanti
mama bhartā mameti ca

hatasyābhimukhasyājau
patitasyānivartinaḥ
hriyate yat parair dravyaṃ
naramedhaphalaṃ tu tat

bhūyo gatiṃ pravakṣyāmi
raṇe ye 'bhimukhā hatāḥ

śakyaṃ tv iha samṛddhais tu
yaṣṭuṃ kratuśatair naraiḥ
ātmadehaṃ tu viprārthe
tyaktuṃ yuddhe suduṣkaram

yāṃ yajñasaṃghais tapasā ca viprāḥ
svargaiṣiṇas tatra cayaiḥ prayānti
kṣaṇena tām eva gatiṃ prayānti
mahāhave svāṃ tanuṃ saṃtyajantaḥ

sarvāṃś ca vedān saha ṣaḍbhir aṅgaiḥ
sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca vane ca vāsam
etān guṇān eka evātiśete
saṃgrāmadhāmny ātmatanuṃ tyajed yaḥ

imāṃ giraṃ citrapadāṃ śubhākṣarāṃ
subhāṣitāṃ vṛtabhidāṃ divaukasām
camūmukhe yaḥ smarate dṛḍhasmṛtir
na hanyate hanti ca so 'raṇe ripūn

eṣa puṇyatamaḥ svargyaḥ
suyajñaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ
sarveṣām eva varṇānāṃ
kṣatriyasya viśeṣataḥ

bhūyaś caiva pravakṣyāmi
bhīṣmavākyam anuttamam
yādṛśāya prahartavyaṃ
yādṛśaṃ parivarjayet

ātatāyinam āyāntam
api vedāntagaṃ raṇe
jighāṃsantaṃ jighāṃsīyān
na tena brahmahā bhavet

hatāśvaś ca na hantavyaḥ
pānīyaṃ yaś ca yācate
vyādhito durbalaś caiva
rathahīnas tathaiva ca

bhagnadhanvācchinaguṇaḥ
prāṇepsuḥ kṛpaṇaṃ bruvan
vimuktakeśo dhāved yo
yaś conmattākṛtir bhavet

parṇaśākhātṛṇagrāhī
tavāsmīti ca yo vadet
brāhmaṇo 'smīti yaś cāha
bālo vṛddho napuṃsakaḥ

tasmād etān parihared
yathoddiṣṭān raṇājire
hato na hanyate sadbhir
hatā eva hi bhīravaḥ

amāṃsabhakṣaṇe rājan
yo dharmaḥ kurupuṅgava
tan me śṛṇu yathātathyaṃ
yaś cāsya vidhir uttamaḥ

māsi māsy aśvamedhena
yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ
na ca khādati yo māṃsaṃ
samam etad yudhiṣṭhira

sadā yajati sattreṇa
sadā dānaṃ prayacchati
sadā tapasvī bhavati
madhumāṃsavivarjanāt

sarvavedā na tat kuryuḥ
sarvadānāni caiva hi
yo māṃsarasam āsvādya
sarvamāṃsāni varjayet

duṣkaraṃ hi rasajñena
māṃsasya parivarjanam
caturvratam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ
prāṇināṃ mṛtyubhīruṇām

tadā bhavati loke 'smin
prāṇināṃ jīvitaiṣiṇām
viśvāsyaś copagamyaś ca
na hi hiṃsārudir yadā

prāṇā yathātmano 'bhīṣṭā
bhūtānām api te tathā
ātmaupamyena gantavyaṃ
buddhimadbhir mahātmabhiḥ

ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ
satyam eva ca pāṇḍava
ahiṃsā caiva satyaṃ ca
dharmo hi paramaḥ smṛtaḥ

na hi māṃsaṃ tṛṇāt kāṣṭhād
upalād vāpi jāyate

jīvād utpadyate māṃsaṃ
tasmād garhanti tad budhāḥ

yadi vai khādako na syān
na tadā ghātako bhavet

lobhād vā buddhimohād vā
yo māṃsāny atti mānavaḥ
nirghṛṇaḥ sa hi mantavyaḥ
saddharmaparivarjitaḥ

svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena
yo vardhayitum icchati
udvignavāse vasati
yatratatrābhijāyate

dhanena krāyako hanti
upabhogena khādakaḥ
ghātako vadhabandhābhyām
ity eṣa trividho vadhaḥ

bhakṣayitvā tu yo māṃsaṃ
paścād api nivartate
tasyāpi sumahān dharmo
yaḥ pāpād vinivartate

varam ekasya sattvasya
dadyād akṣayadakṣiṇām
na tu viprasahasrasya
gosahasraṃ sakāñcanam
yo dadyāt kāñcanaṃ meruṃ
kṛtsnāṃ vāpi vasuṃdharām
abhakṣaṇaṃ ca māṃsasya
na tu tulyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira

śrūyate ca purākalpe hy
ṛṣīṇāṃ vrīhayaḥ paśuḥ
yajante yena vai yajñān
ṛṣayaḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ

ṛṣibhiḥ saṃśayaṃ pṛṣṭo
vasū rājā tataḥ purā
abhakṣyaṃ bhakṣyam iti vai
māṃsam āha narādhipa

ākāśān medinīṃ prāptas
tataḥ sa pṛthivīpatiḥ
etad eva punaś coktvā
viveśa dharaṇītalam

kaumudaṃ tu viśeṣeṇa
śuklapakṣe narādhipa
varjayet sarvamāṃsāni
dharmo hy atra vidhīyate

caturo vārṣikān māsān
yo māṃsaṃ parivarjayet
catvāri bhadrāṇy āpnoti
kīrtir āyur yaśo balam

apy ekam iha yo māsaṃ
sarvamāṃsāni varjayet
atītya sarvaduḥkhāni
sukhaṃ jīven nirāmayaḥ

yo hi varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ
tapas tapyet sudāruṇam
apy ekaṃ varjayen māsaṃ
māṃsam etat samaṃ matam

yo varjayati māṃsāni
māsaṃ pakṣam athāpi vā
sa vai hiṃsānivṛttas tu
brahmaloke mahīyate

sarvakālaṃ tu māṃsāni
varjitāni maharṣibhiḥ
manvā kṣupeṇa śvetena
tathaivekṣvākunāpi ca

bhṛguṇā nalarāmābhyāṃ
dilīparaghupauravaiḥ
āyuṣā caiva gārgyeṇa
janakaiś cakravartibhiḥ

dhundhumārāmbarīṣābhyāṃ
nahuṣeṇa ca dhīmatā
gādhinā purukutsena
kuruṇā puruṇā tathā

mucukundena māndhātrā
sagareṇa mahātmanā
śibinā cāśvapatinā
vīrasenādibhis tathā

saṃjayenātha bhīṣmeṇa
puṣkareṇātha pāṇḍunā
suvarṇaṣṭhīvinā caiva
duṣvantanṛgarohitaiḥ

etaiś cānyaiś ca bahubhiḥ
sarvair māṃsaṃ na bhakṣitam
śaratkaumudikaṃ māsaṃ
tataḥ svargaṃ gatā nṛpāḥ
sarvakāmasamṛddhās te
vasanti divi saṃsthitāḥ

brahmaloke ca pūjyante
jvalamānāḥ śriyāvṛtāḥ
upāsyamānā gāndharvaiḥ
strīsahasrasamanvitāḥ

tad evam uttamaṃ dharmam
ahiṃsālakṣaṇaṃ śubhan
ye rakṣanti mahātmāno
nākapṛṣṭhe vasanti te

madhu māṃsaṃ ca ye nityaṃ
varjayantīha mānavāḥ
janmaprabhṛti madyaṃ ca
sarve te munayaḥ smṛtāḥ

āpannaś cāpado mucyed
baddho mucyeta bandhanāt
vyādhito mucyate rogād
duḥkhān mucyeta duḥkhitaḥ

yaś cainaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ
prayatnād bharatarṣabha
ghoraṃ saṃtarate durgaṃ
svargavāsaṃ ca vindati
tiryagyoniṃ na gacchec ca
rūpavāṃś caiva jāyate

etat te kathitaṃ rājan
māṃsasya parivarjanam
pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca
pramāṇam ṛṣisattamaiḥ

gobrāhmaṇahitārthāya
cāturvarṇyahitāya ca
aśiṣṭanigrahārthāya
śiṣṭānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca
yudhiṣṭhirasya rājarṣer
evaṃ nārāyaṇo 'bravīt

pañca rūpāṇi rājāno
dhārayanty amitaujasaḥ
agner indrasya somasya
yamasya varuṇasya ca

tān na hiṃsen na cākrośen
nākṣipen nāpriyaṃ vadet
devā mānuṣarūpeṇa
caranti pṛthivīm imām

indrāt prabhutvaṃ jvalanāt pratāpaṃ
krauryaṃ yamād vaiśravaṇāt prabhāvam
sattvasthitiṃ rāmajanārdanābhām
ādāya rājñaḥ kriyate śarīram

na cāpi rājā mantavyo
manuṣyo 'yam iti prabho
mahatī devatā hy eṣā
nararūpeṇa tiṣṭhati

svayam indro naro bhūtvā
pṛthivīm anuśāsati
na hi pālayituṃ śakto
manuṣyaḥ pṛthivīm imām

yat prajāpālanaiḥ puṇyaṃ
prāpnuvantīha pārthivāḥ
na tat kratusahasreṇa
prāpnuvanti dvijottamāḥ

adhītahutataptasya
karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasya ca
ṣaṣṭhaṃ labhati bhāgaṃ tu
prajā dharmeṇa pālayan

grāmādhipatyaṃ nagarādhipatyaṃ
deśādhipatyaṃ pṛthivīpatitvam
na prāpnuvantīha manuṣyamātrā
ye devatānāṃ na bhavanti bhāgāḥ

na tad asti vrataṃ loke
yad rājñaś caritopamam
na tad vedarahasyaṃ vā
yad rājñaḥ phalato 'dhikam
evaṃvṛttās tu rājāno
devabhāgā na mānuṣāḥ

caturvedyaṃ hutaca..na
yo hiṃseta narādhipaḥ
daṇḍasyaite bhayād bhītā
na khādanti parasparam
ja..daṇḍabhayāt ke...
na durvanti hi pātakam
yamadaṇḍabhayād anye
na durvanti parasparam
nābhīto yajate kāṃścan (?)
nābhīto daṇḍam icchati

ya eva devā hantāras
tāṃl loko 'rcayate bhṛśam
hantā śakraś ca rudraś ca
hantā vaiśravaṇo yamaḥ
varuṇo vāyur ādityaḥ
parjanyo 'gnir bṛhaspatiḥ

etān devān namasyanti
pratāpapraṇatā janāḥ
na brahmāṇaṃ na dhātāraṃ
na pūṣāṇaṃ kathaṃcana

daṇḍagrastaṃ jagat sarvaṃ
vaśyatvam anugacchati
nāyaṃ klībasya loko 'sti
na paraḥ pārthivottama

na hi paśyāmi jīvantaṃ
rājan kaṃcid ahiṃsayā
udake jantavo nityaṃ
pṛthivyāṃ ca phaleṣu ca
na hatvā lipyate rājā
prajā dharmeṇa pālayan

yadi daṇḍo na vidyeta
durvinītās tatho narāḥ
hanyuḥ paśūn manuṣyāṃś ca
yājñiyāni haviṃṣi ca

vṛkavat kṣapayeyuś ca
yo yasya balavattaraḥ

tasmāt prāṇihite daṇḍe
hiṃsādoṣo na bādhate

naivostrā na balīvardā
nāśvāśvataragardabhāḥ
yuktā vaheyur yānāni
daṇḍaś cen nodyato bhavet

satyaṃ kilaitad yad uvāca śakro
daṇḍaḥ prajā rakṣati sādhuvṛttaḥ
yasyāgnayaḥ pratimāsasya bhītāḥ
saṃtarjitā daṇḍabhayāj jvalanti

yatra śyāmo lohitākṣo
daṇḍaś carati pāpahā
prajās tatra na muhyante
netā cet sādhu paśyati

daṇḍanītau sunītāyāṃ
sarve sidhyanty upakramāḥ
daṇḍaś cen na pravarteta
vinaśyeyur imāḥ prajāḥ

vṛkavad bhakṣayeyuś ca
yo yasya balavattaraḥ
kākādyāś ca purodāśaṃ
śvā caivāvalihed dhaviḥ

svāmyaṃ ca na syāt kasmiṃścit
pravartetādharottaram
cāturvarṇyavimokṣāya
durvinītabhayāya ca

daṇḍena niyato loko
dharmasthānaṃ ca rakṣati
sarvo daṇḍajito loko
durlabho hi śucir janaḥ

daṇḍasya hi bhayād bhītā
narās tiṣṭhanti śāsane
ti 'pi bhogāya kalpante
daṇḍenoparipīḍitāḥ

gurur ātmavatāṃ śāstā
śāstā rājā durātmanāṃ
ihapracchannapāpānāṃ
śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ

pāpānām atha mūḍhānāṃ
paradravyāpahāriṇām
paradāraratā ye ca
ye ca pātakasaṃjñitāḥ
teṣāṃ tu śāsanārthāya
mayaitat samudāhṛtam

brāhmaṇyaṃ duṣkaraṃ jñātvā
tasya daṇḍaṃ nipātayet
karmānurūpo daṇḍaḥ syād
gohiraṇyādiko bhavet
avadhyo brāhmaṇo rājan
strī vṛddho bāla eva ca

yaś cared aśubhaṃ karma
pāpaṃ rājavigarhitam
pātakeṣu ca varteta
nigrahaṃ tasya kārayet

śiraso muṇḍanaṃ kṛtvā
gomayenānulepayet
kharayānena nagaraṃ
ḍiṇḍimena tu bhrāmayet
rājanirdiṣṭadaṇḍasya
prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate

eṣa te kathito daṇḍo
brāhmaṇasya yudhiṣṭhira
kṣatriyasya tu yo daṇḍas
taṃ vakṣyāmy anupūrvaśaḥ

paradravyādiharaṇe
paradārābhimardane
pātakeṣu ca sarveṣu
yo hi varteta kṣatriyaḥ
tasya daṇḍaṃ pravakṣyāmi
tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu

hastapādaparicchedaṃ
karṇanāsāvakartanam
sarvasvaharaṇaṃ kṛtvā
pararāṣṭrāya preśayet

rājyaṃ kāṅkṣeta yo mūḍho
rājapatnīm athāpi vā
śarais tu rājā vidhyeta
śakticakragadādibhiḥ

kṣatriyasya tu duṣṭasya
daṇḍa eṣa vidhīyate
vaiśyasyāpi ca yo daṇḍas
taṃ pravakṣyāmi bhārata

pātakeṣv eva krūreṣu
yas tu vaiśyaḥ pravartate
paradāre paradravye
tasya nigraham ādiśet

śūlāyāṃ bhedanaṃ tasya
vṛkṣaśākhāvalambanam
etad vaiśyasya nirdiṣṭaṃ
śūdrasyāpy anupūrvaśaḥ

śūle śūdrasya yo duṣṭas
tasyaikasya vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ
kuñjareṇābhimardeta
mīnīyām atha pācayet
etac chūdrasya nirdiṣṭaṃ
nānyo daṇḍo vidhīyate

naikasyārthe kulaṃ hanyān
na rāṣṭraṃ na ca grāmakam

dhanalobhān na moktavyo
rāgād vā śāsanaṃ vinā

ekaṃ suśiṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā
śeṣaṃ kośaṃ praveśayet

yudhiṣṭhirasya rājarṣer
evaṃ nārāyaṇo 'bravīt
samāsena yathānyāyaṃ
daṇḍanītim anuttamām

uttamādhamakāryeṣu
sameṣu viṣameṣu ca
rājadharmāṃs tu paśyeta
viṣṇunā samudāhṛtān

etān dharmāñ jagannāthaḥ
pāṇḍuputrāya pṛcchate
jagāda puruṣavyāghra
kim anyac chrotum icchasi

bhagavan vahatāṃ bhaktiṃ
devadeve janārdane
yat phalaṃ kathitaṃ tajjñais
tan me vistarato vada

yat phalaṃ vahatāṃ bhaktim
acyute bhavati prabho
na tad varṇayituṃ śakyaṃ
hariḥ sarvepsitapradaḥ

yādṛk sattvaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ
tādṛg ārādhya keśavam
phalam icchanti tādṛc ca
labhyate tair nareśvara

muktikāmā narā muktiṃ
svargaṃ devatvam īpsavaḥ
gandharvayakṣasiddhānāṃ
vṛṇvanty anye salokatām

varṣeṣv abhīpsavo viṣṇuṃ
pātāleṣu tathāpare
bhogān abhīpsavo viṣṇuṃ
toṣayaṇti narādhipa

tathāpare naraiśvaryam
ārogyaṃ guṇavad bhuvi
prārthayanty acyutaṃ devam
ārādhya jagato gatim

dharmopadeśād acalāṃ
vahan bhaktiṃ janārdane
saśarīro gataḥ svargaṃ
dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

tathaiva janakaḥ kṛṣṇe
viniveśya svamānasam
avāpa paramāṃ siddhiṃ
vasuḥ prāyāt tripiṣṭapam

anye ca ye ye munayo
ye ye ca vasudhādhipāḥ
avāpur atulān kāmāṃs
te te saṃtoṣya keśavam

anārādhya jagannāthaṃ
sarvapāpaharaṃ harim
sadgatiḥ kena saṃprāptā
bhogāś cāpi manoramāḥ

drauṇibrahmāstranirdagdhas
tava rājan pitāmahaḥ
viṣṇoḥ kāryamanuṣyasya
darśanād utthitaḥ punaḥ

nāmasaṃkīrtanād yasya
pāpam anyair upadravaiḥ
samaṃ vināśam āyāti
devaḥ ko 'bhyadhikas tataḥ

rāṣṭrasya śaraṇaṃ rājā
pitarau bālakasya ca
dharmaḥ samastamartyānāṃ
sarvasya śaraṇaṃ hariḥ

muktihetum anādyantam
ajam akṣayam acyutam
namasyan sarvalokasya
namasyo jāyate naraḥ

na hi tasya guṇāḥ sarve
sarvair munigaṇair api
vaktuṃ śakyā viyuktasya
sattvādyair akhilair guṇaiḥ

śrutaṃ mayā yathā pūrvam
āryako me yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
saśarīro gataḥ svargaṃ
jitam ātmīyakarmabhiḥ

yat tv etad bhagavān āha
sa yathā pāṇdupūrvajaḥ
dharmopadeśād govindam
ārādhayata tad vada

purā śāsati dharmajñe
dharmaputre yudhiṣṭhire
tasyaiva vaiśvadevānte
caṇḍālo 'bhyāgamat kila

samupetya gṛhaṃ tasya
dharmaputrasya vismitaḥ
uvāca śvapaco dvāḥsthaṃ
praśrayāvanatasthitaḥ

kasyaitad bhavanaṃ divyaṃ
maṇiratnavibhūṣitam
śuddhasphaṭikasopānaṃ
maṇikāñcanatoraṇam

aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi
brāhmaṇānāṃ dine dine
yudhiṣṭhiram ṛte bhūpaṃ
bhuñjate kasya veśmani

katham etan na jānīṣe
candrabimbam ivāparam
yudhiṣṭhirasya bhavanaṃ
devarājagṛhopamam

abalasya balaṃ rājā
bālasya ruditaṃ balam
balaṃ mūrkhasya vai maunaṃ
taskarasyānṛtaṃ balam

gaccha jalpa svarājānaṃ
pratīhāra vaco mama
duḥkhārtaḥ kāryavān rājaṃś
caṇḍālo dvāri tiṣṭhati

ity ukto dharmarājasya
pratīhāro yathoditam
nivedayām āsa tathā
dharmarājo 'bravīd idam

kiṃ rūpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ śīlaṃ
ko 'syārthaḥ kiṃ prayojanam
brūhi dvāḥstha yathāvan me
naras tiṣṭhati kīdṛśaḥ

kākakokilakṛṣṇāṅgo
bhagnanāsāruṇekṣaṇaḥ
yavamadhyaḥ kṛśagrīvo
vakrapādo mahāhanuḥ

brūhi gaccha durācāraṃ
caṇḍālaṃ pāpakarmiṇam
devakāryasya velāyāṃ
dutas tvaṃ pratyupasthitaḥ

caṇḍālapatitau dṛṣṭvā
naraḥ paśyeta bhāskaram
snātas tv etāv athālokya
sacailasnānam arhati

ity ājñapte tathoktas tu
caṇḍālas tena vai tataḥ
pratyuvāca pratīhāram
īṣan manyupariplutaḥ

kiṃ devakāryeṇa narādhipasya
kṛtvā hi manyuṃ viṣayasthitānām
tad devakāryaṃ sa ca yajñahomo
yad aśrupātā na patanti rāṣṭre

idaṃ vacanam avyagraṃ
pratīhāra tvarā mama
nivedaya svarājendraṃ
yatheṣṭaṃ sa karotu vai
ity uktaḥ satvaraṃ gatvā
dharmarājaṃ tathā tathaṃ (?)
kathayām āsa tat sarvaṃ
cāṇḍālena yad īritam
suśobhanam idaṃ vākyaṃ
na bhaved antyajātiṣu
cintayitvā tato rājā
nirjagāma yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

ity etad vacanaṃ śrutvā
nirjagāma yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
pratyuvāca ca caṇḍālam
īṣan kopasamanvitaḥ

kutas te bhayam utpannaṃ
yena tvaṃ gṛham āgataḥ
āvādhākāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ
yathāvat kathayasva me

tad ahaṃ te pratijñāya
caṇḍakarmakarakṣaṇam
apāsya devakāryārthaṃ
praviśyāmy antaraṃ punaḥ

na bhuñjate brāhmaṇā me
sarvāś codvijate janaḥ
prāṇihiṃsā ca no vṛttir
deva puṣṇāti me 'nṛtam

anekajanmasāhasrīṃ
prāpya saṃsārapaddhatim
mānuṣye kutsitāṃ jātim
āpanno muṣito 'smi bhoḥ

karmabhūmim imāṃ rājan
prārthayanti divaukasaḥ
tāṃ saṃprāpya vṛthājanmā
muṣṭo 'smi kurusattama

duḥkhe duḥkhādhikān paśyet
sukhe paśyet sukhādhikān
ātmānaṃ śokaharṣābhyāṃ
śatrubhyām iva nārpayet

so 'ham icchāmi vijñātum
atiduṣkṛtakarmakṛt
vaktum arhasi dharmajña
kaḥ pāpiṣṭhataro mayā

adhvānam upari śrāntaṃ
brāhmaṇaṃ gṛham āgatam
anarcayitvā yo bhuṅkte
sa pāpiṣṭhataras tvayā

mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva
vikalaṃ netradurbalam
yo nābhyuddharate putraḥ
sa pāpiṣṭhataras tvayā

godhanasya tṛṣārtasya
jalārthaṃ paridhāvataḥ
vighnam ācarate yas tu
sa pāpiṣṭhataras tvayā

vivāhayitvā yaḥ kanyāṃ
kulajāṃ śīlamaṇḍanām
vinā tyajati doṣeṇa
sa pāpiṣṭhataras tvayā

āśākāras tv adātā yo
dātuś ca pratiṣedhakaḥ
dattaṃ ca yaḥ kīrtayati
sa pāpiṣṭhataras tvayā

bahubhṛtyair daridraiś ca
dhanaṃ santaṃ dvijottamaiḥ
yācito na prayacched yaḥ
sa pāpiṣṭhataras tvayā

brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi
vaiśyaḥ śūdro 'pi vā naraḥ
svadharmaṃ saṃtyajed yas tu
sa pāpiṣṭhataras tvayā

kṛtārtho 'haṃ gamiṣyāmi
yaśodharmam avāpnuhi
tuṣṭo 'smy ahaṃ svayā yonyā
mattaḥ proktās tvayādhamāḥ

devatānām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca
pitṝṇāṃ ca kṛtaṃ mayā
sāṃprataṃ deśakālo 'yaṃ
tvam evātra bhavātithiḥ

caṇḍālo 'haṃ mahārāja
patito lokavarjitaḥ
kathaṃ nihīno varṇebhyo
bhokṣyāmi bhavato gṛhe

caṇḍālo bhava pāpo vā
śatrur vā pitṛghātakaḥ
deśakālābhyupetaṃ tvāṃ
bharaṇīyaṃ hi vedmy aham

daśasūnāsamaṃ cakraṃ
daśacakrasamo dhvajaḥ
daśadhvajasamā veśyā
daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ

daśa sūnāsahasrāṇi
kurute yo hi saunikaḥ
tena tulyaḥ smṛto rājā
ghoras tasya pratigrahaḥ

nānāgotrādicaraṇā
bhuñjate brāhmaṇā mama
na te vadanti vāgduṣṭaṃ
yathaitat kīrtitaṃ tvayā

lobhātmāno na jānīyur
brāhmaṇā rājakilbiṣam
varaṃ svamāṃsam attavyaṃ
na tu rājapratigraham

rājakilbiṣadagdhānāṃ
brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
chinnānām iva bījānāṃ
punarjanma na vidyate

rājapratigraho ghoro
madhvāsvādo viṣopamaḥ
budhena pratihartavyaḥ
svamāṃsasyeva bhakṣaṇam

adhītya caturo vedān
sarvaśāstrārthatattvavit
narendrabhavane bhuṅktvā
viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ

dhairyavān ātmano 'nindyo
nāśvāsārthaṃ ca pṛcchasi
vimuktakrodhaharśaś ca
ko 'py atra pratibhāsi naḥ
anindyo nindyarūpeṇa
mahātmā tvaṃ hi me mataḥ
ko bhavān brūhi satyaṃ me
kimartham iha cāgataḥ
bhavān upendraḥ śakro vā
śarvo vā tvaṃ pinākadhṛk

athavā nindyarūpeṇa
pitā nas tvam ihāgataḥ

jñāto 'smi pṛthivīpāla
tuṣṭaś ca tava darśanāt
nandantu bhūmibhāgās te
yeṣu tvaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ

nirjitya parasainyāni
kṣitiṃ dharmeṇa pālaya
svalpam apy astu te velāṃ
mā govindojjhitaṃ manaḥ

kiṃ me rājyena bhos tāta
viṣayair jīvitena vā
yo 'haṃ sūnāsahasrais tu
daśabhiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ

mā viṣādaṃ naraśreṣṭha
samupaihi yudhiṣṭhira
yajñeśvaraṃ yajñamūrtiṃ
tvaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ samāśritaḥ

yeṣāṃ na viṣaye viprā
yajñair yajñapatiṃ harim
yajanti bhūbhujas teṣām
etat sūnoditaṃ phalam

yeṣāṃ pāṣaṇḍasaṃkīrṇaṃ
na rāṣṭraṃ brāhmaṇotkaṭam
te tu sūnāsahasrāṇāṃ
daśānāṃ bhāgino nṛpāḥ

yeṣāṃ na yajñapuruṣaḥ
kāraṇaṃ puruṣottamaḥ
te tu pāpasamācārāḥ
sūnāpāpaughabhāginaḥ

tvaṃ tu matprabhavas tāta
viṣṇubhaktas tathaiva ca
iṣṭir vaiśvānarī pāpam
upahaṃsyati te 'khilam

avaśyaṃ viṣaye kaścid
brāhmaṇaḥ saṃśritavrataḥ
iṣṭiṃ vaiśvānarīṃ kḷptāṃ
nirvaped abdaparyaye
tasya ṣaḍbhāgamātreṇa
tvaṃ pāpaṃ nirdahiṣyasi

sa tvaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te
varaṃ yan manasecchasi
samyak śraddhāsamācārād
aham ārādhitas tvayā

atha pātakabhītas tvaṃ
sarvabhāvena bhārata
vimuktānyasamārambho
nārāyaṇaparo bhava

paraḥ parāṇām ādyo 'sau
jñeyo dhyeyo janārdanaḥ
tadartham api karmāṇi
kurvan pāpaṃ vyapohati

lobhādivyāptahṛdayo
yat pāpaṃ kurute naraḥ
vilayaṃ yāti tat sarvam
acyute hṛdaye sthite

śamāyālaṃ jalaṃ vahnes
tamaso bhāskarādayaḥ
kṣāntiḥ kaler aghaughasya
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ

prasanno yadi me tāta
varārho yadi cāpy aham
varaṃ tad ekam evaitaṃ
prāptum icchāmy ahaṃ pitaḥ

jāgratsvapnasuṣupteṣu
yogasthasya sadā mama
yā kācin manaso vṛttiḥ
sā bhavatv acyutāśrayā

yā yā jāyeta me buddhir
yāvaj jīvāmy ahaṃ pitaḥ
sā sā chinattu saṃdehān
kṛṣṇāptau paripanthinaḥ

yathā govindam ārādhya
saśarīraḥ surālayam
prāpnuyām iti me tāta
prayaccha pravaraṃ varam

evam etad aśeṣaṃ te
matprasādād bhaviṣyati
nāsti govindabhaktānāṃ
vāñchitaṃ bhuvi durlabham

iti dharmopadeśena
sarvadevavaraṃ harim
ārādhya pāṇḍavo yātaḥ
saśarīraḥ surālayam

bhūyaś ca śṛṇu rājendra
janakena mahātmanā
yad gītaṃ vahatā bhaktiṃ
jñānam āsādya keśave

sarvatra samadṛṣṭiṃ taṃ
janakaṃ mithileśvaram
paśyantam acyutamayaṃ
sarvaṃ ca sacarācaram

dvijarūpaṃ samāsthāya
devadevo janārdanaḥ
upatasthe mahābhāgaṃ
pratyuvāca ca pārthivam

rājañ janaka bhadraṃ te
yad bravīmi nibodha tat
kuruṣva ca mahābuddhe
yadi sādhu mataṃ tava

pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpālaḥ
pālayitvā pitā tava
svargaṃ gatas tathā bhrātā
samyak satyadhvajo nṛpaḥ

tvaṃ punar nirabhīmānaḥ
sarvatra samadarśanaḥ
ripumitrādivargeṣu
katham etad bhaviṣyati

mitreṣu mitravan na tvaṃ
nāhiteṣv arivad bhavān
madhyasthabhāg na caiva tvaṃ
tathodāsīnavṛttiṣu

śabdādayo ye viśayās
te vairāgyaphalā nṛpa
nītyā vihīnas tu bhavān
kathaṃ rājyaṃ kariṣyati

sarvair nītiṃ samāsthāya
yathā te prapitāmahaiḥ
kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tathā bhūpa
kuru mātijaḍo bhava

tava prajñā matā hy eṣā
mama moho mahīpate
trivargasādhanaṃ prajñā
na dharmādivirodhinī

samyag āha bhavān vipra
vācyam evaṃ bhavadvidhaiḥ
mamāpi śrūyatāṃ vākyaṃ
bhavato yadi rocate

yadā sarvagato viṣṇuḥ
paramātmā prajāpatiḥ
tadā mitrādimadhyastha-
saṃjñā keṣu nipātyatām

pitā mātā tathā bhrātā
yadā nānyaj janārdanāt
pitṛmātṛmayīṃ saṃjñāṃ
tadā kutra karomy aham

so 'haṃ bravīmi yad vākyaṃ
tan nibodha dvijottama
anekarūparūpo 'yaṃ
viṣṇur evākhilaṃ jagat

viṣṇuḥ pitā me jagataḥ pratiṣṭhā
viṣṇur mātā viṣṇur evāgrajo me
viṣṇur gatir viṣṇumayas tathāsmi
viṣṇau sthito 'smy akṣagataś ca viṣṇuḥ

yo me mamatvopagataḥ sa viṣṇur
yaś cāribhūto mama so 'pi viṣṇuḥ
divaṃ viyad bhūḥ kakubhaś ca viṣṇur
bhūtāni viṣṇur bhuvanāni viṣṇuḥ

paśyāmi viṣṇuṃ na paraṃ tato 'nyac
śṛṇomi viṣṇuṃ na paraṃ tato 'nyat
spṛśāmi viṣṇuṃ na paraṃ tato 'nyaj
jighrāmi viṣṇuṃ na paraṃ tato 'nyat

rasāmi viṣṇuṃ na paraṃ tato 'nyan
manye ca viṣṇuṃ na paraṃ tato 'nyat

jighrāmi viṣṇuṃ na paraṃ tato 'nyac
namāmi viṣṇuṃ na paraṃ tato 'nyat

budhyāmi viṣṇuṃ na paraṃ tato 'nyat
sarvaṃ hi viṣṇur na paraṃ tato 'nyat

viṣṇuḥ samastaṃ na paraṃ tato 'sti
viṣṇuḥ samastaṃ na paraṃ ca devaḥ

viṣṇur laghīyān na paraṃ tato 'sti
viṣṇur garīyān na paraṃ tato 'nyat

yathā na viṣṇuvyatiriktam anyac
śṛṇomi paśyāmi tathā spṛśāmi
satyena tenopaśamaṃ prayāntu
doṣā vimukteḥ paripanthino ye

na me 'sti bandhur na ca me 'sti śatrur
na bhūtavargo na jano madanyaḥ
tvaṃ cāhaṃ anye ca śarīrabhedair
vibhinnam īśasya hareḥ svarūpam

mūrtāmūrtiviśeṣaṃ tu
paśyatas tanmayaṃ dvija
krodhaharṣādayo bhāvāḥ
sthāsyanti hṛdaye katham

sa tvaṃ prasīda moho 'yam
atha cen mama suvrata
tathāpi mā ruṣaṃ kārṣīr
acikitsyā hi mohitāḥ

bahurūpas tato rūpaṃ
śaṅkhacakragadādharam
darśayām āsa suprīto
janakāya janārdanaḥ

tatas taddarśanād bhūpaṃ
śirasā praṇataṃ prabhuḥ
ādyaḥ prajāpatipatiḥ
pratyuvācācyuto hariḥ

varaṃ varaya bhūpāla
parituṣṭo 'smi te 'nagha
mayy arpitamanobuddheḥ
sadaivāhaṃ na durlabhaḥ

yadi deva prasanno 'si
samyag ārādhito mayā
tad vṛṇomi varaṃ bhaktis
tvayy evāstu sadā mama

evaṃ bhaviṣyatīty uktvā
gato 'ntardhānam īśvaraḥ
so 'pi lebhe layaṃ viṣṇau
bhaktyā yogisudurlabham

iti kṛṣṇe naravyāghra
kurvan bhaktiṃ naraḥ sadā
prāpnoti puruṣavyāghra
muktiṃ cāpy atidurlabhām

jagaddhātur anantasya
vāsudevasya bhārgava
mamāvatārān akhilāñ
śrotum icchā pravartate

yathā yathā hi kṛṣṇasya
katheyaṃ kathyate tvayā
jāyate manasaḥ prītir
udbhūtapulakas tathā

manaḥprītir anāyāsād
apuṇyacayasaṃkṣayaḥ
prāpyate puruṣair brahmañ
śṛṇvadbhir bhagavatkathām

sa kuruṣvāmalamate
prasādapravaṇaṃ manaḥ
avatārān sureśasya
viṣṇor icchāmi veditum

jagadguruṃ jagadyonim
anantam udakeśayam
nārāyaṇaṃ purākalpe
pṛṣṭavān kamalodbhavaḥ

vinirjagmur mukhebhyas tu
brahmaṇo vyaktajanmanaḥ
oṃkārapravaṇā vedā
jagmus te ca rasātalam

ekārṇave jagaty asmin
brahmaṇy amitatejasi
kṛṣṇanābhihradodbhūta-
kamalodaraśāyini

bhogiśayyāśayaḥ kṛṣṇo
dvitīyāṃ tanum ātmanaḥ
kṛtvā mīnamayīṃ sadyaḥ
praviveśa rasātalam

vedamūrtis tato vedān
āninye brahmaṇo 'ntikam
madhukaiṭabhābhyāṃ ca punar
bhogiśayyāgato hariḥ
hṛtān hayaśirā bhūtvā
vedān āhṛtavān rasāt

āhṛteṣv atha vedeṣu
devadevaṃ pitāmahaḥ
tuṣṭāva praṇato bhaktyā
tasya cāvir babhau hariḥ

athāmaraguruṃ viṣṇum
anantam ajam avyayam
uvāca prakaṭībhūtaṃ
praṇipatyābjasaṃbhavaḥ

namaḥ sūkṣmātisūkṣmāya
namas tubhyaṃ trimūrtaye
bahurūpādimadhyānta
pariṇāmavivarjita

jagadīśasya sarvasya
jagataḥ sarvakāmada
aham ātmabhavo deva
tvayādhyakṣo nirūpitaḥ

so 'ham icchāmi taṃ jñātum
ātmānaṃ prabhavāvyayam
viśvasya ca virūpasya
sthāvarasya carasya ca

yadi te 'nugrahakṛtā
mayi buddhir janārdana
tan māṃ bhakta iti jñātvā
kathayātmānam acyuta

kathayāmi tavātmānam
anākhyāgodaraṃ param
na vācāṃ viṣaye yo 'sāv
aviśeṣaṇalakṣaṇaḥ

prasādasumukhaḥ so 'ham
imaṃ yacchāmi te varam
anākhyātasvarūpaṃ māṃ
bhavāñ jñāsyati yogataḥ

bhakto māṃ tattvato vetti
mayi bhaktiś ca te parā
majjijñāsā parā brahmaṃs
tena jātā matis tava

evam uktas tato brahmā
viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā
viṣṇoḥ svarūpaṃ jijñāsur
yuyojātmānam ātmanā

sa dadarśātisūkṣmaṃ ca
sūkṣmajyotiṣy ajaṃ vibhum
niyutārdhārdhamātreṇa
vyāptāśeṣacarācaram

ātmānam indrarudrārka-
candrāśvivasumārutān
khādīny atha ca śabdādīn
dadṛśe ca sa tanmayān

ye vyaktā ye tathāvyaktā
bhāvā ye cāpi pauruṣāḥ
tāṃś ca tatrātisūkṣmo 'pi
dṛṣṭavān akhilān vibhuḥ

tataḥ praṇamya deveśam
ajam ārtiharaṃ harim
pitāmahaḥ prahvatanur
vākyam etad uvāca ha

jñātaṃ svarūpam ajñāta-
svarūpa bhagavaṃs tava
mayā na yad vāgviṣaye
tatrasthaṃ cākhilaṃ jagat

dhanyo 'smy anugṛhīto 'smi
svarūpaṃ yan mayā tava
bhagavañ jñātam ajñātam
anantāja namo 'stu te

yadi prasādaṃ deva tvaṃ
prakaroṣi mamāparam
paramaṃ cāvatāreṣu
yad rūpaṃ tad vadasva me

keṣu keṣu mayā jñeyaḥ
sthāneṣu tvam adhokṣaja
saṃbhūtayo mamācakṣva
yā bhaviṣyanti te bhuvi

devaloke nṛloke vā
pātāle khe 'nyato 'pi vā
saṃbhūtayo yās tu bhavān
kariṣyati vadasva tāḥ

tvaṃ kartā sarvabhūtānāṃ
saṃhartā ceśvareśvaraḥ
tavāpi kartā nānyo 'sti
svecchayā krīḍate bhavān
ahaṃ vedmi bhavantaṃ hi
na tavānyo 'sti veditā

yan māṃ tvaṃ pṛcchasi brahman
avatārāśritaṃ param
tat te samyak pravakṣyāmi
nibodha mama suvrata

mama prakṛtyā saṃyogaḥ
svecchayā saṃpravartate
deveṣu nṝṣu tiryakṣu
sthāvareṣu careṣu ca
mamāvatārāḥ kāryārthaṃ
jagataś copakāriṇaḥ

yadā yadā hi dharmasya
glāniḥ samupajāyate
abhyutthānam adharmasya
tadātmāṅgaṃ sṛjāmy aham

paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṃ
vināśāya ca duṣkṛtāṃ
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya
saṃbhavāmi yuge yuge

pūrvotpanneṣu bhūteṣu
nṛdevādiṣu cāpy aham
anupraviśya dharmasya
karomi paripālanam

praviśya ca tathā pūrvaṃ
tanuṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara
jagato 'sya jagatsṛṣṭiṃ
karomi sthitipālanam

devatve devikā ceṣṭā
tiryaktve mama tāmasī
icchayā mānuṣatve ca
vicarāmi nṛceṣṭayā

pratikṣaṇaṃ ca bhūteṣu
sṛjāmi jagataḥ sthitim
karomi vidyamāneṣu
dharmasaṃsthāpaneṣu ca

yad vai dharmopakārāya
yac ca duṣṭanivarhaṇam
caritaṃ mānuṣādīnāṃ
tad vai jānīhi matkṛtam

yac ca pṛcchasi māṃ brahman
kāḥ kāḥ saṃbhūtayas tava
tāḥ śṛṇuṣva samāsena
yā bhaviṣyanti sāṃpratam

matsyena bhūtvā pātālāt
tava vedāḥ samuddhṛtāḥ
madhukaiṭabhābhyāṃ ca hṛtā
dattāśvaśirasā mayā

tvam apy atra mahābhāga
madaṃśaḥ kamalodarāt
mannābhisaṃbhavāj jātaḥ
prajāsṛṣṭikaraḥ paraḥ

ekārṇavaṃ ca yad idaṃ
brahman paśyasy aśeṣataḥ
asmin vasumatīṃ devīṃ
magnāṃ pātālam āgatām

vedapādo yūpadaṃṣṭraḥ
kratudantaś citīmukhaḥ
agnijihvo darbharomā
brahmaśīrṣo mahātapāḥ

ahorātrekṣaṇadharo
vedāṅgaśrutibhūṣaṇaḥ
ājyanāsaḥ śruvastuṇḍaḥ
sāmaghoṣasvaro mahān

prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimān
nānādīkṣābhir ācitaḥ
dakṣiṇāhṛdayo yogī
mahāsattramayo mahān

bhūtvā yajñavarāho 'ham
iti brahman rasātalāt
pṛthivīm uddhariṣyāmi
sthāpayaiṣyāmi ca sthitau

parvatānāṃ nadīnāṃ ca
dvīpādīnāṃ ca yā sthitiḥ
tāṃ ca tadvat kariṣyāmi
śailādīnām anukramāt

hiraṇyākṣaṃ ca durvṛttaṃ
kaśyapasyātmasaṃbhavam
tenaiva ghātayiṣyāmi
rūpeṇāhaṃ prajāpate

utpādya pṛthivīṃ samyak
sthāpayitvā yathā purā
sṛṣṭiṃ tataḥ kariṣyāmi
tvām āviśya prajāpatim

jānāsi kāpilaṃ rūpaṃ
prathamaṃ pauruṣaṃ mama
sarvavidyāpraṇetāraṃ
tvayā vedeṣu darśitam
ravimaṇḍalamadhyastham
agner yat paramaṃ padam

tata utsṛjya rūpāṇi
amarādivibhedataḥ
vyāpayiṣyāmi lokāṃs tu
bhūlokādīm aśeṣataḥ

sṛṣṭaṃ jagad idaṃ deva-
mānuṣyādiviśeṣaṇam
hiraṇyakaśipur daityas
tāpayiṣyati vikramāt

vyaṃsayitvā varāṃs tasya
tais tair hetubhir ātmavān
nṛsiṃharūpaṃ kṛtvāhaṃ
ghātayiṣyāmi taṃ ripum

kṣīrābdau kūrmarūpo 'haṃ
devānāṃ kamalodbhava
mandaraṃ dhārayiṣyāmi
pṛṣṭhenāmṛtamanthane

hariṣyati ca devānāṃ
yajñabhāgān yadā baliḥ
tadāhaṃ vāmano bhūtvā
gatvā tasya mahādhvaram

vañcayitvāsurapatiṃ
kariṣyāmi tripiṣṭapam
baliṃ cāpi kariṣyāmi
pātālatalavāsinam

atrer dattvā varaṃ caiva
tasya putratvam āgataḥ
dattātreyo bhaviṣyāmi
nihaṃsyāmi tathāsurān

sattvānām upakārāya
pradhānapuruṣāntaram
darśayiṣyāmi lokeṣu
kāpilaṃ rūpam āsthitaḥ

kārtavīryādibhiś cānyaiś
caturdaśabhir anvitāḥ
bhaviṣyanti madaṃśena
tretāyāṃ cakravartinaḥ

tataś ca bhārgavo rāmo
gṛhītaparaśur dvijaḥ
bhūtvā kṣatriyahīnāṃ ca
kariṣyāmi vasuṃdharām

punaś ca rāghavo rāmo
bhūtvā daśarathātmajaḥ
baddhvā mahodadhiṃ kartā
rākṣasānāṃ kulakṣayam

uttīrya ca paraṃ pāraṃ
laṅkām āsādya durjayām
nihatya rāvaṇaṃ vīraṃ
varadānena darpitam
māyāvināṃ mahāvīryaṃ
rakṣasāṃ vanaśāyinām
lakṣmaṇānucaro rāmaḥ
kariṣyāmi kulakṣayam

aṣṭāviṃśatime prāpte
dvāpare kaṃsam ucchritam
keśinaṃ dhenukaṃ caiva
śakuniṃ pūtanāṃ tathā
ariṣṭaṃ ca haniṣyāmi
muruṃ narakam eva ca

niśumbhaṃ sahayagrīvaṇ
tathānyāṃś cāsureśvarān
haniṣyāmi sudurvṛttāṃl
lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā

pravarṣati sa devendre
mahobhaṅgavirodhite
govardhanaṃ girivaraṃ
dhārayiṣyāmi bāhunā

bhārākrāntām imām urvīṃ
dhanaṃjayasahāyavān
ghātayitvākhilān bhūpāṃl
laghvīṃ kartāsmi sattama

prāpte kaliyuge kṛtsnam
upasaṃhṛtya vai kulam
dvārakāṃ plāvayiṣyāmi
utsrakṣyāmi manuṣyatām

dvitīyo yo mamāṃśas tu
rāmo 'nantaḥ sa lāṅgalī
so 'pi saṃtyajya vasudhāṃ
rasātalam upeṣyati

tataḥ kaliyuge ghore
saṃprāpte 'bjasamudbhava
śuddhodanasuto buddho
bhaviṣyāmi vimatsaraḥ

bauddhaṃ dharmam upāśritya
kariṣye dharmadeśanām
narāṇām atha nārīṇāṃ
dayāṃ bhūteṣu darśayan

raktāmbarā hy āñjitākṣāḥ
praśāntamanasas tataḥ
śūdrā dharmaṃ pravakṣyanti
mayi buddhatvam āgate

eḍūkacihnā pṛthivī
na devagṛhabhūṣitā
bhavitrī prāyaśo brahman
mayi buddhatvam āgate

skandhadarśanamātraṃ hi
paśyantaḥ sakalaṃ jagat
śūdrāḥ śūdreṣu dāsyanti
mayi buddhatvam āgate

alpāyuṣas tato martyā
mohopahatacetasaḥ
narakārhāṇi karmāṇi
kariṣyanti prajāpate

svādhyāyeṣv avasīdanto
brāhmaṇāḥ śaucavarjitāḥ
antyapratigrahādānaṃ
kariṣyanty alpamedhasaḥ

na śroṣyanti pituḥ putrāḥ
śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ snuṣāḥ
na bhāryā bhartur īśasya
na bhṛtyā vinayasthitāḥ

varṇasaṃkaratāṃ prāpte
loke 'smin dasyutāṃ gate
brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu
bhaviṣyaty adharottaram

dharmakañcukasaṃvītā
vidharmarucayas tathā
mānuṣān bhakṣayiṣyanti
mlecchāḥ pārthivarūpiṇaḥ

tataḥ kaliyugasyānte
vedo vājasaneyakaḥ
daśa pañca ca vai śākhāḥ
pramāṇena bhaviṣyati

tato 'haṃ saṃbhaviṣyāmi
brāhmaṇo haripiṅgalaḥ
kalkī viṣṇuyaśaḥputro
yājñavalkyapurohitaḥ

mlecchān utsādayiṣyāmi
gṛhītāstraḥ kuśāyudhaḥ
sthāpayiṣyāmi maryādāś
cāturvarṇye yathoditāḥ

tathāśrameṣu sarveṣu
brahmacārivratādikāḥ
sthāpayitvā tataḥ sarvāḥ
prajāḥ saddharmavartmani
kalkirūpaṃ parityajya
divam eṣyāmy ahaṃ punaḥ

tataḥ kṛtayugaṃ bhūyaḥ
pūrvavat saṃpravartsyate
varṇāśramāś ca dharmeṣu
dveṣu sthāsyanti sattama

evaṃ sarveṣu kalpeṣu
sarvamanvantareṣu ca
mamāvatārāḥ śataśo
ye bhavanti jagaddhitāḥ

saṃkarṣaṇātmajaś caiva
kalpānte ca rasātalāt
samutpatsyet tadā rudraḥ
kālāgnir iti yaḥ śrutaḥ

tataḥ kṣayaṃ kariṣyāmi
jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam
bhūyaś caiva hi svapsyāmi
jagaty ekārṇave sthite
tvadrūpī ca tato bhūtvā
jagat srakṣyāmy ahaṃ punaḥ

etat saṃkṣepato brahman
mayākhyātaṃ yathātatham
aṃśāvataraṇaṃ sarvaṃ
mattaḥ saṃkṣepataḥ śṛṇu

yad dṛśyaṃ yac ca vai spṛśyaṃ
yad ghreyaṃ rasyate ca yat
yac chravyaṃ yac ca mantavyaṃ
bodhavyaṃ cāham aṃśagaḥ

yat tu buddheḥ parataram
anākhyeyam anopamam
tad ahaṃ brahma nirdvandvaṃ
yad vai paśyanti sūrayaḥ

idaṃ janmarahasyaṃ me
yo naraḥ kīrtayiṣyati
sulabho 'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi
tasya janmani janmani

paṭhann etad brahmahā tu
surāpo gurutalpagaḥ
steyī kṛtaghno goghnaś ca
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

garbhiṇī janayet putraṃ
kanyā vindati satpatim
labhante 'bhimatān kāmān
narās tāṃs tān yathepsitān

iti devātidevena
brahmaṇo vyaktajanmanaḥ
rahasyam idam ākhyātaṃ
tavāpi kathitaṃ mayā

viṣṇuḥ sarvagato 'nantaḥ
sarvaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam
sa ca sarvam idaṃ rājan
na tato vidyate param

etat pavitraṃ paṭhitaṃ
tathā duḥsvapnanāśanam
jātismaratvaṃ prajñāṃ ca
dadāti paṭhatāṃ nṛṇām

mayā hi devadevasya
viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ
śrutāḥ saṃbhūtayaḥ sarvā
gadatas tava suvrata

yadi prasanno bhagavān
anugrāhyo 'smi vā yadi
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi
nṝṇāṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam

svapnā hi sumahābhāga
dṛśyante ye śubhāśubhāḥ
phalāni te prayacchanti
tadguṇāny eva bhārgava

yad yat puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca
nṝṇām atiśubhapradam
duḥsvapnopaśamāyālaṃ
tan me vistarato vada

idam eva mahārāja
pṛṣṭavāṃs te pitāmahaḥ
bhīṣmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ
dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

devavrataṃ mahāprājñaṃ
sarvaśāstraviśāradam
vinayenopasaṃgamya
paryapṛcchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

duḥsvapnadarśanaṃ ghoram
avekṣya bharatarṣabha
prayataḥ kiṃ japej japyaṃ
vibuddhaḥ kim anusmaret

pitāmaha mahābuddhe
buddher bhedo mahān ayam
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi
brūhi me vadatāṃ vara

śṛṇu rājan mahābāho
vartayiṣyāmi te 'khilam
duḥsvapnadarśane japyaṃ
yad vai nityaṃ samāhitaiḥ

atrāpy udāharantīmam
itihāsaṃ purātanam
gajendramokṣaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ
kṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ

sarvaratnamayaḥ śrīmāṃs
trikūṭo nāma parvataḥ
sutaḥ parvatarājasya
sumeror bhāskaradyuteḥ

kṣīrodajalavīcyagrair
dhautāmalaśilātalaḥ
utthitaḥ sāgaraṃ bhittvā
devarṣigaṇasevitaḥ

apsarobhiḥ samākīrṇaḥ
śrīmān prasravaṇākulaḥ
gandharvaiḥ kiṃnarair yakṣaiḥ
siddhacāraṇapannagaiḥ

mṛgair dvīpair dvijaiś caiva
vṛtaḥ sauvarṇarājataiḥ
puṃnāgaiḥ karṇikāraiś ca
puṣpitair upaśobhitaḥ

cūtanīpakadambaiś ca
candanāgarucampakaiḥ
śālais tālais tamālaiś ca
kuṭajaiś cārjunais tathā

evaṃ bahuvidhair vṛkṣaiḥ
sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ
nānādhātūjjvalaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ
prasravadbhiḥ samantataḥ

mṛgaiḥ śākhāmṛgaiḥ siṃhair
mātaṃgaiś ca sadāmadaiḥ
jīvaṃjīvakasaṃghuṣṭaṃ
cakoraśikhināditam

tasyaikaṃ kāñcanaṃ śṛṅgaṃ
sevate yad divādaraḥ
nānāpuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ
nānāgandhasamākulam

dvitīyaṃ rājataṃ śṛṅgaṃ
sevate yan niśākaraḥ
pāṇḍurāmbudasaṃkāśaṃ
tuṣāracayasaṃnibham

vajrendranīlavaiḍūrya-
tejobhir bhāsayan nabhaḥ
tṛtīyaṃ brahmasadanaṃ
prakṛṣṭaṃ śṛṅgam uttamam

na tat kṛtaghnāḥ paśyanti
na nṛśaṃsā na nāstikāḥ
nātaptatapasaḥ śailaṃ
taṃ vai paśyanti mānavāḥ

tasya sānumataḥ pṛṣṭhe
saraḥ kāñcanapaṅkajam
kāraṇḍavasamākīrṇaṃ
rājahaṃsopaśobhitam

utpalaiḥ śatapattraiś ca
kāñcanaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam
pattrair maṇidalaprakhyaiḥ
puṣpaiḥ kāñcanasaṃnibhaiḥ
gulmaiḥ kīcakaveṇūnāṃ
samantāt parivāritam

tasmin sarasi duṣṭātmā
virūpo 'ntarjalāśayaḥ
āsīd grāho gajendrāṇāṃ
durādharṣo mahābalaḥ

atha dantojjvalamukhaḥ
kadācid gajayūthapaḥ
ājagāmāsitābhrābhaḥ
kareṇuparivāritaḥ

madasrāvī mahāraudraḥ
pādacārīva parvataḥ
vāsayan madagandhena
girim airāvatopamaḥ

gandhahastīti vikhyātaḥ
saraḥ samabhigamya tat
tṛṣitaḥ sa jalaṃ prāpya
kusumākaraśītalam
apibat sahasā rājan
kareṇuparivāritaḥ

gṛhītas tena raudreṇa
grāheṇāvyaktamūrtinā
paśyantīnāṃ kareṇūnāṃ
krośantīnāṃ ca dāruṇam

gajaś cākarṣate tīraṃ
grāhaś cākarṣate jalam
tayor dvandva mahāyuddhaṃ
divyavarṣasahasrikam

vāruṇaiḥ saṃyataḥ pāśair
niḥprayatnagatiḥ kṛtaḥ
veṣṭyamānaḥ sughorais tu
pāśair nāgo dṛḍhais tathā

visphurjya ca yathāśakti
vikruśya ca mahāravān
vyathitaḥ saṃnirutsāho
gṛhīto ghorakarmaṇā

paramāpadam āpanno
manasācintayad dharim
sa tu nāgavaraḥ śrīmān
nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ

tam eva paramaṃ devaṃ
gataḥ sarvātmanā tadā
ekāgraṃ cintayām āsa
viśuddhenāntarātmanā

janmajanmāntarābhyāsād
bhaktimān garuḍadhvaje
ādyaṃ devaṃ mahātmānaṃ
pūjayām āsa keśavam

navameghapratīkāśaṃ
śaṅkhacakragadādharam
sahasraśubhanāmānam
ādidevam ajaṃ param

digbāhuṃ sarvamūrdhānaṃ
bhūpādaṃ gaganodaram
ādityacandranayanaṃ
samagraṃ lokasākṣiṇam

pragṛhya puṣkarāgreṇa
kāñcanaṃ kamalottamam
āpadvimokṣam anvicchan
gajaḥ stotram udairayat

nama ādyāya bījāya
śivāya ca praśāntāya

avyaktāya namo namaḥ
purāṇāya namo namaḥ

namo namaḥ kāraṇavāmanāya
nārāyaṇāyāmitavikramāya
śrīśārṅgacakrāsigadādharāya
namo 'stu tasmai puruṣottamāya

ādyāya vedanilayāya mahodarāya
siṃhāya daityanidhanāya caturbhujāya
brahmendrarudramunicāraṇasaṃstutāya
devottamāya varadāya namo 'cyutāya

nābhiprajātakamalasthacaturmukhāya
kṣīrodakārṇavaniketayaśodhanāya
nānāvicitramukuṭāṅgadabhūṣaṇāya
sarveśvarāya varadāya namo varāya

viśvātmane paramakāraṇakāraṇāya
phullāravindavimalāyatalocanāya
devendradānavaparīkṣitapauruṣāya
yogeśvarāya vijayāya namo varāya

lokāyanāya tridaśāyanāya
brahmāyanāyātmabhavāyanāya
dharmāyanāyaikajalāyanāya
mahāvarāhāya sadā nato 'smi

acintyam avyaktam anantarūpaṃ
nārāyaṇaṃ kāraṇam ādidevam
yugāntaśeṣaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ
taṃ vāsudevaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye

yogeśvaraṃ cāruvicitramaulim
ājñeyamaukhyaṃ prakṛteḥ parastham
kṣetrajñam ātmaprabhavaṃ vareṇyaṃ
taṃ vāsudevaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye

adṛśyam acchedyam anādimadhyaṃ
maharṣayo brahmavidaḥ sureśam
vadanti yaṃ vai puruṣaṃ sanātanaṃ
taṃ vāsudevaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye

yad akṣaraṃ brahma vadanti sarvagaṃ
niśāmya yaṃ mṛtyumukhāt pramucyate
tam īśvaraṃ tṛptam anopamair guṇaiḥ
parāyaṇaṃ viṣṇum upaimi śāśvatam

kāryaṃ kriyākāraṇam aprameyaṃ
hiraṇyanābhaṃ varapadmanābham
mahābalaṃ vedanidhiṃ surottamaṃ
vrajāmi viṣṇuṃ śaraṇaṃ janārdanam

vicitrakeyūramahārhaniṣkaṃ
ratnottamālaṃkṛtasarvagātram
pītāmbaraṃ kāñcanabhakticitraṃ
mālādharaṃ keśavam abhyupaimi

bhavodbhavaṃ vedavidāṃ variṣṭhaṃ
yogātmānaṃ sāṃkhyavidāṃ variṣṭham
ādityacandrāśvivasuprabhāvaṃ
prabhuṃ prapadye 'cyutam ātmabhūtam

śrīvatsāṅkaṃ mahādevaṃ
vedaguhyam anuttamam
prapadye sūkṣmam acalaṃ
bhaktānām abhayapradam

prabhavaṃ sarvalokānāṃ
nirguṇaṃ parameśvaram
prapadye muktasaṃgānāṃ
yatīnāṃ paramāṃ gatim

bhagavantaṃ surādhyakṣam
akṣaraṃ puṣkarekṣaṇam
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaktyā
prapadye brāhmaṇapriyam

trivikramaṃ trilokeśam
ādyam ekam anāmayam
bhūtātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ
prapadye madhusūdanam

kṣetrajñaṃ puruṣaṃ yajñaṃ
triguṇātītam avyayam
nārāyaṇam aṇīyāṃsaṃ
prapadye parameśvaram

ekāya lokatrayāya
parataḥ paramātmane
namaḥ sahasraśirase
anantāya mahātmane

vareṇyam anaghaṃ devam
ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ
kīrtayanti ca yaṃ sarve
taṃ prapadye sanātanam

namas te puṇḍarīkākṣa
bhaktānām abhayaprada
subrahmaṇya namas te 'stu
trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam

bhaktiṃ tasyānusaṃcintya
nāgasyāmoghasaṃstavam
prītimān abhavad rājañ
śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
sāṃnidhyaṃ kalpayām āsa
tasmin sarasi mādhavaḥ

grāhagrastaṃ gajaṃ taṃ ca
saṃgṛhya salilāśayāt
ujjahārāprameyātmā
tarasaivārisūdanaḥ

sthalasthaṃ dārayām āsa
grāhaṃ cakreṇa mādhavaḥ
mokṣayām āsa ca gajaṃ
pāśebhyaḥ śaraṇāgatam

sa hi devalaśāpena
hūhū gandharvasattamaḥ
gajatvam agamat kṛṣṇān
mokṣaṃ prāpya divaṃ gataḥ
śāpād vimuktaḥ sadyaś ca
gajo gandharvatāṃ gataḥ

grāho 'pi yakṣatāṃ yāto
yaḥ kṛṣṇena nipātitaḥ
tasyāpi śāpamokṣo 'sau
jaigīṣavyakṛto 'bhavat

prītimāṃs trāti govindaḥ
sadyaḥ saṃsārasāgarāt
kruddho 'pi nighnan devatvam
arātīnāṃ prayacchati

tau ca svaṃ svaṃ vapuḥ prāpya
praṇipatya janārdanam
gandharvarāṭ tathā yakṣaḥ
parāṃ nirvṛtim āgatau

idaṃ caiva mahābāho
devadevo 'bhyabhāṣata
dṛṣṭvā muktau gajagrahau
bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ

yo grāhaṃ nāgarājaṃ ca
māṃ caiva praṇidhānavān
smariṣyati saraś cedaṃ
yuvayor mokṣaṇaṃ tathā

gulmaṃ kīcakaveṇūnāṃ
taṃ ca śailavaraṃ tathā
aśvatthaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaṅgāṃ
naimiṣāraṇyam eva ca

saṃsmariṣyanti ye martyāḥ
samyak śroṣyanti vāpi ye
na te duḥsvapnapāpasya
bhoktāro matparigrahāt

sarvapāpaiḥ pramokṣyante
kalyāṇānāṃ ca bhāginaḥ
bhaviṣyanti tathā puṇyāṃ
gatiṃ yāsyanti mānavāḥ
duḥsvapnaṃ ca nṛṇāṃ teṣāṃ
susvapnaṃ ca bhaviṣyati

kaurmaṃ mātsyaṃ ca vārāhaṃ
vāmanaṃ tārkṣyam eva ca
nārasiṃhaṃ tathā rūpaṃ
sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakam

etāni prātar utthāya
saṃsmariṣyanti ye narāḥ
sarvapāpavinirmuktās
te yānti paramāṃ gatim

evam uktvā tu rājendra
devadevo janārdanaḥ
aspṛśad gajagandharvaṃ
grāhayakṣaṃ ca taṃ tadā

tena spṛṣṭāv ubhau sadyo
divyamālyāmbarānvitau
vimāne 'bhimate prāpya
jagmatus tridaśālayam

tato devapatiḥ kṛṣṇo
mokṣayitvā gajottamam
ṛṣibhiḥ stūyamāno hi
guhyair vedapadākṣaraiḥ
gataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇur
durvijñeyagatiḥ prabhuḥ

gajendramokṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā
sarve cendrapurogamāḥ
brahmāṇam agrataḥ kṛtvā
sarve prāñjalayo 'bhavan

vavandire mahātmānaṃ
prabhuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim
vismayotphullanayanāḥ
prajāpatipuraḥsarāḥ
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ
prātar utthāya mānavaḥ
prāpnuyāt paramāṃ siddhiṃ
duḥsvapnas tasya naśyati

gajendramokṣaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ
sarvapāpapramocanam
śrāvayet prātar utthāya
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

śraddhayā hi kuruśreṣṭha
smṛtena kathitena ca
gajendramokṣaṇeneha
dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt

mayā te kathitaṃ divyaṃ
pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam
kīrtayasva mahābāho
mahāduḥsvapnanāśanam

kīrtyamānaṃ ca viprebhyaḥ
śṛṇu bhaktyā yathoditam

gajendramokṣaṇaṃ śrutvā
kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
bhīṣmād bhagīrathīputrāt
pūjayām āsa keśavam

ye cāpi pāṇḍuputrasya
samīpasthā dvijottamāḥ
te 'pi bhīṣmasya pārśvasthaṃ
vāsudevaṃ praṇemire

varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varapadmanābhaṃ
nārāyaṇaṃ brahmanidhiṃ sureśam
taṃ devaguhyaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ
vavandire brahmavidāṃ variṣṭham

etat puṇyaṃ mahārāja
narāṇāṃ pāpakarmaṇām
duḥsvapnadarśane ghore
śrutvā pāpāt pramucyate
bhaktimān puṇḍarīkākṣe
gajo duḥkhād vimocitaḥ

tathā tvam api rājendra
prapadya śaraṇaṃ harim
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ
prāpsyase paramāṃ gatim

mahāmate mahāprājña
sarvaśāstraviśārada
akṣīṇakarmabandhas tu
puruṣo dvijasattama

maraṇe yaj japañ japyaṃ
yac ca bhāvaṃ anusmaran
paraṃ padam avāpnoti
tan me vada mahāmune

śrīvatsāṅkaṃ jagadbījam
anantaṃ lokabhāvanam
purā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ
nāradaḥ paryapṛcchata

bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa
śraddadhānair jitendriyaiḥ
kathaṃ bhaktair vicintyo 'si
maraṇe pratyupasthite

kiṃ vā japyaṃ japen nityaṃ
kalyam utthāya mānavaḥ
svapan vibudhyan dhyāyaṃś ca
tan me brūhi sanātana

śrutvā tasya tu devarṣer
vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ
provāca bhagavān viṣṇur
nāradaṃ jagato gatiḥ

hanta te kathayiṣyāmi
mune divyām anusmṛtim
maraṇe yām anusmṛtya
prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim

oṃkāram āditaḥ kṛtvā
mām anusmṛtya manmanāḥ
ekāgraprayato bhūtvā
idaṃ mantram udīrayet

avyaktaṃ śāśvataṃ devam
anantaṃ puruṣottamam
prapadye prāñjalir viṣṇum
acyutaṃ parameśvaram

purāṇaṃ paramaṃ viṣṇum
adbhutaṃ lokabhāvanam
prapadye puṇḍarīkākṣam
īśaṃ bhaktānukampinam

lokanāthaṃ prapanno 'smi
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam
bhagavantaṃ prapanno 'smi
bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhum

sraṣṭāraṃ sarvabhūtānām
anantabalapauruṣam
padmanābhaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ
papadye satyam avyayam

hiraṇyagarbhaṃ bhūgarbham
amṛtaṃ viśvatomukham
ābhāsvaram anādyantaṃ
prapadye bhāskaradyutim

sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tārkṣyavāhanam
prapadye sūkṣmam acalaṃ
vareṇyam abhayapradam

nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ haṃsaṃ
yogātmānaṃ sanātanam
śaraṇyaṃ sarvalokānāṃ
prapadye dhruvam īśvaram

yaḥ prabhuḥ sarvalokānāṃ
yena sarvam idaṃ tatam

carācaragurur devaḥ
sa no viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu

yasmāj jātaḥ purā brahmā
padmayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ
prasīdatu sa no viṣṇuḥ
pitā mātā pitāmahaḥ

yaḥ purā pralaye prāpte
naṣṭe loke carācare
ekas tiṣṭhati yogātmā
sa no viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu

caturbhiś ca caturbhiś ca
dvābhyāṃ pañcabhir eva ca
hūyate ca punar dvābhyāṃ
sa no viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu

parjanyaḥ pṛthivī sasyaṃ
kālo dharmaḥ kriyā phalam
guṇākaraḥ sa no babhrur
vāsudevaḥ prasīdatu

yogāvāsa namas tubhyaṃ
sarvāvāsa varaprada
yajñagarbha mahābhāga
pañcayajña namo 'stu te

caturmūrte jagaddhāma
lakṣmyāvāsa varaprada
sarvāvāsa namas te 'stu
sākṣibhūta jagatpate

ajeya khaṇḍaparaśo
viśvamūrte vṛṣākape
trigarte pañcakālajña
namas te jñānasāgara

avyaktād aṇḍam utpannam
avyaktādyaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ
yasmāt parataraṃ nāsti
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

cintayanto hi yaṃ nityaṃ
brahmeśānādayaḥ prabhum
niścayaṃ nādhigacchanti
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

jitendriyā mahātmāno
jñānadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
yaṃ prāpya na nivartante
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

ekāṃśena jagat sarvaṃ
yo 'vaṣṭabhya vibhuḥ sthitaḥ
agrāhyo nirguṇaḥ śāstā
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

divākarasya saumyaṃ hi
madhye jyotir avasthitam
kṣetrajñam iti yaṃ prāhuḥ
sa mahātmā prasīdatu

avyaktam anavasthāno
durvijñeyaḥ sanātanaḥ
āsthitaḥ prakṛtiṃ bhuṅkte
sa mahātmā prasīdatu

kṣetrajñaḥ pañcadhā bhuṅkte
prakṛtiṃ bahubhir guṇaiḥ
manoguṇāṃś ca yo bhuṅkte
sa mahātmā prasīdatu

sāṃkhyā yogāś ca ye cānye
siddhāś caiva maharṣayaḥ
yaṃ viditvā vimucyante
sa mahātmā prasīdatu

namas te sarvatobhadra
sarvato'kṣiśiromukha
nirvikāra namas te 'stu
sākṣibhūta hṛdi sthita
atīndriya namas tubhyaṃ
liṅgebhyas tvaṃ pramīyase

ye tu tvāṃ nābhijānanti
saṃsāre saṃsaranti te
rāgadveṣavinirmuktaṃ
lobhamohavivarjitam
aśarīraṃ śarīrasthaṃ
samaṃ sarveṣu dehiṣu

avyaktaṃ buddhyahaṃkārau
mahābhūtendriyāṇi ca
tvayi tāni na teṣu tvaṃ
teṣu tvaṃ tāni na tvayi

sraṣṭā bhoktāsi kūṭastho
guṇānāṃ prabhur īśvaraḥ
akartā heturahitaḥ
prabhuḥ svātmany avasthitaḥ

namas te puṇḍarīkākṣa
punar eva namo 'stu te
īśvaro 'si jagannātha
kim ataḥ param ucyate
bhaktānāṃ yad dhitaṃ deva
tad dhyāya tridaśeśvara

mā me bhūteṣu saṃyogaḥ
punar bhavatu janmani
ahaṃkāreṇa buddhyā vā
tathā sattvādibhir guṇaiḥ

mā me dharmo hy adharmo vā
punar bhavatu janmani
viṣayair indriyair vāpi
mā me bhūyāt samāgamaḥ

pṛthivīṃ yātu me ghrāṇaṃ
yātu me rasanā jalam
cakṣur hutāśanaṃ yātu
sparśo me yātu mārutam

śabdo hy ākāśam abhyetu
mano vaikārikaṃ tathā
ahaṃkāraś ca me buddhiṃ
tvayi buddhiḥ sametu ca

viyogaḥ sarvakaraṇair
guṇair bhūtaiś ca me bhavet
sattvaṃ rajas tamaś caiva
prakṛtiṃ praviśantu me

niṣkevalaṃ padaṃ caiva
prayāmi paramaṃ tava
ekībhāvas tvayaivāstu
mā me janma bhavet punaḥ

namo bhagavate tasmai
viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave
tvanmanas tvadgatapṛāṇas
tvadbhaktas tvatparāyaṇaḥ
tvām evānusmare deva
maraṇe pratyupasthite

pūrvadehakṛtā ye me
vyādhayas te viśantu mām
ārdayantu ca duḥkhāni
pravimuñcāmi yad ṛṇam

upatiṣṭhantu me rogā
ye mayā pūrvasaṃcitāḥ
anṛṇo gantum icchāmi
tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam

ahaṃ bhagavatas tasya
mama cāsau sureśvaraḥ
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi
sa ca me na praṇaśyati

namo bhagavate tasmai
yena sarvam idaṃ tatam
tam eva ca prapanno 'smi
mama yo yasya cāpy aham

imām anusmṛtiṃ nityaṃ
vaiṣṇavīṃ pāpanāśanīm
svapañ jāgrat paṭhed yas tu
trisaṃdhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ smaret

maraṇe cāpy anuprāpte
yas tv imāṃ samanusmaret
api pāpasamācāraḥ
so 'pi yāti parāṃ gatim

arcayann api yo devaṃ
gṛhe vāpi baliṃ dadet
juhvad agniṃ smared vāpi
labhate sa parāṃ gatim

paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāṃ
dvādaśyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
śrāvayec chraddadhānaṃs tu
ye cānye mām upāśritāḥ

nama ity eva yo brūyān
madbhaktaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ
tasya syur akṣayā lokāḥ
śvapākasyāpi nārada

kiṃ punar ye yajante māṃ
sādhavo vidhipūrvakam
dhyāyanti ca yathānyāyaṃ
te yānti paramāṃ gatim

aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ
yaḥ sahasraṃ samācaret
nāsau tat padam āpnoti
madbhaktair yad avāpyate

iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ tapo 'dhītaṃ
vratāni niyamāś ca ye
sarvam etad vināśāntaṃ
jñānasyānto na vidyate

tasmāt pradeyaṃ sādhubhyo
dharmyaṃ sattvābhayaṃkaram
dānādīny antavantīha
madbhakto nāntam aśnute

yo dadyād bhagavajjñānaṃ
kuryād vā dharmadeśanām
kṛtsnāṃ vā pṛthivīṃ dadyān
na tu tulyaṃ kathaṃcana

kāntāravanadurgeṣu
kṛcchreṣv āpatsu saṃbhrame
dasyubhiḥ saṃniruddhaś ca
nāmabhir māṃ prakīrtayet

varāho rakṣatu jale
viṣameṣu ca vāmanaḥ

rāmo rāmaś ca rāmaś ca
trāyantāṃ dasyudoṣataḥ

aṭavyāṃ nārasiṃhas tu
sarvataḥ pātu keśavaḥ

baddhaḥ parikaras tena
mokṣāya gamanaṃ prati
sakṛd uccāritaṃ yena
harir ity akṣaradvayam

janmāntarasahasrāṇi
tapojñānasamādhibhiḥ
narāṇāṃ kṣīṇapāpānāṃ
kṛṣṇe bhaktiḥ prajāyate
gatvā gatvā nivartane
candrasūryādayo grahāḥ
adyāpi na nivartante
dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ
na vāsudevāt param asti maṅgalaṃ
na vāsudevāt paramaṃ pavitram
na vāsudevāt param asti daivataṃ
na vāsudevaṃ praṇipatya sīdati

tasmān mām eva devarṣe
dhyāyasvātandritaḥ sadā
avāpsyasi tataḥ siddhiṃ
padaṃ drakṣyasi ca dhruvam

evaṃ sa devadevena
nāradaḥ pratibodhitaḥ
cakāra keśave bhaktiṃ
tasmāt tvaṃ kuru bhūpate

yaḥ paṭhet parayā bhaktyā
sa gacched viṣṇusāmyatām
etat puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ
dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam

pāpaṃ praṇaśyate yena
puṇyaṃ yena vivardhate
yaj japan sugatiṃ yāti
śṛṇvaṃś ca mama tad vada

kaścid āsīd dvijadrogdhā
piśunaḥ kṣatriyādhamaḥ
parapīḍārucir duṣṭaḥ
svabhāvād eva nirghṛṇaḥ

paribhūtāḥ sadā tena
pitṛdevadvijātayaḥ
paradāreṣu caivāsya
babhūvābhirataṃ manaḥ

sa tv āyuṣi parikṣīṇe
jajñe ghoro niśācaraḥ
tena vai karmadoṣeṇa
svena pāpakṛtāṃ varaḥ

krūrair eva tato vṛttiṃ
rākṣasatve viśeṣataḥ
cakāra karmabhiḥ pāpaḥ
sarvaprāṇivihiṃsakaḥ

tasya pāparatasyaivaṃ
jagmur varṣaśatāni vai
tena vai karmadoṣeṇa
nānyā vṛttir arocata

yad yat paśyati sattvaṃ sa
tat tad ādāya rākṣasaḥ
cakhāda puruṣavyāghra
bāhugocaram āgatam

evaṃ tasyātiduṣṭasya
kurvataḥ prāṇināṃ vadham
jagāma sumahān kālaḥ
pariṇāmaṃ tathā vayaḥ

sa dadarśa tapasyantaṃ
tāpasaṃ saṃśritavratam
ūrdhvabāhuṃ mahābhāgaṃ
kṛtarakṣaṃ samantataḥ

taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa tu durbuddhir
brāhmaṇaṃ rākṣasādhamaḥ
samabhyadhāvad vegena
samādātuṃ cikhādiṣuḥ

tena rakṣā ca yā dikṣu
brāhmaṇenābhavat kṛtā
tayā nirastaṃ tad rakṣo
nipapātāvidūrataḥ

bhagavan kīdṛśīṃ rakṣāṃ
sa cakāra dvijottamaḥ
yayā nirdhūtavīryo 'sau
nirasto rajanīcaraḥ

ekāgracitto govinde
taj japaṃs tatparāyaṇaḥ
tapaś cacāra vipro 'sau
praviṣṭo viṣṇupañjaram

viṣṇupañjaram icchāmi
śrotuṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara
sadā sarvabhayebhyas tu
rakṣā yā paramābhavat

tripuraṃ jaghnuṣaḥ pūrvaṃ
brahmaṇā viṣṇupañjaraḥ
śaṃkarasya kuruśreṣṭha
rakṣaṇāya nirūpitaḥ

vāgīśena tu śakrasya
balaṃ hantuṃ prayāsyataḥ
tasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi
tan nibodha mahīpate

viṣṇuḥ prācyāṃ sthitaś cakrī
viṣṇur dakṣiṇato gadī
pratīcyāṃ śārṅgadhṛg viṣṇur
viṣṇuḥ khaḍgī mamottare

hṛṣīkeśo vikoṇeṣu
tacchidreṣu janārdanaḥ
kroḍarūpī harir bhūmau
narasiṃho 'mbare mama

kṣurāntam amalaṃ cakraṃ
bhramaty etat sudarśanam
asyāṃśumālā duḥprekṣā
hantu pretaniśācarān

gadā ceyaṃ sahasrārcir
udvamatpāvakolvaṇā
rakṣobhūtapiśācānāṃ
ḍākiṇīnāṃ ca nāśanī

śārṅgavisphūrjitaṃ caiva
vāsudevasya madripūn
tiryaṅmanuṣyakūṣmāṇḍa-
pretādīn hantv aśeṣataḥ

khaḍgadhārājvalajjyotsnā-
nirdhūtā ye samāhatāḥ
te yāntu saumyataṃ sadyo
garuḍeneva pannagāḥ

ye kūṣmāṇḍās tathā yakṣā
ye daityā ye niśācarāḥ
pretā vināyakāḥ krūrā
manuṣyā jambhakāḥ khagāḥ

siṃhādayo ye paśavo
dandasūkāś ca pannagāḥ
sarve bhavantu te saumyāḥ
kṛṣṇaśaṅkharavāhatāḥ

cittavṛttiharā ye me
ye janāḥ smṛtihārakāḥ
balaujasāṃ ca hartāraś
chāyāvibhraṃśakāś ca ye

ye copabhogahartāro
ye ca lakṣaṇanāśakāḥ
kūṣmāṇḍās te praṇaśyantu
viṣṇucakrarayāhatāḥ

buddhisvāsthyaṃ manaḥsvāsthyaṃ
svāsthyam aindriyakaṃ tathā
mamāstu devadevasya
vāsudevasya kīrtanāt

pṛṣṭhe purastān mama dakṣiṇottare
vikoṇagaś cāstu janārdano hariḥ
tad īḍyam īśānam anantam īśvaraṃ
janārdanaṃ praṇipatito na sīdati

yathā paraṃ brahma haris tathā paraṃ
jagatsvarūpaś ca sa eva keśavaḥ
ṛtena tenācyutanāmakīrtanāt
praṇāśam etu trividhaṃ mamāśubham

ity asāv ātmarakṣārthaṃ
nyastavān viṣṇupañjaram
tenāsādhyaḥ sa duṣṭānāṃ
babhūva nṛpa rakṣasām

etayārakṣayā rakṣo
nirdhūtaṃ bhuvi pātitam
japyāvasāne vipro 'sau
dadarśa vigataujasam

dṛṣṭvā ca kṛpayāviṣṭaḥ
samāśvāsya niśācaram
papracchāgamane hetuṃ
taṃ cācaṣṭa yathātatham
kathayitvā ca tat sarvaṃ
rākṣasaḥ punar abravīt

prasīda vipravarya tvaṃ
nirviṇṇasyātipāpinaḥ
pāpapraśamanāyālam
upadeśaṃ prayaccha me

bahūni pāpāni mayā
kṛtāni bahavo hatāḥ
kṛtāḥ striyaś ca me bahvyo
vidhavā hataputrikāḥ
anāgasāṃ ca sattvānām
anekānāṃ kṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ

so 'ham icchāmi viprarṣe
prasādāt tava suvrata
pāpasyāsya kṣayaṃ kartuṃ
kuru me dharmadeśanām

kathaṃ krūrasvabhāvasya
satas tava niśācara
sahasaiva samāyātā
jijñāsā dharmavartmani

tvām attum āgataḥ kṣipto
rakṣayā kṛtayā tvayā
tatsaṃsparśāc ca me brahman
sādhv etan manasi sthitam

kā sā rakṣā na tāṃ vedmi
vedmi nāsyāḥ parāyaṇam
kiṃtv asyāḥ saṃgam āsādya
nirvedaṃ prāpitaṃ param

sa kṛpāṃ kuru dharmajña
mayy anukrośam āvaha
yathā pāpāpanodo me
bhavaty ārya tathā kuru

ity evam uktaḥ sa muniḥ
sadayas tena rakṣasā
pratyuvāca mahābhāga
vimṛśya suciraṃ tadā

yat tvam ātthopadeśārthaṃ
nirviṇṇaḥ svena karmaṇā
yuktam etan na pāpānāṃ
nivṛtter upakārakam

kariṣye yātudhānānāṃ
na tv ahaṃ dharmadeśanām
tāṃs tvaṃ pṛccha dvijān saumya
ye vai pravacane ratāḥ

evam uktvā yayau vipraś
cintām āpa ca rākṣasaḥ
kathaṃ pāpāpanodaḥ syād
ity asau vyākulendriyaḥ

na tadā khādate sattvān
kṣudhā saṃpīḍito 'pi san
ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe tadā kāle
jantum ekam abhakṣayat

sa kadācit kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ
paryaṭan vipine vane
dadarśātha phalāhāram
agrataḥ kauśikaṃ dvijam

taṃ jagrāha ca bhakṣārthaṃ
ṣaṣṭhe kāle bubhukṣitaḥ
guror arthe phalāhāram
āgataṃ brahmacāriṇam

gṛhīto rakṣasā tena
sa tadā munidārakaḥ
nirāśo jīvite prāha
sāmapūrvaṃ niśācaram

bho bhadramukha yatkāryaṃ
gṛhīto 'ham iha tvayā
tad bravīhi yathātattvam
ayam asmy anuśādhi mām

ṣaṣṭhe kāle mamāhāraḥ
kṣudhitasya tvam āgataḥ
niḥśūkasyātipāpasya
nirghṛṇasya dvijadruhaḥ

yady avaśyaṃ tvayādhyāhaṃ
bhakṣaṇīyo niśācara
āyāsyāmi tad adyaiva
nivedya gurave phalam

gurumūle tad āgatya
yat phalagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam
mamātra niṣṭhāṃ prāptasya
tat pāpāya niveditam

sa tvaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ mām
atraiva pratipālaya
nivedya gurave yāvad
ihāgacchāmy ahaṃ phalam

ṣaṣṭhe kāle na me brahman
kaścid grahaṇam āgataḥ
pramucyate nibodhaitad
iti me pāpajīvikām

eka evātra mokṣasya
tava hetuḥ śṛṇuṣva tam
muñcāmy aham asaṃdigdhaṃ
yadi tat kurute bhavān

guror yan na virodhāya
yan na dharmoparodhakam
tat kariṣyāmy ahaṃ rakṣo
yan na vrataharaṃ mama

mayā nisargato brahmañ
jātidoṣād viśeṣataḥ
nirvivekena pāpena
pāpaṃ karma sadā kṛtam

ā bālyān mama pāpeṣu
na puṇyeṣu rataṃ manaḥ
tatpāpasaṃcayān mokṣaṃ
prāpnuyāṃ yena tad vada

yāni pāpāni karmāṇi
bālatvāc caritāni me
duṣṭāṃ yonim imāṃ prāpya
tanmuktiṃ kathaya dvija

yady etad dvijaputra tvaṃ
mamākhyāsyasy aśeṣataḥ
tat kṣudhārtāt samārtas tvaṃ
niyataṃ mokṣam āpsyasi

na caitat pāpaśīlo 'ham
adya tvāṃ kṣutpipāsitaḥ
ṣaṣṭhe kāle nṛśaṃsātmā
bhakṣayiṣyāmi nirghṛṇaḥ

evam ukto munisutas
tena ghoreṇa rakṣasā
cintām avāpa mahatīm
aśaktas tad udīritum

vimṛśya suciraṃ vipraḥ
śaraṇaṃ jātavedasam
jagāma jñānadānāya
saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ

yadi śuśrūṣito vahnir
guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇād anu
vratāni vā sucīrṇāni
saptārciḥ pātu māṃ tataḥ

na mātaraṃ na pitaraṃ
gauraveṇa yathā gurum
yathāham avagacchāmi
tathā māṃ pātu pāvakaḥ

yathā guruṃ na manasā
karmaṇā vacasāpi vā
avajānāmy ahaṃ tena
pātu satyena pāvakaḥ

ity evaṃ śapathān satyān
kurvatas tasya tat punaḥ
saptārciṣā samādiṣṭā
prādurāsīt sarasvatī
sā covāca dvijasutaṃ
rākṣasagrahaṇākulam

mā bhair dvijasutāhaṃ tvāṃ
mokṣayāmy atisaṃkaṭāt

yad asya rakṣasaḥ śreyo
jihvāgre 'haṃ sthitā tava
tat sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi
tato mokṣam avāpsyasi

adṛśyā rakṣasā tena
proktvetthaṃ taṃ sarasvatī
adarśanam itā so 'pi
dvijaḥ prāha niśācaram

śrūyatāṃ tava yac chreyas
tathānyeṣāṃ ca pāpinām
samastapāpaśuddhyarthaṃ
puṇyopacayadaṃ ca yat

prātar utthāya satataṃ
madhyāhne 'hnaḥ kṣaye 'pi vā
ayaṃ śastaḥ sadā jāpaḥ
sarvapāpopaśāntidaḥ

hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ
vāsudevaṃ janārdanam
praṇato 'smi jagannāthaṃ
sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu

viśveśvaram ajaṃ viṣṇum
aprameyaparākramam
praṇato 'smi prajāpālaṃ
sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu

viṣṇum acyutam īśānam
anantam aparājitam
praṇato 'smi mahātmānaṃ
sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu

carācaraguruṃ nāthaṃ
govindaṃ śeṣaśāyinam
praṇato 'smi paraṃ devaṃ
sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu

govardhanadharaṃ dhīraṃ
gobrāhmaṇahite sthitam
praṇato 'smi gadāpāṇiṃ
sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu

śaṅkhinaṃ cakriṇaṃ śāntaṃ
śārṅgiṇaṃ sragdharaṃ param
praṇato 'smi patiṃ lakṣmyāḥ
sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu

dāmodaram udārākṣaṃ
puṇḍarīkākṣam avyayam
praṇato 'smi stutaṃ stutyaiḥ
sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu

nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ śauriṃ
mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam
praṇato 'smi dharādhāraṃ
sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu

keśavaṃ keśihantāraṃ
kaṃsāriṣṭanisūdanam
praṇato 'smi caturbāhuṃ
sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu

śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ śrīśaṃ
śrīdharaṃ śrīniketanam
praṇato 'smi śriyaḥ kāntaṃ
sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu

yam īśaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ
dhyāyanti yatayo 'kṣaram
vāsudevam anirdeśyaṃ
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

samastālambanebhyo 'yaṃ
saṃhṛtya manaso gatim
dhyāyanti vāsudevākhyaṃ
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

sarvagaṃ sarvabhūtaṃ ca
sarvasyādhātam īśvaram
vāsudevaṃ paraṃ brahma
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

paramātmānam avyaktaṃ
yaṃ prayānti sumedhasaḥ
karmakṣaye 'kṣayaṃ devaṃ
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

puṇyapāpavinirmuktā
yaṃ praviśya punarbhavam
na yoginaḥ prāpnuvanti
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

brahmā bhūtvā jagat sarvaṃ
sadevāsuramānuṣam
yaḥ sṛjaty acyuto devas
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

brahmatve yasya vaktrebhyaś
caturvedamayaṃ vapuḥ
sūtaṃ prabho purā jajñe
tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

brahmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ
jagadyoniṃ janārdanam
sraṣṭṛtve saṃsthitaṃ sṛṣṭau
praṇato 'smi sanātanam

yaḥ pāti sṛṣṭaṃ ca vibhuḥ
sthitāv asurasūdanaḥ
tam ādipuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ
praṇato 'smi sanātanam

dhṛtā mahī hatā daityāḥ
paritrātās tathāmarāḥ
yena taṃ viṣṇum ādyeśaṃ
praṇato 'smi sanātanam

yajñair yajanti yaṃ viprā
yajñeśaṃ yajñabhāvanam
taṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ
praṇato 'smi sanātanam

varṇāśramān sthitāv ādyo
yaḥ sthāpayati vartmani
tam ādipuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ
praṇato 'smi sanātanam

kalpānte rudrarūpo yaḥ
saṃharaty akhilaṃ jagat
tam ādipuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ
praṇato 'smi janārdanam

pātālavīthībhūrādīṃs
tathā lokān bibharti yaḥ
tam antapuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ
praṇato 'smi janārdanam

saṃbhakṣayitvā sakalaṃ
yathā sṛṣṭam idaṃ jagat
yo nṛtyaty atiraudrātmā
praṇato 'smi janārdanam

surāsurāḥ pitṛgaṇā
yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ
yasyāṃśabhūtā devasya
sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmy aham

samastadevāḥ sakalā
mānuṣāṇāṃ ca jātayaḥ
yasyāṃśabhūtā devasya
sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmy aham

vṛkṣagulmādayo yasya
tathā paśumṛgādayaḥ
ekāṃśabhūtā devasya
sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmy aham

yasmān nānyat paraṃ kiṃcid
yasmin sarvaṃ mahātmani
yaḥ sarvam avyayo 'nantaḥ
sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmy aham

yathā sarveṣu bhūteṣu
sthāvareṣu careṣu ca
viṣṇur eva tathā pāpaṃ
mamāśeṣaṃ praṇaśyatu

yathā viṣṇumayaṃ sarvaṃ
yat sarvendriyagocaram
yac ca jñānaparicchedyaṃ
pāpaṃ naśyatu me tathā

pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca
karma viṣṇumayaṃ yathā
anekajanmakarmotthaṃ
pāpaṃ naśyatu me tathā

yan niśāyāṃ tathā prātar
yac ca madhyāparāhṇayoḥ
saṃdhyayoś ca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ
karmaṇā manasā girā

tiṣṭhatā vrajatā yac ca
śayyāsanagatena ca
kṛtaṃ yad aśubhaṃ karma
kāyena manasā girā

ajñānato jñānato vā
vāsudevasya kīrtanāt
tat sarvaṃ vilayaṃ yātu
toyasthaṃ lavaṇaṃ yathā

paradāraparadravya-
vāñchādrohodbhavaṃ ca yat
paripīḍodbhavaṃ nindāṃ
kurvato yan mahātmanām

yac ca bhojye tathā peye
yac ca kaṇḍūyanādiṣu
tad yātu vilayaṃ toye
yathā lavaṇabhājanam

yad bālye yac ca kaumāre
yat pāpaṃ yauvane mama
vayaḥpariṇatau yac ca
yac ca janmāntareṣu me

tan nārāyaṇagovinda-
harikṛṣṇeśakīrtanāt
prayātu vilayaṃ toye
yathā lavaṇabhājanam

viṣṇave vāsudevāya
haraye keśavāya ca
janārdanāya kṛṣṇāya
namo bhūyo namo namaḥ

idaṃ sārasvataṃ stotram
aśeṣāghavināśanam
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva
sarvapāpavināśanam

idaṃ yaḥ prātar utthāya
praṇipatya janārdanam
japaty ekamanāḥ pāpaṃ
samastaṃ sa vyapohati

yas tu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ
sāyaṃ prātaḥ samāhitaḥ
japaty etan naraḥ puṇyaṃ
kṛtvā manasi keśavam

śārīraṃ mānasaṃ vāgjaṃ
jñānato 'jñānato 'pi vā
kṛtaṃ tena tu yat pāpaṃ
sapta janmāntarāṇi vai

mahāpātakam alpaṃ vā
tathā yac copapātakam
sakalaṃ nāśayaty etat
tathānyat puṇyam ṛcchati

viprāya suviśiṣṭāya
tilapātrāṇi ṣoḍaśa
ahany ahani yo dadyāt
paṭhaty etac ca tat samam

aviplutamatiś cānte
saṃprāpya smaraṇaṃ hareḥ
viṣṇulokam avāpnoti
satyam etan mayoditam

yathainaṃ paṭhati nityaṃ
stavaṃ sārasvataṃ pumān
api pāpasamāyukto
mokṣaṃ prāpnoty asāv api

yathaitat satyam uktaṃ me
nātrālpam api vai mṛṣā
rākṣasagrastasarvāṅgaṃ
tathā mām eṣa muñcatu

evam uccārite muktaḥ
sa tadā tena rakṣasā
akāmena dvijo bhūyas
tam āha rajanīcaram

etad bhadramukhākhyātaṃ
tava pātakanāśanam
viṣṇoḥ sārasvataṃ stotraṃ
yaj jagāda sarasvatī

hutāśanena prahitā
mama jihvāgrasaṃsthitā
jagādemaṃ stavaṃ viṣṇoḥ
sarvapāpapraśāntidam

anenaiva jagannāthaṃ
tvam ārādhaya keśavam
tataḥ pāpāpanodaṃ tu
stute prāpsyasi keśave

aharniśaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ
stavenānena rākṣasa
stauhi bhaktiṃ parāṃ kṛtvā
tataḥ pāpād vimokṣyase

stuto hi sarvapāpāni
nāśayiṣyaty asaṃśayam
bhaktyā rākṣasaśārdūla
sarvapāpaharo hariḥ

tataḥ praṇamya taṃ vipraṃ
prasādya ca niśācaraḥ
śālagrāmaṃ mahārāja
tadaiva tapase yayau

tatrāharniśam evaitaj
japañ japyaṃ narādhipa
devakriyāratir bhūtvā
tapas tepe sa rākṣasaḥ

ārādhya ca jagannāthaṃ
sa tatra puruṣottamam
sarvapāpavinirmukto
viṣṇulokam avāptavān

tathā tvam api rājarṣe
sarvapāpapraśāntidam
ārādhaya hṛṣīkeśaṃ
japan sārasvataṃ stavam

ya etat paramaṃ stotraṃ
vāsudevasya mānavaḥ
paṭhiṣyati sa sarvebhyaḥ
pāpebhyo mokṣam āpsyati

brahmann asāre saṃsāre
rogādivyāptamānasaḥ
śabdādilubdhaḥ puruṣaḥ
kiṃ kurvan nāvasīdati

sve mahimni sthitaṃ devam
aprameyam ajaṃ vibhum
śokamohavinirmuktaṃ
viṣṇuṃ dhyāyan na sīdati

aprāṇacitikaṃ brahma
vedānteṣu prakāśitam
ādyaṃ puruṣam īśānaṃ
viṣṇuṃ dhyāyan na sīdati

aśanādyair asaṃspṛṣṭaṃ
sevitaṃ yogibhiḥ sadā
sarvadoṣavinirmuktaṃ
viṣṇuṃ dhyāyan na sīdati

dhāmatrayavinirmuktaṃ
suprabhātaṃ sunirmalam
niṣkalaṃ śāśvataṃ devaṃ
viṣṇuṃ dhyāyan na sīdati

kṣarākṣaravinirmuktaṃ
janmamṛtyuvivarjitam
abhayaṃ satyasaṃkalpaṃ
viṣṇuṃ dhyāyan na sīdati

amṛtaṃ sādhanaṃ sādhyaṃ
yaṃ paśyanti manīṣiṇaḥ
jñeyākhyaṃ paramātmānaṃ
viṣṇuṃ dhyāyan na sīdati

atulaṃ sukhadharmāṇaṃ
vyomadehaṃ sanātanam
dharmādharmavinirmuktaṃ
viṣṇuṃ dhyāyan na sīdati

vyāsādyair munibhiḥ sarvair
dhyānayogaparāyaṇaiḥ
arcitaṃ bhāvakusumair
viṣṇuṃ dhyāyan na sīdati

viṣṇvaṣṭakam idaṃ puṇyaṃ
yogināṃ prītivardhanam
yaḥ paṭhet parayā prītyā
sa gacched viṣṇusātmyatām

etat puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ
dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva
viṣṇor māhātmyam uttamam

kurvan bhaktiṃ hṛṣīkeśe
mānavo bhṛgunandana
nirvāṇaṃ samavāpnoti
yādṛśaṃ tad vadasva me

dṛśyante puruṣā bhaktim
udvahanto janārdane
tathāpy anekadehārti-
manastāpāturā mune

smṛtamātraḥ surendrasya
yo 'rtihā madhusūdanaḥ
tasyāpi karmābhiratā
duḥkhabhājaḥ kathaṃ narāḥ

kaiś ca dānair jagatsvāmī
svāmī nārāyaṇo nṛṇām
upakārāya bhaktānāṃ
jāyate sa mahāmune

tvadyukto 'yam anupraśno
mahārāja śṛṇuṣva tam
yathā pṛṣṭam idaṃ samyak
kathyamānaṃ yathākhilam

pṛthivīṃ ratnasaṃpūrṇāṃ
yaḥ kṛṣṇāya prayacchati
tasyāpy anyamanaskasya
sulabho na janārdanaḥ

nārādhyate 'cyuto dānair
na homair bhāvavarjitaiḥ
aikātmyaṃ puruṣair yāti
tanmayair eva mādhavaḥ

śrūyate ca purākhyāto
rājoparicaro vasuḥ
iyāja subahūn yajñāñ
śraddhāpūtena cetasā

sa vipraśāpād rājarṣiḥ
kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare
ākāśacārī sahasā
praviveśa rasātalam

rasātalam anuprāptas
tathāpi jagataḥ prabhum
tuṣṭāva tanmayo bhūtvā
divyair mantrair janārdanam

devānām eṣa yajñāṃśair
yajvī pakṣavivardhanaḥ
cedirāḍ iti daityānāṃ
matir āsīd rasātale

anena vividhair yajñais
tarpitas tridaśeśvaraḥ
jaghāna daityān vadhyo 'yaṃ
prāpto 'smadgocaraṃ ripuḥ

iti saṃmantrya te daityāś
cedirājajighāṃsavaḥ
tatsamīpam anuprāptā
gṛhītavividhāyudhāḥ

paramāmarṣasaṃyuktās
tatas te cedipuṅgavam
hantuṃ na śekuḥ śastrais tu
yatnavanto 'pi pārthivam

sa cāpi vasur āsīnaḥ
keśavārpitamānasaḥ
jajāpa mantram oṃkāraṃ
praṇavaṃ dvādaśākṣaram

dadarśa ca sa viśveśaṃ
dhyānāvasthitamānasaḥ
kṛtvānyaviṣayatyāgi
cittam atyantaniścalam

prāg īśam akṣaraṃ dhyānaṃ
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jagadgurum
saṃcintya vāsudevākhyam
anirdeśyaṃ parāyaṇam

tato 'ntaryāmirupeṇa
prākṛtena ca saṃsthitam
brahmaviṣṇuśivānāṃ ca
svarūpaiḥ saṃsthitaṃ tridhā

punaś ca devagandharva-
siddhādimanujādiṣu
sthāvarānteṣu bhūteṣu
sarveṣv eva samāsthitam

dikṣv ambaradharābhūbhṛt-
toyavāyvanalādiṣu
dṛśyādṛśyeṣu caiveśaṃ
cintayām āsa pārthivaḥ

sarvatra dṛṣṭvā taṃ devam
ātmany api ca sarvagam
sarvaṃ ca tanmayaṃ dṛṣṭvā
virarāma samādhitaḥ

indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu
pūrvavat sa narādhipaḥ
viniveśya tato 'paśyad
asurān udyatāyudhān

tān sa dṛṣṭvā gṛhītārghya
ekaikasyaiva pārthivaḥ
pādyapūrveṇa vidhinā
pūjayām āsa bhaktimān

prasādaṃ kuru bhadraṃ vo
bhagavāñ jagataḥ patiḥ
vāsudevo bhavān prāpto
mamānugrahakāmyayā

ity evaṃ cedirājo 'sāv
ekaikasya ca dānavān
pūjayām āsa pādyādi
nivedya vacasā tathā

te 'pi taṃ cedirājānaṃ
papracchur asurās tadā
kva vāsudevo 'tra vayaṃ
prāptā dākṣāyaṇīsutāḥ

ity evaṃ vadato daityān
sa jagāda punar vasuḥ
praṇāmanamro rājendra
sarvadarśī mahāmatiḥ

vāsudevo jagat sarvaṃ
yac ceṅgaṃ yac ca neṅgati
brahmādiṣu tṛṇānteṣu
sa evaiko jagadguruḥ

ahaṃ bhavanto devādyā
manuṣyāḥ paśavaś ca ye
te 'pi devā jagaddhātur
vyatiriktā na keśavāt

tenaiva māyā vitatā
vaiṣṇavī bhinnadarśanī
tayā svāṅgeṣu devo 'sau
pradarśayati sarvaśaḥ

tad yūyam aham anye ca
yac ca sthāvarajaṅgamam
vāsudevātmakaṃ sarvam
iti matvā namo 'stu vaḥ

ity uktās tena te daityā
na śaktā manujeśvaram
yatnavanto 'pi taṃ hantuṃ
prayayuḥ svān athālayān

tataḥ purohitaṃ sarve
kāvyaṃ nītiviśāradam
sametya te yathāvṛttaṃ
sarvam asmai nyavedayan

asmākam atyantaripur
ayaṃ prāpto rasātalam
devānām upakṛd brahman
yajvā cedipatir vasuḥ

asmatpakṣakṣayāyaiṣa
devānāṃ pakṣavardhanaḥ
tatra yat pratipattavyaṃ
tan no brūhi mahāmate

svagocaram ariḥ prāptaḥ
śatrupakṣopakārakaḥ
na hantavya itīdaṃ ko
nītimān pravadiṣyati

tasmāt pragṛhya divyāni
sarvāstrāṇy amarārdanāḥ
nipātayata taṃ gatvā
cedirājaṃ svagocare

sarvam etan mahābhāga
tasminn asmābhir udyataiḥ
kṛtaṃ na śakito hantuṃ
niryatno 'pi hi pārthivaḥ

kiṃ tad yogaphalaṃ tasya
kiṃ vā japaphalaṃ mune
tapaso vā muniśreṣṭha
vistarāt tad vadasva naḥ

nityaṃ saṃcintayaty eṣa
yogayukto janārdanam
sāsya rakṣā parā manye
ko hinasty acyutāśrayam

kīrtitaḥ saṃsmṛto dhyātaḥ
pūjitaḥ saṃstutas tathā
aihikāmuṣmikīṃ rakṣāṃ
karoti bhagavān hariḥ

yad durlabhaṃ yad aprāpyaṃ
manaso yan na gocare
tad apy aprārthitaṃ dhyāto
dadāti madhusūdanaḥ

śarīrārogyam arthāṃś ca
bhogāṃś caivānuṣaṅgikān
dadāti dhyāyatāṃ nityam
apavargaprado hariḥ

yad idaṃ cedirājānaṃ
hantum icchatha dānavāḥ
tad asya keśavāc cittam
upāyenāpanīyatām

tatas te tadvacaḥ śrutvā
dānavāḥ kurupuṅgava
brahmarūpapraticchannā
jagmur yatra sthito vasuḥ

dadṛśus te mahātmānaṃ
praṇataṃ cedipuṅgavam
kṛtapūjaṃ jagaddhātur
vāsudevasya pārthivam

saṃstutāv udyataṃ śāntaṃ
sarvatra samadarśinam
kṛṣṇārpitamanovṛttiṃ
jānubhyām avaniṃgatam

tataḥ saṃśṛṇvatāṃ teṣāṃ
tuṣṭāva madhusūdanam
tannāmasmaraṇodbhūta-
pulakaś cedipuṅgavaḥ

jagāda yaṃ sa rājarṣiḥ
stavaṃ kṛṣṇasya śaunaka
śṛṇvatāṃ dānavendrāṇāṃ
tan me pāpaharaṃ vada

śṛṇu yad devadevasya
viṣṇor adbhutakarmaṇaḥ
stotraṃ jagāda rājāsau
rasātalatalaṃ gataḥ

staumi devam ajaṃ nityaṃ
pariṇāmavivarjitam
avṛddhikṣayam īśānam
acyutaṃ parataḥ param

kalpanākṛtanāmānam
anirdeśyam ajaṃ vibhum
mūlahetum ahetuṃ tvāṃ
vāsudevaṃ namāmy aham

paramārthaparair īśaś
cintyate yaḥ prajākaraiḥ
taṃ vāsudevam īśeśaṃ
namāmy adya guṇaṃ param

yasmād idaṃ yatra cedam
idaṃ yo viśvam avyayam
taṃ vāsudevam amalaṃ
namāmi parameśvaram

jñeyaṃ jñātāram ajaraṃ
bhoktāraṃ prakṛteḥ prabhum
puruṣasvarūpiṇaṃ devaṃ
nato 'smi puruṣaṃ param

pradhānādiviśeṣānta-
svarūpam ajam avyayam
sthūlasūkṣmamayaṃ sarvaṃ-
vyāpinaṃ taṃ namāmy aham

sraṣṭā pālayitā cānte
yaś ca saṃhārakārakaḥ
trayīmayaṃ taṃ triguṇaṃ
nato 'smi puruṣottamam

ābrahmasthāvarānte ca
yo jagaty atra saṃsthitaḥ
vyaktarūpī ca taṃ devaṃ
nato 'haṃ viṣṇum avyayam

namo namo 'stu te deva
jagatām īśvareśvara
paramārtha parācintya
vidhātaḥ parameśvara

tvam ādir anto madhyaṃ ca
jagato 'sya jagatpate
jagat tvayi jagac ca tvaṃ
jagat tvatto jaganmaya

tavāgnir āsaṃ vasudhāṅghriyugmaṃ
nabhaḥ śiraś candraravī ca netre
samastalokā jaṭharaṃ bhujāś ca
diśaś catasro bhagavan namas te

yad bhūgataṃ yad gaganāntarāle
yad vā nabhasy akhilalokagaṃ ca
yat sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paratas tato 'pi
yad asti yan nāsti ca tat tvam īśa

vedāś ca vedyaṃ ca bhagavān ananto
vedāntavedyaś ca samastaheto
vadanti tat tvā munayaḥ pareśaṃ
tvayi prasanne paramārthadṛśye

namo hṛṣīkeśa tavāprameya
namaś ca tubhyaṃ paramārthasāra
viṣṇo namas te 'stu parāpareśa
kṛṣṇācyutānanta jagannivāsa

namo 'stu tubhyaṃ parameśvarāya
namas tathāntaḥkāraṇasthitāya
pradhānabhūtāya namaś ca tubhyam
vyaktasvarūpeṇa ca saṃsthitāya

saṃhṛtya viśvaṃ jalaśāyine namo
namaś ca te kaiṭabhasūdanāya
svanābhipadmodaraśāyine ca
brahmasvarūpopanatāya caiva

sraṣṭre namaḥ pālayitre sthitau ca
sarveśa tubhyaṃ puruṣottamāya
rudrāya cānte kṣayahetave te
nato 'smi saṃhārakarāya viṣṇo

jaya prapannārtiharāprameya
jayāgnivasvaśvimaya prajeśa
rudrendracandrastuta devadeva
jayāmarāṇām ariśātanāya

jitaṃ tvayā sarvaga sarvasāraṃ
sarvātmabhūtākhila vedavedya
jitaṃ jitākṣāmalacittadṛśya
carācarādhāra dharādhareḍya

yajñāśrayo yajñapumān aśeṣa
deveśa martyāsurayajñabhoktaḥ
tvam īḍyamāno 'bhimataṃ dadāsi
dharādhareśācyuta vāsudeva

namas te devadeva tvaṃ
yathā pāsy akhilaṃ jagat
sthitau tathā samastebhyo
doṣebhyo māṃ samuddhara

kṛṣṇācyuta hṛṣīkeśa
sarvabhūteśa keśava
mahātmaṃs trāhi māṃ bhaktaṃ
vāsudeva prasīda me

iti stotrāvasāne taṃ
cedirājaṃ tato 'surāḥ
jahasuḥ satalākṣepaṃ
procuś ca dvijarūpiṇaḥ

prājñaḥ kila prajāpālaś
cedirāṭ saṃśruto bhuvi
tas asya jñānam akhilaṃ
viparītārtham īdṛśam

kva vāsudevaḥ kva bhavān
imām antyāṃ daśāṃ gataḥ
yo bhavān vipraśāpena
rasātalatalāśrayaḥ

bhaviṣyati smṛto devas
trātā kila tavācyutaḥ
yo 'sāv āpyāyyate viprair
adhvareṣu haviḥsravaiḥ

yo 'nyatras trāṇakāmo vā
yajñabhāgam abhīpsate
sa trātā tava govindo
bhaviṣyaty ativismayaḥ

yadā tvaṃ bhagavadbhakto
vipraśāpān nipātitaḥ
tadā sa vāsudevas te
kva gato 'lpaśruto 'vyayaḥ

na vāsudevo na harir
na govindo na keśavaḥ
śāpaṃ dadatsu vipreṣu
paritrāṇaparo bhavet

sa tvam ārtapralāpebhyo
viramādya yadīcchasi
kubuddhim etāṃ saṃtyajya
svapauruṣaparo bhava

na vayaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ
nānantaṃ nācyutaṃ harim
saṃśritā na ca sīdāmaḥ
svapauruṣam upāśritāḥ

yady asmadvacanaṃ vīra
na mohena viśaṅkase
tadāśrayasva svaṃ vīryaṃ
parityajya vimūḍhatām

ity udīritam ākarṇya
sa teṣāṃ cedipuṅgavaḥ
ajñānapaṭalacchannān
hṛdayena śuśoca tān

aho moho 'yam eteṣām
ahaṃkārasamudbhavaḥ
yena sarveśvare viṣṇāv
eteṣām āvṛtā matiḥ

prakāśaṃ ca sa tān āha
dānavān prītipūrvakam
pāpatas tatparitrāṇaṃ
cikīrṣur vasudhādhipaḥ

maivaṃ bho bhagavadbhaktiṃ
kurudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ
saṃsārābdhau manuṣyāṇām
ekaḥ poto janārdanaḥ

yūyaṃ vayaṃ tathaivānye
tasya sarve vibhūtayaḥ
brahmādisthāvarāntaṃ hi
tasya devasya vistṛtiḥ

sukhaduḥkhamayo nṝṇāṃ
vipākaḥ karmaṇāṃ ca yaḥ
saṃśuddhihetuḥ svacchandāt
so 'pi viprāḥ pravartate

parīkṣāṃ ca jagannāthaḥ
karoty adṛḍhacetasām
narāṇām arthavidhvaṃsa-
nikāśeṣu janārdanaḥ

alpayatnena cāyānti
vimuktiṃ keśavāśrayāt
tadvighātāya śakrādyā
yatante vighnahetubhiḥ

yadā janārdane bhaktiṃ
vahan sīdati mānavaḥ
nirviṇṇacetāḥ śaithilyaṃ
manasaḥ kurute tadā

devānāṃ mahatī śaṅkā
bhaktiyuktā janārdane
muktibhājo bhaviṣyantīty
atas te paripanthinaḥ

prāyo bhavanti govinde
bhaktivyāghātahetavaḥ
vighnāś cittavighātā hi
vimuktiparipanthinaḥ

satyaṃ śatena vighnānāṃ
sahasreṇa tathā tapaḥ
vighnāyutena govinde
nṝṇāṃ bhaktir nivāryate

svaṃ cāpi karma puruṣaḥ
śubhāśubham upāgatam
bhuṅkte kim atra devasya
garhyate yena keśavaḥ

maryādāṃ ca kṛtāṃ tena
yo bhinatti sa mānavaḥ
na viṣṇubhakto mantavyaḥ
sādhu dharmārcano hariḥ

na puṣpair na ca dhūpena
nopahārānulepanaiḥ
toṣaṃ prayāti govindaḥ
svakarmābhyarcito yathā

brāhmaṇā devadevena
mukhāt sṛṣṭā mahātmanā
devānām api saṃpūjya
bhūmidevā dvijottamāḥ
anuvṛttiḥ sadā kāryā
teṣāṃ varṇair anuvrataiḥ

te pūjyās te namaskāryās
toṣaṇīyāś ca yatnataḥ
teṣu tuṣṭeṣv aśeṣāṇāṃ
devānāṃ prītir uttamā

teṣāṃ mayā yad ajñānāj
jñānād vā kṛtam apriyam
tenāpi tuṣṭa evāhaṃ
viṣṇor aṃśā dvijottamāḥ

kriyāvān mama poto 'yaṃ
bhūtalād yo rasātale
patitasyātibhīme 'smin
duruttāre bhavārṇave

rasātalatalottāraṃ
na hi vāñchāmy ahaṃ dvijāḥ
saṃsāragartād uttāraṃ
vṛṇomy ārādhanād dhareḥ

yathāhaṃ nābhivāñchāmi
bhogān ārādhya keśavam
tena satyena viṣṇur me
sarvadoṣān vyapohatu

yathā na mātā na pitā
nātmā na suhṛdaḥ sutāḥ
kṛṣṇālāpāt priyatarās
tathā māṃ pātu keśavaḥ

yathā viṣṇumayaṃ sarvam
etat paśyāmy ahaṃ jagat
tathā mama manodoṣān
aśeṣān sa vyapohatu

jātā viṣṇuvilomeṣu
bhavatsv api dayā mama
yathā tenādya satyena
bhavantaḥ santu tanmayāḥ

yathā nāhaṃ bhavaddveṣān
na saṃharṣād bravīmy aham
kṛpayaiva tathā sarve
bhavantaḥ santu tanmayāḥ

yo yo na bhakto govinde
tatra tatra kṛpā yathā
mamārivarge 'pi tathā
bhaktir vo 'stu janārdane

evam uccārite teṣāṃ
daityānāṃ tatkṣaṇāt tathā
tasmin rājany abhūn maitrī
tathānyeṣu ca jantuṣu

devadeve 'py abhūd bhaktir
bhāvo naṣṭas tathāsuraḥ
svarūpadhāriṇaś cainaṃ
praṇamyāsurapuṅgavāḥ
pratyūcuḥ pārthivaṃ viṣṇu-
bhaktaṃ sadbrahmacāriṇam

cedibhūpāla bhadraṃ te
bhavato 'tulavikrama
saṃsāre tvatsamaiḥ saṅgaḥ
puṇyabhājāṃ pravartate

vayaṃ svajātidoṣeṇa
devapakṣavirodhinaḥ
bhavantam āgatā hantuṃ
devaprīṇanatatparam

yadā na śaktito hantum
asmābhis tvaṃ nirāyudhaḥ
viṣṇudhyānamahārakṣā-
kakṣāntaragataḥ prabho

tyājayadbhis tathā bhaktiṃ
keśavād iti darśitam
vaiphalyam atipuṇyeṣu
viṣṇuśuśrūṣaṇā nṛṇām

sa tvaṃ devātidevasya
viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ
anugrāhyo yathā teyam
acyute niścalā matiḥ

diṣṭyā krodhābhibhūtānām
asmākaṃ tvannivarhaṇe
matir jātā yataḥ prāptā
tvatsaṅgād durlabhā matiḥ

kuruṣva ca prasādaṃ tvaṃ
praṇatānāṃ nareśvara
śatrāv api kṛpāśīlaṃ
yan no duṣṭam abhūn manaḥ

diśāṃ vaimalyaṃ vimalaṃ
cakṣuṣaś copapāditam
bhavatā duṣṭatāṃ etām
āsurīm apamārjatā

duṣṭāḥ sma varṣapūgāni
yad yātāni vṛthaiva naḥ
viṣayākṣiptacittānāṃ
kṛṣṇe bhaktim akurvatām

karmabhūmau manuṣyāṇāṃ
tad eva viphalaṃ dinam
yad acyutakathālāpa-
dhyānārcārahitaṃ gatam

ity uktvā te 'surā bhūyaḥ
prasādya ca tathā vasum
viṣṇau bhaktiparā yātās
tīvrasaṃyogino 'layan

sa cāpi cedirāṭ tasmād
devadevena cakriṇā
pātālād uddhṛtaḥ paścāt
saṃsāragahanād api

ity etat sarvam ākhyātaṃ
yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi
yathāvasīdanti narā
bhaktimanto 'pi keśave

dṛḍhā janārdane bhaktir
yadaivāvyabhicāriṇī
tadā kiyat svargasukhaṃ
saiva nirvāṇahetukī

ity etad asuraiḥ sārdhaṃ
saṃvādaṃ yaḥ purā vasoḥ
paṭhiṣyaty akhilaṃ bhaktyā
sa tallokam upaiṣyati

jagatprabhuṃ devadevam
aśeṣeśam janārdanam
praṇipatyāham etaṃ tvāṃ
yat pṛcchāmi tad ucyatām

yair upāyaiḥ pradānair vā
narāṇām amarārcitaḥ
prītimān puṇḍarīkākṣo
bhavaty ācakṣva tan mama

ye svadharme sthitā varṇā
viprādyāḥ kurunandana
vidharmeṣu na vartante
prītimāṃs teṣu keśavaḥ

brahmacārigṛhasthādyā
na cyavanty āśramāc ca ye
svadharmato haris teṣāṃ
prītimān eva sarvadā

ye na dambhena vartante
narā bhūteṣv alolupāḥ
tyaktagrāmyādisaṃgāś ca
teṣu prītiḥ parā hareḥ

dātāro nāpahartāraḥ
parasvānām amāyinaḥ
ye narās teṣu govindaḥ
putreṣv iva sadā hitaḥ

yeṣāṃ narāṇāṃ na matir
jihvā vāsatyam ujjhati
te priyā vāsudevasya
ye ca dvijaparāyaṇāḥ

karmaṇā manasā vācā
ye na hiṃsānuvartinaḥ
te narā vāsudevasya
priyāḥ pāṇḍukulodvaha

sarvadeveṣu ye viṣṇuṃ
sarvabhūteṣv avasthitam
manyante vāsudevasya
te priyāḥ putravat sadā

brahmādyaṃ sthāvarāntaṃ ca
bhūtagrāmaṃ janārdanāt
ye ca paśyanty abhedena
te viṣṇoḥ satataṃ priyāḥ

devavedadvijātīnāṃ
nindāyāṃ ye na mānavāḥ
prītibhājo bhavantīṣṭās
te sadā śārṅgadhanvinaḥ

priyāṇām atha sarveṣāṃ
devadevasya sa priyaḥ
āpatsv api sadā yasya
bhaktir avyabhicāriṇī

tasmāt priyatvaṃ kṛṣṇasya
vāñchatā nijadharmajaiḥ
guṇair ātmā sadā yojyo
na dūre guṇino hariḥ

yeṣāṃ na gṛddhiḥ pārakye
dāre dravye ca cetasaḥ
hiṃsāyāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ
te kṛṣṇenāvalokitāḥ

vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ smṛtayo
yeṣāṃ sanmārgasevinām
paropakārasaktānāṃ
te kṛṣṇenāvalokitāḥ

kalikalmaṣadoṣeṇa
yeṣāṃ nopahatā matiḥ
pāṣaṇḍānugatā naiva
te kṛṣṇenāvalokitāḥ

yeṣāṃ kleśo guror arthe
devaviprodbhavo 'pi vā
na vivitsāsamudbhūtas
te kṛṣṇenāvalokitāḥ

svapantaḥ saṃsthitā yāntas
tiṣṭhantaś ca janārdanam
ye cintayanty avirataṃ
te kṛṣṇenāvalokitāḥ

yathātmani tathāpatye
yeṣāṃ adrohiṇī matiḥ
samastasattvajāteṣu
te kṛṣṇenāvalokitāḥ

devapūjām anudinaṃ
guruviprārthasatkriyām
ye kurvanti narā viddhi
te kṛṣṇenāvalokitāḥ

suvarṇaṃ ratnam athavā
pārakyaṃ vijane vane
vilokya naiti yo lobhaṃ
taṃ avaihi hareḥ priyam

devān pitṝṃs tathāpannān
atithīñ jāmayo 'dhvagān
yo bibharti vijānīhi
taṃ naraṃ bhagavatpriyam

na krodham eti kruddhebhyaḥ
sahate yo nirākriyām
taṃ vijānīhi bhartavyaṃ
devadevasya śārṅginaḥ

paralokapratīkāra-
karaṇāya sadodyamam
kurvann ālakṣyatām eti
keśavenāvalokitaḥ

nātmasaṃstavam anyeṣāṃ
na nindāṃ cārthalipsayā
karoti puruṣavyāghra
yasya nārāyaṇo hṛdi

sarvabhūtadayāṃ satyam
akrodhaṃ dharmaśīlatām
bhajante puruṣā deve
govinde hṛdaye sthite

na kalau na paradravye
paradārāśritā matiḥ
narāṇāṃ jāyate rājan
govinde hṛdayasthite

kṣamāṃ karoti kruddheṣu
dayāṃ mūḍheṣu mānavaḥ
mudaṃ ca dharmaśīleṣu
govinde hṛdaye sthite

yadā bibhety adharmāder
dharmādīṃś ca yadecchati
tadā kuruvaraśreṣṭha
naraḥ kṛṣṇena vīkṣitaḥ

putradāragṛhakṣetra-
dravyāder mamatāṃ naraḥ
nāyāsyati jagannāthe
hṛṣīkeśe parāṅmukhe

kalau kṛtayugaṃ teṣāṃ
kleśās teṣāṃ sukhādhikāḥ
yeṣāṃ śarīragrahaṇe
hariśuśrūṣaṇe matiḥ

yadā necchati pāpāni
yadā puṇyāni vāñchati
jñeyas tadā manuṣyeṇa
hṛdaye 'sya hariḥ sthitaḥ

paramārthe matiḥ puṃsām
asāre tu bhavārṇave
kathaṃ bhavati rājendra
viṣvaksena parāṅmukhe

śraddadhāno dayāśīlaḥ
samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ
parārthe mānavaḥ kṛṣṇe
prasanne nṛpa jāyate

vahato 'pi sadā kṛṣṇe
bhaktim avyabhicāriṇīm
pāṇiṣv asamadṛgbuddheḥ
sulabho naiva keśavaḥ

ye dāmbhikā bhinnavṛttā
ye ca dharmadhvajocchrayāḥ
durlabho bhagavān devas
teṣāṃ suyatatām api

kāmalobhāśritaṃ yeṣāṃ
cittaṃ krodhādidūṣitam
teṣāṃ janmasahasre 'pi
na matiḥ keśavāśrayā

heyāṃ kṛṣṇāśrayāṃ vṛttiṃ
manyante hetusaṃśritāḥ
aviyopahatajñānā
ye 'jñāne jñānamāninaḥ

vedavādavirodhena
kūṭayuktim apāśritāḥ
ye keśavas taddhṛdaye
na kadācit priyātithiḥ

mānuṣaṃ taṃ manuṣyatve
manyamānāḥ kubuddhayaḥ
karmāṇi ye 'sya nindanti
na teṣāṃ niṣkṛtir nṛṇām

kecid vadanti taṃ devaṃ
manuṣyaṃ cālpamedhasaḥ
tiryaktvaṃ cāpare viṣṇuṃ
māyayā tasya mohitāḥ

devatvam api kṛṣṇasya
yasya nindā mahātmanaḥ
stutiṃ tasya kathaṃ śaktāḥ
kartum īśasya mānavāḥ

vyāpitvaṃ śāśvatatvaṃ ca
janmabhāvavivarjitam
yadāsya procyate kāsya
stutir arthe tathā sthitau

sarveśvareśvaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ
procyate yadi paṇḍitaḥ
tathāpi svalpam evoktaṃ
bhūtārthe katamā stutiḥ

ābrahmastambaparyante
saṃsāre yasya saṃsthitiḥ
nindāpi tasya na nṛbhiḥ
kartum īśasya śakyate

yadā kāṇāś ca kūṇṭhāś ca
mūḍho durbuddhir āturaḥ
sarvagatvāt sa evaikas
tadāsau nindyate katham

sraṣṭā pālayitā hartā
jagato 'sya jagac ca saḥ
yaṣṭā yājayitā yājyaḥ
sa eva bhagavān hariḥ

dātā dānaṃ tathādātā
kartā kāryaṃ tathā kriyāḥ
hantā ghātayitā hiṃsyo
hāryaṃ hartā ca yaḥ svayam

sarvakāraṇabhūtasya
tasyeśasya mahātmanaḥ
kaḥ karoti stutiṃ viṣṇor
nindāṃ vā pṛthivīpate

tasmāt sarveśvaro viṣṇur
na stotuṃ na ca ninditum
śakyate sarvabhūtatvāc
cokṣācokṣasvarūpiṇā

stuteḥ pādād yato nānyad
utkṛṣṭam upalabhyate
tasyāpy uccāraṇeneśo
na stotuṃ śakyate hariḥ

bhūtārthavādastutaye
na nindāyai vidhīyate
yato 'taḥ sarvabhūtasya
kā nindā tasya kā stutiḥ

yena sarvātmanā tatra
hṛdayaṃ saṃniveśitam
api maunavatas tasya
sulabho 'yaṃ janārdanaḥ

tasmāt tvaṃ kuruśārdūla
svadharmaparipālanam
kuru viṣṇuṃ ca hṛdaye
sarvavyāpinam īśvaram

tanmanā bhava tadbhaktas
tadyājī taṃ namaskuru
viṣṇor evaṃ priyatvaṃ tvam
āśu yāsyasi pārthiva

yaṃ stuvan stavyatām eti
vandyamānaś ca vandyatām
tam īśvareśvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ
hṛdaye saṃniveśaya

saṃpūjya yaṃ pūjyatamo
bhavaty atra jagattraye
tam īśvareśvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ
hṛdaye kuru pārthiva

svavarṇakarmābhirataḥ
kuru citte janārdanam
eṣa śāstrārthasadbhāvaḥ
kim uktair bahuvistaraiḥ

yasmin prasannacittas tvaṃ
yasmin kopam upaiṣi ca
tāv ubhāv api tadbhūtau
cintayan siddhim eṣyasi

yatra yatra sthitaṃ cetaḥ
prītyā snehena vā tava
taṃ taṃ cintaya govindaṃ
manasaḥ sthairyakāraṇāt

svapan vibuddhyann uttiṣṭhan
sthito bhuñjan piban vrajan
sarvagaṃ sarvakartāraṃ
viṣṇuṃ sarvatra cintaya

yathāgnisaṃgāt kanakam
apadoṣaṃ prajāyate
saṃśliṣṭaṃ vāsudevena
manuṣyāṇāṃ tathā manaḥ

yajvino yaṃ namasyanti
yaṃ namasyanti devatāḥ
yogino yaṃ namasyanti
taṃ namasyaṃ namāmy aham

bhūyaś ca śṛṇu rājendra
yaj jagāda janārdanaḥ
nāgaparyaṅkaśayane
pṛṣṭaḥ kṣīrābdhikanyayā

purā śayānaṃ govindaṃ
prāvṛṭkāle mahodadhau
śeṣabhogimahābhoge
vīcyambukaṇaśītale

yoganidrāvasānastham
acyutaṃ jagataḥ patim
papraccha puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ
puṇḍarīkakarā harim

sṛṣṭaṃ jagad idaṃ sarvaṃ
bahuśaś copasaṃhṛtam
tvayā jagatpate cātra
kiṃ kaścid dayitas tava

devān manuṣyān gandharvān
yakṣavidyādharāsurān
sṛṣṭvā sṛṣṭān nirghṛṇatvād
upasaṃharate bhavān

kaścid eteṣu bhūteṣu
devādiṣu tavācyuta
dveṣo 'sti prītir athavā
samaḥ sarvatra vā bhavān

samo 'smi sarvabhūteṣu
na me dveṣyo 'sti na priyaḥ
tathāpi guṇagṛhyo 'haṃ
pratyekahṛdayasthitaḥ

antarātmani sarvasya
lokasyāham avasthitaḥ
puṇyāpuṇyakṛtau teṣu
prītidveṣau śubhe mama

puṇyaṃ prītyanubhāvena
sādhu buddhiṣu vartate
dveṣānubhāvenāpuṇyaṃ
phaladaṃ teṣu bhāmini

śrūyatāṃ ca mahābhāge
nareṣu śubhacāriṣu
satataṃ yeṣu me prītis
tathāprītir varānane

pralayotpattitattvajñā
ātmajñānaparāś ca ye
ete svakarmaṇā bhadre
mama prītipathaṃ gatāḥ

vāṅmanaḥkāyikīṃ hiṃsāṃ
ye na kurvanti kutracit
sarvamaitrā narā lakṣmi
dayitās te sadā mama

svakīyadravyasaṃtuṣṭā
nivṛttāś cauryakarmaṇaḥ
satyaśīladayāyuktā
narā mama sadā priyāḥ

mātṛsvasṛsutātulyān
paradārāṃś ca ye narāḥ
manyante te ca me lakṣmi
dṛḍhaṃ priyatamāḥ sadā

na kāmān na ca saṃrambhān
na dveṣād ye ca bhāmini
saṃtyajanti svakaṃ karma
te 'tīva dayitā mama

viśvāsyāḥ sarvabhūtānām
ahiṃsrāś ca dayālavaḥ
tyaktānṛtakathā devi
manuṣyā dayitā mama

dharmalabdhāṃs tu ye bhogān
bhuñjate nātikīkaṭāḥ
paralokāvirodhena
te mamātipriyā narāḥ

na lobhe na ca kārpaṇye
na steye na ca matsare
yeṣāṃ matir manuṣyāṇāṃ
te 'tīva dayitā mama

dharmalabdheṣu dāreṣu
ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ
gṛhasthakarmābhiratā
narās te dayitā mama

pararandhreṣu jātyandhāḥ
paradāreṣv apuṃsakāḥ
parāpavāde ye mūkā
dayitās te narā mama

parāpavādaṃ nindāṃ ca
paramarmāvaghaṭṭanam
ye na kurvanti puruṣās
te devi mama vallabhāḥ

satyāṃ ślakṣṇāṃ nirābādhāṃ
madhurāṃ prītidāyinīm
ye vācam īrayanti sma
te manuṣyā mama priyāḥ

ye brāhmaṇārthe saṃtyajya
sadyaḥ svam api jīvitam
yatante parayā bhaktyā
