te devi dayitā mama

sākṣād devam ivāyāntaṃ
yā patiṃ nityam arcati
pādaśaucādibhir nārī
tasyā nāhaṃ sudurlabhaḥ

pūrṇacandram ivodyataṃ
bhartāraṃ yā gṛhāgatam
hṛṣṭā paśyati tāṃ viddhi
dayitāṃ yoṣitaṃ mama

te bhaktā ye sadā viprān
pūjayanty abdhisaṃbhave
yathāvibhavato bhaktyā
svakarmābhiratā narāḥ

śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ
manasāpi na ye narāḥ
samullaṅghya pravartante
te bhaktā mama bhāmini

brahmarūpadharasyāsyān
mama vedā viniḥsṛtāḥ
manvādirūpiṇaś caiva
samastāḥ smṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ

śrutiḥ smṛtir mamaivājñā
tām ullaṅghya yajec chubhe
sarvasvenāpi māṃ devi
nāpnoty ājñāvighātakṛt

yaḥ svadharmān na calati
hiṃsādhau yo na sajyate
vahatas tasya madbhaktiṃ
sadaivāhaṃ na durlabhaḥ

etad devi mayākhyātaṃ
yat pṛṣṭo 'ham iha tvayā
priyāṇāṃ mama sarveṣāṃ
śṛṇu yo 'titaraṃ priyaḥ

brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ
śūdraś ca varavarṇini
svadharmād acalan devi
dayāvān sarvajantuṣu

satyavāc chaucasaṃpanno
na drohī na ca matsarī
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiḥ śānto
dayitaḥ satataṃ mama

evaṃ śrīr devadevena
prāg uktā harimedhasā
tavāpi hi naraśreṣṭha
yathāvat kathitaṃ mayā

saṃvādam etad devasya
saha lakṣmyā jagatpateḥ
yaḥ śṛṇoti sa pāpebhyaḥ
samastebhyaḥ pramucyate

bhūyo 'khilaṃ jagaddhātur
vāsudevasya bhārgava
samyagārādhanāyālaṃ
kriyāyogaṃ bravīhi me

yat phalaṃ keśavasyārcāṃ
pratiṣṭhāpya labhen naraḥ
yac ca devakulaṃ viṣṇoḥ
kārayitvā phalaṃ labhet

yad dīpadhūpapuṣpāṇāṃ
gandhānāṃ ca nivedane
dhvajādidāne yat puṇyaṃ
yat puṇyaṃ gītavādite

tathā pavitrapaṭhane
jayaśabdādyudīraṇe
saṃmārjanādau yat puṇyaṃ
namaskāre pradakṣiṇe

śīrṇasphuṭitasaṃskāra-
karaṇe cāpi yat phalam
tan me vistarataḥ sarvaṃ
bhagavan vaktum arhasi

yaiś copavāsair bhagavān
narair ārādhyate hariḥ
teṣāṃ phalaṃ ca yat kṛtsnaṃ
tan mamācakṣva vistarāt

saṃkṣepāt pūrvam evaitad
bhavataḥ kathitaṃ mayā
vistareṇa mahārāja
śrūyatāṃ bruvato mama

aditir nāma devānāṃ
mātā paramaduścaram
tapaś cacāra varṣāṇāṃ
sahasraṃ pṛthivīpate

ārādhanāya kṛṣṇasya
vāgyatā vāyubhojanā
daityair nirākṛtān dṛṣṭvā
tanayān kurunandana

vṛthāputrāham asmīti
nirvedāt praṇatā harim
tuṣṭāva vāgbhir iṣṭābhiḥ
paramārthāvabodhinī

namaḥ smṛtārtināśāya
namaḥ puṣkaramāline
namaḥ paramakalyāṇa-
kalyāṇāyādivedhase

namaḥ paṅkajanetrāya
namaḥ paṅkajanābhaye
namaḥ paṅkajasaṃbhūti-
saṃbhavāyātmayonaye

śriyaḥ kāntāya dāntāya
dāntadṛśyāya cakriṇe
namaḥ śaṅkhāsihastāya
namaḥ kanakaretase

tathātmajñānavijñāna-
yogacittātmayogine
nirguṇāya viśeṣāya
haraye brahmarūpiṇe

jagat pratiṣṭhitaṃ yatra
jagatā yo na dṛśyate
namaḥ sthūlātisūkṣmāya
tasmai devāya śaṅkhine

yaṃ na paśyanti paśyanto
jagad apy akhilaṃ narāḥ
apaśyadbhir jagad yac ca
dṛśyate svahṛdi sthitaḥ

bahirjyotiṣi lakṣyo yo
lakṣyate jyotiṣaḥ paraḥ

yasminn etad yataś caitad
yaś caitad akhilaṃ jagat
tasmai samastajagatām
ādhārāya namo namaḥ

ādyaḥ prajāpatipatir
yaḥ pitṝṇāṃ paraḥ patiḥ
patiḥ surāṇāṃ yas tasmai
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase

yaḥ pravṛttair nivṛttaiś ca
karmabhir vibhur ijyate
svargāpavargaphalado
namas tasmai gadādhṛte

yaś cintyamāno manasā
sadyaḥ pāpaṃ vyapohati
namas tasmai viśuddhāya
parasmai harimedhase

yaṃ praviśyākhilādhāram
īśānam ajam avyayam
na punar janmamaraṇe
prāpnuvanti namāmi tam

yo yajñe yajñaparamair
ijyate yajñasaṃsthitiḥ
taṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ
namāmi prabhum īśvaram

gīyate sarvavedeṣu
vedavidbhir vidāṃ gatiḥ
yas tasmai vedavedyāya
viṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ

yato viśvaṃ samudbhūtaṃ
yasmiṃś ca layam eṣyati
viśvodbhavapratiṣṭhāya
namas tasmai mahātmane

brahmādistambaparyantaṃ
vinā yena tatām imām
māyāṃ nālaṃ samuttartuṃ
tam upendraṃ namāmy aham

yam ārādhya viśuddhena
manasā karmaṇā girā
haraty avidyām akhilāṃ
tam upendraṃ namāmy aham
viṣādatoṣaroṣādyair
yo 'jasraṃ sukhaduḥkhajaiḥ
nṛtyaty akhilabhūtasthas
tam upendraṃ namāmy aham

yo 'nnatoyasvarūpastho
bibharty akhilam īśvaraḥ
viśvaṃ viśvapatiṃ viṣṇuṃ
taṃ namāmi prajāpatim

mūrtaṃ tamo 'suramayaṃ
tadvadhād vinihanti yaḥ
rātrijaṃ sūryarūpī ca
tam upendraṃ namāmy aham

kapilādisvarūpastho
yaś cājñānamayaṃ tamaḥ
hanti jñānapradānena
tam upendraṃ namāmy aham

yasyākṣiṇī candrasūryau
sarvalokaśubhāśubham
paśyete karma satataṃ
tam upendraṃ namāmy aham

yasmin sarveśvare sarvaṃ
satyam etan mayoditam
nānṛtaṃ tam ajaṃ viṣṇuṃ
namāmi prabhavāvyayam

yathaitat satyam uktaṃ me
bhūyaś cāto janārdanaḥ
satyena tena sakalāḥ
pūryantāṃ me manorathāḥ

evaṃ stuto 'tha bhagavān
vāsudeva uvāca tām
adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ
tasyāḥ saṃdarśane sthitaḥ

manorathāṃs tvam adite
yān icchasy abhipūritān
tāṃs tān prāpsyasi dharmajñe
matprasādād asaṃśayam

śṛṇuṣva ca mahābhāge
varaṃ yas te hṛdi sthitaḥ

taṃ prayacchāmi niyataṃ
mātra kāryā vicāraṇā

maddarśanaṃ hi viphalaṃ
na kadācid bhaviṣyati

yadi deva prasannas tvaṃ
bhaktāyā bhaktavatsala
trailokyādhipatiḥ putras
tad astu mama vāsavaḥ

hṛtarājyo hṛtaś cāsya
yajñabhāgo mahāsuraiḥ
tvayi prasanne varada
taṃ prāpnotu suto mama

hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ na duḥkhāya
mama putrasya keśava
sapatnād āyatibhraṃśo
bādhāṃ naḥ kurute hṛdi

kṛtaḥ prasādo hi mayā
tava devi yathepsitaḥ
svāṃśena caiva te garbhe
saṃbhaviṣyāmi kaśyapāt

tava garbhasamudbhūtaḥ
sutas te ye surārayaḥ
tān ahaṃ nihaniṣyāmi
nirvṛtā bhava nandini

prasīda devadeveśa
namas te viśvabhāvana
nāhaṃ tvām udareṇeśa
voḍhuṃ śakṣyāmi keśava

yasmin pratiṣṭhitaṃ viśvaṃ
yo viśvaṃ svayam īśvara
tad ahaṃ nodareṇa tvāṃ
voḍhuṃ śakṣyāmi durdharam

satyam āttha mahābhāge
mayi sarvam idaṃ jagat
pratiṣṭhitaṃ na māṃ śaktā
voḍhuṃ sendrā divaukasaḥ

kintv ahaṃ sakalāṃl lokān
sadevāsuramānuṣān
jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ sarvaṃ
tvāṃ ca devi sakāśyapām
dhārayiṣyāmi bhadraṃ te
tava garbhaśayo 'dite

na te glānir na te khedo
garbhasthe bhavitā mayi
dākṣāyaṇi prasādaṃ te
karomy anyaiḥ sudurlabham

garbhasthe mayi putrāṇāṃ
tava yo 'rir bhaviṣyati
tejasas tasya hāniṃ ca
kariṣye mā vyathāṃ kṛtāḥ

evam uktvā tataḥ sadyo
gato 'ntardhānam īśvaraḥ
sāpi kālena taṃ garbham
avāpa kurusattama

garbhasthite tataḥ kṛṣṇe
cacāla sakalā kṣitiḥ
cakampire mahāśailā
jagmuḥ kṣobham athābdhayaḥ

yato yato 'ditir yāntī
dadāti lalitaṃ padam
tatas tataḥ kṣitiḥ khedān
nanāma vasudhādhipa

daityānām api sarveṣāṃ
garbhasthe madhusūdane
babhūva tejaso hānir
yathoktaṃ parameṣṭhinā

nistejaso 'surān dṛṣṭvā
samastān asureśvaraḥ
prahrādam atha papraccha
balir ātmapitāmaham

tāta nistejaso daityā
nirdagdhā iva vahninā
kim ete sahasaivādya
brahmadaṇḍahatā iva

duriṣṭaṃ kiṃ nu daityānāṃ
kiṃ kṛtyā vairinirmitā
nāśāyaiṣāṃ samudbhūtā
yena nistejaso 'surāḥ

ity āsuravaras tena
pṛṣṭaḥ pautreṇa pārthiva
ciraṃ dhyātvā jagādedam
asurendraṃ tadā balim

calanti girayo bhūmir
jahāti sahajāṃ dhṛtim
sadyaḥ samudrāḥ kṣubhitā
daityā nistejasaḥ kṛtāḥ

sūryādayo yathā pūrvaṃ
tathā gacchanti na grahāḥ
devānāṃ ca parā lakṣmīḥ
kāraṇair anumīyate

mahad etan mahābāho
kāraṇaṃ dānaveśvara
na hy alpam iti mantavyaṃ
tvayā kāryaṃ surārdana

ity uktvā dānavapatiṃ
prahrādaḥ so 'surottamaḥ
atyantabhakto deveśaṃ
jagāma manasā harim

sa dhyānapathagaṃ kṛtvā
prahrādaḥ svaṃ mano 'suraḥ
vicārayām āsa tato
yato devo janārdanaḥ

sa dadarśodare 'dityāḥ
prahrādo vāmanākṛtim
antaḥsthān bibhrataṃ sapta
lokān ādiprajāpatim

tad antaś ca vasūn rudrān
aśvinau marutas tathā
sādhyān viśve tathādityān
gandharvoragarākṣasān

virocanaṃ satanayaṃ
baliṃ cāsuranāyakam
jambhaṃ kujambhaṃ narakaṃ
bāṇam anyāṃs tathāsurān

ātmānam urvīgaganaṃ
vāyum ambho hutāśanam
samudrādridrumasarit-
sarāṃsi paśavo mṛgān

vayomanuṣyān akhilāṃs
tathaiva ca sarīsṛpān
samastalokasraṣṭāraṃ
brahmāṇaṃ bhavam eva ca

grahanakṣatratārāś ca
dakṣādyāṃś ca prajāpatīn
saṃpaśyan vismayāviṣṭaḥ
prakṛtisthaḥ kṣaṇāt punaḥ

prahrādaḥ prāha daityendraṃ
baliṃ vairocaniṃ tadā

vatsa jñātaṃ mayā sarvaṃ
yadarthaṃ bhavatām iyam
tejaso hānir utpannā
tac chṛṇu tvam aśeṣataḥ

devadevo jagadyonir
ayonir jagadādikṛt
anādir ādir viśvasya
vareṇyo varado hariḥ

parāparāṇāṃ paramaḥ
paraḥ paravatām api
prabhuḥ pramāṇaṃ mānānāṃ
saptalokaguror guruḥ

sthitiṃ kartuṃ jagannāthaḥ
so 'dityā garbhatāṃ gataḥ

prabhuḥ prabhūṇām paramaḥ parāṇām
anādimadhyo bhagavān anantaḥ
trailokyam aṃśena sanātham eṣa
kartuṃ mahātmāditijo 'vatīrṇaḥ

na yasya rudro na ca padmayonir
nendro na sūryendumarīcimiśrāḥ
jānanti daityādhipa yat svarūpaṃ
sa vāsudevaḥ kalayāvatīrṇaḥ

yo 'sau kalāṃśena nṛsiṃharūpī
jaghāna pūrvaṃ pitaram aśeṣaḥ
yaḥ sarvayogīśamanonivāsaḥ
sa vāsudevaḥ kalayāvatīrṇaḥ

yam akṣaraṃ vedavido viditvā
viśanti taṃ jñānavidhūtapāpāḥ
yasmin praviṣṭā na punar bhavanti
taṃ vāsudevaṃ praṇamāmi devam

bhūtāny aśeṣāṇi yato bhavanti
yathormayas toyanidher ajasram
layaṃ ca yasmin pralaye prayānti
taṃ vāsudevaṃ praṇamāmy acintyam

na yasya rūpaṃ na balaṃ prabhāvo
na ca svabhāvaḥ paramasya puṃsaḥ
vijñāyate sarvapitāmahādyais
taṃ vāsudevaṃ praṇamāmy acintyam

rūpasya cakṣur grahaṇe tvag eṣā
sparśagrahītrī rasanā rasasya
śrotraṃ ca śabdagrahaṇe narāṇāṃ
ghrāṇaṃ ca gandhagrahaṇe niyuktam

na ghrāṇacakṣuḥśravaṇādibhir yaḥ
sarveśvaro veditum avyayātmā
śakyas tam īḍyaṃ manasaiva devaṃ
grāhyaṃ nato 'haṃ harim īśitāram

yenaikadaṃṣṭrāgrasamuddhṛteyaṃ
dharācalā dhārayatīha sarvam
grastvā sa śete sakalaṃ jagad yas
tam īḍyam īśaṃ praṇato 'smi viṣṇum

aṃśāvatīrṇena ca yena garbhe
hṛtāni tejāṃsi mahāsurāṇām
namāmi taṃ devam anantam īśam
aśeṣasaṃsārataroḥ kuṭhāram

devo jagadyonir ayaṃ mahātmā
sa ṣoḍaśāṃśena mahāsurendra
surendramātur jaṭharaṃ praviṣṭo
hṛtāni vas tena bale vapūṃṣi

tāta ko 'yaṃ harir nāma
yato na bhayam āgatam
santi me śataśo daityā
vāsudevabalādhikāḥ

vipracittiḥ śibiḥ śaṅkur
ayaḥśaṅkus tathaiva ca
ayaḥśirā aśvaśirā
bhaṅgakāro mahāhanuḥ

pratāpī praghasaḥ śaṃbhuḥ
kurkurākṣaś ca durjayaḥ
ete cānye ca me santi
daiteyā dānavās tathā

mahābalā mahāvīryā
bhūbhāradharaṇakṣamāḥ
yeṣām ekaikaśaḥ kṛṣṇo
na vīryārdhena saṃmitaḥ

pautrasyaitad vacaḥ śrutvā
prahrādo daityapuṅgavaḥ
dhig dhig ity āha sa baliṃ
vaikuṇṭhākṣepavādinam

vināśam upayāsyanti
manye daiteyadānavāḥ
yeṣāṃ tvam īdṛśo rājā
durbuddhir avivekavān

devadevaṃ mahābhāgaṃ
vāsudevam ajaṃ vibhum
tvām ṛte pāpasaṃkalpaṃ
ko 'nya evaṃ vadiṣyati

ya ete bhavatā proktāḥ
samastā daityadānavāḥ
sabrahmakās tathā devāḥ
sthāvarāntāś ca bhūtayaḥ

tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca jagac cedaṃ
sādridrumanadīnadam
samudradvīpalokāś ca
yac ceṅgaṃ yac ca neṅgati

yasyātivandyavandyasya
vyāpinaḥ paramātmanaḥ
ekāṃśāṃśakalājanma
kas tam evaṃ pravakṣyati

ṛte vināśābhimukhaṃ
tvām ekam avivekinam
durbuddhim ajitātmānaṃ
vṛddhānāṃ śāsanātigam

śocyo 'haṃ yasya vai gehe
jātas tava pitādhamaḥ
yasya tvam īdṛśaḥ putro
devadevāvamanyakaḥ

tiṣṭhatv anekasaṃsāra-
saṃhṛtāghavināśanī
kṛṣṇe bhaktir ahaṃ tāvad
avekṣyo bhavato na kim

na me priyataraḥ kṛṣṇād
api deho 'yam ātmanaḥ
iti jānāty ayaṃ loko
bhavāṃś ca ditijādhamaḥ

jānann api priyataraṃ
prāṇebhyo 'pi hariṃ mama
nindāṃ karoṣi ca katham
akurvan gauravaṃ mama

virocanas tava gurur
gurus tasyāpy ahaṃ bale
mamāpi sarvajagatāṃ
gurur nārāyaṇo guruḥ

nindāṃ karoṣi tasmiṃs tvaṃ
kṛṣṇe guruguror gurau
yasmāt tasmād ihaiśvaryād
acirād bhraṃśam eṣyasi

mā devo mā jagannātho
bale māsau janārdanaḥ
bhavatv aham avekṣyas te
prītimān atra me guruḥ

etāvanmātram apy atra
nindatā jagato gurum
nāpekṣitā vayaṃ yasmāt
tasmāc chāpaṃ dadāmi te

yathā me śirasaś chedād
idaṃ gurutaraṃ bale
tvayoktam acyutākṣepi
rājyabhraṣṭas tathā pata

yathā na kṛṣṇād aparaṃ
paritrāṇaṃ bhavārṇave
tathācireṇa paśyeyaṃ
bhavantaṃ rājyavicyutam

iti daityapatiḥ śrutvā
guror vacanam apriyam
prasādayām āsa guruṃ
praṇipatya puṇaḥ punaḥ

prasīda tāta mā kopaṃ
kuru mohahate mayi
balāvalepamattena
mayaitad vākyam īritam

mohopahatavijñānaḥ
pāpo 'haṃ ditijottama
yac chapto 'smi durācāras
tat sādhu bhavatā kṛtam

rājyabhraṃśaṃ vasubhraṃśaṃ
saṃprāpsyāmīti na tv aham
viṣaṇṇo 'smi yathā tāta
tavaivāvinaye kṛte

trailokyarājyam aiśvaryam
anyad vā nātidurlabham
saṃsāre durlabhās tāta
guravo ye bhavadvidhāḥ

tat prasīda na me kopaṃ
kartum arhasi daityapa
tvatkopahetuduṣṭo 'haṃ
paritapye na śāpataḥ

vatsa kopena moho me
janitas tena te mayā
śāpo datto vivekaś ca
mohenāpahṛto mama

yadi mohena me jñānaṃ
nākṣiptaṃ syān mahāsura
tat kathaṃ sarvagaṃ jñānan
hariṃ kaṃcic chāpāmy aham

yo 'yaṃ śāpo mayā datto
bhavato 'surapuṅgava
bhāvyam etena nūnaṃ te
tasmāt tvaṃ mā viṣīdathāḥ

adyaprabhṛti deveśe
bhagavaty acyute harau
bhavethā bhaktimān īśaḥ
sa te trātā bhaviṣyati

śāpaṃ prāpya ca māṃ vīra
saṃsmarethāḥ smṛtas tvayā
tathā tathā yatiṣyāmi
śreyasā yokṣyate yathā

evam uktvā sa daityendro
virarāma mahāmatiḥ
ajāyata sa govindo
bhagavān vāmanākṛtiḥ

avatīrṇe jagannāthe
tasmin sarvam aśīśamat
yad āsuram abhūd duḥkhaṃ
devānām adites tathā

vavur vātāḥ sukhasparśā
nīrajaskam abhūn nabhaḥ
dharme ca sarvabhūtānāṃ
tadā matir ajāyata

nodvegaś cāpy abhūd dehe
manujānāṃ janeśvara
tathā hi sarvabhūtānāṃ
bhūmyambaradivaukasām

taṃ jātamātraṃ bhagavān
brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
jātakarmādikāḥ kṛtvā
kriyās tuṣṭāva pārthiva

jayādyeśa jayājeya
jaya sarvātmakātmaka
jaya janmajarāpeta
jayānanta jayācyuta

jayājita jayāśeṣa
jayāvyakta sthite jaya
paramārthārtha sarvajña
jñāna jñeyātmaniḥsṛta

jayāśeṣajagatsākṣiñ
jaya kartar jagadguroḥ
jagato jagadante 'nta
sthitau pālayitā jaya

jayākhila jayāśeṣa
jayākhilahṛdi sthita
jayādimadhyāntamaya
sarvajñānamayottama

mumukṣubhir anirdeśya
svayaṃdṛṣṭa jayeśvara
yogibhir muktiphalada
damādiguṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ

jayātisūkṣma durjñeya
jagat sthūla jaganmaya
jaya sthūlātisūkṣma tvaṃ
jayātīndriya sendriya

nṛkesariñ jayārāti-
vakṣaḥsthalavidāraṇa
sāṃprataṃ jaya viśvātman
māyāvāmana keśava

nijamāyāpaṭacchanna
jagaddhātar janārdana
jayācintya jayāneka-
svarūpaikavidha prabho

vardhasva vardhitāneka-
vikāraprakṛte hare
tvayy eṣā jagatām īśa
saṃsthitā dharmapaddhatiḥ

na tvām ahaṃ na ceśāno
nendrādyās tridaśā hare
jñātum īśā na munayaḥ
sanakādyā na yoginaḥ

tvanmāyāpaṭasaṃvīte
jagaty atra jagatpate
kas tvāṃ vetsyati sarveśaṃ
tvatprasādaṃ vinā naraḥ

tvam evārādhito yasya
prasādasumukhaḥ prabho
sa eva kevalaṃ deva
vetti tvāṃ netaro janaḥ

tad īśvareśvareśāna
vibho vardhasva bhāvana
prabhāvāyāsya viśvasya
viśvātman pṛthulocana

evaṃ stuto hṛṣīkeśaḥ
sa tadā vāmanākṛtiḥ
prahasya bhāvagambhīram
uvācābjasamudbhavam

stuto 'haṃ bhavatā pūrvam
indrādyaiḥ kaśyapena ca
mayā ca vaḥ pratijñātam
indrasya bhuvanatrayam

bhūyaś cāhaṃ stuto 'dityā
tasyāś cāpi pratiśrutam
yathā śakrāya dāsyāmi
trailokyaṃ hatakaṇṭakam

so 'haṃ tathā kariṣyāmi
yathendro jagataḥ patiḥ
bhaviṣyati sahasrākṣaḥ
satyam etad bravīmi te

tataḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ brahmā
hṛṣīkeśāya dattavān
yajñopavītaṃ bhagavān
dadau tasmai bṛhaspatiḥ

āṣāḍham adadad daṇḍaṃ
marīcir brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ
kamaṇḍaluṃ vasiṣṭhaś ca
kauśyaṃ vedam athāṅgirāḥ
akṣasūtraṃ ca pulahaḥ
pulastyaḥ sitavāsasī

upatasthuś ca taṃ vedāḥ
praṇavasvarabhūṣaṇāḥ
śāstrāṇy aśeṣāṇi tathā
sāṃkhyayogoktayaś ca yāḥ

sa vāmano jaṭī daṇḍī
chattrī dhṛtakamaṇḍaluḥ
sarvadevamayo bhūpa
baler adhvaram abhyayāt

yatra yatra padaṃ bhūpa
bhūbhāge vāmano dadau
dadāti bhūmir vivaraṃ
tatra tatrātipīḍitā

sa vāmano jaḍagatir
mṛdu gacchan saparvatām
sābdhidvīpavatīṃ sarvāṃ
cālayām āsa medinīm

saparvatavanām urvīṃ
dṛṣṭvā saṃkṣubhitāṃ baliḥ
papracchośanasaṃ śukraṃ
praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ

ācārya kṣobham āyāti
sābdhibhūbhṛddharā mahī
kasmāc ca nāsurān bhāgān
pratigṛhṇanti vahnayaḥ

iti pṛṣṭo 'tha balinā
kāvyo vedavidāṃ varaḥ
uvāca daityādhipatiṃ
ciraṃ dhyātvā mahāmatiḥ

avatīrṇo jagadyoniḥ
kaśyapasya gṛhe hariḥ
vāmaneneha rūpeṇa
paramātmā sanātanaḥ

sa nūnaṃ yajñam āyāti
tava dānavapuṅgava
tatpadanyāsavikṣobhād
iyaṃ pracalitā mahī

kampante girayaś cāmī
kṣubhitā makarālayāḥ
nainaṃ bhūtapatiṃ bhūmiḥ
samarthā voḍhum īśvaram

sadevāsuragandharva-
yakṣarākṣasapannagā
anenaiva dhṛtā bhūmir
āpo 'gniḥ pavano nabhaḥ
dhārayaty akhilān deva-
manuṣyādīn mahāsura

iyam asya jagaddhātur
māyā kṛṣṇasya gahvarī
dhāryadhārakabhāvena
yayā saṃpiṇḍitaṃ jagat

tatsaṃnidhānād asurā
na bhāgārhāḥ suradviṣaḥ
bhuñjate cāsurān bhāgān
amī te na tavāgnayaḥ

dhanyo 'haṃ kṛtapuṇyaś ca
yan me yajñapatiḥ svayam
yajñam abhyāgato brahman
mattaḥ ko 'nyo 'dhikaḥ pumān

yaṃ yoginaḥ sadodyuktāḥ
paramātmānam avyayam
draṣṭum icchanti devo 'sau
madadhvaram upaiṣyati

hotā bhāgaprado yasya
yam udgātā ca gāyati
tam adhvareśvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ
mattaḥ ko 'nya upaiṣyati

sarveśvareśvare viṣṇau
mamādhvaram upāgate
yan mayā cārya kartavyaṃ
tan mamādeṣṭum arhasi

yajñabhāgabhujo devā
vedaprāmāṇyato 'sura
tvayā tu dānavā daityā
yajñabhāgabhujaḥ kṛtāḥ

ayaṃ ca devaḥ sattvasthaḥ
karoti sthitipālanam
nisṛṣṭeś cāyam ante ca
svayam atti prajāḥ prabhuḥ

tvayānubandhī bhavitā
nūnaṃ viṣṇuḥ sthitau sthitaḥ
viditvaitan mahābhāga
kuru yat te manogatam

tvayāsya daityādhipate
svalpake 'pi hi vastuni
pratijñā naiva voḍhavyā
vācyaṃ sāma tathāphalam

nālaṃ dātuṃ dhanaṃ devety
evaṃ vācyaṃ tu yācataḥ
kṛṣṇasya devabhūtyarthaṃ
pravṛttasya mahāsura

brahman katham ahaṃ brūyām
anyenāpi hi yācitaḥ
nāstīti kimu devena
saṃsārāghaughahāriṇā

vratopavāsair vividhair
yaḥ pratigrāhyate hariḥ
sa ced vakṣyati dehīti
govindaḥ kim ato 'dhikam

yadartham upahārāḍhyā
damaśaucaguṇānvitaiḥ
yajñāḥ kriyante deveśaḥ
sa māṃ dehīti vakṣyati

tat sādhu sukṛtaṃ karma
tapaḥ sucaritaṃ ca naḥ
yan mayā dattam īśeśaḥ
svayam ādāsyate hariḥ

nāstīty ahaṃ guro vakṣye
tam apy āgatam īśvaram
yadi tad vañcyate prāpte
nūnam asmadvidhaḥ phalaiḥ

yajñe 'smin yadi yajñeśo
yācate māṃ janārdanaḥ
nijamūrdhānam apy adya
tad dāsyāmy avicāritam

nāstīti yan mayā noktam
anyeṣām api yācatām
vakṣyāmi katham āyāte
tad anabhyastam acyute

ślāghya eva hi dhīrāṇāṃ
dānād āpatsamāgamaḥ
nābādhākāri yad dānaṃ
tad aṅgamalavat katham

madrājye nāsukhī kaścin
na daridro na cāturaḥ
nātṛṣito na codvigno
na sragādivivarjitaḥ

hṛṣṭatuṣṭaḥ sugandhī ca
tṛptaḥ sarvasukhānvitaḥ
janaḥ sarvo mahābhāga
kimutāhaṃ sadā sukhī

etad viśiṣṭapātrotthaṃ
dānabījaphalaṃ mama
viditaṃ bhṛguśārdūla
mayaitat tvatprasādataḥ

etad vijānato dāna-
bījaṃ patati ced guro
janārdane mahāpātre
kiṃ na prāptaṃ tato mayā

matto dānam avāpyeśo
yadi puṣṇāti devatāḥ
upabhogānvayaguṇaṃ
dānaṃ ślāghyataraṃ tataḥ

matprasādaparo nūnaṃ
yajñenārādhito hariḥ
tenābhyeti na saṃdeho
darśanād upakārakṛt

atha kopena vābhyeti
devabhāgoparodhinam
māṃ nihantum ato 'pi syād
vadhaḥ ślāghyataro 'cyutāt

yanmayaṃ sarvam evedaṃ
nāprāpya yasya vidyate
sa māṃ yācitum abhyeti
nānugraham ṛte hariḥ

yaḥ sṛjaty ātmabhūḥ sarvaṃ
cetasaivāpahanti ca
sa māṃ hantuṃ hṛṣīkeśaḥ
kathaṃ yatnaṃ kariṣyati

etad viditvā tu guro
dānavighnapareṇa me
naiva bhāvyaṃ jagannāthe
govinde samupasthite

ity evaṃ vadatas tasya
prāptas tatra jagapatiḥ
sarvadevamayo 'cintyo
māyāvāmanarūpadhṛk

taṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñavāṭāntaḥ-
praviṣṭam asurāḥ prabhum
jagmuḥ prabhāvataḥ kṣobhaṃ
tejasā tasya niṣprabhāḥ

jepuś ca munayas tatra
ye sametā mahādhvare
baliś caivākhilaṃ janma
mene saphalam ātmanaḥ

tataḥ saṃkṣobham āpanno
na kaścit kiṃcid uktavān
pratyeko devadeveśaṃ
pūjayām āsa cetasā

athāsurapatiṃ prahvaṃ
dṛṣṭvā munivarāṃś ca tān
devadevapatiḥ sākṣād
viṣṇur vāmanarūpadhṛk

tuṣṭāva yajñaṃ vahniṃś ca
yajamānam atha rtvijaḥ
yajñakarādhikārasthān
sadasyān dravyasaṃpadam

tataḥ prasannam akhilaṃ
vāmanaṃ prati tatkṣaṇāt
yajñavāṭasthitaṃ vīraṃ
sādhu sādhv ity udīrayan

sa cārgham ādāya baliḥ
prodbhūtapulakas tadā
pūjayām āsa govindaṃ
prāha cedaṃ vaco 'suraḥ

suvarṇaratnasaṃghātaṃ
gajāśvam amitaṃ tathā
striyo vastrāṇy alaṃkārān
gāvo grāmāṃś ca puṣkalān

sarvasvaṃ sakalām urvīṃ
bhavato vā yad īpsitam
tad dadāmi vṛṇuṣva tvaṃ
mamārthī satataṃ priyaḥ

ity ukto daityapatinā
prītigarvānvitaṃ vacaḥ
prāha sasmitagambhīraṃ
bhagavān vāmanākṛtiḥ

mamāgniśaraṇārthāya
dehi rājan padatrayam
suvarṇagrāmaratnādi
tad arthibhyaḥ pradīyatām

tribhiḥ prayojanaṃ kiṃ te
padaiḥ padavatāṃ vara
śataṃ śatasahasraṃ vā
padānāṃ mārgatāṃ bhavān

etāvatā daityapate
kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mārgatām
anyeṣām arthināṃ vittam
icchayā dāsyate bhavān

etac chrutvā tu gaditaṃ
vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ
vācayām āsa tat tasmai
vāmanāya padatrayam

pāṇau tu patite toye
vāmano bhūtabhāvanaḥ
sarvadevamayaṃ rūpaṃ
darśayām āsa tatkṣaṇāt

candrasūryau ca nayane
dyauḥ śiraś caraṇau kṣitiḥ
pādāṅgulyaḥ piśācāś ca
hastāṅgulyaś ca guhyakāḥ

viśvedevāś ca jānusthā
jaṅghe sādhyāḥ surottamāḥ
yakṣā nakheṣu saṃbhūtā
rekhāsv apsarasaḥ sthitāḥ

dṛṣṭir dhiṣṇāny aśeṣāṇi
keśāḥ sūryāṃśavaḥ prabho
tārakā romakūpāṇi
romāṇi ca maharṣayaḥ

bāhavo vidiśas tasya
diśaḥ śrotraṃ mahātmanaḥ
aśvinau śravaṇau tasya
nāsā vāyur mahābalaḥ

prasādaś candramā devo
mano dharmaḥ samāśritaḥ
satyam asyābhavad vāṇī
jihvā devī sarasvatī

grīvāditir devamātā
vidyās tadvalayas tathā
svargadvāram abhūn maitraṃ
tvaṣṭā pūṣā ca vai bhruvau

mukhaṃ vaiśvānaraś cāsya
vṛṣaṇau tu prajāpatiḥ
hṛdayaṃ ca paraṃ brahma
puṃstvaṃ vai kaśyapo muniḥ

pṛṣṭhe 'sya vasavo devā
marutaḥ sarvasaṃdhiṣu
sarvasūktāni daśanā
jyotīṃṣi vimalaprabhāḥ

vakṣaḥsthale tathā rudro
dhairye cāsya mahārṇavaḥ
udare cāsya gandharvā
marutaś ca mahābalāḥ
lakṣmīr medhā dhṛtiḥ kāntiḥ
sarvavidyāś ca vai kaṭiḥ

sarvajyotīṃṣi yānīha
tapaś ca paramaṃ mahat
tasya devātidevasya
tejaḥ prodbhūtam uttamam

stanau kukṣau ca vedāś ca
jānū cāsya mahāmakhāḥ
iṣṭayaḥ paśubandhāś ca
dvijānāṃ ceṣṭitāni ca

tasya devamayaṃ rūpaṃ
dṛṣṭvā viṣṇor mahābalāḥ
upasarpanti daiteyāḥ
pataṃgā iva pāvakam

pramathya sarvān asurān
pādahastatalair vibhuḥ
kṛtvā rūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ
sa jahārāśu medinīm

tasya vikramato bhumiṃ
candrādityau stanāntare
nabho vikramamāṇasya
sakthideśe sthitāv ubhau

paraṃ vikramamāṇasya
jānumūle prabhākarau
viṣṇor āstām mahīpāla
devapālanakarmaṇi

jitvā lokatrayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ
hatvā cāsurapuṅgavān
puraṃdarāya trailokyaṃ
dadau viṣṇur urukramaḥ

sutalaṃ nāma pātālam
adhastād vasudhātalāt
baler dattaṃ bhagavatā
viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā

yat tvayā salilaṃ dattaṃ
gṛhītaṃ pāṇinā mayā
kalpapramāṇaṃ tasmāt te
bhaviṣyaty āyur uttamam

vaivasvate tathātīte
bale manvantare tataḥ
sāvarṇake ca saṃprāpte
bhavān indro bhaviṣyati

sāṃprataṃ devarājāya
trailokyam akhilaṃ mayā
dattaṃ caturyugānāṃ vai
sādhikā hy ekasaptatiḥ

niyantavyā mayā sarve
ye tasya paripanthinaḥ
tenāhaṃ parayā bhaktyā
pūrvam ārādhito bale

sutalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ
tam āsādya manoramam
vasāsura mamādeśaṃ
yathāvat paripālayan

upabhuñjan mahābhogān
vividhān dānaveśvara
mamājñayā kālam imaṃ
tiṣṭha strīśatasaṃvṛtaḥ

yāvat suraiś ca vipraiś ca
na virodhaṃ kariṣyasi
tāvad etān mahābhogān
avāpsyasy asurottama

yadā ca devaviprāṇāṃ
viruddhāny ācariṣyasi
bandhiṣyanti tathā pāśā
vāruṇās tvām asaṃśayam

etad viditvā bhavatā
mayājñaptam aśeṣataḥ
na virodhaḥ suraiḥ kāryo
viprair vā daityasattama

ity evam ukto devena
viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā
baliḥ prāha mahārāja
praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ

tatrāsato me pātāle
bhagavan bhavadājñayā
kiṃ bhaviṣyaty upādānam
upabhogopapādakam

āpyāyito yena deva
smareyaṃ tvām ahaṃ sadā

dānāny avidhidattāni
śrāddhāny aśrotriyāṇi ca
hutāny aśraddhayā yāni
tāni dāsyanti te phalam

adakṣiṇās tathā yajñāḥ
kriyāś cāvidhinā kṛtāḥ
phalāni tava dāsyanti
adhītāny avratāni ca

baler varam idaṃ dattvā
śakrāya trividaṃ tathā
vyāpinā tena rūpeṇa
jagāmādarśanaṃ hariḥ

śaśāsa ca yathā pūrvam
indras trailokyam ūrjitam
siṣeva ca parān kāmān
baliḥ pātālam āśritaḥ

ity etad devadevasya
viṣṇor māhātmyam uttamam
vāmanasya paṭhed yas tu
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

baliprahrādasaṃvādaṃ
mantritaṃ baliśukrayoḥ
baliviṣṇvoś ca kathitaṃ
yaḥ smariṣyati mānavaḥ

nādhayo vyādhayo vāsya
na ca mohākulaṃ manaḥ
bhaviṣyati kuruśreṣṭha
puṃsas tasya kadācana

cyutarājyo nijaṃ rājyam
iṣṭaprāptiṃ viyogavān
avāpnoti mahābhāga
naraḥ śrutvā kathām imām

pātāle nivasan vīras
tadā vairocanir baliḥ
kāmopabhogasaṃprāptyā
mudaṃ prāpa parāṃ vibhuḥ

alaṃbuṣā miśrakeśī
puṇḍarīkātha vāmanā
ghṛtācī menakā rambhā
nanṛtus tasya saṃnidhau

prajagur devagandharvā
viśvāvasupurogamāḥ
tuṣṭuvuś ca mahābhāga
baliṃ siddhāḥ sacāraṇāḥ

tasmin saṃgītagītā tu
vīṇāveṇuravākule
sragādibhūṣito daityaḥ
papau pānam anuttamam

śarkārasavamādhvikāṃ
puṣpāsavaphalāsavam
divyāḥ prasannāś ca surās
tadarhāṇi madhūni ca

parāvadaṃśān madhurāṃl
lavaṇāṃs tiktakāṇ kaṭūn
kaṣāyāṃś ca mahārāja
sumṛṣṭāny aparāṇi ca

suhṛṭsujanasaṃbandhi-
bhṛtyavargasamanvitaḥ
bubhuje pātālagatas
tadā vairocanir baliḥ

prāsādāḥ kāñcanāḥ sarve
suvarṇamaṇimaṇḍitāḥ
sphāṭikāmalasopānā
muktāhāraśatojjvalāḥ

teṣu sarveṣu daiteyā
baleḥ saṃbandhibāndhavāḥ
nṛtyavādyādimuditā
bubhujur viṣayān priyān

baliś ca bhagavān daityo
daityoragaśatair vṛtaḥ
upagīyamāno bubhuje
yatheṣṭaṃ viṣayān priyān

patnī vindhyāvalī nāma
tasya daityapater abhūt
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇā
śrīr ivābjaṃ vināparā

na devī nāpi gandharvī
nāpsarā na ca mānuṣī
tasyā rūpeṇa sadṛśī
babhūva manujeśvara

sā tu pīnāyataśroṇī
mṛdvaṅgī madhurasvarā
ghanonnatakucā subhrūḥ
sasmitāyatalocanā

mṛdvalpapāṇipādābjā
sumadhyā gajagāminī
sukeśī sumukhī śyāmā
sarvair yoṣidguṇair yutā

tayā tu ramatas tasya
ramaṇīye rasātale
śaktir āsīd anudinaṃ
vivekapratilominī

kadācid ramatas tasya
daityarājasya pārthiva
tīkṣṇāṃśur madhyamāṃ vīthīṃ
yayau vaiṣuvatīṃ raviḥ

yadā yadā ca viṣuvaṃ
bhāskaraḥ pratipadyate
tadā tadā hareś cakraṃ
pātāle parivartate

sravanti yoṣitāṃ garbhās
tasya dhārāṃśutāpitāḥ
sahasā daityapatnīnāṃ
yāsu puṃsāṃ samudbhavaḥ
nistejaso daityabhaṭā
bhavanti ca mahīpate

tad dṛṣṭvā sahasāyāntam
ādityaśatatejasam
jvālāmālāsuduḥprekṣyaṃ
viṣṇucakraṃ sudarśanam
hāhākṛtam abhūt sarvaṃ
pātālam arisūdana

jepur ye munayas tatra
sārghapātrā mahoragāḥ
babhūvuḥ praṇatāś cānye
siddhagandharvacāraṇāḥ
vaiklavyaṃ cāgatāḥ sarvāḥ
striyaḥ parapuraṃjaya

tad dṛṣṭvā vyākulībhūtaṃ
pātālam asurās tataḥ
ye tasthuḥ pauruṣaparās
te hatāḥ śataneminā

bhrāmyatā tena cakreṇa
saptalokavicāriṇā
samastajagadādhāra-
karamuktena veginā

tan niṣūditadaityaughaṃ
daityastrīgarbhahānidam
śrutvā cakraṃ mahācakro
niścakrāma gṛhād baliḥ

āḥ kim etad itīty uktvā
sa tu madyamahoddhataḥ
vimalaṃ khaḍgam ādāya
śatacandraṃ ca bhānumat

niryāntam atha vegena
tam udāraparākramam
vidhyāvalī nāma śubhā
dadhāra dayitaṃ patim

uvāca ca pariṣvajya
krodhatāmrekṣaṇaṃ balim
kalyāṇī guṇadoṣajñā
praṇayān mṛdubhāṣiṇī

daityarāja na kopasya
vaśam āgantum arhasi
vimṛśya tajjñaḥ sāmādīn
prayuñjīta balābalam

kim etat kasya vā kutra
kiṃnimittam ihāgatam
cakram itthaṃ vicārya tvaṃ
krodhaṃ yāhi praśāmya vā

etat kila jagaddhātuś
cakraṃ viṣṇoḥ sudarśanam
pratiṣaṇmāsam abhyeti
daityagarbhavināśanam

puṅgarbhān nikhilān etad
dānavānāṃ mahāsura
vināśayaty anantarāṃ
sarvaduṣṭanibarhaṇam

karoti duḥkham atulaṃ
ghātanāt pratipakṣajam
puruṣāṇāṃ na sarvatra
saṃsthitā jagataḥ pateḥ

mayi tvayi tathānyatra
yathā viṣṇur vyavasthitaḥ
tasyaitac cakram āyāntaṃ
puruṣaḥ ko na pūjayet

yasyādhikṣepajā rājaṃs
tava trailokyavicyutiḥ
tasya cakraṃ jaganmūrteḥ
samupaiṣi ruṣā katham

sadṛśe puruṣe krodhaṃ
naraḥ kurvīta daityapa
na tu sarveśvare viṣṇau
yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam

tat prasīda mahābhāga
samupaihi jagatpatim
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ
yaṃ praṇamya na sīdati

yasmin prasanne trailokyaṃ
tvattaḥ prāptaḥ śacīpatiḥ
bhraṣṭaś ca yadadhikṣepāt
taṃ tvaṃ śaraṇam āvraja

yatra sarveśvare sarvaṃ
sarvabhūte jagat sthitam
tasya cakram upaihi tvaṃ
vinayād asurādhipa

sarvakāraṇabhūtasya
devadevasya cakriṇaḥ
kaś cakram ativarteta
martyadharmā mahāsura

cakram atra jagaddhātuḥ
karoti sthitipālanam
vipakṣāsurasaṃbhūti-
garbhavisraṃsanāt prabho

prasādya cakranāmānaṃ
govindaṃ jagato gurum
śreyase sarvadharmajña
śaraṇaṃ vraja keśavam

saṃsmarasva ca daityendra
prahrādaṃ svapitāmaham
bhraṣṭarājyena bhavatā
smartavyo 'ham iti prabho

sa vyājahāra bhagavāṃs
tavānugrahakāmyayā
saṃsmaryatāṃ mahābhāga
sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
viṣṇubhakto mahābāhuḥ
sa te śreyo 'bhidhāsyati

etad vacanam ākarṇya
tadā vairocanir baliḥ
yayau tadārgham ādāya
viṣṇoś cakrasya pūjakaḥ

sa dadarśa samāyāntam
anantakarasaṅginam
cakram akṣayacakrasya
viśvasya paripālakam

sasmāra ca baliḥ sarvaṃ
prahrādavacanaṃ nṛpa
jagāda yac ca govindaḥ
prasādasumukhaḥ prabhuḥ

bhaktinamras tato bhūtvā
bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhoḥ
tuṣṭāva vāsudevasya
cakram avyaktamūrtinaḥ

taṃ dṛṣṭvā tejasā rāśim
upasaṃgamya cā vibhum
uvāca daityaśārdūlaḥ
praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ

anantasyāprameyasya
viśvamūrter mahātmanaḥ
namāmi cakriṇaś cakraṃ
karasaṅgi sudarśanam

sahasram iva sūryāṇāṃ
saṃghātaṃ vidyutām iva

duṣṭarāhugalaccheda-
śoṇitāruṇatārakam
tan namāmi hareś cakraṃ
śatanemi sudarśanam

yasyārakeṣu śakrādyā
lokapālā vyavasthitāḥ
tadantar vasavo rudrās
tathaiva marutāṃ gaṇāḥ

dhārāyāṃ dvādaśādityāḥ
samastāś ca hutāśanāḥ
dhārājāle 'bdhayaḥ sarve
nābhimadhye prajāpatiḥ

samastanemiṣv akhilā
yasya vidyāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
yasya rūpam anirdeśyam
api yogibhir uttamaiḥ

yad bhramat surasaṅghānāṃ
tejasaḥ paribṛṃhaṇam
daityaujasāṃ ca nāśāya
tan namāmi sudarśanam

bhraman matamahāvega-
vibhrāntākhilakhecaram
tan namāmi hareś cakram
anantāraṃ sudarśanam

nakṣatravadvahnikaṇa-
vyāptaṃ kṛtsnaṃ nabhastalam
tan namāmi hareś cakraṃ
karasaṅgi sudarśanam

svabhāvatejasā yuktaṃ
yad arkāgnimayaṃ mahat
viśeṣato harer gatvā
sarvadevamayaṃ karam

durvṛttadaityamathanaṃ
jagataḥ paripālakam
tan namāmi hareś cakraṃ
daityacakraharaṃ param

karotu me sadā śarma
dharmatāṃ ca prayātu me
prasādasumukhe kṛṣṇe
tasya cakraṃ sudarśanam

prasīda saṃyuge 'riṇāṃ
sudarśanasudarśanam
vidyujjvālāmahākakṣaṃ
dahāntar mama yat tamaḥ

jahi no viṣayagrāhi
mano grahaviceṣṭitam
visphoṭayākhilāṃ māyāṃ
kuruṣva vimalāṃ matim

evaṃ saṃsthūyamānaṃ tad
vahnipiṇḍopamaṃ mahat
babhūva prakaṭaṃ cakraṃ
daityacakrpates tadā

dadarśa sa mahābāhuḥ
prabhāmaṇḍaladurdṛśam
agnijvālāgataṃ tāmraṃ
taptacakram ivāparam

bhramatas tasya cakrasya
nābhimadhye mahīpate
trailokyam akhilaṃ daityo
dṛṣṭavān bhūrbhuvādikam

mervādīn akhilāñ śailān
gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tathā
kṣīrābdhipramukhāṃś cābdhīn
dvīpāñ jambvādisaṃjñitān

vaimānikān sagandharvān
sūryādīṃś ca tathā grahān
nakṣatratārakākāśaṃ
śakrādīṃś ca divaukasaḥ

rudrādityāṃś ca marutāṃ
sādhyānāṃ ca mahīpate
saṃnidhānaṃ nirīkṣyāsau
daityānāṃ vismito 'bhavat

tataḥ praṇamyārtiharaṃ surāṇām
apārasāraṃ paramāyudhaṃ hareḥ
namo namas te 'stv iti daityarājaḥ
provāca bhūyo 'pi namo namas te

yan no 'śubhaṃ cetasi vāyuvega
yan no 'śubhaṃ vāci hutāśanottha
yac cāśubhaṃ kāyakṛtaṃ hares tad
varāyudhaṃ tvaṃ praśamaṃ nayāśu

prasīda satkārakṛtaṃ mamāghaṃ
prayātu te nāśam anantavīrya
satāṃ ca sanmārgavatāṃ manāṃsi
sthirībhavantv acyutapādayugme

evaṃ stute tatas tasmin
viṣṇucakre sudarśane
puṣpavṛṣṭir baler mūrdhni
nipapātāntarikṣataḥ
parihṛtya ca daityendraṃ
yayau cakraṃ yathecchayā

bhramad eva ca daityānāṃ
yayau tadbhayam āvahat

tatas tad adbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā
cakrasyāgamanaṃ hareḥ
pūrvavatsmaraṇaṃ prāpya
sasmāra svapitāmaham

gacchatā pūrvam āryeṇa
smartavyo 'ham itīritam
taṃ smariṣyāmi daityendraṃ
sa naḥ śreyo 'bhidhāsyati

ity etad adhisaṃsmṛtya
balir ātmapitāmaham
sasmāra daityādhipatiṃ
prahrādaṃ bhagavatpriyam

saṃsmṛtaś ca sa pātālam
ājagāma mahāmatiḥ
cakrodyatakaraḥ sākṣād
bhagavān iva keśavaḥ

tam āgatam athotthāya
yathāvat sa mahāmatiḥ
abhivādya balir bhaktyā
nivedyārgham abhāṣata

tātāṃhridarśanād adya
pāvito 'smy apakalmaṣaḥ
divaś cyuto 'py ahaṃ manye
śakrād ātmānam uttamam

trailokyaharaṇād ugraṃ
yad duḥkhaṃ hṛdaye mama
tac chāntaṃ pādasaṃparkam
upetya bhavato mama

iti saṃstūya dattvā ca
varāsanam udāradhīḥ
paryupāsata rājendro
daityānāṃ svapitāmaham

tam upāsīnam anaghaḥ
prahrādo daityapuṅgavaḥ
pratyuvāca mahātmānaṃ
baliṃ vairocaniṃ nṛpa

bale brūhi yadarthaṃ te
smṛto 'ham arisūdana
tavopakāraṇe viddhi
dharme māṃ satatodyatam

tātenāhaṃ purā jñapto
bhraṣṭarājyena te bale
saṃsmartavyo 'smy asaṃdigdhaṃ
śreyo vakṣyāmy ahaṃ tadā

so 'haṃ rājyaparibhraṣṭo
viṣayāsaktihṛṣitaḥ
indriyair avaśas tāta
yat kāryaṃ tat praśādhi mām

yadi mad-vacanaṃ tāta
śraddhadhāsi hitaṃ bale
taṃ devadevam anaghaṃ
prayāhi śaraṇaṃ harim

śabdādiṣv anuraktāni
tavākṣāṇy asurādhipa
śabdādayaś ca govinde
santy eva vyavahārataḥ

gītakair gīyatāṃ viṣṇur
manohāribhir ātmanaḥ
anyālambanataś cittam
ākṛṣyādhatsva keśave

gandhān udārān bhakṣāṃś ca
srajo vāsāṃsi cāsura
prayaccha devadevāya
taccheṣāṇy upayuñja ca

yatra yatra ca te prītir
viṣaye ditijeśvara
tat tam acyutam uddiśya
viprebhyaḥ pratipādaya

sarvabhūteṣu govindo
bahurūpo vyavasthitaḥ
iti matvā mahābāho
sarvabhūtahito bhava

ātmānam acyutaṃ viddhi
śatruṃ ca ripum ātmanaḥ
itijñānavataḥ kopas
tava kutra bhaviṣyati

śabdādayo ye viṣayā
viṣayī yaś ca puruṣaḥ
tad aśeṣaṃ vijānīhi
svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ

paramātmā ca bhagavān
viṣvakseno janārdanaḥ
tadbhaktimān bhāgavato
nālpapuṇyo hi jāyate

bhagavacchāsanālambī
bhagavacchāsanapriyaḥ
bhagavadbhaktim āsthāya
vatsa bhāgavato bhava

bhagavān bhūtakṛd bhavyo
bhūtānāṃ prabhavo hi yaḥ
bhāvena taṃ bhajasveśaṃ
bhavabhaṅgakaraṃ harim

bhajasva bhāvena vibhuṃ
bhagavantaṃ maheśvaram
tato bhāgavato bhūtvā
bhavabandhād vimokṣyase

sarvabhūte manas tasmin
samādhāya mahāmate
prāpsyase paramāhlāda-
kāriṇīṃ paramāṃ gatim

tatra cittaṃ samāveṣṭuṃ
na śaknoti bhavān yadi
tadabhyāsaparas tasmin
kuru yogaṃ divāniśam

tatrāpy asāmarthyavataḥ
kriyāyogo mahātmanā
brahmaṇā yaḥ samākhyātas
tanmanāḥ satataṃ bhava

karoṣi yāni karmāṇi
tāni deve jagatpatau
samarpayasva bhadraṃ te
tataḥ karma prahāsyasi

kṣīṇakarmā mahābāho
śubhāśubhavivarjitaḥ
layam abhyeti govinde
tad brahma paramaṃ mahat

bhoktum icchasi daityendra
karmaṇām atha cet phalam
tatas tam arcayeśeśaṃ
tataḥ karmaphalodayaḥ

yo 'rtham icchati daityendra
sa samārādhya keśavam
niḥsaṃśayam avāpnoti
dhundhumāro yathā nṛpaḥ

atrigehasamudbhūtaṃ
dattātreyasvarūpiṇam
rājyam ārādhya govindaṃ
kārtavīryas tathāptavān

dharmaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādena
mudgalo jājaliḥ kuṇiḥ
prāpur anye tathā kāmān
narendrā nahuṣādayaḥ

janakaḥ sudhvajo nāma
janakaḥ samitidhvajaḥ
dharmadhvajas tathā muktiṃ
keśavārādhanād gataḥ

tathānye munayo daitya
rājānaś ca sahasraśaḥ
prāpur muktiṃ mahābhāgāḥ
kṛtvā bhaktiṃ janārdane

yathā hi jvalito vahnis
tamohāniṃ tadarthinām
śītahāniṃ tathānyeṣāṃ
svedaṃ svedābhilāṣiṇām

karoti kṣudhitānāṃ ca
bhojyapākaṃ tathotkaṭam
tathaiva kāmān bhūteśaḥ
sa dadāti yathepsitān

tad etad akhilaṃ jñātvā
yat taveṣṭaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat
kalpadrumād iva harer
yat te manasi vartate

etat prahrādavacanaṃ
niśāmya ditijeśvaraḥ
pratyuvāca mahābhāgaṃ
praṇipatya pitāmaham

saṃprāptasyāmṛtasyeva
tava vākyasya nāsti me
tṛptir etad ahaṃ tāta
śrotum icchāmi vistarāt

akṣīṇakarmā puruṣo
maraṇe samupasthite
kīdṛśaṃ lokam āyāti
yaḥ saṃsmarati keśavam

yathā ca vāsudevasya
smaraṇaṃ tāta mānavaiḥ
mumūrṣubhiḥ prakartavyaṃ
tan mamācakṣva vistarāt

kiṃ japyaṃ kīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ
smartavyaṃ ca hares tadā
kathaṃ dhyeyaṃ ca vidvadbhis
tad ācakṣva yathātatham

sādhu vatsa tvayā praśnaḥ
suguhyo 'yam udāhṛtaḥ
tapasāṃ tāta sarveṣāṃ
tapo nānaśanāt param

kathyate ca mahābāho
saṃvādo 'yaṃ purātanaḥ
bhagīrathasya rājarṣer
brahmaṇaś ca prajāpateḥ

atītyāmaralokaṃ ca
gavāṃ lokaṃ ca mānada
ṛṣilokaṃ ca yo 'gacchad
bhagīratha iti śrutaḥ

taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa vacaḥ prāha
brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
kathaṃ bhagīrathāgās tvam
imaṃ deśaṃ durāsadam

na hi devā na gandharvā
na manuṣyā bhagīratha
āyānty ataptatapasaḥ
kathaṃ vai tvam ihāgataḥ

niḥśaṅkam annam adadaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ
śataṃ sahasrāṇi sadaiva dāyam
brāhmaṇaṃ vrataṃ nityam āsthāya vidvan
na tv evāhaṃ tasya phalād ihāgām

daśaikarātrān daśa pañcarātrān
ekādaśaikādaśakāṃs tathaiva
jyotiṣṭomānāṃ ca śataṃ yad iṣṭaṃ
phalena tenāpi na cāgato 'ham

yac cāvasaṃ jāhnavītīranityaḥ
śataṃ samās tapyamānas tapo 'ham
pradāya tatrāśvatarīsahasraṃ
phalena tasyāpi na cāgato 'ham

daśa dhenusahasrāṇi
maṇiratnavibhūṣitāḥ
daśārbudāni cāśvānām
ayutāni ca viṃśatiḥ
puṣkareṣu dvijātibhyaḥ
prādāṃ gāś ca sahasraśaḥ

suvarṇacandrottamadhāriṇīnāṃ
kanyottamānām adadaṃ sragviṇīnām
ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāṇi vibhūṣitānāṃ
jāmbūnadair ābharaṇair na tena

daśārbudāny adadaṃ gosave yās tv
ekaikaśo daśa gā lokanātha
samānavatsāḥ payasā samanvitāḥ
suvarṇakāṃsyopaduhā na tena

ahany ahani vipreṣu
ekaikaṃ triṃśato 'dadam
gṛṣṭīnāṃ kṣīradātrīṇāṃ
rohiṇīnāṃ śatāni ca

dogdhrīṇāṃ vai gavāṃ caiva
prayutāni daśaiva tu
prādāṃ daśaguṇaṃ brahman
na ca tenāham āgataḥ

koṭīś ca kāñcanasyāṣṭau
prādāṃ brahman daśa tv aham
ekaikasmin kratau tena
phalenāhaṃ na cāgataḥ

vājināṃ śyāmakarṇānāṃ
haritānāṃ pitāmaha
prādāṃ hemasrajāṃ brahman
koṭīr daśa ca sapta ca

īṣādantān mahākāyān
kāñcanasragvibhūṣitān
patnīvataḥ sahasrāṇi
prāyacchaṃ daśa sapta ca

alaṃkṛtānāṃ deveśa
divyaiḥ kanakabhūṣaṇaiḥ
rathānāṃ kāñcanāṅgānāṃ
sahasrāṇy adadaṃ daśa
sapta cānyāni yuktānāṃ
vājibhiḥ samalaṃkṛtaiḥ

dakṣiṇāvayavāḥ kecid
devair ye saṃprakīrtitāḥ
vājapeyeṣu daśasu
prādāṃ tenāpi nāgataḥ

śakratulyaprabhāvānām
ījyayā vikrameṇa ca
sahasraṃ niṣkakaṇṭhānāṃ
pradadan dakṣiṇām aham

vijitya nṛpatīn sarvān
makhair iṣṭvā pitāmaha
aṣṭābhyo rājasūyebhyo
na ca tenāham āgataḥ

srotaś ca yāvad gaṅgāyāṃ
chinnam āsīj jagatpate
dakṣiṇābhiḥ pravṛttābhir
mama nāgaṃ ca tatkṛte

vājināṃ ca sahasre dve
suvarṇamaṇibhūṣite
vāraṇānāṃ śataṃ cāham
ekaikasya tridhādadam
varaṃ grāmaśataṃ cāham
ekaikasya tridhādadam

tapasvī niyatāhāraḥ
śamam āsthāya vāgyataḥ
dīrghakālaṃ himavati
gaṅgāyāś ca durutsahām

mūrdhnā dhārāṃ mahādevaḥ
śirasā yām adhārayat
na tenāpy aham āgacchaṃ
phaleneha pitāmaha

śamyākṣepair ayajaṃ devadeva
tathā kratūnām ayutaiś cāpi yattaḥ
trayodaśadvādaśāhaiś ca deva
sapuṇḍarīkair na ca teṣāṃ phalena

aṣṭau sahasrāṇi kakudminām ahaṃ
śuklarṣabhāṇām adaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ
patnīś caiṣām adadaṃ niṣkakaṇṭhīs
teṣāṃ phaleneha na cāgato 'smi

hiraṇyaratnaracitān
adadaṃ ratnaparvatān
dhanadhānyasahasrāṃś ca
grāmāñ śatasahasraśaḥ

śataṃ śatānāṃ gṛṣṭīnām
adadaṃ cāpy atandritaḥ
iṣṭvānekair mahāyajñair
brāhmaṇebhyo dhanena ca

ekādaśāhair ayajaṃ sudakṣiṇair
dvir dvādaśāhair aśvamedhaiś ca deva

arkāyaṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiś ca brahmaṃs
teṣāṃ phaleneha na cāgato 'smi

niṣkrāmakaṃ cāpy adadaṃ yojanānāṃ
dvir vistīrṇaṃ kāñcanapādapānām
vanaṃ cūtānāṃ ratnavibhūṣitānām
na caiva teṣām āgato 'haṃ phalena

turāyaṇaṃ tu vratam apradhṛṣyam
akrodhano 'karavaṃ triṃśato 'bdān
śataṃ gavām aṣṭa śatāni cāhaṃ
dine dine prādadaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ

payasvinīnāṃ atha rohiṇīnāṃ
tathaiva cāpy anaḍuhāṃ lokanātha
prādām nityaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sureśa
nehāgatas tena phalena cāham

triṃśataṃ vidhivad vahnīn
ayajaṃ yac ca nityaśaḥ
aṣṭābhiḥ sarvamedhaiś ca
nṛmedhair dviguṇais tathā

daśabhir viśvajidbhiś ca
stobhair aṣṭādaśottaraiḥ
na caiva teṣāṃ deveśa
phalenāham ihāgamam

saravyāṃ bāhudāyāṃ ca
gayāyām atha naimiṣe
gavāṃ śatānām ayutam
adadaṃ na ca tena vai

utkrāntikāle govindaṃ
smarann anaśanasthitaḥ
tyaktavān asmi yad dehaṃ
tenedṛk prāptavān phalam

evam etad itīty āha
brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
bhagīrathaṃ mahīpālaṃ
puṇyalokanivāsinam

tad etad uktaṃ tapasāṃ
samastānāṃ mahāmate
guṇair anaśanaṃ brahmā
pradhānataram abravīt

tyajaty anaśanastho hi
prāṇān yaḥ saṃsmaran harim
sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ
yāvad indrāś caturdaśa

atītānāgatānīha
kulāni puruṣarṣabha
punāty anaśanaṃ kurvan
sapta sapta ca sapta ca

ślokāś cātra mahābāho
śrūyante yān bhagīrathaḥ
jagāda brahmaṇo lokam
upetaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ

brahma brahmamayaṃ viṣṇor
yaḥ padaṃ paramātmanaḥ
saṃsmaraṃs tyajati prāṇān
sa viṣṇuṃ praviśaty ajam

yaḥ kṣīṇakarmā bhogena
tapasā vāpi saṃsmaran
karoti kālaṃ kālena
na paricchedyate hi saḥ

akṣīṇakarmā maraṇe
saṃsmaran devam acyutam
yathā tvam eva devānāṃ
loke bhogān upāśnute

kṣutite 'pi kule kaścij
jāyeyaṃ karmaṇaḥ kṣaye
manuṣyo yena sarveśaṃ
cintayeyaṃ sadā harim

taccintayādhunāśeṣa-
puṇyapāpavivarjitaḥ
maraṇe tanmanas tatra
layam etya tam āpnuyāt

karmabhūmau samastānāṃ
karmaṇām uttamottamam
yad antakāle puruṣaiḥ
smaryate puruṣottamaḥ

ity etān āha rājarṣiḥ
ślokān ādyo bhagīrathaḥ
viṣṇusaṃsmaraṇāt prāpya
lokān anaśane mṛtaḥ

evam atyantaśastānāṃ
karmaṇām asureśvara
nānyad utkṛṣṭam uddiṣṭaṃ
tajjñair anaśanāt param

tasyāhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye
yac ca japyaṃ mumūrṣubhiḥ
yādṛgrūpaś ca bhagavāṃś
cintanīyo janārdanaḥ

āsannam ātmanaḥ kālaṃ
jñātvā prājño mahāsura
nirdhūtamaladoṣaś ca
snāto niyatamānasaḥ

samabhyarcya hṛṣīkeśaṃ
puṣpadhūpādibhis tataḥ
praṇipātaiḥ stavaiḥ puṇyair
dhyānayogaiś ca pūjayet

dattvā dānaṃ ca viprebhyo
vikalādibhya eva ca
sabhāprapābrāhmaṇauka-
devaukādyupayogi ca

bandhuputrakalatrauka-
kṣetradhānyadhanādiṣu
mitravarge ca daityendra
mamatvaṃ vinivartayet

mitrān amitrān madhyasthān
parān svāṃś ca punaḥ punaḥ
abhyarthanopacāreṇa
kṣāmayet kukṛtaṃ svakam

tataś ca prayataḥ kuryād
utsargaṃ sarvakarmaṇām
śubhāśubhānāṃ daityendra
vākyaṃ cedam udāharet

parityajāmy ahaṃ bhogāṃs
tyajāmi suhṛdo 'khilān
bhojanādi mayotsṛṣṭam
utsṛṣṭam anulepanam

sragbhūṣaṇādikaṃ geyaṃ
dānam ādānam eva ca
homādayaḥ padārthā ye
yāś ca nityakriyā mama

naimittikās tathā kāmyā
varṇadharmās tathojjhitāḥ
guṇadharmādayo dharmā
yāś ca kāścin mama kriyāḥ

padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ viharan
kurvan vā karma na tv aham
kariṣye prāṇināṃ pīḍāṃ
prāṇinaḥ santu nirbhayāḥ

nabhasi prāṇino ye tu
ye jale ye ca bhūtale
kṣiter antaragā ye ca
ye ca pāṣāṇasaṃpuṭe

ye dhānyādiṣu vastreṣu
śayaneṣv āsaneṣu ca
te svapantu vibudhyantu
sukhaṃ matto bhayaṃ vinā

na me 'sti bāndhavaḥ kaścid
viṣṇuṃ muktvā jagadgurum
mitrapakṣe ca me viṣṇur
adhaś cordhvaṃ tathāgrataḥ

pārśvato mūrdhni pṛṣṭhe ca
hṛdaye vāci cakṣuṣi
śrotrādiṣu ca sarveṣu
mama viṣṇuḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ

iti sarvaṃ samutsṛjya
dhyātvā sarvatra cācyutam
vāsudevety avirataṃ
nāma devasya kīrtayan

dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu
śayīta prācchirās tataḥ
udacchirā vā daityendra
cintayañ jagataḥ patim

viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ
keśavaṃ madhusūdanam
nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ
vāsudevaṃ janārdanam

vārāhaṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ
puṇḍarīkākṣam acyutam
vāmanaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīśaṃ
nṛsiṃham aparājitam

padmanābham ajaṃ śaurim
dāmodaram adhokṣajam
sarveśvareśvaraṃ śuddham
anantaṃ rāmam īśvaram

cakriṇaṃ gadinaṃ śārṅgiṃ
śaṅkhinaṃ garuḍadhvajam
kirīṭakaustubhadharaṃ
praṇamāmy aham avyayam

aham atra jagannāthe
mayi cāstu janārdanaḥ
āvayor antaraṃ māstu
samīranabhasor iva

ayaṃ viṣṇur ayaṃ śaurir
ayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ puro mama
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaḥ
padmapattropamekṣaṇaḥ

eṣa paśyatu mām īśaḥ
paśyāmy aham adhokṣajam
yato na vyatirikto 'haṃ
yanmayo 'haṃ yadāśrayaḥ

itthaṃ japann ekamanāḥ
smaran sarveśvaraṃ harim
āsīnaḥ sukhaduḥkheṣu
samo mitrāhiteṣu ca

oṃ namo vāsudevāyety
etad vā satataṃ vadan
yad vodīrayituṃ nāma
samarthas tad udīrayan
dhyāyeta devadevasya
rūpaṃ viṣṇor manoramam

praśāntanetrabhrūvaktraṃ
śaṅkhacakragadādharam
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ caiva
caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam

pītāmbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ
cārukeyūradhāriṇam
cintayec ca tadā rūpaṃ
manaḥ kṛtvaikaniścayam

yādṛśe vā manaḥ sthairyaṃ
rūpe badhnāti cakriṇaḥ
tad eva cintayan nāma
vāsudeveti kīrtayet

ittaṃ japan smaran vetthaṃ
svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ
ā prāṇoparamād vīras
taccittas tatparāyaṇaḥ

nirvikalpena manasā
yaḥ smaret puruṣottamam
sarvapātakayukto 'pi
puruṣaḥ puruṣarṣabha
prayāti devadeveśe
layam īḍyatame 'cyute

yathāgnis tṛṇajālāni
dahaty anilasaṃgataḥ
tathānaśanasaṃkalpaḥ
puṃsāṃ pāpam asaṃśayam

viṣṇoḥ saṃsmaraṇe prāpya
lokam anaśane mṛtaḥ
evam atyantaśastānāṃ
karmaṇām asureśvara

nāsti satyāt paro dharmo
nāsty adharma tathānṛtāt
nāsti vidyāsamaṃ cakṣus
tapo nānaśanāt param

nāsti jñānasamaṃ dānaṃ
na saṃtoṣasamaṃ sukham
na caiverṣyāsamaṃ duḥkhaṃ
tapo nānaśanāt param

nāsty arogasamaṃ dhanyaṃ
nāsti gaṅgāsamā sarit
nāsti viṣṇusamaṃ dhyeyaṃ
tapo nānaśanāt param

utkrāntikāle bhūtānāṃ
muhyante cittavṛttayaḥ
jarāvyādhividhīnānāṃ
kimu vyādhyādidoṣataḥ

atyantavayasā vṛddhyā
vyādhinā cātipīḍitaḥ
yadi sthātuṃ na śaknoti
kṣitisthe darbhasaṃstare

tat kim anyo 'py upāyo 'sti
na vānaśanakarmaṇi
viphalyaṃ yena nāpnoti
tan me brūhi pitāmaha

nātra bhūmir na ca kuśāḥ
saṃstaraś ca na kāraṇam
cittasyālambanībhūto
viṣṇur evātra kāraṇam

bhuñjann abhuñjan gacchaṃś ca
svapaṃs tiṣṭhann athāpi vā
utkrāntikāle govindaṃ
saṃsmaraṃs tanmayo bhavet

kiṃ japaiḥ kiṃ bhuvā kṛtyaṃ
kiṃ kuśair daityasattama
tathāpi kurvato yasya
hṛdaye na janārdanaḥ

tasmāt pradhānamantroktaṃ
vāsudevasya kīrtanam
tanmayatvena daityendra
tasyopāyaś ca vistaraḥ

ity etat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ
pṛṣṭo 'haṃ yat tvayā bale
utkrāntikāle smaraṇaṃ
kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te

kriyāyogas tvayā pūrvaṃ
mamokto yaḥ pitāmaha
tam ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi
phalaṃ cāsya yathātatham

devārcāṃ devatāgāre
tanmayatvena pūjayam
yathāvac cetaso bhūmiṃ
karoti niyato hi saḥ

tapasā brahmacaryeṇa
puṇyasvādhyāyasaṃstavaiḥ
kriyāyogaḥ sa vidvadbhir
yogināṃ samudāhṛtaḥ

tatrāhaṃ śrotum icchāmi
kriyāyogasthito naraḥ
yat phalaṃ samavāpnoti
kārayitvā harer gṛham

devārcāṃ kārayitvā vā
yat puṇyaṃ puruṣo 'śnute
saṃpūjayitvā vidhivad
anulipya ca yat phalam

kāni mālyāni śastāni
kāni nārhanti keśave
ke dhūpāḥ kṛṣṇadayitāḥ
ke varjyāś ca jagatpateḥ

upahāre phalaṃ kīm syāt
kiṃ phalaṃ gītavādite
ghṛtakṣīrādinā yac ca
snāpite keśave phalam

yac copalepane tāta
phalam abhyukṣite ca yat
vāsudevagṛhe sarvaṃ
tad aśeṣaṃ vadasva me

sādhu vatsa yad etat tvaṃ
vāsudevasya pṛcchasi
śuśrūṣaṇavidhau puṇyaṃ
tad ihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu

brahmaṇā kila devānām
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām
śuśrūṣaṇaphalaṃ viṣṇoḥ
proktaṃ daityapate purā

tebhyaḥ sakāśān manunā
prāptaṃ svārociṣeṇa tu
svārociṣaḥ svaputrāya
dattavān ṛtacakṣuṣe

ṛtacakṣuś ca bhargave
śukras tasmād avāpa ca
mamākhyātaṃ ca śukreṇa
yathāvat sumahātmanā

śuśrūṣave mahābhāga
daityācāryeṇa dhīmatā
tad etac chrūyatāṃ tāta
kriyāyogāśritaṃ phalam

jñānayogas tu saṃyogaś
cittasyaivātmanā tu yaḥ
yas tu bāhyārthasāpekṣaḥ
sa kriyāyoga ucyate

paramaṃ kāraṇaṃ yogo
vimukter ditikeśvara
kriyāyogaś ca yogasya
paramaṃ tāta sādhanam

yat tv etad bhavatā pṛṣṭaṃ
phalam anvicchatā phalam
devālayādikaraṇe
tad ihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu

yas tu devālayaṃ viṣṇor
dārvaṃ śailamayaṃ tathā
kārayen mṛnmayaṃ vāpi
śṛṇu tasya bale phalaṃ

ahany ahani yajñena
yajato yan mahāphalam
prāpnoti tat phalaṃ viṣṇor
yaḥ kārayati mandiram

kulānāṃ śatam āgāmi
samatītaṃ tathā śatam
kārayan bhagavaddhāma
nayaty acyutalokatām

saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ
svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu
viṣṇor ālayavinyāsa-
prārambhād eva naśyati

saptalokamayo viṣṇus
tasya yaḥ kurute gṛham
pratiṣṭhāṃ samavāpnoti
sa naraḥ saptalaukikīm

praśastadeśabhūbhāge
yaḥ śastaṃ bhavanaṃ hareḥ
kārayaty akṣayāṃl lokān
sa naraḥ pratipadyate

iṣṭakācayavinyāso
yāvanty ṛkṣāṇi tiṣṭhati
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi
tatkartur divi saṃsthitiḥ

pratimāṃ lakṣaṇavatīṃ
yaḥ kārayati mānavaḥ
keśavasya sa tallokam
akṣayaṃ pratipadyate

ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ
sahasrāṇi sa modate
svargaukasāṃ nivāseṣu
pratyekam arisūdana

pratiṣṭhāpya harer arcāṃ
supraśaste niveśane
puruṣaḥ kṛtakṛtyatvān
nainaṃ śvomaraṇaṃ tapet

ye bhaviṣyanti ye 'tītā
ākalpāt puruṣāḥ kule
tāṃs tārayati saṃsthāpya
devasya pratimāṃ hareḥ

anuśastāḥ kila purā
yamena yamakiṃkarāḥ
pāśodyatāyudhā daitya
prajāsaṃyamane ratāḥ

viharadhvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ
niyogo me 'nupālyatām
nājñābhaṅgaṃ kariṣyanti
bhavatāṃ jantavaḥ kvacit

kevalaṃ ye jagaddhātum
anantaṃ samupāśritāḥ
bhavadbhiḥ parihartavyās
teṣāṃ nāsty atra saṃsthitiḥ

ye tu bhāgavatā loke
taccittās tatparāyaṇāḥ
pūjayanti sadā viṣṇuṃ
te vas tyājyāḥ sudūrataḥ

yas tiṣṭhan prasvapan gacchaṃs
tattiṣṭhan skhalite kṣute
saṃkīrtayati govindaṃ
te vas tyājyāḥ sudūrataḥ

nityanaimittikair devaṃ
ye yajanti janārdanam
nāvalokya bhavadbhis te
tattejo hanti vo gatim

ye dhūpapuṣpavāsobhir
bhūṣaṇaiś cāpi vallabhaiḥ
arcayanti na te grāhyā
narāḥ kṛṣṇāśrayoddhatāḥ

upalepanakartāraḥ
saṃmārjanaparāś ca ye
kṛṣṇālaye parityājyaṃ
teṣāṃ tripuruṣaṃ kulam

yena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ
kāritaṃ tatkulodbhavam
puṃsāṃ śataṃ nāvalokyaṃ
bhavadbhir duṣṭacakṣuṣā

yenārcā bhagavadbhaktyā
vāsudevasya kāritā
narāyutaṃ tatkulajaṃ
bhavatāṃ śāsanātigam

bhavatāṃ bhramatām atra
viṣṇusaṃśrayamudrayā
vinājñābhaṅgakṛn naiva
bhaviṣyati naraḥ kvacit

vatsa vaivasvatasyaitāḥ
śrutvā gāthā marīcinā
purukutsāya kathitāḥ
pārthivendrāya dhīmate

etāṃ mahāphalāṃ yo 'rcāṃ
viṣṇoh kārayate naraḥ
tavākhyātaṃ mahābāho
gṛhakārayituś ca yat

yajñā narāṇāṃ pāpaugha-
kṣālakāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ
tathaivejyo jagaddhātuḥ
sarvayajñamayo hariḥ

sthāpitāṃ pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ
samyak saṃpūjya mānavaḥ
yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ
taṃ tam āpnoty asaṃśayam

yaḥ snāpayati devasya
ghṛtena pratimāṃ hareḥ
prasthe prasthe dvijāgryāṇāṃ
sa dadāti gavāṃ śatam

gavāṃ śatasya viprāṇāṃ
yad dattasya bhavet phalam
ghṛtaprasthena tad viṣṇor
labhet snānopayoginā

bhūridyumnena saṃprāptā
saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā
ghṛtāḍhakena govinda-
pratimāsnāpanāt kila

pratimāsaṃ sitāṣṭamyāṃ
ghṛtena jagataḥ patim
snāpayitvā samastebhyaḥ
pāpebhyo vipramucyate

dvādaśyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ ca
gavyena haviṣā hareḥ
snāpanaṃ daityaśārdūla
mahāpātakanāśanam

jñānato 'jñānato vāpi
yat pāpaṃ kurute naraḥ
tat kṣālayati saṃdhyāyāṃ
ghṛtena snāpayan harim

sarvayajñamayo viṣṇur
havyānāṃ paramaṃ ghṛtam
tayor aśeṣapāpānāṃ
kṣālakaḥ saṃgamo 'sura

yeṣu kṣīravahā nadyo
hradāḥ pāyasakardamāḥ
tāṃl lokān puruṣā yānti
kṣīrasnānakarā hareḥ

āhlādaṃ nirvṛtiṃ svāsthyam
ārogyaṃ cārurūpatām
sapta janmāny avāpnoti
kṣīrasnānakaro hareḥ

dadhyādīnāṃ vikārāṇāṃ
kṣīrataḥ saṃbhavo yathā
tathaivāśeṣakāmānāṃ
kṣīrasnāpanato hareḥ

yathā ca vimalaṃ jñānaṃ
yathā nirvṛtikārakam
tathāsya nirmalaṃ jñānaṃ
bhavaty atiphalapradam

grahānukūlatāṃ puṣṭiṃ
priyatvaṃ cākhile jane
karoti bhagavān viṣṇuḥ
kṣīrasnāpanatoṣitaḥ

sarvo 'sya snigdhatām eti
dṛṣṭamātraḥ prasīdati
ghṛtakṣīreṇa deveśe
snāpite madhusūdane

atrāpy udāharantīmaṃ
saṃvādaṃ keśavāśritam
śāṇḍilyā saha kaikeyyāḥ
sumanāyāḥ surālaye

svarge 'tiśobhanāṃ dṛṣṭvā
kaikeyīṃ patinā saha
brāhmaṇī śāṇḍilī nāma
paryapṛcchata vismitā

śataśaḥ santi kaikeyi
devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ
devapatnyas tathaivaitāḥ
siddhāḥ siddhāṅganās tathā

na teṣām īdṛśo gandho
na kāntir na surūpatā
na vāsasāṃ ca śobheyaṃ
yathā te patinā saha

naivābharaṇajātāni
teṣāṃ bhrājanti vai tathā
yathā tava yathā patyus
tava svarganivāsinaḥ

svasthatā cetasaś ceyaṃ
yuvayor atiricyate
śakrādyānām apīsānāṃ
kṣayātiśayavarjitaḥ

tapaḥprabhāvo dānaṃ vā
karma vā homasaṃjñitam
yuvayor yan mamācakṣva
tat sarvaṃ varavarṇini

yajñair yajñeśvaro viṣṇur
āvābhyāṃ yat tu toṣitaḥ
svargaprāptir iyaṃ tasya
karmaṇaḥ phalam uttamam

surūpatāṃ manaḥprīti
paśyatāṃ cāruveṣatām
yat pṛcchasi mahābhāge
tad apy eṣā vadāmi te

tīrthodakais tathā snānaiḥ
snāpito 'yaṃ janārdanaḥ
tena kāntir atītyaitān
devāṃs tribhuvaneśvarān

manaḥprasādaḥ saumyatvaṃ
śārīrā yā ca nirvṛtiḥ
yat priyatvaṃ ca sarvasya
tad ghṛtasnānajaṃ phalam

yāny abhīṣṭāni vāsāṃsi
yac cābhīṣṭaṃ vibhūṣaṇam
ratnāni yāny abhīṣṭāni
yat priyaṃ cānulepanam

ye dhūpā yāni mālyāni
dayitāny abhavaṃs tadā
mama bhartus tathaivāsya
mama rājyaṃ praśāsataḥ

tāni sarvāṇi sarvajñe
sarvakartari keśave
dattāni tatsamuttho 'yaṃ
gandhabhūṣātmako guṇaḥ

āhārā dayitā ye ca
pavitrāś ca niveditāḥ
te lokakartre kṣṛṇāya
tṛptis tadguṇasaṃbhavā

svargakāmena me bhartrā
mayā ca śubhadarśane
kṛtam etad ato nābhūd
āvayor bhavasaṃkṣayaḥ

ye tv akāmāṃ narāḥ samyag
etat kurvanti śobhane
teṣāṃ dadāti viśveśo
bhagavān muktim acyutaḥ

evam abhyarcya govindaṃ
sarvabhūteśvareśvaram
prāpnoty abhimatān kāmān
daityāha sumanā yathā

candanāgarukarpūra-
kuṅkumośīrapadmakaiḥ
anulipto harir bhaktyā
varān bhogān prayacchati

kāleyakaṃ tuṅgakaṃ ca
padmacandanam eva ca
nṝṇāṃ bhavanti rogāya
dattāni puruṣottame

tasmād ebhir na govindaḥ
pūjanīyo mahāsura
yāny ātmanaḥ sadeṣṭāni
tāni śastāny upākuru

tathaiva śubhagandhā ye
dhūpās te jagataḥ pateḥ
vāsudevasya dharmajñair
nivedyā dānaveśvara

na śallakījaṃ nākṣaulaṃ
na śuktāsavasaṃbhṛtam
dadyāt kṛṣṇāya dharmajño
dhūpān ārādhanodyataḥ

mālatī mallikā caiva
yūthikāthātimuktakā
pāṭalā karavīraś ca
javā pārantir eva ca

kubjakas tagaraś caiva
karṇikāraḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ
campako rotakaḥ kundo
bāṇo varvaramālikāḥ

aśokatilakā rodhrās
tathā caivāṭarūṣakaḥ
amī puṣpaprakārās tu
śastāḥ keśavapūjane

bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ
patraṃ bhṛṅgārakasya ca
tamālapatraṃ ca bale
sadaiva bhagavatpriyam

tulasīkālatulasī-
patraṃ bhṛṅgarajasya ca
ketakīpatrapuṣpaṃ ca
sadyas tuṣṭikaraṃ hareḥ

padmāny ambusamutthānāṃ
raktanīle tathotpale
sitotpalaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya
dayitāni sadāsura

nārkaṃ nonmattakaṃ kāṃcit
tathaiva girikarṇikām
na kaṇṭakārikāpuṣpam
acyutāya nivedayet

kauṭajaṃ śālmalīpuṣpaṃ
śairīṣaṃ ca janārdane
nivedite bhayaṃ rogaṃ
niḥsvatāṃ ca prayacchati

yeṣāṃ na pratiṣedho 'sti
gandhavarṇānvitāni ca
tāni puṣpāṇi deyāni
viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave

sugandhaiś ca surāmāṃsī-
karpūrāgarucandanaiḥ
tathānyaiś ca śubhair dravyair
arcayej jagataḥ patim

dukūlapaṭukauśeya-
vārkṣakarpāsikādibhiḥ
vāsobhiḥ pūjayed viṣṇuṃ
daiteyendrātmanaḥ priyaiḥ

bhakṣyāṇi yāny abhīṣṭāni
bhojyāny abhimatāni ca
phalaṃ ca vallabhaṃ yat syāt
tat tad deyaṃ janārdane

suvarṇamaṇimuktādi
yac cānyad ativallabham
tat tad devātidevāya
keśavāya nivedayet

ātmānaṃ keśavaṃ matvā
yad yat tasyaiva rocate
tat tad avyaktarūpāya
keśavāya nivedayet

cakravartī mahāvīryo
māndhātā yuvanāśvajaḥ
śaśāsa sa mahābāhuḥ
saptadvīpāṃ vasuṃdharām

agāyanta ca yā gāthā
ye purāṇavido janāḥ
māndhātari mahābāho
yauvanāśve samāśritāḥ

yāvat sūrya udeti sma
yāvac ca pratitiṣṭhati
sarvaṃ tad yauvanāśvasya
māndhātuḥ kṣetram ucyate

sa yauvanagataḥ saṃrāṭ
saptadvīpavatīṃ mahīm
śaśāsa dharmeṇa purā
cakravartī mahābalaḥ

nānyāyakṛn na cāśakto
na daridro na kīkaṭaḥ
tasyābhūt puruṣo rājye
samyagdharmānuśāsinaḥ

catasro gatayas tasya
yauvanāśvasya dhīmataḥ
babhūvur apratihatā
hatārātibalasya vai

tasya bhaktir atīvābhūn
nisargād eva bhūpateḥ
vāsudeve jagaddhāmni
sarvakāraṇakāraṇe

tasya rddhiṃ mahimānaṃ ca
vilokya pṛthivīpateḥ
na kevalaṃ janasyābhūt
tasyāpy atyantavismayaḥ

sa cintayām āsa nṛpaḥ
samṛddhyā vismitas tayā
kathaṃ syāt sampad eṣā me
punar apy anyajanmani

evaṃ subahuśo rājā
daityendra sumahābalaḥ
cintayann api tanmūlaṃ
na cāsīn niścayānvitaḥ

yadā na niścayaṃ rājā
sa yayau yuvanāśvajaḥ
tadā papraccha dharmajñān
sa viprān samupāgatān

vasiṣṭhapramukhān vatsa
viviktāntaḥpurasthitaḥ
praṇipatya mahābāhur
gṛhītāsanasatkriyān

yadi sānugrahā buddhir
bhavatāṃ mayi sattamāḥ
tad ahaṃ praṣṭum icchāmi
kiṃcit tad vaktum arhatha

sametyākhilavijñānaṃ
samyagdhautāntarātmabhiḥ
bhavadbhir yady ahaṃ na syāṃ
vimalas tan mahādbhutam

yad yathā tan mayā pṛṣṭā
bhavanto matprasādhitāḥ
vaktum arhanti vidvāṃsaḥ
sarvasyaivopakāriṇaḥ

yas te manasi saṃdehas
taṃ pṛcchādya mahīpate
gadiṣyāmo yathānyāyaṃ
yat te sāṃśayikaṃ hṛdi

vayaṃ hi naraśārdūla
bhavatā paritoṣitāḥ
samyak prajāḥ pālayatā
saptadvīpe mahītale

sutuṣṭo brāhmaṇo 'śnīyāc
chindyād vā dharmasaṃśayam
hitaṃ vopadiśed dharmam
ahitād vā nivartayet

vivakṣum atha bhūpālaṃ
bhāryā tasyaiva dhīmataḥ
praṇāmapūrvam āhedaṃ
vinayāt praṇayānvitam

na strīṇām avanīpāla
vaktum īdṛg iheśyate
tathāpi bhūpate vakṣye
saṃpad īdṛk sudurlabhā

bhūyo 'pi saṃśayaṃ praṣṭum
alam īśa bhavān ṛṣīn
na tv ahaṃ puruṣavyāghra
sadāntaḥpuracāriṇī

sa prasādaṃ yadi bhavān
karoti mama pārthiva
tan madīyam ṛṣīn praṣṭuṃ
saṃśayaṃ pārthivārhasi

brūhi subhru mataṃ yat te
praṣṭavyā yan mayā dvijāḥ
bhūyo 'ham ātmasaṃdehaṃ
prakṣyāmy etān dvijottamān

śrūyante pṛthivīpāla
nṛpa ye ca purātanāḥ
teṣāṃ na saṃpad bhūpāla
yathā tava kilābhavat

tad īdṛksaṃpadāṃ dhāma
tvam aśeṣakṣitīśvaraḥ
yena karmavipākena
tad vadantu maharṣayaḥ

ahaṃ ca bhavato bhāryā
sarvasīmantinī bhuvi
vidhinā kena tapasā
niyuktā bhavato gṛhe
atīva karmaṇā yena
tadvijñāne kutūhalam

tāratamyatayeśitvam
anyeṣv api hi vidyate
nirastātiśayatvena
nūnaṃ nālpena karmaṇā

tad anyajanmacaritaṃ
naranātha nijaṃ bhavān
munīn pṛcchatu yā cāhaṃ
yan mayā ca purā kṛtam

sa tathoktas tayā rājā
patnyā vismitamānasaḥ
munīnāṃ purato bhāryāṃ
praśaṃsan vākyam abravīt

sādhu devi mataṃ yan me
tvayā tad idam īritam
satyaṃ munivacaḥ puṃsām
ardhaṃ vai gṛhiṇī yathā

mamāpy etad abhipretam
imān praṣṭuṃ mahāmunīn
yat tvayābhihitaṃ bhadre
matsvabhāvānuyātayā

so 'ham etan mahābhāge
prakṣyāmy etān mahāmunīn
naiṣām aviditaṃ kiṃcit
triṣu lokeṣu vidyate

evam uktvā priyāṃ bhāryāṃ
praṇipatya ca tān ṛṣīn
yathāvad etad akhilaṃ
papracchāsurasattama

bhagavanto mamāśeṣaṃ
prasādāhṛtacetasaḥ
kathayantu yathāvṛttaṃ
yan mayā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam

ko 'ham āsaṃ purā viprāḥ
kiṃ ca karma mayā kṛtam
kiṃ vānayā sucārvaṅgyā
mama patnyā kṛtaṃ dvijāḥ

yenāvayor iyaṃ sphītir
martyaloke sudurlabhā
catvāraś cāpratihatā
gatayo mama gacchataḥ

aśeṣā bhūbhṛto vaśyāḥ
kośasyānto na vidyate
balaṃ caivāpratihataṃ
śarīrārogyam uttamam

atibhāti ca me kāntyā
bhāryeyam akhilaṃ jagat
mamāpi vapuṣas tejo
na kaścit sahate dvijāḥ

so 'ham icchāmi vijñātuṃ
tathaiveyam aninditā
nijānuṣṭhānam akhilaṃ
yasyāśeṣam idaṃ phalam

iti praṣṭā narendreṇa
samastās te tapodhanāḥ
vasiṣṭhaṃ codayām āsuḥ
kathyatām iti bhūbhṛtaḥ

coditaḥ so 'pi dharmajñair
maitrāvaruṇir ātmavān
yogam āsthāya suciraṃ
yathāvad yatamānasaḥ
jñātavān nṛpates tasya
pūrvadehaviceṣṭitam

sa tam āha munir bhūpaṃ
viditārtho mahāsura
māndhātāraṃ mahābuddhiṃ
sapatnīkam idaṃ vacaḥ

śṛṇu bhūpāla sakalaṃ
yasyedaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam
tava rājyādikaṃ subhrūr
yeyaṃ cāsīn mahīpate

tvam āsīḥ śūdrajātīyaḥ
parahiṃsāparāyaṇaḥ
vākkrūro daṇḍapāruṣyo
niḥsnehaḥ sarvajantuṣu

tatheyaṃ bhavato bhāryā
pūrvam apy āyatekṣaṇā
dveṣyā babhūva taccittā
tava śuśrūṣaṇe ratā

pativratā mahābhāgā
bhartsyamānāpy aniṣṭhurā
tvadvākyād anu sarveṣu
vīrakarmasu codyatā

naiṣṭhuryād asahāyasya
tyajyamānasya bandhubhiḥ
kṣayaṃ jagāma yo 'rtho 'bhūt
saṃcitaḥ prapitāmahaiḥ

tasmin kṣīṇe kṛṣiparas
tvam āsīḥ pṛthivīpate
sāpi karmavipākena
kṛṣir viphalatāṃ gatā

tato niḥsvaṃ parikṣīṇaṃ
pareṣāṃ bhṛtyatāṃ gatam
tatyāja sādhvī veyaṃ tvāṃ
tyajyamānāpi pārthiva

anayā ca samaṃ sādhvyā
viṣṇor āvasathe tvayā
kṛtaṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ vīra
parivrāḍbrahmacāriṇām

bhagnehaḥ sarvakāmebhyas
tanmayas tvaṃ tadarpaṇaḥ
ananyagatir ekasthas
tasminn āyatane hareḥ

tadvṛttilipsuḥ śuśrūṣāṃ
janarañjanahetukaḥ
kṛtavān yogināṃ vīra
kṛṣṇasya jagataḥ pateḥ

vāsudevājire nityaṃ
kṛtaṃ saṃmārjanaṃ tvayā
tathaivābhyukṣaṇaṃ vīra
nityaṃ caivānulepanam
patnyānayā ca dharmajña
yaṣmaccittānuvṛttayā

ahany ahani tat karma
yuvayor nṛpa kurvatoḥ
tatra caitanmayatvena
pāpahānir ajāyata

viṣṇoḥ kāryaṃ mayā kāryaṃ
yogiśuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā
na prabhātaṃ prabhātaṃ tu
cinteyam abhavan niśi

evam āyatanaṃ ramyam
ity evaṃ ca sukhāvaham
sthairyaṃ na caivam etat syād
ity āsīt te manaḥ sadā

yogināṃ sukhadaṃ tv evaṃ
karmaivaṃ naivam ity api
tava cittam abhūt tatra
yogikarmaṇy aharniśam

evaṃ tanmanasas tatra
kṛtodyogasya pārthiva
bhṛtyāvasāyinaḥ samyag
yathoktādhikakāriṇaḥ

smarataḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ
kāryeṇātidṛḍhātmanaḥ
niḥśeṣam upaśāntaṃ tat
pāpaṃ yoginiṣevaṇāt

tato 'dhikaṃ puras tasmād
ādarād anulepanam
saṃmārjanaṃ ca bahuśaḥ
sapatnikena te kṛtam

tatrāgataś ca sauvīraḥ
purujin nāma bhūpatiḥ
mahāsainyaparīvāraḥ
prabhūtagajavāhanaḥ

sarvasaṃpadupetaṃ taṃ
sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam
vṛtaṃ bhāryāsahasreṇa
dṛṣṭvā srakcandanojjvalam
spṛhā kṛtā tvayā tatra
cārumaulini pārthive

sarvakāmapradaṃ karma
devadevasya kurvatā
tenaitad akhilaṃ rājyam
aśeṣadvīpavat tava

tejaś caivādhikaṃ yat te
tathaitac chṛṇu pārthiva
yogaprabhāvopalabdhaṃ
kathayāmy akhilaṃ tava

tatraivāvasathe dīpaḥ
praśāntaḥ snehasaṃkṣayāt
nijabhojanatailena
punaḥ prajvālitas tvayā

anayā cottarīyānta-
cīravartyupavṛṃhitaḥ
tava patnyā sa jajvāla
kāntir asyās tato 'dhikā

tavāpy akhilabhūpāla-
manaḥkṣobhakaraṃ tataḥ
tejo narendra na syāc ca
kim ārādhya janārdanam

evaṃ narendra śūdratvād
viṣṇukarmaparāyaṇaḥ
tanmayatvena saṃprāpto
mahimānam anuttamam

kiṃ punar yo naro bhaktyā
viṣṇuśuśrūṣaṇādṛtaḥ
karoti satataṃ pūjāṃ
niṣkāmo nānyamānasaḥ

sa tvam ṛddhim imāṃ labdhvā
sarvalokeśvareśvaram
pūjayācyutam īśeśaṃ
tam ārādhya na sīdati

puṣpair dhūpais tathā gandhair
dīpavastrānulepanaiḥ
ārādhayācyutaṃ tadvad
veśmasaṃmārjanādibhiḥ

yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcid
yad yad atyantadurlabham
tat tad dāttvā jagaddhātre
vaikuṇṭhāya na sīdati

sugandhāgarukarpūra-
candanākṣodakuṃkumaiḥ
vāsobhir vividhair dhūpaiḥ
puṣpasragcāmarair dhvajaiḥ

annopahārair vividhair
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣecanaiḥ
gītavāditanṛtyādyais
toṣayasvācyutaṃ nṛpa

puṇyarātriṣu govindaṃ
nṛtyagītaravojjvalaiḥ
bhūpa jāgaraṇair bhaktyā
toṣayācyutam avyayam

evaṃ saṃtoṣyate bhaktyā
bhagavān bhavabhaṅgakṛt
bhūpa bhāgavatair bhūta-
bhavyakṛt keśavo naraiḥ

yeṣāṃ na vittaṃ tair bhaktyā
mārjanādyupalepanaiḥ
toṣito bhagavān viṣṇur
dadāty abhimataṃ phalam

devakarmāsamarthāṇāṃ
prāṇināṃ smṛtisaṃstavaiḥ
toṣito 'bhimatān kāmān
prayacchati janārdanaḥ

naiṣa vittair na ratnaughaiḥ
puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ
sadbhāvenaiva govindas
toṣam āyāti saṃsmṛtaḥ

tvayaikāgramanaskena
gṛhasaṃmārjanādikam
kṛtvālpam īdṛśaṃ prāptaṃ
rājyam atyantadurlabham

prāptopakaraṇo yas tvam
ekāgramatir acyutam
toṣayiṣyasi nendro 'pi
bhavitā tena te samaḥ

tasmāt tvam anayā devyā
sahātyantavinītayā
keśavārādhane yatnaṃ
kuru dharmabhṛtāṃ vara

tataḥ prāpsyasi bhaktyaiva
yat tapobhiḥ sudurlabham

etan muner vasiṣṭhasya
niśāmya vacanaṃ nṛpaḥ
bhāryāsahāyaḥ sa tadā
saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ

kṛtakāryam ivātmānaṃ
manyamāno 'surottama
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā
māndhātā vāruṇiṃ vacaḥ

yathāmaratvaṃ saṃprāpya
yathā vā brahma śāśvatam
paraṃ nirvāṇam āpnoti
tathāhaṃ vacasā tava

kṛtakṛtyaḥ sukhī cāsmi
nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ
ajñānatamasāchanne
yat pradīpas tvayaidhitaḥ

aham eṣā ca tanvaṅgī
vibhūtibhraṃsabhīrukau
āḍhyāv āpāditau brahmann
ihādya vacasā tava

saṃpadāṃ kathitaṃ bījam
āvayor bhavatā mune
taduptāv udyatāv āvāṃ
vijānīhi dvijottama

na ratnair na ca vittaughair
na ca puṣpānulepanaiḥ
ārādhyate jagannātho
bhāvaśūnyair janārdanaḥ

bāhyārthanirapekṣaiś ca
manasaiva manogatiḥ
niḥsvair ārādhyate devo
viṣṇuḥ sarveśvareśvaraḥ

sarvam etan mayā jñātaṃ
yat tvam āttha mahāmune
yat tvāṃ pṛcchāmi tan me tvaṃ
prasādasumukho vada

kāni vratāni yair devo
naraiḥ strībhiś ca keśavaḥ
toṣam ārādhito 'bhyeti
kaiś ca dānair mahāmune

rahasyāni ca devasya
prītaye yāni cakriṇaḥ
tāny aśeṣāṇi me brūhi
kṛṣṇārādhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ

śṛṇu bhūpāla yair viṣṇur
narair ārādhyate vrataiḥ
nārībhiś cātighore 'smin
patitābhir bhavārṇave

samabhyarcya jagannāthaṃ
vāsudevaṃ samādhinā
ekam aśnāti yo bhaktaṃ
dvitīyaṃ brāhmaṇātmakam
karoti keśavaprītyai
kārttikaṃ māsam ātmavān

pūrve vayasi yat tena
jñānato 'jñānato 'pi vā
pāpam ācaritaṃ tasmān
mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

anenaiva vidhānena
mārgaśīrṣe 'pi mādhavam
samabhyarcyaikabhaktaṃ vai
varṇibhyo yaḥ prayacchati
bhagavatprīṇanārthāya
phalaṃ tasya śṛṇuṣva me

madhye vayasi yat pāpaṃ
yoṣitā puruṣeṇa vā
kṛtaṃ tasmāc ca tenokto
vimokṣaḥ paramātmanā

tathā caivaikabhaktaṃ vai
varṇāgrebhyaḥ prayacchati
puṇḍarīkākṣam abhyarcya
pauṣamāse mahīpate

tatprīṇanāya yat pāpaṃ
vārddhike tena vai kṛtam
sa tasmān mucyate rājan
pumān yoṣid athāpi vā

traimāsikavratam idaṃ
yaḥ karoti nareśvara
sa viṣṇuprīṇanāt pāpair
laghubhir vipramucyate

dvitīye vatsare rājan
mucyate copapātakaiḥ
tadvat tṛtīye 'pi kṛtaṃ
mahāpātakanāśanam

vratam etan naraiḥ strībhis
tribhir māsair anuṣṭhitam
tribhiḥ saṃvatsarair eva
pradadāti phalaṃ nṛṇām

tribhir māsais trir avasthās
trividhāt pātakān nṛpa
trīṇi nāmāni devasya
mocayanti trivārṣikaiḥ

yatas tato vratam idaṃ
trikramaṃ samudāhṛtam
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ
keśavārādhanaṃ param

śṛṇuṣva ca mahīpāla
vrataṃ viṣṇupadatrayam
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ
yaj jagāda purā hariḥ

prācetasāya dakṣāya
dakṣaś cāha vivasvate
vivasvān alasidhrāya
alasidhro 'sitāya ca

asitena samākhyātam
alpāyāsaṃ mahāphalam
tad idaṃ śrūyatāṃ samyag
vrataṃ viṣṇupadatrayam

dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ pūrvaṃ
viṣṇum ārādhya pṛṣṭavān
bahuśas tu vipannāyāṃ
sṛṣṭāv arinisūdana

bhagavan sarvakaṛtvaṃ
mamādiṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā
brahmaṇā devadeveśa
tavādeśena keśava

vipannā ca jagannātha
mama sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā kṛtā
pūrvakarmavipākena
vyākulaś cāsmi cetasā

yathā ca deva mucyeya
asmāt saṃsārasaṃkaṭāt
viṣayāsaṅgaviṣamāt
tan mamājñāpayācyuta

ity evam ukto dakṣeṇa
devadevo janārdanaḥ
ācaṣṭa duḥkhakṣayadaṃ
vrataṃ viṣṇupadatrayam

sarvārambhaviniṣpatti-
kārakaṃ pāpanāśanam
saṃsārocchedakaṃ dhīrair
ācīrṇaṃ sthirabuddhibhiḥ

tad ahaṃ tava rājendra
vratānām uttamottamam
kathayāmi samācaṣṭa
yathā pūrvaṃ mamāsitaḥ

āṣāḍhe māsi pūrvāsu
tathāṣāḍhāsu pārthiva
samabhyarcya jagannātham
acyutaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ

puṣpair hṛdyais tathā dhūpair
gandhaiḥ sāgarucandanaiḥ
yathāvibhavataś cānyair
annair vāsobhir eva ca

kṣīrasnehasthitaṃ tadvat
paiṣṭaṃ viṣṇupadadvayam
samabhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ
keśavasyāgrato nyaset

yavāṃś ca dadyād viprāya
bhūgatiḥ prīyatām iti
naktaṃ bhuñjīta rājendra
haviṣyānnaṃ susaṃskṛtam

tathottarāsv āṣāḍhāsu
śrāvaṇe māsi mānavaḥ
tathaivābhyarcya govindaṃ
tadvad viṣṇupadadvayam

viprāya ca yavān dadyāt
prīṇayitvā ca bhūgatim
naktaṃ bhūñjīta rājendra
naro yoṣid athāpi vā

prāpte bhādrapade māsi
pūrvabhadrapadāsu ca
tathaivābhyarcya govindaṃ
tadvad viṣṇupadadvayam

viprāya ca yavān dattvā
prīṇayitvā bhuvogatim
bhuñjīta gorasaprāyaṃ
naro yoṣid athāpi vā

tadvad āśvayuje dānaṃ
tadvad govindapūjanam
padadvayasya pūjāṃ ca
prīṇanaṃ ca bhuvogateḥ

tathaiva naktaṃ bhuñjīta
gorasaṃ maunam āsthitaḥ
strī vā rājendra pūrvāsu
tathā bhadrapadāsu vai

phālgune phalgunī pūrvā
bhavatī ha yadā nṛpa
trivikramaṃ tadā devaṃ
pūrvoktavidhinārcayet

padadvayaṃ ca devasya
samyag abhyarcya pārthiva
hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā
svargatiḥ prīyatām iti

naktaṃ bhuñjīta rājendra
vahnipākavivarjitam
eṣa evottarāyoge
caitre māse vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ

etaj jagāda govindaḥ
purā dakṣāya pṛcchate
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ
vrataṃ viṣṇupadatrayam

yathoktam etad yo bhakto
karoti nṛpasattama
sarvakāmān avāpnoti
keśavasya vaco yathā

aputro labhate putram
apatir labhate patim
samāgamaṃ proṣitaiś ca
tathā prāpnoti bāndhavaiḥ

dravyam aiśvaryam ārogyaṃ
saubhāgyaṃ cārurūpatām
prāpnuvanty akhilān etān
pūjayitvā padatrayam

yān yān kāmān naraḥ strī vā
hṛdayenābhivāñchanti
tāṃs tāṃś cāpnoti niṣkāmo
viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati

pūrvaṃ kṛtvāpi pāpāni
naraḥ strī vā narādhipa
padatrayavrataṃ cīrtvā
mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ

viṣṇor ārādhanārthāya
yāni dānāni sattama
deyāni tāny aśeṣāṇi
mamācakṣva dvijottama

yena caiva vidhānena
dānaṃ puṃsaḥ sukhāvaham
prīṇanāya ca kṛṣṇasya
tan mamākhyāhi vistarāt

kṛtopavāsaḥ saṃprāśya
pañcagavyaṃ nareśvara
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekaṃ ca
kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ samāhitaḥ

samabhyarcya ca govindaṃ
puṣpādibhir ariṃdama
udaṅmukhīm arcayitvā
tathā gṛṣṭiṃ payasvinīm

saputrāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ
sitayajñopavītinīm
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ śubhākārāṃ
hiraṇyoparisaṃsthitām

hiraṇyaṃ vācayitvāgre
brāhmaṇāyopapādayet
imāṃ tvaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva
govindaḥ prīyatām iti

samyag uccārya taṃ vipraṃ
govindaṃ nṛpa kalpayet
anuvrajec ca gacchantaṃ
padāny aṣṭau narādhipa

anena vidhinā dhenuṃ
yo viprāya prayacchati
govindaprīṇanād rājan
viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati

saptāvarāṃs tathā pūrvān
saptātmānaṃ ca mānavaḥ
saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān
mocayaty avanīpate

pade pade ca yajñasya
gosavasya sa mānavaḥ
phalam āpnoti rājendra
dakṣāyaivaṃ jagau hariḥ

sarvakāmasamṛddhasya
sarvakāleṣu pārthiva
bhavaty aghaughāpaharā
yāvad indrāś caturdaśa

sarveṣām eva pāpānāṃ
kṛtānām avijānatā
prāyaścittam idaṃ śastam
anutāpopavṛṃhitam

ikṣvākunaiṣā rājendra
pūrvaṃ dattā mahātmanā
tataḥ sa lokān amalān
prāptavān avanīpatiḥ

tathaivānyair mahīpālair
dvijavaiśyādibhis tathā
lokāḥ kāmadughāḥ prāptā
dattvedṛgvidhinā nṛpa

tiladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi
keśavaprīṇanāya yā
dattā bhavati yaś cāsyā
narendra vidhir uttamaḥ

phalam āpnoti rājendra
tadvad vā vidhivat tadā

yāṃ dattvā brahmahā goghnaḥ
pitṛghno gurutalpagaḥ
āgāradāhī garadaḥ
sarvapāparato 'pi vā

mahāpātakayukto yo
yukto yaś copapātakaiḥ
sa mucyate 'khilaiḥ pāpair
viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati

svanulipte mahīpṛṣṭe
vastrājinasamāvṛte
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ kṛtvā
sarvaratnaiḥ samanvitām

suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ
gandhaghrāṇavatīṃ śubhām
mṛṣṭānnajihvāṃ kurvīta
guḍāsyāṃ sūtrakambalām

ikṣupādāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ
kuryān muktāphalekṣaṇām
praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ
phaladantavatīṃ śubhām

sragdāmapucchāṃ kurvīta
navanītastanānvitām
phalair manoharair bhakṣair
maṇimuktāphalānvitām
tiladroṇena kurvīta
āḍhakena tu vatsakam

śubhavastrayugacchannāṃ
cārucchattrasamanvitām
īdṛksaṃsthānasaṃpannāṃ
kṛtvā śrāddhasamanvitaḥ
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dadyāt
keśavaḥ prīyatām iti

samyag uccārya vidhinā
dattvaitena narādhipa
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ
pitaraṃ sapitāmaham

prapitāmahaṃ tathā pūrvaṃ
puruṣāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam
ātmānaṃ tanayaṃ pautraṃ
tadadhas tu catuṣṭayam
tārayaty avanīpāla
tiladhenuprado naraḥ

yaś ca gṛhṇāti vidhivat
tasyāpy evaṃvidhān kulān
caturdaśa tathā caiva
dadataś cānumodakāḥ

dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti
tiladhenuṃ ca ye narāḥ
te 'py aśeṣāghanirmuktāḥ
prayānti paramāṃ gatim

praśāntāya suśīlāya
tathāmatsariṇe budhaḥ
tiladhenuṃ naro dadyād
vedasnātāya dharmiṇe

trirātraṃ yas tilāhāras
tiladhenuṃ prayacchati
dattvaikarātraṃ ca punas
tilān atti nareśvara

dātur viśuddhapāpasya
tasya puṇyavato nṛpa
cāndrāyaṇād abhyadhikaṃ
śastaṃ tat tilabhakṣaṇam

tilābhāve tathā dadyād
ghṛtadhenuṃ yatavrataḥ
kalpayitvā yathānyāyaṃ
tiladhenvā yatavrataḥ
yena bhūpa vidhānena
tad ihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu

vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ
puruṣeśam ajaṃ vidhum
sarvapāpanihantāraṃ
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣecanāt
saṃpūjya pūrvavat puṣpa-
gandhadhūpādibhir naraḥ

ahorātroṣito bhūtvā
tatparaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ
parameśam atho nāmnā
abhiṣṭūya ghṛtārciṣā

gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ kumbhaṃ
puṣpamālyādibhūṣitam
kāṃsyopadhānasaṃyuktaṃ
sitavastrayugena ca
hiraṇyagarbhasahitaṃ
maṇividrumamuktikaiḥ

ikṣuyaṣṭimayān pādān
khurān raupyamayāṃs tathā
sauvarṇe cākṣiṇī kuryāc
śṛṅge cāgarukāṣṭhaje

saptadhānyamaye pārśve
pattrorṇāni ca kambalam
kuryāt turuṣkakarpūrau
ghrāṇaṃ phalamayān stanān

tadvac charkarayā jihvāṃ
guḍakṣīramayaṃ mukham
kṣaumasūtreṇa lāṅgūlaṃ
romāṇi sitasarṣapaiḥ
tāmrapātramayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ
kuryāc chraddhāsamanvitaḥ

īdṛksvarūpāṃ saṃkalpya
ghṛtadhenuṃ narādhipa
tadvatkalpanayā dhenvā
ghṛtavatsaṃ prakalpayet

taṃ ca vipraṃ mahābhāga
manasaiva ghṛtārciṣam
kalpayitvā tatas tasmai
prayataḥ pratipādayet

etāṃ mamopakārāya
ghṛhṇīṣva tvaṃ dvijottama
prīyatāṃ mama deveśo
ghṛtāṛciḥ puruṣottamaḥ
ity udāhṛtya viprāya
dadyād dhenuṃ narottama

dattvaikarātraṃ sthitvā ca
ghṛtāhāro narādhipa
mucyate sarvapāpebhyas
tathā dānaphalaṃ śṛṇu

ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo
yatra pāyasakardamāḥ
teṣu lokeṣu lokeśa
sa puṇyeṣūpajāyate

pitur ūrdhvena ye sapta
puruṣāḥ sapta ye 'py adhaḥ
tāṃs teṣu nṛpa lokeṣu
sa nayaty astakalmaṣaḥ

sakāmānām iyaṃ vyuṣṭiḥ
kathitā nṛpasattama
viṣṇulokaṃ narā yānti
niṣkāmā ghṛtadhenudāḥ

ghṛtam agnir ghṛtaṃ somas
tanmayāḥ sarvadevatāḥ
ghṛtaṃ prayacchatā dattā
bhavanty akhiladevatāḥ

jaladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi
prīyate dattayā yayā
devadevo hṛṣīkeśaḥ
sarveśaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ

jalakumbhaṃ naravyāghra
suvarṇarajatānvitam
ratnagarbham aśeṣais tu
grāmyair dhānyaiḥ samanvitam

sitavastrayugacchannaṃ
dūrvāpallavaśobhitam
kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsīm uśīraṃ ca
vālakāmalakair yutam

caturbhiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ bhūpa
tilapātraiś caturdiśam
sthagitaṃ dadhipātreṇa
ghṛtakṣaudravatā mukhe

upoṣitaḥ samabhyarcya
vāsudevaṃ janeśvaram
puṣpadhūpopahārais tu
yathāvibhavam ādṛtaḥ

saṃkalpya jaladhenuṃ ca
kumbhaṃ samabhipūjya ca
pūjayed vatsakaṃ tadvat
kṛtaṃ jalamayaṃ budhaḥ

evaṃ saṃpūjya govindaṃ
jaladhenuṃ savatsakām
sitavastradharaḥ śānto
vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ

dadyād viprāya rājendra
prītyarthaṃ jalaśāyinaḥ
jalaśāyī jagadyoniḥ
prīyatāṃ mama keśavaḥ

iti coccārya bhūnātha
viprāya pratipādyatām
apakvānnāśinā stheyam
ahorātram ataḥparam

anena vidhinā dattvā
jaladhenuṃ janādhipa
sarvāhlādān avāpnoti
ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ

śarīrārogyam ābādhā-
praśamaḥ sārvakāmikaḥ
nṛṇāṃ bhavati dattāyāṃ
jaladhenvāṃ na saṃśayaḥ

atrāpi śrūyate bhūpa
pudgalena mahātmanā
jātismareṇa yad gītam
ihābhyetya purā kila

sa pudgalaḥ purā vipro
yamalokagato muniḥ
dadarśa yātanā ghorāḥ
pāpakarmakṛtāṃ kila

dīptāgnitīkṣṇaśastrotthāḥ
kvāthatailagatās tathā
uṣṇakṣāranadīpātā
bhairavāḥ puruṣarṣabha

vraṇāḥ kṣāranipātogrāḥ
kumbhīpākamahābhayāḥ
tā dṛṣṭvā yātanā vipraś
cakāra paramāṃ kṛpām

āhlādaṃ te tadā jagmuḥ
pāpās tadanukampitāḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nārakāḥ kecit
kecit tadavalokinaḥ

tadā svasthaṃ vilokyaiva
munir nārakamaṇḍalam
dharmarājaṃ sa papraccha
teṣāṃ praśamakāraṇam

tasmai cācaṣṭa rājendra
tadā vaivasvato yamaḥ
āhlādahetuṃ viprāya
pṛcchate pṛthivīpate

tavānubhāvād eteṣāṃ
nārakāṇāṃ dvijottam
saṃpravṛtto 'yam āhlādaḥ
kāraṇaṃ yac chṛṇuṣva tat

tvayābhyarcya jagannāthaṃ
sarveśaṃ jalaśāyinam
jaladhenuḥ purā dattā
vidhivan munipuṅgava

asmāt tu janmano 'tīte
tṛtīye dvija janmani
tasya dānasya te vyuṣṭir
iyam āhlādadāyinī

yena tvaṃ tapasā yukto
mānavānām agocaram
saṃprāpto 'si mahāprajña
sarvaśāstraviśārada

ye tvāṃ paśyanti śṛṇvanti
ye ca dhyāyanti pāpinaḥ
śṛṇoṣi yāṃs tvaṃ viprendra
yāṃś ca dhyāyasi paśyasi

nirvṛtiḥ paramā teṣāṃ
sarvāhlādapradāyinī
sadyo bhavati mātra tvaṃ
dvijendra kuru vismayam

āhlādahetujananaṃ
nāsti viprendra tādṛśam
jaladhenur yathā nṝṇāṃ
janmāny ekonasaptatiḥ

na dāgho na klamo nārtir
na moho vipra jāyate
api janmasahasreṣu
jaladhenupradāyinām

ekajanmakṛtaṃ vāñchā
trijanmotthaṃ samāhṛtā
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ
hanti dattāmbugaur nṛṇām

sa tvaṃ gaccha gṛhītvārgham
asmatto dvijasattama
yeṣāṃ samāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇo
na niyamyā hi te mayā

kṛṣṇaḥ saṃpūjito yais tu
ye kṛṣṇārtham upoṣitāḥ
yaiś ca nityaṃ smṛtaḥ kṛṣṇo
na te madviṣayopagāḥ

namaḥ kṛṣṇācyutānanta
vāsudevety udīritam
yair bhāvabhāvitair vipra
na te madviṣayopagāḥ

dānaṃ dadadbhir yair uktam
acyutaḥ prīyatām iti
śraddhāpuraḥsarair vipra
na te madviṣayopagāḥ

uttiṣṭhadbhiḥ svapadbhiś ca
vrajadbhiś ca janārdanaḥ
yaiḥ saṃsmṛto dvijaśreṣṭha
na te madviṣayopagāḥ

kṣutaskhalitabhītyādāv
asahadbhiś ca vedanām
kṛṣṇety udīritaṃ yaiś ca
na te madviṣayopagāḥ

sarvābādhāsu ye kṛṣṇaṃ
smaranty uccārayanti ca
tadbhāvabhāvitā vipra
na te madviṣayopagāḥ

sa eva dhātā sarvasya
tanniyogakarā vayam
janasaṃyamanodyuktāḥ
so 'smatsaṃyamano hariḥ

itthaṃ niśāmya vacanaṃ
yamasya vadato munim
ūcus te nārakāḥ sarve
vahniśastrāstrabhīravaḥ

namaḥ kṛṣṇāya haraye
viṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ
hṛṣīkeśāya devāya
jagaddhātre 'cyutāya ca

namaḥ paṅkajanetrāya
namaḥ paṅkajanābhaye
janārdanāya śrīśāya
śrīpate pītavāsase

govindāya namo nityaṃ
namaś codadhiśāyine
namaḥ karālavaktrāya
nṛsiṃhāyātinādine

śārṅgiṇe sitakhaḍgāya
śaṅkhacakragadādhṛte
namo vāmanarūpāya
krāntalokatrayāya ca

varāharūpāya tathā
namo yajñāṅgadhāriṇe
vyāptāśeṣadigantāya
śāntāya paramātmane

vāsudeva namas tubhyaṃ
namaḥ kaiṭabhasūdana
keśavāya namo vyāpin
namas te 'stu mahīdhara

namo 'stu vāsudevāyety
evam uccārite tataḥ
śastrāṇi kuṇṭhatāṃ jagmur
analaś cāpy aśīśamat

abhajyanta ca yantrāṇi
samutpetur ayomukhāḥ
saṃśuṣkāḥ kṣārasaritaḥ
patitaḥ kūṭaśālmaliḥ

prakāśatāmasītattvaṃ
narakaś cāgatas tu saḥ
vivān babhañja pavano 'py
asipatravanaṃ tataḥ

nirutsāhā jaḍadhiyo
babhūvur yamakiṃkarāḥ
āsan gandhāmbuvāhinyaḥ
pūyaśoṇitanimnagāḥ

vavau sugandhī pavano
manaḥprītikaras tataḥ
veṇuvīṇāsvanayutān
gītaśabdāṃś ca śuśruvuḥ

taṃ tādṛśam athālakṣya
nṛpa vaivasvato yamaḥ
narakasya viparyāsaṃ
saṃkṣuddhahṛdayas tataḥ

dadarśa nārakān sadyo
divyasraganulepanān
jājvalyamānāṃs tejobhir
amalāmbaravāsasaḥ

namo namo 'stu kṛṣṇāya
govindāyāvyayātmane
vāsudevāya devāya
viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave

ity evaṃ vādinas tatra
prajāsaṃyamano yamaḥ
kṣīṇapāpacayāṃs tāṃs tu
pādyārghyādibhir arcayan

pūjayitvā ca tān āha
sa kṛṣṇāya kṛtāñjaliḥ
samāhitamanā bhūtvā
dharmarājo nareśvara

viṣṇor devātidevasya
jagaddhātuḥ prajāpateḥ
praṇāmaṃ ye 'pi kurvanti
teṣām api namo namaḥ

sarvasya sarvasaṃsthasya
sarvādhārasya yoginaḥ
ye viṣṇoḥ praṇatās tebhyo
namaḥ sadyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ

tasya yajñavarāhasya
viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ
praṇāmaṃ ye 'pi kurvanti
teṣām api namo namaḥ

evaṃ te saṃstutās tena
dharmarājena nārakāḥ
vimānāni samārūḍhā
nṛttagāndharvavanti vai

pudgalo 'pi mahābuddhir
dṛṣṭvaitad akhilaṃ nṛpa
jātismaro 'bhavad bhūpa
kaṇvagotre mahāmuniḥ

saṃsmṛtya yamavākyāni
viṣṇor māhātmyam eva ca
jaladhenvāś ca māhātmyaṃ
saṃsmṛtyaitad agāyata

aho duruttarā viṣṇor
māyeyam atigahvarī
yayā mohitacittas taṃ
na vetti parameśvaram

jīvo vāñchati kīṭatvaṃ
yūkāmatkuṇayonitaḥ
tasmāc ca śalabhādīnāṃ
yoniṃ tasmāc ca pakṣiṇām

tataś ca paśutāṃ prāpya
naratvam abhivāñchati
vimuktihetukī dhanyā
narayoniḥ kṛtātmanām

na prāpnuvanti saṃsāre
vibhrāntamanaso gatim
jīvā mānuṣyatām anye
janmanām ayutair api

viṣṇumāyāparītās te
prāpyāpi na taranti ye

tad īdṛgdurlabhaṃ prāpya
muktidvāram acetasaḥ
patanti bhūyaḥ saṃsāre
viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ

dustarāpi tu sādhyāsau
māyā kṛṣṇasya mohanī
chidyate yāmanonyaste
mudhaiva hi janārdane

asaṃtyajya ca gārhasthyam
ataptvaiva tathā tapaḥ
chindanti vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ
keśavārpitamānasāḥ

avirodhena viṣayām
bhuñjan viṣṇuvyapāśrayaḥ
kṛtvā manas taraty etāṃ
viṣṇor māyāṃ sudustarām

īdṛgbahuphalāṃ bhaktiṃ
sarvadhātari keśave
māyayā tasya devasya
na kurvanti vimohitāḥ

mudhaivoktaṃ mudhāyātaṃ
mudhā tad vidhiceṣṭitam
mudhaiva janma tan naṣṭaṃ
yatra nārādhito hariḥ

ārādhito hi yaḥ puṃsām
aihikāmuṣmikaṃ phalam
dadāti bhagavān devaḥ
kas taṃ na pratipūjayet

saṃvatsarās tathā māsā
viphalā divasāś ca te
narāṇāṃ viṣayāndhānāṃ
yeṣu nārādhito hariḥ

yo na vittarddhivibhavair
na vasobhir na bhūṣaṇaiḥ
tuṣyate hṛdayenaiva
kas tam īśaṃ na pūjayet

jaladhenvāś ca māhātmyaṃ
niśāmyāpīdṛśaṃ narāḥ
tāṃ na yacchanti ye teṣāṃ
vivekaḥ kutra tiṣṭhati

karmabhūmau hi mānuṣyaṃ
janmanām ayutair api
svargāpavargaphaladaṃ
kadācit prāpyate naraiḥ

saṃprāpya tan na yair viṣṇus
toṣito nāmbudhenukā
dattā ca samyak te muṣṭā
janmani subahūni bhoḥ

ūrdhvabāhur viraumy eṣa
dṛṣṭalokadvayo 'smi bhoḥ
ārādhayata govindaṃ
jaladhenuṃ prayacchata

duḥsaho nārako vahnir
aviṣahyāś ca yātanāḥ
jñānaṃ mamaitad ālambya
kṛṣṇe bhavata susthirāḥ

adeśike deśiko 'ham
atra mārge mayoditam
vimṛṣya satyam ity etan
manaḥ kṛṣṇe niveśyatām

prātaḥ kṛṣṇeti deveti
govindeti ca jalpatām
madhyāhne cāparāhne ca
yo 'vasādaḥ sa ucyatām

anekaviṣayālambi
yac cittaṃ taj janārdane
kurudhvam ālambanavat
saṃsmṛtaḥ puṇyado hi saḥ

mudhaiva jihvā kṛṣṇeti
keśaveti ca vakṣyati
mudhā ca cittaṃ tadgāmi
yadi syāt kim ato 'dhikam

mayoktam etad bahuśo
vinaṣṭe tu śarīrake
manuṣyatvaṃ vinā viṣṇur
durlabho vo bhaviṣyati

etāḥ pudgalagāthās te
yamavākyaṃ tavoditam
jaladhenvāś ca māhātmyaṃ
viṣṇusaṃpūjanasya ca

vratāni sopavāsāni
sarvakāmapradāni te
vratam anyan mahābhāga
sarvakāmapradaṃ śṛṇu

bhaviṣyaṃ cāparaṃ bhūpa
mamaitac chrotum arhasi
yat prakṣyati mahīpālaḥ
parikṣit svapurohitam

parīkṣitaḥ purodhās tu
dvijo gauramukho nṛpa
bhaviṣyati śamīkasya
śiṣyaḥ paramasaṃmataḥ

sa ca rājā jagaddhātur
devadevasya śārṅginaḥ
sadaivārādhane yatnaṃ
bhaktiyuktaḥ kariṣyati

purodhasaṃ gauramukhaṃ
praṇipatya sa pārthivaḥ
prakṣyaty ārādhanārthāya
devadevasya cakriṇaḥ

bhagavan bhavabhīto 'ham
abhavāya tato bhavān
ārādhayitum icchāmi
sarvecchāpūrakaṃ hariṃ

saṃkuruṣva mahābhāga
prasādaṃ mama suvrata
kṛṣṇārādhanakāmasya
manaso deśiko bhava

ārādhanena yeneśo
jagatām īśvareśvaraḥ
viṣṇur ārādhyate puṃbhiḥ
saṃsārābdhiparikṣataiḥ

tan mamopadiśa brahman
prasādapravaṇaṃ manaḥ
kṛtvā sadaivārtimatāṃ
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ guruḥ

evaṃ sa tena bhūpāla
bhūpālena rṣipuṅgavaḥ
keśavārādhanārthāya
samyak pṛṣṭaḥ pravakṣyati

namaskṛtya jagaddhātre
devadevāya śārṅgine
parameśasureśāya
hṛṣīkeśāya vedhase

varārthinām amoghāya
parasmai harimedhase
sarvakalyāṇabhūtāya
śaṅkhacakragadādhṛte

śvetādidīrghahrasvādi-
kaṭhinādivikalpanā
yogicintye jagaddhāmni
yatra nāsty akhilātmani

tam ajaṃ śāśvataṃ nityaṃ
pariṇāmavivarjitam
yogibhiś cintyate mūrtir
yatra tatrākhilātmani

tatra tatrātmano nityaṃ
pariṇāmavivarjitam
praṇamya jagatām īśam
anantaṃ parataḥ param

paraṃ parāṇāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ
purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ prabhum
varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ
sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpiṇam

yasyopacārataḥ svargaṃ
svarūpaṃ vyatiricyate
jñānajñeyasya munibhir
jñānavidbhir mahātmabhiḥ

tasmai pārthivamukhyāya
raghuvaryamahātmane
śrūyatāṃ sa muniśreṣṭho
yad vakṣyati parīkṣite

devakī nāma rājendra
devakasyābhavat sutā
anapatyā tapas tepe
putrārthaṃ kila bhāminī

bhāryā sā vasudevasya
satyadharmaparāyaṇā
na cātuṣyata govindas
tatas tām āha bhārgavaḥ

kimarthaṃ tapyate bhadre
tapaḥ paramaduścaram
ko 'rthas tavābhilaṣito
gantuṃ kutra tavepsitam

aputrāhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha
patyur me nāsti saṃtatiḥ
sāham ārādhya govindaṃ
putram icchāmi śobhanam

tapas tāvat kariṣyāmi
parameṇa samādhinā
yāvad ārādhito viṣṇur
dāsyaty abhimataṃ mama

govindārādhane yatno
yadi te kulanandini
tad idaṃ vratam āsthāya
toṣayāśu janārdanam

prathame kārttikasyāhni
saṃprāpte devakātmaje
pañcagavyajalasnātaḥ
pañcagavyakṛtāśanaḥ

bāṇapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya
vāsudevam ajaṃ vibhum
dattvā ca candanaṃ dhūpaṃ
paramānnaṃ nivedayet
ghṛtena vācayed vipraṃ
gṛhṇīyāc ca tato vratam

adyaprabhṛty ahaṃ māsaṃ
virataḥ prāṇināṃ vadhāt
asatyavacanāt stainyān
madhumāṃsādibhakṣaṇāt

svapan vibudhyan gacchaṃś ca
smariṣyāmy aham acyutam
parāpavādapaiśūnyaṃ
parapīḍākaraṃ tathā

sacchāstradevatāyajvi-
nindām anyasya vā bhuvi
na vakṣyāmi jagaty asmin
paśyan sarvagata harim

ity anyac cāpi śaknoti
yan nirvoḍhuṃ yaśasvini
kurvīta niyamaṃ tasya
tyāgo dharmāya yasya ca

kṛtvaivaṃ purato viṣṇor
nivṛttiṃ pāpataḥ śubhe
naivedyaṃ svayam aśnīyān
maunī nityam udaṅmukhaḥ

mārgaśīrṣe tathā māsi
jātipuṣpair janārdanam
samabhyarcya śubhe dhūpaṃ
candanaṃ saṃnivedya ca

paramānnaṃ ca devāya
viprāya ca punar ghṛtam
dattvā tathaiva gṛhṇīyān
niyamaṃ cāsya rocate

tathaiva naktaṃ bhuñjīta
naivedyaṃ kulanandini
sarveṣv eva tu māseṣu
pañcagavyādikaṃ samam

puṣpadhūpopahāreṣu
viśeṣo dakṣiṇāsu ca
snānaprāśanayoḥ sāmyaṃ
tathā vai naktabhojane

arcayet pratimāsaṃ ca
yaiḥ puṣpais tāni me śṛṇu
ye ca dhūpāḥ pradātavyā
naivedyānnaṃ ca yad yadā

bāṇasya jātikusumais
tathaiva ca kuruṇṭhakaiḥ
kundātimuktakai rakta-
karavīraiś ca devaki

śvetais tato mālikayā
tathā mallikayā tataḥ
dadhipiṇḍyātha ketakyā
padmaraktotpalena ca
krameṇābhyarcito viṣṇur
dadāti manasepsitam

kārttike mārgaśīrṣe ca
dhūpaḥ pauṣe ca candanam
māghaphālgunacaitreṣu
dadyād viṣṇos tathāgarum

vaiśākhādiṣu māseṣu
triṣu devaki bhaktitaḥ
karpūraṃ devadevāya
guggulaṃ śrāvaṇādiṣu

kārttikādiṣu māseṣu
paramānnaṃ śubhe triṣu
kāsāraṃ māghapūrveṣu
yavānnaṃ ca tatas triṣu

ghṛtaṃ tilāñ jalaghaṭān
hiraṇyam athavājinam
pratimāsaṃ tathā dadyād
brāhmaṇāya śubhavrate

yathoktaṃ niyamānāṃ ca
grahaṇaṃ pratimāsikam
kurvañ jagatpatir viṣṇuḥ
prīyatām iti mānavaḥ

yoṣid apy amalaprajñe
vratam etad yathāvidhi
karoti yā sā sakalān
avāpnoti manorathān

vratenārādhito viṣṇur
anena jagataḥ patiḥ
dadāty abhimatān kāmān
alpakālena bhāmini

dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ
saubhāgyārogyadaṃ tathā
vratam etat priyatamaṃ
vratebhyo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
