vratenānena śuddhānām
abdenaikena keśavaḥ
sukhadṛśyo na saṃdeho
dīpenaivāgrataḥ sthitaḥ

kāyavāṅmanaso śuddhiṃ
karoty etan mahāvratam
śuddhānāṃ cāmalo devo
dṛśya eva janārdanaḥ

tasminn ekāgracittānāṃ
prāṇināṃ varavarṇini
viprā eva prayatnena
muktibhājo vibhūtayaḥ

yathā kalpataruṃ prāpya
yad yad icchati cetasā
tat tat phalam avāpnoti
tathā saṃprāpya taṃ vibhum

śuddhivratam idaṃ tasmān
mahāpātakanāśanam
ārādhanāya kṛṣṇasya
kuru devaki pāvanam

tasmiṃś cīrṇe hṛṣīkeśas
tubhyaṃ dāsyati darśanam
dṛṣṭe cābhimataṃ yat te
tad aśeṣaṃ bhaviṣyati

devakī bhārgavasyaitac
śrutvā vākyaṃ narādhipa
śuddhikāmā cacārātha
sarvakāmapradaṃ vratam

vratenārādhitas tena
tadā devyā janārdanaḥ
dadau darśanam īśeśaḥ
śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ

dṛṣṭe tasminn aśeṣeśe
jagaddhātari keśave
kṛtvā praṇāmam āhedaṃ
bhaktinamrātha devakī

jagatām īśvareśeśa
jñāna jñeya bhavāvyaya
samastadevatādeva
vāsudeva namo 'stu te

pradhānapuṃsor ajayor
yaḥ kāraṇam akāraṇam
aviśeṣyam ajaṃ rūpaṃ
tava tasmai namo 'stu te

tvaṃ pradhānaṃ pumāṃś caiva
kāraṇākāraṇātmakaḥ
sad asac cākhilaṃ deva
kenoktena tava stavaḥ

prasīda deva devānām
ariśātana vāmana
lobhābhibhūtā yad ahaṃ
varayāmi prayaccha tat

aditis tvaṃ mahābhāge
bhuvaṃ prāptā surāraṇi
bhartā ca te kaśyapo 'yaṃ
deyas tava varo mayā

aputrāsmi na me bhartur
asti keśava saṃtatiḥ
prasīda dehi me putram
aridurdhārapauruṣam

bhaviṣyaty acirād devi
madaṃśena sutas tava
hantavyā dānavās tena
saddharmaparipanthinaḥ

tvām ahaṃ jagaddhātāram
udāroruparākramam
dhārayiṣyāmi garbheṇa
katham acyuta śaṃsa me

tavodare 'vatāraṃ vai
purāpi balibandhane
kurvatā vidhṛtāḥ sapta
lokās tvaṃ cātmamāyayā

tathā sāṃpratam apy etāṃl
lokān sasthāṇujaṅgamān
dhārayiṣyāmy athātmānaṃ
tvāṃ ca devaki līlayā

ity evam uktvā tāṃ devīṃ
devakīṃ bhagavān prabhuḥ
tirobabhūva govindo
bhūrbhuvaḥprabhavo vibhuḥ

taṃ jātaṃ devakī devaṃ
nidhānaṃ sarvatejasām
praṇipatyābhituṣṭāva
saṃprastutapayodharā

abālo bālarūpeṇa
yeneśa tvam ihāsthitaḥ
tvadrūpaṃ praṇipatyāhaṃ
yad bravīmi nibodha tat

namas te sarvabhūteśa
namas te madhusūdana
namas te puṇḍarīkākṣa
namas te 'stu janārdana

namas te śārṅgacakrāsi-
gadāparighapāṇaye
upendrāyāprameyāya
hṛṣīkeśāya vai namaḥ

namo 'stu te 'ṇurūpāya
bṛhadrūpāya vai namaḥ
aśeṣabhūtarūpāya
tathārūpāya te namaḥ

anirdeśyaviśeṣāya
tubhyaṃ sarvātmane namaḥ
sarveśvarāya sarvāya
sarvabhūtāya te namaḥ

aśeṣabhūtarūpāya
tathābhūtāya te namaḥ
namo 'stu te 'śvarūpāya
tathārūpāya te namaḥ
anirdeśyaviśeṣāya
tubhyaṃ sarvātmane namaḥ
namo 'stu te vāsudeva
namas te puṣkarekṣaṇa

viṣṇo namo 'stu te kṛṣṇa
namas te puruṣottama
namo nārāyaṇa hare
namas te 'stu sadācyuta

namo namas te govinda
namas te garuḍadhvaja
śrīśa śrīvatsa yogīśa
śrīkānteśa namo 'stu te

nīlotpaladalaśyāma
daṃṣṭroddhṛtavasuṃdhara
hiraṇyākṣaripo deva
namas te yajñasūkara

nṛsiṃha jaya viśvātman
daityoraḥsthaladāraka
namo namas te 'stu sadā
vikṣepadhvastatāraka

māyāvāmanarūpāya
tubhyaṃ deva namo namaḥ
trivikrama namas tubhyaṃ
trailokyakrānti durjaya

niḥkṣatriyorvīkaraṇa
vikarālaparākrama
jāmadagnya namas tubhyaṃ
kārtavīryāsutaskara

paulastyakulanāśāya
sādhumārgavicāriṇe
nalasetukṛte tubhyaṃ
namo rāghavarūpiṇe

sāṃprataṃ matprasannāya
saṃbhūtāya mamodare
svamāyābālarūpāya
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vai hare

yāvanti tava rūpāṇi
yāvatyaś ca vibhūtayaḥ
namāmi kṛṣṇa sarvebhyas
tebhyas tābhyaś ca sarvadā

svarūpaceṣṭitaṃ yat te
yad devatve viceṣṭitam
yac ca tiryaṅmanuṣyatve
ceṣṭitaṃ tan namāmy aham

parameśa pareśeśa
tiryagīśa nareśvara
sarveśvareśvareśeśa
namas te puruṣottama

evaṃ stutas tayā devyā
devakyā madhusūdanaḥ
bālarūpī jagādaivaṃ
vasudevasya śṛṇvataḥ

samyag ārādhitenoktaṃ
yat prasannena vai śubhe
tat kṛtaṃ sakalaṃ bhūyo
yad vṛṇoṣi dadāmi tat

avatāre tathaivāsmin
varṣāṇām adhikaṃ śatam
sthāsyāmi naratāṃ prāpto
duṣṭadaityanibarhaṇaḥ

tat tvaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te
varaṃ yan manasecchasi
dāsyāmy aham asaṃdigdhaṃ
yady api syāt sudurlabham

yadi deva prasannas tvaṃ
pradadāsi mamepsitam
vṛṇomi tad ahaṃ nityaṃ
tava keśava darśanam

tavedṛgrūpam ālokya
hārdaprasrutalocanā
nālaṃ viyogaṃ saṃsoḍhuṃ
tavāhaṃ madhusūdana

dākṣāyaṇī tvam aditiḥ
saṃbhūtā vasudhātale
nityam eva jagaddhātri
prasādaṃ te karomy aham

ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe tadā pakṣe
dine 'sminn eva bhāmini
tvaṃ māṃ drakṣyasy asaṃdigdhaṃ
prasādas te kṛto mayā

anenaiva mahābhāge
bālarūpeṇa saṃvṛtaḥ
tava darśanam eṣyāmi
yatra te snehavan manaḥ

tasmin kāle ca lokās tvāṃ
pūjayiṣyanti devaki
māṃ ca puṣpādibhir devi
tavotsaṅgavyavasthitam

saṃpūjito 'haṃ lokānāṃ
tasmin kāle sutoṣitaḥ
pradāsyāmi jagaddhātri
yathābhilaṣitaṃ varam

aputrāṇāṃ varān putrān
adhanānāṃ tathā dhanam
śubhān dārān adārāṇāṃ
sarogāṇām arogatām

sugatiṃ gatikāmānāṃ
vidyāṃ vidyārthinām api
pradāsyasi mahābhāge
matprasādopavṛṃhitā

prasāditā hi martyānāṃ
yat tvaṃ dāsyasi śobhane
tat teṣāṃ matprasādena
bhaviṣyati na durlabham

tvām abhyarcyopacāreṇa
snāpayitvā ghṛtena mām
sarvakāmān avāpsyanti
kāle ṣaṭpakṣasaṃjñite

tvadaṅkasthaṃ ca māṃ bālaṃ
saṃsmariṣyanti bhaktitaḥ

pratimāsaṃ ca te pūjām
aṣṭamyāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati
mama caivākhilān kāmān
saṃprāpnoty apakalmaṣaḥ

evaṃ pūrvaṃ hṛṣīkeśo
devakyāḥ pradadau varam
tasmāt kṛṣṇāṣṭamī puṃsām
aśeṣāghaughahāriṇī

tasyāṃ hi pūjitaḥ kṛṣṇo
devakī ca samādhinā
pāpāpanodaṃ kurute
dadāti ca manorathān

tad eṣa puṣṭikāmānāṃ
nṝṇāṃ puṇyārthinām api
upavāso mahīpāla
śastaḥ keśavatoṣadaḥ

śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣe tu
dvādaśyāṃ prīyate nṛpa
gopradānena govindo
yat pūrvaṃ kathitaṃ tava

pauṣaśukle tu tadvac ca
dvādaśyāṃ ghṛtadhenukām
ghṛtārciḥ prīṇanāyālaṃ
pradadyāt phaladāyinīm

tathaiva māghadvādaśyāṃ
pradattā tilagaur nṛpa
keśavaṃ prīṇayaty āśu
sarvakāmān prayacchati

jyaiṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe
dvādaśyāṃ jaladhenukā
dattā yathāvad vidhinā
prīṇayaty ambuśāyinam

lavaṇaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu
kṛṣṇam abhyarcya yo naraḥ
prayacchati dvijāgryāya
sa sarvarasadāyakaḥ

sarvabhogamahābhogān
bhrājiṣmanto manoramān
lokān avāpnoti nṛpa
prasanne garuḍadhvaje

pauṣamāse tu yo dadyād
ghṛtaṃ viprāya pārthiva
samabhyarcyācyutaṃ so 'pi
sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt

māghamāse tu saṃpūjya
mādhavaṃ brāhmaṇāya yaḥ
prayacchati tilāṃl lokān
saṃprāpnoty abhivāñchitān

phālgune puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ
yaḥ samabhyarcya yacchati
saptadhānyaṃ naraśreṣṭha
sa sarvasyeśvaro bhavet

caitre citrāṇi vastrāṇi
yaḥ prayacchati keśavam
pūjayitvā sa vai bhogān
vicitrāṃl labhate naraḥ

vaiśākhe viṣṇum abhyarcya
yavagodhūmado naraḥ
lokān aindrān samāsādya
modate vigatajvaraḥ

durnivartyam ahaṃ manye
cañcalaṃ hi mano yataḥ

jyaiṣṭhe 'bhyarcya hṛṣīkeśam
udakumbhaprado hi yaḥ
sa parāṃ nirvṛtiṃ yāti
sapta janmāntarāṇi vai

āṣāḍhamāse ca hariṃ
yaḥ samabhyarcya yacchati
viprāya candanaṃ so 'pi
paramāhlādabhājanam

yo nṛsiṃhaṃ samabhyarcya
brāhmaṇāya prayacchati
śrāvaṇe navanītaṃ tu
sa svargaṃ sukṛtī vrajet

chattraṃ ca yo bhādrapade
vāsudevābhipūjakaḥ
prayacchati dvijāgryāya
sa cchattrādhipatir bhavet

guḍaśarkarayā yuktaṃ
modakaṃ ca prayacchati
tathaivāśvayuje 'bhyarcya
yo 'nantaṃ so 'maro bhavet

nārāyaṇaṃ samabhyarcya
yaḥ prayacchati kārttike
dīpakaṃ viprageheṣu
vimānaṃ so 'dhirohati

kāmyāny etāny aśeṣāṇi
yaḥ saṃpūjya jagatpatim
dānāni yacchati naraḥ
sa saṃpūrṇamanorathaḥ
sarvaśreṣṭhaḥ samastānāṃ
bandhūnām āśrayo bhavet

evaṃ sarvāṇi dānāni
prīṇanāyācyutasya yaḥ
prayacchati sa sarveṣāṃ
phalānāṃ bhuvi bhājanam

tasmān narendra viprebhyaḥ
prīṇanāya jagadguroḥ
prayacchaitāni dānāni
yac cānyad dayitaṃ tava

yadīcchasi punaḥ prāptuṃ
bhūtim abhraṃśanīṃ nṛpa
tadārādhaya govindaṃ
nānyathā syur vibhūtayaḥ

evaṃ vasiṣṭhena tadā
māndhātā nṛpa bodhitaḥ
saha patnyā mahīpālaḥ
paritoṣaṃ paraṃ yayau

jagāda ca mudā yuktaḥ
praṇipatya purohitam
saha patnyā naraśreṣṭhaḥ
samutthāya varāsanāt

dhig dhig vṛthaiva yātāni
mamaitāni dināny aho
anāsajya manaḥ kṛṣṇe
viṣayāsaktacetasaḥ

tā niśās te ca divasās
te rtavas te ca vatsarāḥ
narāṇāṃ saphalā yeṣu
cintito bhagavān hariḥ

cintyamānaḥ samastānāṃ
pāpānāṃ hāṇido hi saḥ
samutsṛjyākhilaṃ cintyaṃ
so 'cyutaḥ kiṃ na cintyate

kaṣṭaṃ muṣṭo 'smi śiṣṭeṣu
vidyamāneṣu mantriṣu
parāṅmukhānāṃ govinde
yat prāptaṃ paramaṃ vayaḥ

evaṃ vinindya so 'tmānāṃ
māndhātā pṛthivīpatiḥ
cakārārādhane yatnaṃ
devadevasya śārṅgitiṇaḥ

tam ārādhya ca viśveśam
upendram asureśvara
prāpa siddhiṃ parāṃ pūrvaṃ
dakṣaḥ prācetaso yathā

tathā tvam api rājendra
sarvabhāvena keśavam
samārādhaya govindaṃ
tam ārādhya na sīdati

evaṃ sa daityarājendraḥ
prahrādenāvabodhitaḥ
balir ārādhane yatnaṃ
cakre cakrabhṛtas tadā

puṣpopahārair dhūpaiś ca
tathā caivānulepanaiḥ
vāsobhir bhūṣaṇaiḥ samyag
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ

japair homair vrataiś caiva
yathoktaṃ puruṣarṣabha
saha patnyā tathaiva tvaṃ
samārādhaya keśavam

bhagavaṃś cañcalaṃ cittaṃ
manuṣyāṇām aharniśam
viṣayāsaṅgadurduṣṭaṃ
pāpāyaiva pravartate

maunena vācikaṃ pāpaṃ
puṃbhir brahman nivartyate
śārīram apy akaraṇāt
sunivartyaṃ mataṃ mama

yat tv etan mānasaṃ pāpaṃ
manuṣyais tan mahāmate
durnivartyam ahaṃ manye
cañcalaṃ hi mano yataḥ

tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi
manuṣyair durvicintitaiḥ
yat smartavyaṃ ca japyaṃ ca
mānasāghapraśāntaye

tvadyukto 'yam anupraśnaḥ
sādhv etad bhavatoditam
cañcalatvād dhi cittānāṃ
mānasaṃ bahu pātakam

bhūmau tṛṇam asaṃkhyātaṃ
yathā ca divi tārakāḥ
tathā pāpam asaṃkhyeyaṃ
cetasā kriyate tu yat

paradāraparadravya-
parahiṃsāsu mānasam
aharniśaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ
sātatyena pravartate

yady asyopaśamo rājan
bhuvi na kriyate nṛbhiḥ
tan nāsti narakottāro
varṣakoṭīśatair api

tad asya praśamāyālaṃ
prāyaścittaṃ narādhipa
śṛṇuṣva yena cittotthaṃ
sadyaḥ pāpaṃ vyapohati

oṃ namo vāsudevāya
puruṣāya mahātmane
hiraṇyaretase 'cintya-
svarūpāyātivedhase

viṣṇave jiṣṇave nityaṃ
śāntāyānagharūpiṇe
sarvasthityantakaraṇa-
vratine pītavāsase

nārāyaṇāya viśvāya
viśveśāyeśvarāya ca
namaḥ kamalakiñjalka-
suvarṇamukuṭāya ca

keśavāyātisūkṣmāya
brahmamūrtimate namaḥ
namaḥ paramakalyāṇa-
kalyāṇāyātmayonaye

janārdanāya devāya
śrīdharāya sumedhase
mahātmane vareṇyāya
namaḥ paṅkajanābhaye

smṛtamātrāghaghātāya
kṛṣṇāyākliṣṭakarmaṇe
namo natāya namreśair
aśeṣair vāsavādibhiḥ

namo māyāvine tubhyaṃ
haraye harimedhase
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhāya
jagataḥ kāraṇātmane

govindāyādibhūtāya
śrādīnāṃ mahātmane
namo bhūtātmabhūtāya
ātmane paramātmane

acyutāya namo nityam
anantāya namo namaḥ
dāmodarāya śucaye
yajñeśāya namo namaḥ

namo māyāpaṭacchanna-
jagaddhāmne mahātmane
hṛṣīkeśāya ceśāya
sarvabhūtātmarūpiṇe

dayālave namo nityaṃ
kapilāya sumedhase
saṃsārasāgarottāra-
jñānapotapradāyine

akuṇṭhamataye dhātre
sargasthityantakarmaṇi
karālasaumyarūpāya
vaikuṇṭhāya namo namaḥ

yathā hi vāsudeveti
prokte naśyati pātakam
tathā vilayam abhyetu
mamaitad durvicintitam

yathā na viṣṇubhakteṣu
pāpam āpnoti saṃsthitim
tathā vināśam abhyetu
mamaitad durvicintitam

smṛtamātro yathā viṣṇuḥ
sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati
tathā praṇāśam abhyetu
mamaitad durvicintitam

yathā sarvatrago viṣṇus
tatra sarvaṃ ca saṃsthitam
upayātu tathā nāśaṃ
mamāghaṃ cittasaṃbhavam

pāpaṃ praṇāśaṃ mama saṃprayātu
yan mānasaṃ yac ca karomi vācā
śārīram apy ācaritaṃ ca yan me
smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve

prayāntu doṣā mama nāśam āśu
rāgādayaḥ kāraṇakāraṇeśe
vijñānadīpāmalamārgadṛśye
smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve

bhavantu bhadrāṇi samastadoṣāḥ
prayāntu nāśaṃ jagato 'khilasya
mayādya bhaktyā parameśvareśe
smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve

ye bhūtale ye divi ye 'ntarikṣe
rasātale prāṇigaṇāś ca kecit
bhavantu te siddhiyujo mayādya
smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve

puṣyantu maitrīṃ viramantu rāgād
ujjhantu lobhaṃ kṣamiṇo bhavantu
ābrahmavṛkṣāntaragā mayādya
smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve

ye prāṇinaḥ kutracid atra santi
brahmāṇḍamadhye parataś ca kecit
te yāntu siddhiṃ paramāṃ mayādya
smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve

ajñānino jñānavido bhavantu
praśāntibhājaḥ satatogracittāḥ
kurvantu bhaktiṃ paramām anante
matstotratuṣṭasya hareḥ prasādāt

śṛṇvanti ye me paṭhatas tathānye
paśyanti ye mām idam īrayantam
devāsurādyā manujās tiraśco
bhavantu te 'py acyutayogabhājaḥ

ye cāpi mūkā vikalendriyatvāc
śṛṇvanti no naiva vilokayanti
paśvādayaḥ kīṭapipīlikāś ca
bhavantu te 'py acyutayogabhājaḥ

nāmasv anantasya ca kīrtiteṣu
yad atra puṇyaṃ jagataḥ prasūteḥ
tenāvivekopahatātmabodhā
bhavantu puṃsāṃ matayaḥ suśīlāḥ

ye duḥkhitās te sukhino bhavantu
dveṣānvitā maitraguṇopapannāḥ
satyārjavādyās tv anṛtā vimāyā
matsaṃstavārādhitakṛṣṇadṛṣṭāḥ

naśyantu duḥkhāni jagaty apaitu
lobhādiko doṣaguṇaḥ prajābhyaḥ
yathātmani bhrātari cātmaje ca
tathā janasyāstu jane 'pi hārdam

saṃsāravaidye 'khiladoṣahāni-
vicakṣaṇe nirvṛtihetubhūte
saṃsārabandhāḥ śithilībhavantu
hṛdi sthite sarvajanasya viṣṇau

etat paṭhan pārthiva sarvapāpair
vimucyate viṣṇuparaḥ sadaiva
prāpnoti siddhiṃ vipulaṃ maharddhim
na cāpy anartheṣu matiṃ karoti

uddiśya sattvāni ca yāni yāni
stotraṃ paṭhante kṛpayā manuṣyāḥ
sarvāṇi tāny apratighā bhavanti
prayānti siddhiṃ bhagavatprasādāt

tasmāt tvayaitat satataṃ niśāsu
dineṣu caiveśvara mādhavasya
saṃkīrtanaṃ kāryam aśeṣapāpa-
vimokṣahetor abhavāya caiva

iti sakalajanopakārakārī
haricaraṇābjaviniṣṭaśuddhabuddhiḥ
paṭhati khalu mahīpa yo manuṣyaḥ
sa layam upaiti harau hṛtākhilāghaḥ

idaṃ ca śṛṇu bhūpāla
naśyate durvicintitam
yenopāyena vai puṃsāṃ
yoṣitāṃ vāpy asaṃśayam

paradāraparadravya-
jīvahiṃsādike sadā
pravartate nṛṇāṃ cittaṃ
tad etad abhisaṃsmaret

viṣṇave viṣṇave nityaṃ
viṣṇave viṣṇave namaḥ
jiṣṇave jiṣṇave sarvaṃ
jiṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ

namāmi viṣṇuṃ buddhistham
ahaṃkāra-gataṃ harim
cittastham īśam avyaktam
anantam aparājitam
viṣṇum īḍyam aśeṣeśam
anādinidhanaṃ vibhum

viṣṇuś cittagato yan me
viṣṇur buddhigataś ca yat
yac cāhaṃkārago viṣṇur
yad viṣṇur mayi saṃsthitaḥ

karoti kartṛbhūto 'sau
sthāvarasya carasya ca
tat pāpaṃ nāśam āyātu
tasminn eva vicintite

dhyāto harati yaḥ pāpaṃ
svapne dṛṣṭaḥ śubhāvahaḥ
tam upendram ahaṃ viṣṇuṃ
praṇato 'rtiharaṃ harim

jagaty asmin nirādhāre
majjamāne tamasy adhaḥ
hastāvalambadaṃ viṣṇuṃ
praṇato 'smi parātparam

sarveśvareśvara vibho
paramātmann adhokṣaja
hṛṣīkeśa hṛṣīkeśa
hṛṣīkeśa namo 'stu te

nṛsiṃhānanta govinda
bhūtabhāvana keśava
duruktaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ dhyātaṃ
praśamāgrya namo 'stu te

yan mayā cintitaṃ duṣṭaṃ
svacittavaśavartinā
narakāvaham atyugraṃ
tac chamaṃ naya keśava

brahmaṇyadeva govinda
paramārtha parāyaṇa
jagannātha jagaddhātaḥ
pāpaṃ praśamayācyuta

yac cāparāhne pūrvāhne
madhyāhne ca tathā niśi
kāyena manasā vācā
kṛtaṃ pāpam ajānatā

jānatā vā hṛṣīkeśa
puṇḍarīkākṣa mādhava
nāmatrayoccāraṇatas
tat prayātu mama kṣayam

śārīraṃ me hṛṣīkeśa
puṇḍarīkākṣa mānasam
pāpaṃ praśamayādya tvaṃ
vākkṛtaṃ mama mādhava

yad vrajan yat svapan bhuñjan
yad uttiṣṭhan yad āsthitaḥ
kṛtavāṃś cāpi yac cāhaṃ
kāyena manasā girā

mahat svalpam atisthūlaṃ
kuyoninarakāvaham
tad yātu praśamaṃ sarvaṃ
vāsudevasya kīrtanāt

paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma
pavitraṃ paramaṃ ca yat
tasmin saṃkīrtite viṣṇoḥ
pade pāpaṃ praṇaśyatu

sūrayo yat pravekṣyanti hy
apunarbhavakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
mamākhilaṃ daha tvaṃ hi
tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam

yat prāpya na ninvartante
gandhasparśādivarjitam
pāpaṃ praṇāśayatv adya
tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam

sadasad yat tathā vyaktā-
vyaktarūpam ajājaram
praṇamāmi jagaddhāma
tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam

śārīre mānase caiva
pāpe vāgje ca pārthiva
kṛte samyaṅ naro bhaktyā
paṭhec chraddhāsamanvitaḥ
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ
kṛṣṇanāmaprakīrtanāt

uccāryamāne caitasmin
devadevasya saṃstave
vilayaṃ pāpam āyāti
bhāṇḍam āmam ivāmbhasi

tasmāt saṃcintite pāpe
samanantaram eva te
japtavyam etat pāpasya
praśamāya mahīpate

saṃsārārṇavamagnena
puruṣeṇa mahāmune
viṣayāsaktacittena
yat kāryaṃ tad vadasva me

bhrāmyatāṃ saṃkaṭe durge
saṃsāre viṣayaiṣiṇām
svakarmabhir manuṣyāṇām
upakārakam ucyatām

kṣīpte manasy anāyatte
vṛddhe lobhādike gaṇe
śaraṇaṃ yan manuṣyāṇāṃ
tad ācakṣva mahāmune

saṃsārāṇavapotāya
haraye harimedhase
namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi
narāṇām upakārakam

samyag ārādhito bhaktyā
vedabhāraguror guruḥ
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prāha
yac chiṣyāya sumantave

purā kila durācāro
durbuddhir ajitendriyaḥ
kṣatrabandhur abhūt pāpaḥ
paramarmāvaghaṭṭakaḥ

mātāpitror aśuśrūṣur
drogdhā bandhujanasya ca
gurudevadvijātīnāṃ
nindāsu satatodyataḥ

moṣṭā viśvasatāṃ nityam
aprītiḥ prītim icchatām
ṛjūnām anṛjuḥ kṣudraḥ
parahiṃsāparāyaṇaḥ

sa bāndhavaiḥ parityaktas
tathānyaiḥ sādhuvṛttibhiḥ
avṛttimān aviśvāsyo
mṛgayājīvano 'bhavat

ahany ahani cakrāṅgān
eṇakādīṃs tathā mṛgān
hatvātmapoṣaṇaṃ cakre
vyādhavṛttirato 'dhamaḥ

etayā tasya duṣṭasya
kuvṛttyā pāpacetasaḥ
jagāma sumahān kālaḥ
kurvato dārapoṣaṇam

ekadā tu munis tena
nidāghe vijane vane
mṛgayām aṭatā dṛṣṭo
vartmanaḥ pracyutaḥ pathi

śvāsāyāsaślathair aṅgaiḥ
kṛcchrād ātmānam udvahan
sūryāṃśutāpāt pragalat-
svedārdracaraṇo nṛpa

tasmin dṛṣṭe tatas tasya
kṣatrabandhor ajāyata
kāruṇyaṃ dāruṇasyāpi
vyādhavṛttiparigrahāt

tam upetya ca bhūpāla
kṣatrabandhuḥ sa tāpasam
uvāca viprapravaraṃ
vimārge vartate bhavān

naiṣa panthā dvijaśreṣṭha
vipino 'yaṃ mahāṭaviḥ
mām anvehi tvarāyukto
mā vipattiṃ sameṣyasi

niśāmya tad vacaḥ śrāntaḥ
kṣatrabandhor mahānuniḥ
anuvavrāja rājendra
jalāśājanitodyamaḥ

kiṃcid bhūbhāgam āsādya
dadarśa ca mahāmuniḥ
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ
protphullanalinaṃ saraḥ

sārasābhirutaṃ ramyaṃ
sūpatīrtham akardamam
padmotpalayutaṃ cāru
pūrṇaṃ svacchena vāriṇā

suśītavanaṣaṇḍaiś ca
samantāt pariveṣṭitam
tatkṣaṇāt tṛṭparītānāṃ
cakṣuṣo hlādakāriṇam

dṛṣṭvaiva sa munis tatra
tadāmalajalaṃ saraḥ
sūryāṃśutapto gharmārto
nipapāta tadambhasi

tatrāśvāsya kṛtāhlādaḥ
papau vāri narādhipa
ujjīvayan munivaro
jihvātālu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ

so 'pi kṣatriyadāyādo
munitrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ
vihāya saśaraṃ cāpam
ujjahāra bisāny atha

dadau ca tasmai rājendra
kṣudhitāya tapasvine
yayau ca tṛptiṃ vipro 'pi
bisanālāmbubhakṣaṇāt

tam āśvastaṃ kṛtāhāram
upaviṣṭaṃ suśītale
nyagrodhaśākhāsaṃchanne
niṣpaṅke sarasas taṭe
saṃvāhayām āsa ca taṃ
kṣatrabandhuḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ

pādajaṅghorupṛṣṭeṣu
tena saṃvāhito muniḥ
jahau śramam amitraghna
vākyaṃ cedam uvāca ha

kas tvaṃ bhadramukhādyeha
mama prāṇaparikṣaye
hastāvalambado dhātrā
janito vipine vane

vibhraṣṭamārgo mūḍho 'haṃ
kṣutpipāsāśramāturaḥ
trātas tvayā mahābhāga
kas tvam atra vane 'jane

kṣutpipāsāśramārtasya
yas trāṇaṃ vipine vane
karoti puruṣavyāghra
tasya lokā madhuścyutaḥ

sa tvaṃ brūhi mahābhāga
mamābhyuddhārakārakaḥ
yeṣāṃ prakhyātayaśasāṃ
samutpannaḥ kule bhavān

haryaśvasya kule jātaḥ
putraś citrarathasya ca
vimatir nāma nāmnāhaṃ
hantum abhyāgato mṛgān

pitrarthaṃ mṛgayeyaṃ te
lakṣyārthaṃ vā mahāmate
āhārārtham utāho 'tra
mṛgayā vyasanaṃ tu te

vṛttir eṣā mama brahman
parityaktasya bāndhavaiḥ
bhṛtyair anyaiś ca naṣṭe 'rthe
nirdhanasyāmiṣāśinaḥ

kimarthaṃ tvaṃ parityakto
bhṛtyasvajanabandhubhiḥ
pātakī kīkaṭaḥ kṣudrair
upajaptaḥ pareṇa vā

ity uktaḥ so 'bhavan maunī
paśyan doṣaṃ nṛpātmani
aduṣṭāṃś cātmano bhṛtyān
vicintyātīva durmanāḥ

avekṣya taṃ sādhvasinaṃ
kṣatrabandhuṃ mahāmuniḥ
dhyātvā ciram athāpaśyat
kṣatrabandhuṃ svadoṣiṇam

saṃtyaktabandhuloke ca
tasmin durvṛttacetasi
kṛpāṃ cakāra sa muniḥ
kṣatrabandhau dayāparaḥ

uvāca ca munir bhūyaḥ
kṣatrabandhuṃ kṛpālukaḥ
upakāriṇam ugreṇa
karmaṇā taṃ vidūṣitam

api śaknoṣi saṃyantum
akāryaprasṛtaṃ manaḥ
prāṇi pīḍānivṛttiṃ ca
kartuṃ krodhādisaṃyamam

api maitrīṃ jane kartuṃ
śaknoṣi tvaṃ mudhaiva yā
aihikāmuṣmikī vīra
kriyamāṇā mahāphalā

na śaknomi kṣamāṃ kartuṃ
na maitrīṃ mama cetasi
prāṇinām avadhād brahman
nāsti dārādipoṣaṇam

anāyattaṃ ca me cittaṃ
viṣayān eva dhāvati
tadaprāptau ca sarveṣāṃ
krodhādīnāṃ samudbhavaḥ

so 'haṃ na maitrīṃ na kṣāntiṃ
na hiṃsādivivarjanam
kartuṃ śaknomi yat kāryaṃ
tadanyad upadiśyatām

tenaivam ukto vipro 'sau
tam upekṣyam amanyata
tathāpy atikṛpālutvāt
kṣatrabandhum abhāṣata

yady etad akhilaṃ kartuṃ
na śaknoṣi bravīhi me
svalpam anyan mayoktaṃ hi
kariṣyati bhavān yadi

aśakyam uktaṃ bhavatā
cañcalatvād dhi cetasaḥ
vākśarīraviniṣpādyaṃ
yac chakyaṃ tad udīraya

uttiṣṭhatā prasvapatā
prasthitena gamiṣyatā
govindeti sadā vācyaṃ
kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu

kāryaṃ vartmani mūḍhānāṃ
kṣemamārge 'vatāraṇam
hitaṃ ca vācyaṃ pṛṣṭena
śatrūṇām api jānatā

etat tavopakārāya
bhaviṣyaty anupālitam
yady anyad upasaṃhartuṃ
na śaknoṣi mahīpate

ity uktvā prayayau vipras
tena vartmani darśite
so 'pi tac chāsanaṃ sarvaṃ
kṣatrabandhuś cakāra ha

govindeti kṣute gacchan
prasthānaskhalitādiṣu
udīrayann avāpāgryāṃ
ratiṃ tatra śanaiḥ śanaiḥ

tataḥ kālena mahatā
kṣatrabandhur mamāra vai
ajāyata ca viprasya
kule jātismaro nṛpa

tasya saṃsmarato jātīḥ
śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
nirvedaḥ sumahāñ jajñe
saṃsāre 'trātiduḥkhade
sa cintayām āsa jagat
sarvam etad acetanam

aham eko 'tra saṃjñāvān
govindodīritaṃ hi yat
yac cādhvani vimūḍhānāṃ
kṛtaṃ vartmāvatāraṇam
hitam uktaṃ ca pṛṣṭena
tasya jātismṛtiḥ phalam

so 'haṃ jātismaro bhūyaḥ
kariṣyāmy atisaṃkaṭe
tadā saṃsāracakre 'smin
yena prāpsyāmi nirvṛtim

yasyoccāraṇamātreṇa
jātā jātismṛtir mama
tam evārādhayiṣyāmi
jagatām īśvaraṃ harim

yanmayaṃ paramaṃ brahma
tad avyaktaṃ ca yanmayam
yanmayaṃ vyaktam apy etad
bhaviṣyāmi hi tanmayaḥ

yady anārādhite viṣṇau
mamaitaj janma yāsyati
dhruvaṃ bandhavato muktir
naiva jātūpapadyate

aho duḥkham aho duḥkham
aho duḥkham atīva hi
svarūpam atighorasya
saṃsārasyātidurlabham

viṇmūtrapūyakalile
garbhavāse 'tipīḍanāt
aśucāv atibībhatse
duḥkham atyantaduḥsaham

duḥkhaṃ ca jāyamānānāṃ
gātrabhaṅgādipīḍanāt
vātena preryamāṇānāṃ
mūrchākāry atibhītidam

bālatve nirvivekānāṃ
bhūtadevātmasaṃbhavam
yauvane vārddhake caiva
maraṇe cātidāruṇam

śītoṣṇatṛṣṇākṣudroga-
jvarādiparivāritaḥ
sarvadaiva pumān āste
yāvaj janmāntasaṃsthitiḥ

duḥkhātiśayabhūtaṃ hi
yad ante vāsukhaṃ nṛṇām
tasyānumānaṃ naivāsti
kāryeṇaivānumīyate

kṛṣyamāṇasya puruṣair
yad yamasyātiduḥsaham
duḥkhaṃ tatsaṃsmṛtiprāptaṃ
karoti mama vepathum

kumbhīpāke taptakumbhe
mahārauravaraurave
kālasūtre mahāyantre
śūkare kūṭaśālmalau

asipatravane duḥkham
apratiṣṭhe ca yan mahat
viḍālavaktre ca tathā
tamasy ugre ca duḥsaham

śastrāgniyantravegeṣu
śītoṣṇādiṣu dāruṇam
tataś ca muktasya punar
yonisaṃkramaṇeṣu yat

garbhasthasya ca yad duḥkham
atiduḥsaham ulvaṇam
punaś ca jāyamānasya
janma yauvanajaṃ ca yat

duḥkhāny etāny asahyāni
saṃsārāntarvivartibhiḥ
puruṣair anubhūyante
sukhabhrāntivimohitaiḥ

na vai sukhakalā kācit
tatrāsty atyantaduḥkhade
saṃsārasaṃkaṭe tīvre
upetānāṃ kadācana

viṣayāsaktacittānāṃ
manuṣyāṇāṃ kadā matiḥ
saṃsārottāraṇe vāñchāṃ
kariṣyati hi cañcalā

govindanāmnā satataṃ
samuccāraṇasaṃbhavam
jātismaratvam etan naḥ
kiṃ vṛthaiva prayāsyati

so 'haṃ muktipradānārtham
anantam ajam avyayam
taccittas tanmayo bhūtvā
toṣayiṣyāmi keśavam

ātmānam ātmanaivaṃ sa
proktvā jātismaro dvijaḥ
tuṣṭāva vāgbhir iṣṭābhiḥ
praṇataḥ puruṣottamam

praṇipatyākṣaraṃ viśvaṃ
viśvahetuṃ nirañjanam
yat prārthayāmy avikalaṃ
sakalaṃ tat prayacchatu

kartāram akṛtaṃ viṣṇuṃ
sarvakāraṇakāraṇam
aṇor aṇīyāṃsam ajaṃ
sarvavyāpinam īśvaram

parāt parataraṃ yasmān
nāsti sarveśvarāt param
taṃ praṇamyācyutaṃ devaṃ
prārthayāmi yad astu tat

sarveśvarācyutānanta
paramātmañ janārdana
saṃsārābdhimahāpota
samuddhara mahārṇavāt

vyomānilāgnyambudharāsvarūpa
tanmātrasarvendriyabuddhirūpa
antaḥsthitātman paramātmarūpa
prasīda sarveśvara viśvarūpa

tam ādir anto jagato 'sya madhyam
ādes tvam ādiḥ pralayasya cāntaḥ
tvatto bhavaty etad aśeṣam īśa
tvayy eva cānte layam abhyupaiti

pradīpavartyantagato 'gnir alpo
yathātikakṣe vitataṃ prayāti
tadvad visṛṣṭer amarādibhinnair
vikāśam āyāsi vibhūtibhedaiḥ

yathā nadīnāṃ bahavo 'mbuvegāḥ
samantato 'bdhiṃ bhagavan viśanti
tvayy antakāle jagad acyutedaṃ
tathā layaṃ gacchati sarvabhūte

tvaṃ sarvam etad bahudhaika eva
jagatpate kāryam ivābhyupetam
yad asti yan nāsti ca tat tvam eva
hare tvadanyad bhagavan kim asti

kiṃtv īśa māyā bhavato nijeyam
āviṣkṛtāviṣkṛtalokasṛṣṭe
yayāham eṣo 'nyatamo mameti
madīyam asyābhivadanti mūḍhāḥ

tayā vimūḍhena mayābhanābha
na yat kṛtaṃ tat kvacid asti kiṃcit
bhūmyambarāgnisalileṣu deva
jāgratsuṣuptādiṣu duḥkhitena

na santi tāvanti jalāny apīḍya
sarveṣu nāthābdhiṣu sarvakālam
stanyāni yāvanti mayātighore
pītāni saṃsāramahāsamudre

saṃpac chilānāṃ himavanmahendra-
kailāsamervādiṣu naiva tādṛk
dehāny anekāny anugṛhṇato me
prāptāsthisaṃpan mahati yatheśa

tvayy arpitaṃ nātha punaḥ punar me
manaḥ samākṣipya sudurdharo 'pi
rāgo hi vaśyaṃ kurute tato 'nu
lobhādayaḥ kiṃ bhagavan karomi

ekāgratāmūlyabalena labhyaṃ
bhavauṣadhaṃ tvaṃ bhagavan kilaikaḥ
manaḥ parāyattam idaṃ bhave 'smin
saṃsāraduḥkhāt kim ahaṃ karomi

na santi te deva bhuvi pradeśā
na yeṣu jāto 'smi tathā vinaṣṭaḥ
attā mayā yeṣu na jantavaś ca
saṃbhakṣito yaiś ca na jantusaṃghaiḥ

siṃhena bhūtvā bahavo mayāttā
vyāghreṇa bhūtvā bahavo mayāttāḥ
tathānyarūpair bahavo mayāttāḥ
saṃbhakṣito 'haṃ bahubhis tataś ca

utkrāntiduḥkhāny atiduḥsahāni
sahasraśo yāny anusaṃsmarāmi
taiḥ saṃsmṛtais tat kṣaṇam eva deva
taḍid yathā me hṛdayaṃ prayāti

tataś ca duḥkhāny anivāraṇāni
yantrāgniśastraughasamudbhavāni
bhavanti yāny acyuta nārakānāṃ
tāny eva teṣām upamānamātram

duḥkhāny asahyāni ca garbhavāse
viṇmūtramadhye 'tinipīḍitasya
bhavanti yāni cyavataś ca garbhāt
teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ gadituṃ na śakyam

duḥkhāni bāleṣu mahanti nātha
kaumārake yauvaninaś ca puṃsaḥ
jvarātisārākṣirugādikāni
samastaduḥkhālaya eva vṛddhaḥ

karoti karmācyuta tatkṣaṇena
pāpaṃ naraḥ kāyamanovacobhiḥ
yasyābdalakṣair api nāntam eti
śastrādiyantrāgninipīḍaneṣu

duḥkhāni yānīṣṭaviyogajāni
bhavanti saṃsāravihārabhājām
pratyekaśas teṣu narā vināśam
icchanty asūnāṃ mamatābhibhūtāḥ

śokābhibhūtasya mamāśru deva
yāvatpramāṇaṃ na jalaṃ payodā
tāvatpramāṇaṃ na jalaṃ payodā
muñcanty anekair api varṣalakṣaiḥ

manye dharitrī paramāṇusaṃkhyām
upaiti pitror gaṇanāmaśeṣam
mitrāṇy amitrāṇy anujīvibandhūn
saṃkhyātam īśo 'smi na devadeva

so 'haṃ bhṛśārtaḥ karuṇāṃ kuru tvaṃ
saṃsāragātre patitasya viṣṇo
mahātmanāṃ saṃśrayam abhyupeto
naivāvasīdaty atidurgato 'pi

parāyaṇaṃ rogavatāṃ hi vaidyo
mahābdhimagnasya ca naur narasya
bālasya mātāpitarau sughora-
saṃsārakhinnasya hare tvam ekaḥ

prasīda sarveśvara sarvabhūta
sarvasya heto paramārthasāra
mām uddharāsmād uruduḥkhapaṅkāt
saṃsāragartāt svaparigraheṇa

dharmātmanām avikalāṃ tvayi nātha bhaktiṃ
śraddhāvatāṃ satatam udvahatāṃ vareṇya
kāryaṃ kiyan mama vimūḍhadhiyo 'dhamasya
bhūtvā kṛpālur amalām aja dehi buddhim

jñātvā yayākhilam asāram asāram eva
bhūtendriyādikam apāram amuktimūlam
māyāntareyam acalāṃ tava viśvarūpa
saṃmohitaṃ sakalam eva jagad yayaitat

brahmendrarudramarudaśvidivākarādyā
jñātuṃ na yaṃ paramaguhyatamaṃ samarthāḥ
na tvām alaṃ stutipatheṣv aham īśitāraṃ
stoṣyāmi mohakaluṣālpamatir manuṣyaḥ

yasmād idaṃ bhavati yatra jagat tathedaṃ
yasmiṃl layaṃ vrajati yaś ca jagatsvarūpaḥ
taṃ sargasaṃsthitivināśanimittabhūtaṃ
stotuṃ bhavantam alam īśa na kaścid asti

mūḍho 'yam alpamatir alpasuceṣṭito 'yaṃ
kliṣṭaṃ mano 'sya viṣayair na mayi prasaṅgi
itthaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru mayi praṇate kileśa
tvāṃ stotum ambujabhavo 'pi hi deva neśaḥ

yasyodare sakala eva mahīdhracandra-
devendrarudramarudaśvidivākarāgni-
bhūmyambuvāyugaganaṃ jagatāṃ samuhāṃ
stoṣyāmi taṃ stutipadaiḥ katamair bhavantam

yasyāgnirudrakamalodbhavavāsavādyaiḥ
svāṃśāvatārakaraṇeṣu sadāṅghriyugmam
abhyarcyate vada hare sa kathaṃ mayādya
saṃpūjitaḥ param upaiṣyasi toṣam īśa

na stotum acyuta bhavantam ahaṃ samartho
naivārcanair alam ahaṃ tava deva yogyaḥ
cittaṃ ca na tvayi samāhitam īśa doṣair
ākṣipyate kathaya kiṃ nu karomi pāpaḥ

tat tvaṃ prasīda bhagavan kuru mayy anāthe
viṣṇo kṛpāṃ paramakāruṇikaḥ kila tvam
saṃsārasāgaranimagnam ananta dīnam
uddhartum arhasi hare puruṣottamo 'si

itthaṃ tena naravyāghra
stuto bhaktimatā tataḥ
saṃsārabandhabhītena
kṛṣṇaḥ pratyakṣatāṃ yayau

sa taṃ pratyakṣam īśānam
anantam aparājitam
devadevam uvācedam
anādinidhanaṃ harim

śirasā dharaṇīṃ gatvā
yatavākkāyamānasaḥ
parāpareśvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ
jiṣṇum ādyam anopamam

divyākṣarapadānanta
prasanno bhagavān yadi
tad deva dehi dīnāya
mahyam ekam imaṃ varam

varaṃ varaya mattas tvaṃ
yat te manasi vartate
varārthināṃ dvijaśreṣṭha
nāphalaṃ mama darśanam

janmasaṃpaccitā deva
pāpasaṃpan mamākhilā
prayātu nāśam īśeśa
tvatprasādād adhokṣaja

bhaktibhāvapareṇādya
manmayena dvijottama
yaḥ stuto 'smi kṣayaṃ pāpaṃ
tenaivākhilam āgatam

asmatto varayehādya
dvijavaryāparaṃ varam
mayi bhaktimatām atra
loke kiṃcin na durlabham

dhanyo 'smi sarvanāthena
yatkṛto mayy anugrahaḥ
tad ekam eva tvatto 'haṃ
varam icchāmi keśava

nirdhūtasarvapāpebhyo
nātha puṇyakṣayān mama
tvatparasyāstu govinda
mā punar dehasaṃbhavaḥ

yad akṣaraṃ yad acalaṃ
vyāpi sūkṣmaṃ ca yat param
viśeṣāir aviśeṣaṃ ca
gaccheyaṃ tat padaṃ tava

evaṃ bhaviṣyatīty uktvā
prasādasumukhas tataḥ
bhūpāla taṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ
gato 'ntardhānam īśvaraḥ

tatprasādād dvijaḥ so 'pi
tanmayas tadvyapāśrayaḥ
prakṣīṇakarmabandhas tu
prayātaḥ paramaṃ padam

evam akṣīṇapāpo 'pi
jagatām īśvareśvaram
vyapāśrito hariṃ yāti
pāpamuktaḥ paraṃ padam

etat tvayā nāvratine
na cāśuśrūṣave param
ākhyeyaṃ rājaśārdūla
yaś ca nārcayate harim

viṣṇubhaktāya dāntāya
vratine puṇyaśīline
kathanīyam idaṃ bhūpa
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ hareḥ

bahuśo bhavatā proktaṃ
sāṃprataṃ ca yad īritam
śrotum icchāmi viprendra
tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam

yatsvarūpaṃ yadādhāraṃ
yatpramāṇaṃ yadātmakam
sarvadhātuḥ padaṃ tan me
śrotum icchā pravartate

sādhv etad bhavatā pṛṣṭaṃ
pṛṣṭam ātmajñānasamāśritam
tat kathyamānam ekāgraḥ
śṛṇu viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam

yat tad brahma yataḥ sarvaṃ
yad sarvaṃ sarvasaṃsthitiḥ
agrāhyakam anirdeśyaṃ
tad eva bhagavatpadam

tatsvarūpaṃ ca rājendra
śṛṇuṣveha samāhitaḥ
viṣṇoḥ padasyāvyayasya
brahmaṇo gadato mama

pradhānādiviśeṣāntaṃ
yad etat paṭhyate jagat
carācarasya tasyādyaṃ
paraṃ brahma vilakṣaṇam

janmasvapnādirūpādi-
duḥkhādirahitaṃ ca yat
nopacaryam anirdeśyaṃ
svapratiṣṭhaṃ ca tat param

kṣīṇakleśās tu saṃsāra-
vimuktipatham āśritāḥ
yoginas tat prapaśyanti
samarthā naiva coditum

tat sarvaṃ sarvabhāvasthaṃ
viśeṣeṇa vivarjitam
paśyatām apy anirdeśyaṃ
yato vāgviṣaye na tat

kurvanty ālambanatvena
yatprāptyarthaṃ ca devatāḥ
brahma prakāśate teṣāṃ
tad vareṇaiva sarvagam

pradhānādiviśeṣāntaṃ
yatraitad akhilaṃ jagat
tasyānantasya kaḥ śaktaḥ
pramāṇaṃ gadituṃ naraḥ

sūkṣmāṇāṃ tat paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ
sthūlānāṃ tan mahattaram
sarvavyāpy api rājendra
dūrasthaṃ cāntike ca tat

parāṅmukhānāṃ govinde
viṣayākrāntacetasām
teṣāṃ tat paramaṃ brahma
dūrād dūratare sthitam

na prāpnuvanti gacchanto
yato janmāyutair api
saṃsārādhvani rājendra
tato dūratare hi tat

tanmayatvena govinde
ya narā nyastacetasaḥ
viṣayatyāginas teṣāṃ
vijñeyaṃ ca tadantike

sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaṃ
sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham
sarvataḥ śrutimal loke
sarvam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati

sarvendriyagunābhāsaṃ
sarvendriyavivarjitam
asaktaṃ sarvabhṛc cainan
nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca

avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu
vibhaktam iva ca sthitam
bhūtabhartṛ ca taj jñeyaṃ
grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca

jyotiṣām api taj jyotis
tamasaḥ param ucyate
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ
hṛdi sarvasy adhiṣṭhitam

tac cādyo jagatām īśaḥ
pareśaḥ parameśvaraḥ
parāparasvarūpeṇa
viṣṇuḥ sarvahṛdi sthitaḥ

yajñeśaṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ
kecid icchanti tatparam
kecid viṣṇuṃ hariṃ kecit
kecit keśavasaṃjñitam

kecid govindanāmānaṃ
puṇḍarīkākṣam acyutam
kecij janārdanaṃ tv anye
vadanti puruṣottamam

kecid viriñciṃ brāhmaṇam
abjayoniṃ tathāpare
śarvam īśam ajaṃ rudraṃ
śūlinaṃ cāpare nṛpa

varuṇaṃ kecid ādityam
indram agnim athāpare
yamaṃ dhaneśam apare
somam anye prajāpatim

hiraṇyagarbhaṃ kapilaṃ
kṣetrajñaṃ kālam īśvaram
svabhāvam antarātmānam
ātmānaṃ buddhirūpiṇam
vadanti nāmabhiś cānyair
anāmānam arūpiṇam

śrūyatāṃ tu naravyāghra
vedavedāntaniścayaḥ
yajñeśo yajñapuruṣo
puṇḍarīkākṣasaṃjñitaḥ

tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ brahma
yato nāvartate punaḥ
sa eva rudraś candro 'gniḥ
sūryo vaiśravaṇo yamaḥ

brahmā prajāpatiḥ kālaḥ
svabhāvo buddhir eva ca
kṣetrajñākhyas tathaivānyāḥ
saṃjñābhiḥ procyate budhaiḥ

saṃjñā tu tasya naivāsti
na rūpaṃ nāpi kalpanā
sa sarvabhūtānugataḥ
paramātmā sanātanaḥ

ākhyātaṃ bhavatā brahmann
etad brahma sanātanam
yasmād utpadyate kṛtsnaṃ
jagad etac carācaram

kiṃtu kautukam atrāsti
mama bhārgavanandana
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi
tvattaḥ saṃdeham uttamam

yad etad bhavatākhyātaṃ
brahma brahmavidāṃ vara
pariṇāmo na tasyāsti
nirguṇaṃ sarvagaṃ yataḥ

sanātanāt sarvagatāt
pariṇāmavivarjitāt
kathaṃ saṃjāyate kṛtsnaṃ
tasmād apaguṇād api

dvividhaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhūpa
nibodha gadato mama
nimittakāraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ
dvitīyaṃ pariṇāmi ca

yathā kumbhasya karaṇe
kulālaḥ prathamaṃ nṛpa
kāraṇaṃ pariṇāmākhyaṃ
mṛddravyam aparaṃ smṛtam

dharmādharmādayas tadvaj
jagatsṛṣṭer mahīpate
kāraṇaṃ pariṇāmākhyaṃ
nimittākhyaṃ tu tat param

kāraṇaṃ kālagagane
yathā saṃnidhimātrataḥ
avikāritayā brahma
tathā sṛṣṭer nareśvara

kurvadbhir nṛpate karma
kartṛtvam upacārataḥ
kriyate sarvabhūtasya
sarvagasyāvyayātmanaḥ

yataḥ saṃbandhavān ebhir
aśeṣaiḥ prāṇibhiḥ prabhuḥ
kartṛtvam upacāreṇa
tatas tasyāpi bhūpate

bhedābhedasvarūpeṇa
tatra brahma vyavasthitam
tayoḥ svarūpaṃ nṛpate
śrūyatām ubhayor api

anādisaṃbandhavatyā
kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetravidyayā
vyāptaḥ paśyaty abhedena
brahma tad dhy ātmani sthitam

paśyatv ātmānam anyatra
yāvad vai paramātmanaḥ
tāvat saṃbhrāmyate jantur
mohito nijakarmaṇā

saṃkṣīnāśeṣakarmā tu
paraṃ brahma prapaśyati
abhedenātmanaḥ śuddhaṃ
śuddhatvād akṣayo 'kṣayam

bhedaś ca karmajanitaḥ
kṣetrajñaparamātmanoḥ
saṃkṣīṇakarmabandhasya
na bhedo brahmaṇā saha

upāsyopāsyakatayā
bhedo yair api kathyate
tau hi śuddhyartham icchanti
malānāṃ tad upāsanam
paro 'sāv apareṇātmā
saṃtyaktamamatena tu
upāsyate tadā so 'pi
tadbhāvaṃ pratipadyate

karmiṇāṃ karmabhedena
bhedād evādayo yataḥ
karmakṣayād aśeṣāṇāṃ
bhedānāṃ saṃkṣayas tataḥ

avidyā tu kriyā sarvā
vidyā jñānaṃ pracakṣate
karmaṇā jāyate jantur
vidyayā tu vimucyate

advaitaṃ paramārtho hi
dvaitaṃ tadbheda ucyate
ubhayaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ
dvaitādvaitavibhedataḥ
tayoḥ svarūpaṃ vadato
nibodha mama pārthiva

devatiryaṅmanuṣyākhyas
tathaiva nṛpa tārakaḥ
caturvidho hi bhedo yo
mithyājñānanibandhanaḥ

aham anyo 'paraś cāyam
amī cātra tathāpare
vijñānam etat tad dvaitaṃ
yad anyac chrūyatāṃ param

mametyahamitiprajñā-
viyuktam avikalpavat
avikāram anākhyeyam
advaitam api bhūpate

abhedena tavākhyātaṃ
yad etad brahma śāśvatam
jñānajñeyaikyasadbhāvaṃ
tad evādvaitasaṃjñitam

yaś ca dvaite prapañcaḥ syān
nivartyobhayacetasaḥ
manovṛttimayaṃ dvaitam
advaitaṃ paramārthataḥ

manaso vṛttayas tasmād
dharmādharmanimittajāḥ
nirodhavyās tannirodhād
dvaitaṃ naivopapadyate

manodṛśyam idaṃ dvaitaṃ
yat kiṃcit sacarācaram
manaso hy amatībhāve
dvaitābhāvāt tad āpnuyāt

mano hi viṣayaṃ yadvad
ādatte tadvad eva tat
bhavaty apāstaviṣayaṃ
grāhidharme ca jāyate

agrāhi tac ca vidhṛtaṃ
yogināṃ viṣayaṃ prati
nirodhe yogasāmarthyād
brahmagrāhy eva jāyate

grāhyaṃ ca paramaṃ brahma
yogicittasya pārthiva
samujjhitagrāhyavṛttir
amalasya malaṃ mahat

ye 'pi karmāṇi kurvanti
bhagavantam apāśritāḥ
kriyāyogaparā rājan
kāmākāṅkṣāvivarjitāḥ
brahmaniṣṭhā dhyānaparā
brahmaṇy eva vyavasthitāḥ
te 'pi tadbhāvam āyānti
vimuktipatham āśritāḥ

yoginas taṃ prapaśyanti
samarthā naiva coditum

karmaṇo bhāvanā yeyaṃ
sā brahmaparipanthinī
karmabhāvanayā tulyaṃ
vijñānam upapadyate

tādṛg bhavato vijñaptir
yādṛśī karmabhāvanā
kṣaye tasyāḥ paraṃ brahma
svayam eva prakāśate

evam etan mayā bhūpa
yathāvat kathitaṃ tava
dvaitādvaitasvarūpeṇa
yathā brahma vyavasthitam

svarūpaṃ brahmaṇaś coktam
ubhayatrāpi te pṛthak
vāsudevamayasyānyat
kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te

ākhyātaṃ bhagavan samyak
paraṃ brahma tvayā mama
viṣṇur eva jagaddhātā
yogināṃ vartate yataḥ

upāyas tasya yaḥ prāpto
viṣṇor īśasya bhārgava
advaitadvaitarūpasya
tan me vistarato vada

yena janmajarāmṛtyu-
mahāgrāhabhavārṇavam
tvadvākyanāvam āruhya
muktitīram avāpnuyām

tan mama brūhi tattvena
prāpnuyāṃ yena tat padam

bandhaḥ karmamayo hy atra
yathāmuktivighātakṛt
tasyāpagamane yatnaḥ
kāryaḥ saṃsārabhīruṇā

suvarṇādimahādāna-
puṇyatīrthāvagāhanaiḥ
śārīraiś ca tathā kleśaiḥ
śāstroktais tacchamo bhavet

devatāstutisacchāstra-
śravaṇaiḥ puṇyadarśanaiḥ
guruśuśrūṣaṇāc caiva
pāpabandhaḥ praṇaśyati

prapākūpataḍāgāni
devatāyatanāni ca
kārayan puruṣavyāghra
pāpabandhāt pramucyate

yoginām atha śuśrūṣāṃ
tathaivāvasathān nṛpa
kurvan pūrtāśritaṃ cānyat
pāpabandhāt pramucyate

viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇo vāsudevo
govindaḥ puṣkarekṣaṇaḥ
ityādi vyāharan nityaṃ
pāpabandhāt pramucyate

viśvo viśveśvaro viśva-
vidhātā dhāma śāśvatam
viṣṇur ityādi ca japan
pāpabandhāt pramucyate

padmanābho hṛṣīkeśaḥ
keśavo madhusūdanaḥ
ityādi vyāharan nityaṃ
pāpabandhāt pramucyate

nārāyaṇaś cakradharo
viśvarūpas trivikramaḥ
ityādi vyāharan nityaṃ
pāpabandhāt pramucyate

viṣṇau pratiṣṭhitaṃ viśvaṃ
viṣṇur viśve pratiṣṭhitaḥ
viṣṇur viśveśvaro viśvam
iti bhāvāt pramucyate

evaṃ saṃśāntapāpasya
puṇyavṛddhimato nṛpa
icchā pravartate pūṃso
muktidāyiṣu karmasu

muktidāyīni karmāṇi
niṣkāmena kṛtāni tu
bhavanti doṣakṣayakāḥ
puṇyabandhāt pramucyate

nityanaimittikānīha
karmāṇy uktāni yāni vai
teṣāṃ niṣkāmakāraṇāt
puṇyabandhaḥ praśāmyati

anekajanmasaṃsāra-
citasyāpi dṛḍhātmanaḥ
karmabandhasya śaithilya-
kāraṇaṃ cāparaṃ śṛṇu

ahiṃsā nātimānitvam
adambhitvam amatsaram
titikṣā samadarśitvaṃ
maitryādau daṇḍasaṃyamaḥ

ṛjutvam indriyajayaḥ
śaucam ācāryapūjanam
puṇyastavādipaṭhanam
apaiśunyam akatthanam

viṣayān prati vairāgyam
anahaṃkāram eva ca
akāmitvaṃ manaḥsthairyam
adrohaḥ sarvajantuṣu

avivādas tathā mūḍhair
amūḍhaiḥ praśnasatkathā
viviktadeśe 'bhiratir
mahājanavivarjanam

sadbhiḥ sahāsya satataṃ
yogābhyāso mitoktitā
strībhartsotsavasaṃlāpa-
vivarjanam avekṣaṇam

parayoṣidvilāsānāṃ
kāvyālāpavivarjanam
gītavāditanṛtteṣu
mṛdaṅgeṣv apareṣu ca

asaktir manaso maunam
ātmatattvāvalokanam
tapaḥ saṃtoṣaḥ satyeṣu
sthitir lobhavivarjanam

tathā parigraho rājan
māyāvyājavivarjanam
asṛṅmāṃsādibhūtatvān
nijadehajugupsanam

sarvāṇy etāni bhūtāni
viṣṇur ity acalā matiḥ
tatraivāśeṣabhūteśe
bhaktir avyabhicāriṇī

ete guṇā mayākhyātā
manonirvṛtikārakāḥ
śaithilyahetavaś caite
karmabandhasya pūrthiva

ebhiḥ śāntiṃ gate citte
dhyānākṛṣṭaḥ sthito hariḥ
śamaṃ nayati karmāṇi
sitamiśrāsitāni vai

bhūyaś ca śṛṇu śāstrārthaṃ
saṃkṣepād vadato mama
yathā saṃprāpyate muktir
manujendra mumukṣubhiḥ

nityanaimittikānāṃ tu
niṣkāmasya hi yā kriyā
nisiddhānāṃ sakāmānāṃ
tathaivākaraṇaṃ nṛpa

sarveśvare ca govinde
bhaktir avyabhicāriṇī
prayacchati nṛṇāṃ muktiṃ
mā te bhūd atra saṃśayaḥ

ākhyātam etad akhilaṃ
yat pṛṣṭo 'si mayā dvija
jāyate śamakāmānāṃ
praśamaḥ karmaṇāṃ yathā

kiṃtv atra bhavatā proktā
praśāntiḥ sarvakarmaṇām
nātyantanāśaḥ śāntānām
udbhavo bhavitā punaḥ
nijakāraṇam āsādya
stokasyāgner yathā tṛṇam

tad ācakṣva mahābhāga
prasādasumukho mama
saṃkṣayo yena bhavati
mūlodvartena karmaṇām

na karmaṇāṃ kṣayo bhūpa
janmanām ayutair api
karmakṣayam ṛte yogād
yogāgniḥ kṣapayet param

taṃ yogaṃ mama viprarṣe
praṇatasyābhiyācataḥ
tvam ācakṣva kṣayo yena
jāyate 'khilakarmaṇām

hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān
anādir munibhiḥ purā
pṛṣṭaḥ provāca yaṃ yogaṃ
taṃ samāsena me śṛṇu

anādikālaprasṛtā
yathā vidyā mahīpate
tathā tatkṣayahetutvād
yogo vidyāmayo 'vyayaḥ

taṃ paraṃparayā śrutvā
munayo 'tra dayālavaḥ
prakāśayanti bhūtānām
upakāracikīrṣavaḥ

devā maharṣayo rājaṃs
tathā rājarṣayo 'khilāḥ
śreyo'rthinaḥ purā jagmuḥ
śaraṇaṃ kapilaṃ kila

te tam ūcur bhavān nityaṃ
dayāluḥ sarvajantuṣu
so 'smān uddhara saṃmagnān
itaḥ saṃsārakardamāt

yac chreyaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ
strīṇām apy upakārakam
yasmāt parataraṃ nānyac
śreyas tad brūhi naḥ prabho

ādāv ante ca madhye ca
nṝṇāṃ yad upakārakam
api kīṭapataṃgānāṃ
tan naḥ śreyaḥ paraṃ vada

ity uktaḥ kapilaḥ sarvair
devair devarṣibhis tathā
nāsti yogāt paraṃ śreyaḥ
kiṃcid ity uktavān purā

yathā janmāyutaiḥ kleśāḥ
sthairyaṃ cetasy upāgatāḥ
tacchāntaye tathā yogo
bahujanmārjito bhavet

sa evābhyasatāṃ nṝṇāṃ
tīvrasaṃvegicetasām
āsannatāṃ prayāty āśu
viṣṇuḥ saṃnyastakarmaṇām

brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ
strīśūdrasya ca pāvanam
śāntaye karmaṇāṃ nānyad
yogād asti hi muktaye

abhyastaṃ janmabhir naikaiḥ
śubhajātibhaveṣu yat
yogasvarūpaṃ tat teṣāṃ
strīśūdratve vyavasthitam

yogābhyāso nṛṇāṃ yeṣāṃ
nāsti janmāntarāhṛtaḥ
yogasya prāptaye teṣāṃ
śūdravaiśyādikaḥ kramaḥ

strītvāc chūdratvam abhyeti
tato vaiśyatvam āpnuyāt
tataś ca kṣatriyo vipraḥ
kriyāhīnas tato bhavet

anūcānas tathā yajvī
karmanyāsī tataḥ param
tato jñānitvam abhyetya
yogī muktiṃ kramāl labhet

yeṣāṃ tu jātimātreṇa
yogābhyāsas tirohitaḥ
āste tatraiva mucyante
jātihetau kṣayaṃgate

asatkarma kṛtaṃ pūrvam
asajjātipradāyi yat
tasmin yogāgninā dagdhe
tasya jāter balaṃ kutaḥ

yathā vāteritaḥ kakṣaṃ
dahaty ūrdhvaśikho 'nalaḥ
sarvakarmāṇi yogāgnir
bhasmasāt kurute tathā

yathā dagdhatuṣaṃ bījam
abījatvān na jāyate
yogadagdhais tathā kleśair
nātmā saṃjāyate punaḥ

adṛṣṭā dṛṣṭatattvānāṃ
yogināṃ yogavicyutiḥ
yeṣāṃ bhavati yogitvaṃ
prāpnuvantīha te punaḥ

sajjātiprāpakaṃ karma
kṛtaṃ tena tadātmanā
jātiṃ prayānti viprādyā
yogakarmānurañjitāḥ

tatrāpy anekajanmottha-
yogābhyāsānurañjitāḥ
tenaivābhyāsayogena
hriyante tattvavidyayā

jaigīṣavyo yathā vipro
yathā caivāsitādayaḥ
hiraṇyanābho rājanyas
tathā vai janakādayaḥ

pūrvābhyastena yogena
tulādhārādayo viśaḥ
saṃprāptāḥ paramāṃ siddhiṃ
śūdrāḥ pailavakādayaḥ

maitreyī sulabhā gārgī
śāṇḍilī ca tapasvinī
strītve prāptāḥ parāṃ siddhim
anyajanmasamādhitaḥ

dharmavyādhādayo 'py anye
pūrvābhyāsāj jugupsite
varṇāvaratve saṃprāptāḥ
saṃsiddhiṃ śravaṇī tathā

pūrvābhyastaṃ ca tat teṣāṃ
yogajñānaṃ mahātmanām
suptotthitapratyayavad
upadeśādinā vinā

tasmād yogaḥ paraṃ śreyo
vimuktiphalado hi yaḥ
vimuktau sukham atyantaṃ
saṃmohas tv itarat sukham

etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ
mayā manujakuñjara
śreyaḥ parataraṃ yogāt
kiṃcid anyan na vidyate

kathitaṃ yogamāhātmyaṃ
bhavatā munisattama
svarūpaṃ tu na me proktaṃ
śrotum icchāmi tad dhy aham

dvaividhyaṃ nṛpa yogasya
paraṃ cāparam eva ca
tac chṛṇuṣva vadāmy eṣa
vācyaṃ śuśrūṣatāṃ satām

yo dadyād bhagavajjñānaṃ
kuryād vā dharmadeśanām
kṛtsnāṃ vā pṛthivīṃ dadyān
na tattulyaṃ kathaṃcana

kṣayiṣṇūny aparāṇīha
dānāni manujādhipa
ekam evākṣayaṃ śastaṃ
jñānadānam anuttamam

dānāny ekaphalānīha
trailokye dadatā satām
jñānaṃ prayacchatā samyak
kiṃ na dattaṃ bhaven nṛpa

jñānāny anyāny asārāṇi
śilpinīva nareśvara
ekam eva paraṃ jñānaṃ
yad yogaprāptikārakam

ahaṃ vaktā bhavāñ śrotā
vācyo yogo vimuktidaḥ
prāṇinām upakārāya
saṃpad eṣā guṇādhikā

pareṇa brahmaṇā sārdham
ekatvaṃ yan nṛpātmanaḥ
sa eva yogo vikhyātaḥ
kim anyad yogalakṣaṇam

aparaṃ ca paraṃ caiva
dvau yogau pṛthivīpate
tayoḥ svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi
tad ihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu

sattāmātraṃ paraṃ brahma
viṣṇvākhyam aviśeṣaṇam
durvicintyaṃ yataḥ pūrvaṃ
tatprāptyartham athocyate

vātālīcañcalaṃ cittam
anālambanam asthiti
sūkṣmatvād brahmaṇo rājann
agrāhy agrāhyadharmiṇaḥ

samyag abhyasyato 'jasram
upavṛṃhitaśaktimat
janmāntaraśatair vāpi
brahmagrāhy abhijāyate

yady antarāya doṣeṇa
nāpakarṣo narādhipa
yogino yogarūḍhasya
tālāgrāt patanaṃ yathā

jñānaṃ prayacchatāṃ samyak
kiṃ vadatu bhaven nṛpa

tad āpnoti paraṃ brahma
kleśena mahatā nṛpa
janmābhyāsāntarotthena
vijñānena samedhitaḥ

viṣṇvākhyaṃ brahma duṣprāpaṃ
viṣayākṛṣṭacetasā
manuṣyeṇeti tatprāptāv
upāyam aparaṃ śṛṇu

surūpāṃ pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ
prasannavadanekṣaṇām
kṛtvātmanaḥ prītikarīṃ
suvarṇarajatādibhiḥ

tasyāś ca lakṣaṇaṃ bhūpa
śṛṇuṣva gadato mama
yaddravyā yatsvarūpā ca
kartavyā dhyānakarmaṇi

suvarṇarūpyatāmrais tu
ārakūṭamayīṃ tathā
śailadārumṛdā vāpi
lekhyajāṃ vāpi kārayet

kāryas tu viṣṇur bhagavān
saumyarūpaś caturbhujaḥ
salilādhmātameghābhaḥ
śrīmāñ śrīvatsabhūṣitaḥ

ābaddhamakuṭaḥ sragvī
hārabhārārpitodaraḥ
svakṣeṇa cārucipukaḥ
sulalāṭena subhruṇā

svoṣṭhena sukapolena
vadanena virājatā
kaṇṭhena śubhalekhena
varābharaṇadhāriṇā

madhyena trivalībhaṅga-
bhūṣitena ca cāruṇā
supādaḥ sūruyugalaḥ
sukaṭīgulphajānukaḥ

vāmapārśve gadādevī
cakraṃ devasya dakṣiṇe
śaṅkho vāmakare deyo
dakṣiṇe padma suprabham

ūrdhvadṛṣṭim adhodṛṣṭiṃ
tiryagdṛṣṭiṃ na kārayet
nimīlitākṣo bhagavān
na praśasto janārdanaḥ
saumyā tu dṛṣṭiḥ kartavyā
kiṃcit prahasiteva ca

kāryaś caraṇavinyāsaḥ
sarvataḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ
caraṇāntarasaṃsthā ca
bibhratī rūpam uttamam
kāryā vasuṃdharā devī
tatpādataladhāriṇī

yādṛgvidhā vā manasaḥ
sthairyalambhopapādikā
nṛsiṃhavāmanādīnāṃ
tādṛśīṃ kārayed budhaḥ

brahma tasyāṃ samāropya
manasā tanmayo bhavet
tām ārcayet tāṃ praṇamet
tāṃ smaret tāṃ vicintayet

tām arcayaṃs tāṃ praṇamaṃs
tāṃ smaraṃs tāṃ ca cintayan
viśaty apāstadoṣas tu
tām eva brahmarūpiṇīm

saṃkalpanakriyārūḍhaḥ
svarūpeṇa nṛpātmanaḥ
kurvīta bhāvanāṃ tatra
tadbhāvotpattikāraṇāt
nānyatra manasāneyā
buddhir īṣad api kvacit

yamaiś ca niyamaiś caiva
pūtātmā pṛthivīśvara
mūrtiṃ bhagavataḥ saṃyak
pūjayet tanmayaḥ sadā

yamāṃś ca niyamāṃś caiva
śrotum icchāmi bhārgava
yair dhūtakalmaṣo yogī
muktibhāg upajāyate

ahiṃsā satyam asteyaṃ
brahmacaryāparigrahau
yamās tavaite kathitā
niyamān api me śṛṇu

saṃtoṣaśaucasvādhyāyās
tapaś ceśvarabhāvanā
niyamāḥ kauravaśreṣṭha
yogasaṃsiddhihetavaḥ

ebhir mūlaguṇaiḥ sadbhir
viṣṇor bhaktimatas tathā
śraddadhānasya cānyāni
yogāṅgāni nibodha me

madhyamaprāṇam acalaṃ
sukhadāyi śubhaṃ śuci
yogasaṃsiddhaye bhūpa
yoginām āsanaṃ smṛtam

prāṇāyāmas tridhā vāyoḥ
prāṇasya hṛdi dhāraṇam
kumbharecakapūrākhyās
tasya bhedās trayo nṛpa

ete nibodha mātrās tu
nālambanaguṇānvitāḥ
sālambanaś caturtho 'nyo
bāhyāntarviṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ

indriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayād
buddhiḥ pratyekaśas tu yat
karoty āharaṇaṃ jñeyaḥ
pratyāhāraḥ sa paṇḍitaiḥ

śubhe hy ekatra viṣaye
cetaso yac ca dhāraṇam
niścalatvāt tu sā sadbhir
dhāraṇety abhidhīyate

paunaḥpunyena tatraiva
viṣaye saiva dhāraṇā
dhyānākhyā labhate rājan
samādhim api me śṛṇu

arthamātraṃ ca yad grāhye
cittam ādāya pārthiva
arthasvarūpavad bhāti
samādhiḥ so 'bhidhīyate

kathitāni tavaitāni
yogāṅgāni kṛtais tu yaiḥ
utkarṣo jāyate vyastaiḥ
samastair heyasaṃkṣayaḥ

yogāṅgāny aṅgabhūtāni
dhyānasyaitāny aśeṣataḥ
dhyānam apy avanīpāla
yogasyāṅgatvam archati

dhyānam ekavratānāṃ tu
kuśalākuśaleṣu tat
artheṣv āśaktim abhyeti
sarvadaiva nareśvara

śubhāvyāvartitaṃ dhyānam
avivekasya jāyate
saṃsāraduḥkhadaṃ rājann
aśubhālambi tad yataḥ

tad evākṛṣya duṣṭebhyo
viṣayebhyaḥ śubhāśubham
sarvasaṃsārakāntāra-
pāram abhyeti mānavaḥ

duḥkhadāghapraśamane
yā cintāharniśaṃ nṛṇām
taddhyānam aviśuddhārthaṃ
sukhadānām apālane

kathaṃ saṃsārabandho 'yam
asmān muktiḥ kathaṃ tv iti
manovṛttir manuṣyāṇāṃ
dhyānam etac chubhaṃ dvidhā

śuddham apy etad akhilaṃ
lobhakāryatayānayā
sukhābhilāṣo yanmuktau
bandhuduḥkhādipīḍanāt

avāñchitaphalaṃ lobham
alobhāṃśavivarjitam
śubhāśubhaphalaṃ dhyānam
araktaṃ dviṣṭam iṣyate

dṛṣṭānumānāgamikaṃ
dhyānasyālambanaṃ tridhā
na hi nirviṣayaṃ dhyānaṃ
mūḍhavṛttir iveṣyate

prāk sthūleṣu padārtheṣu
tataḥ sūkṣmeṣu paṇḍitaḥ
dhyānaṃ kurvīta tatpaścāt
paramāṇau mahīpate

dhyānābhyāsaparasyaivaṃ
heyālambanabādhane
tacchāntaye tadvipakṣa-
bhāvanām eva bhāvayet

taccittas tanmayo jñānī
bhavaty asmān na doṣavat
kurvītālambanaṃ kāle
kasmiṃścid api pārthiva

yatas tato na te dhyāne
dhyāninām upakārakāḥ
avidyāntargatāḥ sarve
te hi saṃsāragocarāḥ

paścād udbhūtabodhāś ca
dhyātā naivopakārakāḥ
naisargiko na vai bodhas
teṣām apy anyato yataḥ

tasmāt tad amalaṃ brahma
nisargād eva bodhavat
dhyeyaṃ dhyānavidāṃ samyag
yad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam

na tad yajñair na dānena
na tapobhir na tad vrataiḥ
paśyanty ekāgramanaso
dhyānenaiva sanātanam

tac ca viṣṇoḥ paraṃ rūpam
anirdeśyam ajaṃ sthiram
yataḥ pravartate sarvaṃ
layam abhyeti yatra ca

anidram ajam asvapnam
arūpānāma śāśvatam
yoginas taṃ prapaśyanti
jñānadṛśyaṃ sanātanam

nirdhūtapuṇyapāpā ye
te viśanty evam īśvaram

tac ca sarvagataṃ brahma
viṣṇuḥ sarveśvareśvaraḥ
paramātmā paraḥ proktaḥ
sarvakāraṇakāraṇam

anantaśaktim īśeśaṃ
svapratiṣṭham anopamam
yoginas taṃ prapaśyanti
bhagavantaṃ sanātanam

yatra sarvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ
yaḥ sarvaṃ sarvataś ca yaḥ
yoginas taṃ prapaśyanti
bhagavantaṃ sanātanam

sargādikāraṇaṃ yasya
svabhāvād eva śaktayaḥ
yoginas taṃ prapaśyanti
bhagavantaṃ sanātanam

nirdhūtapuṇyapāpā yaṃ
viśanty avyayam īśvaram
yoginas taṃ prapaśyanti
bhagavantaṃ sanātanam

tatra yogavataḥ samyak
puruṣasya nareśvara
yad uktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tan me
gadataḥ śrotum arhasi

brahmaṇy eva sthitaṃ cittaṃ
sarvataḥ saṃnivartitam
nānyālambanasāpekṣaṃ
yoginaḥ siddhikārakam

saṃsthānam avikāreṇa
cetaso brahmasaṃsthitau
nivāta iva dīpasya
yoginaḥ siddhilakṣaṇam

evam ekāgracittasya
puṇyāpuṇyam aśeṣataḥ
prayāti saṃkṣayam ṛte
dehārambhakare nṛpa

dehārambhakarasyāpi
karmaṇaḥ saṃkṣayāvahaḥ
yo yogaḥ pṛthivīpāla
śṛṇu tasyāpi lakṣaṇam

yat tad brahma paraṃ proktaṃ
viṣṇvākhyam ajam avyayam
cetasaḥ pralayas tatra
yoga ity abhidhīyate

yogasevānirodhena
pralīne tatra cetasi
puruṣaḥ kāranābhāvād
bhedaṃ naivānupaśyati

parātmanor manuṣyendra
vibhāgo jñānakalpitaḥ
kṣaye tasyātmaparayor
vibhāgābhāga eva hi

paramātmātmanor yo 'yam
avibhāgaḥ paraṃtapa
sa eva paramo yogaḥ
samāsāt kathitas tava

yathā kamaṇḍalau bhinne
tattoyaṃ salile gatam
vrajaty aikyaṃ tathaivaitad
ubhayaṃ kāraṇakṣayāt

yathāgnir agnau saṃkṣiptaḥ
samānatvam anuvrajet
tadākhyas tanmayo bhūtvā
gṛhyate na viśeṣataḥ

evaṃ brahmātmanor yogād
akatvam upapannayoḥ
na bhedaḥ kalaśākāśa-
nabhasor iva jāyate

prakṣīṇāśeṣakarmā tu
yadā brahmamayaḥ pumān
tadā svarūpam asyokter
gocare nopapadyate

ghaṭadhvaṃse ghaṭākāśaṃ
na bhinnaṃ nabhaso yathā
brahmaṇā heyavidhvaṃse
viṣṇvākhyena pumāṃs tathā

bhinne dṛtau yathā vāyur
naivānyaḥ saha vāyunā
kṣīṇapuṇyāghabandhas tu
tathātmā brahmaṇā saha

tataḥ samastakalyāṇa-
samastasukhasaṃpadām
āhlādam anyam atulaṃ
kam apy āpnoti śāśvatam

brahmasvarūpasya tadā hy
ātmano nityadaiva saḥ
vyuttānakāle rājendra
āste heyatirohitaḥ

ādarśasya malābhāvād
vaimalyaṃ kāśate yathā
jñānāgnidagdhaheyasya
so 'hlādo hy ātmanas tathā

yathā na kriyate jyotsnā
malaprakṣālanādinā
doṣaprahāṇaṃ na jñānam
ātmanaḥ kriyate tathā

yathodupānakaraṇāt
kriyate na jalāmbaram
sadaiva nīyate vyaktim
asataḥ saṃbhavaḥ kutaḥ

yathā heyagaṇadhvaṃsād
avabodhādayo guṇāḥ
prakāśyante na janyante
nityā evātmano hite

jñānavairāgyam aiśvaryaṃ
dharmaś ca manujeśvara
ātmano brahmabhūtasya
nityam eva catuṣṭayam

etad advaitam ākhyātam
eṣa yogas tavoditaḥ
ayaṃ viṣṇur idaṃ brahma
tathaitat satyam uttamam

punaś ca śrūyatām eṣa
saṃkṣepād gadato mama
nānādvaikatvavijñāna-
svarūpam avanīpate

ātmā kṣetrajñasaṃjño 'yaṃ
saṃyuktaḥ prākṛtair guṇaiḥ
tair eva vigataiḥ śuddhaḥ
paramātmā nigadyate

dhyeyaṃ brahma pumān dhyātā
upāyo dhyānasaṃjñitaḥ
yas tv etat karaṇeṣv āste
tadvarge kā vibhāgatā

saṃkṣepād api bhūpāla
saṃkṣepan aparaṃ śṛṇu
putrāya yat pitā brūyāt
svaśiṣyāyāthavā guruḥ

na vāsudevāt param asti kiṃcin
na vāsudevād gaditaṃ paraṃ ca
satyaṃ paraṃ vāsudevo 'mitātmā
namo namo vāsudevāya nityam

tasmāt tam ārādhaya cintayeśam
abhyarcayānantam atandritātmā
saṃsārapāraṃ param īpsamānair
ārādhanīyo harir eka eva

ārādhito 'rthān dhanakāṅkṣakānāṃ
dharmārthināṃ dharmam aśeṣadharmī
dadāti kāmāṃś ca manoniviṣṭān
mokṣārthināṃ muktida eva viṣṇuḥ

mamaitat kathitaṃ samyag
ātmavidyāśritaṃ mune
yat tv anyac chrotum icchāmi
tat prasanno vadasva me

yeyaṃ muktir bhagavatā
proktā varṇakramān mama
tatrecchāmi mune śrotuṃ
varṇād varṇottarocchrayam

śūdro vaiśyatvam abhyeti
kathaṃ vaiśyaś ca bhārgava
kṣatriyatvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha
brāhmaṇatvaṃ kathaṃ tataḥ

vipratvān muktiyogyatvaṃ
yathā yāti mahāmune
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi
tvatto bhārgavanandana

tvadyukto 'yam anupraśnaḥ
kuruvarya śṛṇuṣva tam
mayocyamānam akhilaṃ
varṇānām upakārakam

śūdradharmān aśeṣeṇa
kurvañ śūdro yathāvidhi
vaiśyatvam eti vaiśyaś ca
kṣatriyatvaṃ svakarmakṛt

vipratvaṃ kṣatriyaḥ samyag
dvijadharmaparo nṛpa
vipraś ca muktilābhena
yujyate satkriyāparaḥ

sarveṣām eva varṇānāṃ
svadharmam anuvartatām
sadocchritir nyūnakṛto
hāniś cotkṛṣṭakarmaṇaḥ

teṣāṃ ca brāhmaṇādīnāṃ
varṇadharmān anukramāt
samucchritipradān rājan
gadato me niśāmaya

anasūyā dayā kṣāntiḥ
śaucaṃ maṅgalam aspṛhā
akārpaṇyam anāyāsas
tathānyaḥ sārvavarṇikaḥ

aṣṭāv ete guṇāḥ puṃsāṃ
paratreha ca bhūtaye
bhavanti kuruśārdūla
pṛthagdharmāṃś ca me śṛṇu

yajñādhyayanadānāni
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ nṛpa
sādhāraṇāni teṣāṃ tu
jīvikākarma kathyate

yājanādhyāpanair vipras
tathā śastapratigrahaiḥ
bhṛtyādibharaṇaṃ kuryād
yajñāṃś ca vibhave sati

bhṛtyādibharaṇe nālaṃ
svavṛttyā hi yadā dvijaḥ
tadā jīvet samālambya
vṛttiṃ kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ

saṃtyajeta samastāṃs tān
na kuryād vṛttisaṃkaram
āpatkāle 'pi viprasya
śūdrakarma na śasyate

prajānāṃ pālanaṃ samyag
vidhiḥ prathamakalpitaḥ
rājanyasya mahīpāla
śastrājīvena vā bhṛtiḥ

tadutpannair dhanaiḥ kuryāt
samastāḥ kṣatriyakriyāḥ
tasyāpy āpadi vaiśyasya
yā vṛttiḥ sā vidhīyate

vāṇijyaṃ vaiśyajātasya
paśūnāṃ pālanaṃ kṛṣiḥ
dadyād yajec ca vidhivat
tadutpannadhanena saḥ

dvijātijanaśuśrūṣāṃ
krayavikrayajair dhanaiḥ
śūdro yajet pākayajñair
dadyād iṣṭāni cārthinām

tasmai śuśrūṣave deyaṃ
jīrṇavastram upānahau
chattrādikaṃ tathā kuryāt
samyagdharmopapādanam

caturṇām api varṇānāṃ
dharmas te kathito mayā
śṛṇuṣva ca mahīpāla
dharmam āśramiṇām ataḥ

kṛtopanayanaḥ pūrvaṃ
brahmacārī guror gṛhe
guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ kuryād
bhaikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ

nivedya gurave bhaikṣam
attavyaṃ tadanujñayā
guror bhuktavataḥ paścān
nātisvādumudāvatā

vahniśuśrūṣaṇaṃ kruyād
vedāharaṇam eva ca
guror arthe sadā toyaṃ
samidāharaṇaṃ tathā

puṣpādīnāṃ ca kurvīta
supte tasmiñ śayīta ca
śayane ca samuttiṣṭhet
taṃ vrajantam anuvrajet

āhūtaś ca paṭhet tena
tanmanā nānyatomukhaḥ
vratāni caratā saṃyag
grāhyo vedo yatātmanā
daṇḍavatplavanaṃ snāne
śastaṃ nāsyāṅgaśodhanam

adhītya vedān vedau vā
vedaṃ vāpi yathākramam
aviplutabrahmacaryo
gṛhasthāśramam āvaset

yatheṣṭāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā
gurave kurunandana
tato 'nujñāṃ samāsādya
gṛhasthāśramam āvaset

tenaivāntaṃ vrajet prājñas
tacchuśrūṣaṇatatparaḥ
vānaprasthāśramaṃ tasmāc
caturthaṃ vāpi saṃśrayet
yathākramaṃ vā kurvīta
vidhivad dārasaṃgraham

tatas tv arogikulajāṃ
tulyāṃ patnīṃ samudvahet
gṛhasthāśramavṛttyartham
avyaṅgāṃ vidhinā nṛpa

ākhyātavarṇadharmeṇa
dhanaṃ labdhvā mahīpate
kurvīta śraddhayā yukto
nityanaimittikīḥ kriyāḥ

abhyāgatātithīn bandhūn
bhṛtyādīn āturāṃs tathā
toṣayec chaktito 'nnena
vayāṃsy antyapaśūn api

ṛtāv upagamaś caiva
gṛhasthasyāpi śabditaḥ
dharmo dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha
yajñocchiṣṭaṃ ca bhojanam

havyena prīṇayed devān
pitṛn kavyena śaktitaḥ
manuṣyān annapānena
svādhyāyena rṣitarpaṇam

kuryāc ca prīṇanaṃ nityaṃ
bhūtānāṃ balikarmaṇā
prajāpatiṃ sutotpattyā
hārdena sakalaṃ janam

śubhena karmaṇātmānam
upadeśena cātmajān
anujīvijanaṃ vṛtyā
gṛhasthas toṣayet sadā

tathaivāparamānebhyaḥ
pradeyaṃ gṛhamedhinā
annaṃ bhikṣārthino ye ca
parivrāḍbrahmacāriṇaḥ

evaṃ gṛhāśrame devāḥ
pitaro munayas tathā
sarvakāmān prayacchanti
manuṣyāś ca supūjitāḥ

gṛhasthas tu yadā paśyed
valīpalitam ātmanaḥ
apatyasya tathāpatyaṃ
tadāraṇyaṃ samāśrayet

pitṛdevātithīnāṃ tu
smṛtaṃ tatrāpi pūjanam
tathaivāraṇyabhogaś ca
tapobhiś cātmakarṣaṇam

brahmacaryaṃ mahīśayyā
homas triṣavaṇāplutiḥ
maunādikaraṇaṃ śastaṃ
jaṭāvalkaladhāraṇam

grīṣme pañcatapobhiś ca
varṣāsv abhrāvakāśikaiḥ
jalaśayyā ca hemante
bhāvyaṃ vananiketanaiḥ

iṅgudairaṇḍatailena
gātrābhyaṅgāni ceṣyate
śyāmākanīvāramayaṃ
phalamūlaiś ca bhojanam

apraveśas tathā grāme
vānaprasthavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ
vānaprasthasya te proktaṃ
dharmalakṣaṇam āditaḥ

āśramaṇaṃ tv aparaṃ bhikṣoḥ
śṛṇuṣva gadato mama
grāmaikarātrir vasatir
nagare pañcarātrikā

sarvasaṅgaparityāgaḥ
kṣāntir indriyasaṃyamaḥ
vikālabhaikṣacaraṇam
anārambhas tathā nṛpa

caturthaś caiṣa kathitas
tava bhikṣor mayāśramaḥ
kramād vimuktikāmānāṃ
puruṣāṇām ayaṃ vidhiḥ

evaṃ tu varṇadharmeṇa
tathā cāśramakarmanā
nijena saṃpūjya hariṃ
siddhim āpnoti mānavaḥ

brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca
bhikṣur vaikhānasas tathā
kurvanto nijakarmāṇi
viṣṇum eva yajanti te

yato hi devatāḥ sarvā
brahmādyāḥ kurunandana
aṃśabhūtā jagaddhātur
viṣṇor avyaktajanmanaḥ

viśve devā yato viṣṇur
viṣṇuḥ pitṛgaṇo yataḥ
devā yajñabhujaś ceśo
yataḥ pāpaharo hariḥ

viśve bhūtāni bhūtāni
yato viṣṇus tatharṣayaḥ
tataḥ sarvāśramāṇāṃ hi
pūjya eko janārdanaḥ

sarveśvaraṃ sarvamayaṃ samasta-
saṃsārahetukṣayakāraṇeśam
varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ variṣṭhaṃ
viṣṇuṃ kriyāvān yajate manuṣyaḥ

yasyodare jagad idaṃ paramāṇubhūtaṃ
candrendrarudramarudaśvivasuprajeśaiḥ
sarvaiḥ sametam amitātmatanos tam ekam
abhyarcya viṣṇum abhivāñchitam asty alabhyam

ārādhya yaṃ bhuvanabhāvanam acyutākhyam
aiśvaryam īpsitam avāpa patiḥ surāṇām
trailokyasāram amarārcitapādapadmam
ekaṃ tam eva harim arcayatārcanīyam

yasyāṅghripadmagalitāmbhasi deva daitya-
yakṣādibhiḥ sakalapāpam apohya siddhiḥ
saṃprāpyate maraṇajanmajarāpahantrī
viṣṇor ajāt kathaya ko 'bhyadhikas tato 'sti

kamalajaharasūryacandraśakraiḥ
satatam abhiṣṭutam ādyam īśitāram
sakalabhuvanakāryakāraneśaṃ
puruṣatanuṃ praṇato 'smi vāsudevam

śrutaṃ bhagavato rūpam
advaite yat tvayoditam
viṣṇor bhṛgukulaśreṣṭha
yac ca dvaite mahātmanaḥ

avidyābhinnadṛgbuddhiḥ
puruṣo munipuṅgava
dvaitabhūte jagaty asminn
advaitaṃ bhāvayet katham

krodhalobhādayo doṣā
ye mukteḥ paripanthinaḥ
vinivṛttirūpā yena
teṣāṃ yena vader ha tam

sarveśvareśvareśasya
yac ca rūpaṃ hareḥ param
tac cāhaṃ śrotum icchāmi
tvatto bhṛgukulodvaha

samyak pṛṣṭam idaṃ bhūpa
bhavatā guhyam uttamam
dvaitādvaitakathālāpa-
saṃbandhād upakārakam

purā dharmagṛhe jajñe
caturmūrtir nareśvara
devadevo jagaddhātā
paramātmā janārdanaḥ

jagataḥ pālanārthāya
durvṛttanidhanāya ca
svecchayā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ
saṃbhavaty eva bhūtale

svarge vāpi bhūloke vā
bhuvarloke 'thavā vibhuḥ
yatra vā rocate tatra
cikīrṣur jagato hitam

turīyāṃśena dharmasya
bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ
yadāvatāraṃ kṛtavāṃs
tadā taccaritaṃ śṛṇu

naro nārāyaṇaś caiva
hariḥ kṛṣṇas tathaiva ca
viṣṇor aṃśāṃśakā hy ete
catvāro dharmasūnavaḥ

teṣāṃ nārāyaṇanarau
gandhamādanaparvate
ātmany ātmānam ādhāya
tepate paramaṃ tapaḥ

dhyāyamānāv anaupamyaṃ
svakāraṇam akāraṇam
vāsudevam anirdeśyam
apratarkyam ajaṃ param
yogayuktau mahāmaunam
āsthitau gurutejasau

tayos tapaḥprabhāveṇa
na tatāpa divākaraḥ
vavau cāśaṅkito vāyuḥ
sukhasparśo hy asarkaraḥ

śiśiro 'bhavad atyarthaṃ
jvalann api vibhāvasuḥ
siṃhavyāghrādayaḥ saumyāś
ceruḥ saha mṛgair girau

tayor gauravabhārārtā
pṛthivī pṛthivīpate
cacāla bhūdharāś celuś
cukṣubhuś ca mahābdhayaḥ

devāś ca sveṣu dhiṣṇyeṣu
niṣprabheṣu hataprabhāḥ
babhūvur avanīpāla
paramaṃ kṣobham āgatāḥ

devarājas tataḥ śakraḥ
saṃtrastas tapasas tayoḥ
yuyojāpsarasaḥ śubhrās
tayor vighnacikīrṣayā

rambhe tilottame kuṇṭhe
ghṛtāci lalitāvati
umloce subhrupramloce
saurabhe 'pi madoddhate

alambuṣe miśrakeśi
puṇḍarīke varūthini
vilobhanīyaṃ bibhrāṇā
vapur manmathabodhanam
gandhamādanam āsādya
kurudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama

naranārāyaṇau tatra
tapodīkṣānvitau dvijau
tapyete dharmatanayau
tapaḥ paramaduścaram

tāv asmākaṃ varārohāḥ
kurvāṇau paramaṃ tapaḥ
karmātiśayaduḥkhārti-
pradāvayatināśakau

tad gacchata na bhīḥ kāryā
bhavatībhir idaṃ vacaḥ
smaraḥ sahāyo bhavitā
vasantaś ca varāṅganāḥ

rūpaṃ ca vaḥ samālokya
madanoddīpanaṃ param
kandarpavaśam abhyeti
vivaśaḥ ko na mānavaḥ

ity uktā devarājena
madanena samaṃ tadā
jagmur apsarasaḥ sarvā
vasantaś ca mahīpate

gandhamādanam āsādya
puṃskokilakulākulam
cakāra mādhavo ramyaṃ
protphullavanapādapam

pravavau dakṣiṇaḥ sadyo
malayānugato 'nilaḥ
bhṛṅgamālārutaravair
ramaṇīyam abhūd vanam

gandhaś ca surabhiḥ sadyo
vanarājisamudbhavaḥ
kiṃnaroragayakṣāṇāṃ
babhūva ghrāṇatarpaṇaḥ

varāṅganāś ca tāḥ sarvā
naranārāyaṇāv ṛṣī
vilobhayitum ārabdhā
varāṅgalalitaiḥ smitaiḥ

jagur manoharaṃ kāścin
nanṛtuś cātra cāparāḥ
avādayaṃs tathaivānyā
manoharataraṃ nṛpa

hāvair bhāvaiḥ smitais trāsais
tathānyā valgubhāṣitaiḥ
tayoḥ kṣobhāya tanvaṅgyaś
cakrur udyamam aṅganāḥ

tathāpi na tayoḥ kaścin
manasaḥ pṛthivīpate
vikāro 'bhavad adhyātma-
pārasaṃprāptacetasoḥ

nivātasthau yathā dīpāv
akampau nṛpa tiṣṭhataḥ
vāsudevārpaṇe svacche
tathaiva manasī tayoḥ

pūryamāṇo 'pi cāmbhobhir
bhuvam anyāṃ mahodadhiḥ
yathā na yāti na yayau
tathā tanmānasaṃ kvacit

sarvabhūtahitau brahma
vāsudevamayaṃ param
manyamānau na rāgasya
dveṣasya ca vaśaṃgatau

smaro 'pi na śaśākātha
praveṣṭuṃ hṛdayaṃ tayoḥ
vidyāmayaṃ dīpayutam
andhakāram ivālayam

puṣpojjvalāṃs taruvarān
vasantaṃ dakṣiṇānilam
tāś caivāpsarasaḥ sarvāḥ
kandarpaṃ ca mahāmunī

yac cārabdhaṃ tapas tābhyām
ātmānaṃ gandhamādanam
dadṛśāte 'khilaṃ rūpaṃ
brahmaṇaḥ puruṣarṣabha

dāhāya nānalo vahner
nāpaḥkledāya cāmbhasaḥ
taddravyam eva taddravya-
vikārāya na vai yataḥ

tato vijñānavijñāta-
parabrahmasvarūpayoḥ
madhukandarpayoṣitsu
vikāro nābhavat tayoḥ

tato gurutaraṃ yatnaṃ
vasantamadanau nṛpa
cakrāte tāś ca tanvaṅgyas
tatkṣobhāya punaḥ punaḥ

atha nārāyaṇo dhairya-
gāmbhīryodāryamānasaḥ
ūror utpādayām āsa
tāṃ varorubalāṃ tadā

trailokyasundarīratnam
aśeṣam avanīpate
guṇalāghavam abhyeti
yasyāḥ saṃdarśanād anu

tāṃ vilokya mahīpāla
cakampe mādhavānilam
vasanto vismayaṃ yātaḥ
saṃyātaḥ saṃsmaraṃ smaraḥ

rambhātilottamādyāś ca
vilakṣā devayoṣitaḥ
na rejur avanīpāla
tallakṣahṛdayekṣaṇāḥ

tataḥ kāmo vasantaś ca
pārthivāpsarasaś ca tāḥ
praṇamya bhagavantau tau
tuṣṭuvur munisattamau

prasīdatu jagaddhātā
yasya devasya māyayā
mohitāḥ sma vijānīmo
nāntaraṃ vandyanindyayoḥ

prasīdatu sa no devo
yasya rūpam idaṃ dvidhā
dhāma bhūtasya lokānām
anāder atra tiṣṭhati

naranārāyaṇau devau
śārṅgacakrāyudhāv ubhau
āstāṃ prasādasumukhāv
asmākam aparādhinām

nidhānaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ
sarvapāpendhanānalaḥ
nārāyaṇo no bhagavān
sarvapāpaṃ vyapohatu

śārṅgacakrāyudhaḥ śrīmān
ātmajñānamayo 'naghaḥ
naraḥ samastapāpāni
hatvātmā sarvadehinām

jaṭākalāpabandho 'yam
anayor akṣayātmanoḥ
saumyā ca dṛṣṭiḥ pāpāni
hantu sarvāṇi naḥ śubhā

prasīdatu naro 'smākaṃ
tathā nārāyaṇo 'vyayaḥ
aparādhaḥ kṛto 'smābhir
yayor avyaktajanmanoḥ

kva mūrtir aiśvaryaguṇair
yuktā divyair mahātmanoḥ
kva naḥ śarīrakāṇīdṛg
miśrakarmacitāni vai

tathāpy avidyāduṣṭena
manasā yaḥ kṛto hi vām
asmābhir aparādho 'yaṃ
kṣamyatāṃ sumahādyutī

śaraṇaṃ ca prapannānāṃ
tavāsmīti ca vādinām
prasādaṃ pitṛhantṝṇām
api kurvanti sādhavaḥ

eṣa eva varo 'smākam
avivekāhṛto mahān
trailokyavandyau yannāthau
vilobhayitum āgatāḥ

prasīda deva vijñāna-
ghanamūḍhadṛśām api
bhavanti santaḥ satataṃ
saddharmanyavatārakāḥ

dṛṣṭvaitan naḥ samutpannaṃ
yathā strīratnam īdṛśam
tvayi nārāyaṇotpannā
śreṣṭhā pāravatī matiḥ

tena satyena satyātman
paramātman sanātanam
nārāyaṇa prasīdeti
sarvalokaparāyaṇa

prasannabuddhe śāntātman
prasannavadanekṣaṇa
prasīda yoginām īśa
nara sarvagatācyuta

namasyāmo naraṃ devaṃ
tathā nārāyaṇaṃ harim
namo narāya namyāya
namo nārāyaṇāya ca

prasannānām anāthānām
aparādhavatāṃ prabhuḥ
śaṃ karotu naro 'smākaṃ
śaṃ nārāyaṇa dehi naḥ

evam abhyarthitaḥ stutyā
rāgadveṣādivarjitaḥ
prāheśaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ
sādhyo nārāyaṇo nṛpa

svāgataṃ madhave kāma
bhavato 'psarasām api
yat kāryam āgatānāṃ va
ihāsmābhis tad ucyatām

yūyaṃ saṃsiddhaye nūnam
asmākaṃ valaśatruṇā
saṃpreṣitās tato 'smākaṃ
nṛttageyādidarśitam

na vayaṃ nṛttagītena
nāṅgaceṣṭādibhāṣitaiḥ
lubhyāmo viṣato manye
viṣayā dāruṇātmakāḥ

śabdādisaṅgaduṣṭāni
yadā nākṣāṇi naḥ śubhāḥ
tadā nṛttādayo bhāvāḥ
kathaṃ lobhapradāyinaḥ

te siddhāḥ sma na vai sādhyā
bhavatīnāṃ smarasya ca
mādhavasya ca śakro 'pi
svāsthyaṃ yātv aviśaṅkitaḥ

yo 'sau parasmāt paramaḥ
puruṣāt parameśvaraḥ
paramātmā hṛṣīkeśaḥ
sthāvarasya carasya ca

utpattihetur ante ca
yasmin sarvaṃ pralīyate
sa sarvavāsidevatvād
vāsudevety udāhṛtaḥ

vayam aṃśāṃśakās tasya
caturvyūhasya māyinaḥ
tadādeśitavartmano
jagadbodhāya dehinaḥ

taṃ sarvabhūtaṃ sarveśaṃ
sarvatra samadarśinaḥ
paśyantaḥ kutra rāgādīn
kariṣyāmo vibhedakān

vasante mayi cendre ca
bhavatīṣu tathā smare
yadā sa eva viśvātmā
tadā dveṣādayaḥ katham

tanmayāny avibhaktāni
yadā sarveṣu jantuṣu
pṛthivy āpas tathā tejo
vāyur ākāśam eva ca

tathendriyāṇy ahaṃkāro
buddhiś ca na pṛthag yataḥ
samadṛṣṭir yataḥ kutra
rāgadveṣau pravartataḥ

ātmā cāyam abhedena
yataḥ sarveṣu jantuṣu
sarveśvareśvaro viṣṇuḥ
kutra rāgādayas tataḥ

brahmāṇam indram īśānam
ādityān maruto 'khilān
viśvedevān ṛṣīn sādhyān
vasūn pitṛgaṇāṃs tathā

makṣikāmaśakādaṃśāñ
śalabhān alasān kṛmīn
gulmavṛkṣalatāvalli-
tvaksāratṛṇajātijān

yac ca kiṃcid adṛśyaṃ vā
dṛśyaṃ vā tridaśāṅganāḥ
manyadhvaṃ rūpam ekasya
tat sarvaṃ paramātmanaḥ

jānamānaḥ kathaṃ viṣṇum
ātmānaṃ paramaṃ ca yat
rāgadveṣau tathā lobhaṃ
kaḥ kuryād amarāṅganāḥ

sarvabhūtasthite viṣṇau
sarvage sarvadhātari
nipātyatāṃ pṛthagbhūte
kutra rāgādiko gaṇaḥ

evam asmāsu yuṣmāsu
sarvabhūteṣu cābalāḥ
tanmayatvaikabhūteṣu
rāgādyavasaraḥ kutaḥ

samyagdṛṣṭir iyaṃ proktā
samastaikyāvalokinī
pṛthagvijñānam atraiva
lokasaṃvyavahāravat

bhūtendriyāntaḥkaraṇa-
pradhānapuruṣātmakam
jagad yad etad akhilaṃ
tadā bhedaḥ kimātmakaḥ

bhavanti layam āyānti
samudre salilormayaḥ
na vāribhedato bhinnās
tathaivaikyād idaṃ jagat

yathāgner arciṣaḥ pītāḥ
piṅgalāruṇadhūsarāḥ
bhavanti nāgnibhedena
tathaitad brahmaṇo jagat

bhavatībhiś ca yat kṣobham
asmākaṃ sa puraṃdaraḥ
kārayaty asad etac ca
vivekādhāracetasām

bhavatyaḥ sa ca devendro
lokāś ca sasurāsurāḥ
samudrādrivanopetā
maddehāntaragocarāḥ

yatheyaṃ cārusarvāṅgī
bhavatīnāṃ mayorutaḥ
darśitā darśayiṣyāmi
tathātraivākhilaṃ jagat

prayātu śakro mā garvam
indratvaṃ kasya susthiram
yūyaṃ ca mā smayaṃ yāta
santi rūpānvitāḥ striyaḥ

kiṃ surūpaṃ kurūpaṃ vā
yadā bhedo na dṛśyate
tāratamyaṃ surūpatve
satataṃ bhinnadarśinām

bhavatīnāṃ smayaṃ matvā
rūpaudāryaguṇodbhavam
mayeyaṃ darśitā tanvī
tatas tacchamam icchatā

yasmān madūror udbhūtā
iyam indīvarekṣaṇā
urvaśī nāma kalyāṇī
bhaviṣyati tato 'psarāḥ

tad iyaṃ devarājāya
nīyatāṃ varavarṇinī
bhavatyas tena cāsmākaṃ
preṣitāḥ prītim icchatā

vaktavyaś ca sahasrākṣo
nāsmākaṃ bhogakāraṇāt
tapaścaryā na cāprāpya-
phalaṃ prāptum abhīpsitam

sanmārgam asya jagato
darśayiṣyan karomy aham
tapo nareṇa sahito
jagataḥ pālanodyataḥ

yadi kaścit tavābādhāṃ
karoti tridaśeśvara
tam ahaṃ vārayiṣyāmi
nirvṛto bhava vāsava

kartāsi cet tvam ābādhām
aduṣṭasyeha kasyacit
tavāpi śāstaitad ahaṃ
pravartiṣyāmy asaṃśayam

etaj jñātvā na saṃtāpas
tvayā kāryo hi māṃ prati
upakārāya jagatām
avatīrṇo 'smi vāsava

yā ceyam urvaśī mattaḥ
samudbhūtā puraṃdara
tretāgnihetubhūteyam
ailaṃ prāpya bhaviṣyati

ity ukte 'psarasaḥ sarvāḥ
praṇipatyātivismitāḥ
ūcur nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ
taddarśanakutūhalāḥ

ukto bhagavatā yo 'yam
upadeśo hitārthinām
proktaḥ sa sarvo vijñāto
māhātmyaṃ viditaṃ ca te

yat tv etad bhavatā proktaṃ
prasannenāvyayātmanā
darśiteyaṃ viśālākṣī
darśayiṣyāmi vo jagat

tannātha sarvabhāvena
prapannānāṃ jagatpate
darśayātmānam akhilaṃ
darśiteyaṃ yathorvaśī

yadi devāparāddheṣu
nāsmāsu kupitaṃ tava
manas taj jagatam īśa
darśayātmānam ātmanā

paśyatehākhilāṃl lokān
mama dehe surāṅganāḥ
madhuṃ madanam ātmānaṃ
yac cānyad draṣṭum icchatha

ity uktvā bhagavān devas
tadā nārāyaṇo nṛpa
uccair jahāsa svanavat
tatrābhūd akhilaṃ jagat

brahmā prajāpatiḥ śakraḥ
saha rudraiḥ pinākadhṛk
ādityā vasavaḥ sādhyā
viśvedevā maharṣayaḥ

nāsatyadasrāv anilāḥ
sarve sarve tathāgnayaḥ
yakṣagandharvasiddhāś ca
piśācāḥ kiṃnaroragāḥ

samastāpsaraso vidyāḥ
sāṅgā vedās taduktayaḥ
manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ kīṭāḥ
pakṣiṇaḥ pādapās tathā

sarīsṛpāś ca ye sūkṣmā
yac cānyaj jīvasaṃjñitam
samudrāḥ sakalāḥ śailāḥ
saritaḥ kānanāni ca

dvīpāny aśeṣāṇi tathā
nadāḥ sarvasarāṃsi ca
nagaragrāmapūrṇā ca
medinī medinīpate
devāṅganābhir devasya
dehe dṛṣṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ

nakṣatragrahatārābhiḥ
samavetaṃ nabhastalam
dadṛśus tāḥ sucārvaṅgyas
tasyāntar viśvarūpiṇaḥ

nordhvaṃ na tiryaṅ nādhaś ca
yadāntas tasya dṛśyate
tam anantam anādiṃ ca
tatas tās tuṣṭuvuḥ prabhum

madanena samaṃ sarvā
madhunā ca surāṅganāḥ
sasādhvasā bhaktimatyaḥ
paraṃ vismayam āgatāḥ

paśyāma nādiṃ tava deva nāntam
na madhyam avyākṛtarūpapāram
parāyaṇaṃ tvā jagatām anantam
natāḥ sma nārāyaṇam ātmabhūtam

mahī divaṃ vāyujalāgnayas tvaṃ
śabdādirūpaś ca parāparātman
tvatto bhavaty acyuta sarvam etad
abhedarūpo 'si vibho tvam ebhiḥ

draṣṭāsi rūpasya rasasya vettā
śrotā ca śabdasya hare tvam ekaḥ
spraṣṭā bhavān spraśavato 'khilasya
ghrātāsi gandhasya pṛthakśarīrī

sureṣu sarveṣu na so 'sti kaścin
manuṣyaloke ca na so 'sti kaścit
paśvādivarge ca na so 'sti kaścid
yo nāṃśabhūtas tava devadeva

brahmādyupendrapramukhāni saumyeṣv
indrāgnirūpāṇi ca vīryavatsu
rudrāntakādīni ca raudravatsu
rūpeṣu rūpāṇi tavottamāni

samudrarūpaṃ tava dhairyavatsu
tejasvirūpeṣu ravis tathāgniḥ
kṣamādhaneṣu kṣitirūpam agryaṃ
rūpaṃ tavāgryaṃ balavatsu vāyuḥ

manuṣyarūpaṃ tava rājaseṣu
mūḍheṣu sarveśvara pādapo 'si
darpānviteṣv acyuta dānavas tvaṃ
sanatsujātaś ca vivekavatsu

rasasvarūpeṇa jale sthito 'si
gandhasvarūpo bhavato dharitryam
dṛśyasvarūpaś ca hutāśane tvaṃ
sparśasvarūpo bhagavān samīre

śabdātmakaṃ te nabhasi svarūpaṃ
mantavyarūpo manasi prabho tvam
bodhavyarūpaś ca vibho tvam ekaḥ
sarvatra sarveśvara sarvabhūtaḥ

paśyāma te nābhisarojamadhye
brahmāṇam etaṃ ca haraṃ bhrukūṭyam
tatrāśvinau karṇagatau samastāṇ
avasthitān bāhuṣu lokapālān

ghrāṇe 'nilaṃ netragatau ravīndū
jihvā ca te nātha sarasvatīyam
pādau dharitrīṃ jaṭharaṃ samastāṃl
lokān hṛṣīkeśa vilokayāmaḥ

jaṅghe viyat pādakarāṅgulīṣu
piśācarakṣoragasiddhasaṅghān
puṃstve prajānāṃ patir oṣṭhayugme
pratiṣṭhitās te kratavaḥ samastāḥ

sarveṣṭayas te daśaneṣu deva
daṃṣṭṛāsu vidyā bhavataś catasraḥ
romasv aśeṣās tava devasaṅghā
vidyādharā nātha karāṅghrirekhāḥ
sāṅghāḥ samastās tava deva vedāḥ
samāsthitā bahuṣu saṃdhibhūtāḥ

varāharūpaṃ dharaṇīdhṛtas te
nṛsiṃharūpaṃ ca saṭākarālam
paśyāma te vājiśiras tathoccais
trivikrame yaś ca tavāprameyaḥ

amī samudrās tava deva dehe
mervādayaḥ śailavarās tavāmī
imāś ca gaṅgāpramukhāḥ sravatyo
dvīpāny aśeṣāṇi vanāni caiva

stuvanti caite munayas taveśa
dehe sthitās tvanmahimānam agryam
tvām īśitāraṃ jagatām anantam
yajñeśam arcanti ca yajvino 'mī

tvatto na saumyaṃ jagatīha kiṃcit
tvatto na raudraṃ ca samastamūrte
tvatto na śītaṃ na ca keśavoṣṇaṃ
sarvasvarūpātiśayī tvam ekaḥ

prasīda sarveśvara sarvabhūta
sanātanātman parameśvareśa
tvanmāyayā mohitamānasābhir
yat te 'parāddhaṃ tad idaṃ kṣamasva

kiṃ vāparāddhaṃ tava deva mūḍhair
yan māyayā no hṛdayaṃ tathāpi
pāpāvaśaṃ kiṃ praṇatārtihārin
mano hi no viṅkalatām upaiti

na te 'parāddhaṃ yadi vāparāddham
asmābhir unmārgavivartanībhiḥ
tat kṣamyatāṃ sṛṣṭikaras tavaiva
devāparādhaṃ sṛjato vivekān

namo namas te govinda
nārāyaṇa janārdana
tvannāmasmaraṇāt pāpam
aśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu

tato 'nanta namas tubhyaṃ
viśvātman viśvabhāvana
tvannāmasmaraṇāt pāpam
aśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu
namo namas te vaikuṇṭha
śrīvatsāṅkābjalocana
vareṇya yajñapuruṣa
prajāpālaka vāmana

namo 'stu te 'bjanābhāya
prajāpatikṛte hare
tvannāmasmaraṇāt pāpam
aśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu

saṃsārārṇavapotāya
namas tubhyam adhokṣaja
tvannāmasmaraṇāt pāpam
aśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu

namaḥ parasmai śrīśāya
vāsudevāya vedhase
svecchayā guṇabhoktṛtve
sargāntasthitikāriṇe

upasaṃhāra viśvātman
rūpam etat samantataḥ
vardhamānaṃ na no draṣṭuṃ
samarthaṃ cakṣur īśvara

pralayāgnisahasrasya
samā dīptis tavācyuta
pramāṇena diśo bhūmir
gaganaṃ ca samāvṛtam

na vidmaḥ kva nu vartāmo
bhavān naivopalakṣyate
sarvaṃ jagad ihaikasthaṃ
piṇḍitaṃ lakṣayāmahe

kiṃ varṇayāmo rūpaṃ te
kiṃ pramāṇam idaṃ hare
māhātmyaṃ kiṃtu te deva
jihvāyā yan na gocaram

vaktrāṇām ayutenāpi
buddhīnām ayutāyutaiḥ
guṇānāṃ varṇanaṃ nātha
tava vaktuṃ na śakyate

tad etad darśitaṃ rūpaṃ
prasādaḥ paramaḥ kṛtaḥ
chandato jagatām īśa
tad etad upasaṃhara

ity evaṃ saṃstutas tābhir
apsarobhir janārdanaḥ
divyajñānopapannānāṃ
tāsāṃ pratyakṣam īśvaraḥ
viveśa sarvabhūtāni
svair aṃśair bhūtabhāvanaḥ

taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvabhūteṣu
līyamānam adhokṣajam
vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ
samastā devayoṣitaḥ

sa ca sarveśvaraḥ śailān
pādapān sāgarān bhuvam
jalam agniṃ tathā vāyum
ākāśaṃ ca viveśa ha

kāle dikṣv atha sarvātmā
manuṣyātmany athāpi ca
ātmarūpaḥ sthitaḥ svena
mahimnā bhāvayañ jagat

ye 'ntarikṣe tathā bhūmau
divi ye ye jalāśrayāḥ
tān praviśya sa viśvātmā
punas tad rūpam āsthitaḥ
nareṇa sārchaṃ yat tābhir
dṛṣṭapūrvam ariṃdama

tāḥ paraṃ vismayaṃ gatvā
sarvās tridaśayoṣitaḥ
praṇemuḥ sādhyasāḥ pāṇḍu-
vadanā nṛpasattama

nārāyaṇo 'pi bhagavān
āha tās tridaśāṅganāḥ
nīyatām urvaśī bhadrā
yatrāste tridaśeśvaraḥ

bhavatīnāṃ hitārthāya
sarvabhūteṣv asāv iti
jñānam utpāditaṃ bhūyo
layaṃ bhūteṣu kurvatā

tad gacchata samasto 'yaṃ
bhūtagrāmo madaṃśakaḥ
aham apy ātmabhūtasya
vāsudevasya yoginaḥ

yasmāt parataraṃ nāsti
yo 'nantaḥ paripaṭhyate
tam ajaṃ sarvabhūteśaṃ
jānīta paramaṃ padam

ahaṃ bhavatyo devāś ca
manuṣyāḥ paśavaś ca ye
etat sarvam anantasya

devadevasya vistṛtiḥ
etaj jñātvā samaṃ sargaṃ
sadevāsuramānuṣam
sapaśvādigaṇaṃ caiva
draṣṭavyaṃ tridaśāṅganāḥ

ity uktas tena devena
samastās tāḥ surastriyaḥ
praṇamya tau samadanāḥ
savasantāś ca pārthiva

ādāya corvaśīṃ bhūyo
devarājam upāgatāḥ
ācakhyuś ca yathāvṛttaṃ
devarājāya tat tathā

tathā tvam api rājendra
sarvabhūteṣu keśavam
cintayan samatāṃ gaccha
samataiva hi muktaye

jānann evam aśeṣeṣu
bhūteṣu parameśvaram
vāsudevaṃ kathaṃ doṣāṃl
lobhādīn na prahāsyasi

sarvabhūtāni govindād
yadā nānyāni bhūpate
tadā vairādayo bhāvāḥ
kriyatāṃ kutra pārthiva

iha paśyañ jagat sarvaṃ
vāsudevātmakaṃ nṛpa
etad eva hi kṛṣṇena
rūpam āviṣkṛtaṃ tadā

paramasmād api mahad
rūpaṃ yat kathitaṃ tava
janmādibhāvarahitaṃ
tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam

saṃkṣepeṇa ca bhūpāla
śrūyatāṃ yad vadāmi te
yan matau puruṣaḥ kṛtvā
paraṃ nirvāṇam ṛcchati

sarvaṃ viṣṇuḥ samastau hi
bhāvābhāvau ca tanmayau
sadasat sarvam īśeśo
vāsudevaḥ paraṃ padam

bhavajaladhigatānāṃ dvandvavātāhatānāṃ
sutaduhitṛkalatratrāṇabhārārditānām
viṣamaviṣayatoye majjatām aplavānāṃ
bhavati śaraṇam eko viṣṇupoto narāṇām

ity uktaṃ tava dharmajña
viṣṇor māhātmyam uttamam
svarūpaṃ ca jagaddhātur
ārādhanaviniścayaḥ

ārādhitāt phalaṃ yac ca
keśavāt prāpyate naraiḥ
kathitaś ca mahābhāga
dānānāṃ vistarād vidhiḥ

yogadvaidhaṃ ca kathitam
advaitaṃ dvaitam eva ca
advaitabhāvanopāyo
vistarāc ca tavoditaḥ

saṃkṣepavistarābhyāṃ ca
sarvam etat tavoditam
devadevasya māhātmyaṃ
sarvagasyāvyayātmanaḥ

sa eṣa sarvapravaraḥ
sarvabhūtaś ca mādhavaḥ
sarvam atra ca sarvasminn
eṣa eva pratiṣṭhitaḥ

triyugaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣam
apavargamahāhradam
samutpatya parāhlādam
anantaṃ pratipadyate

śrutam etan mayā pūrvaṃ
vistareṇa tvayoditam
yat tv etat triyugety uktaṃ
tasya nirvacanaṃ vada

caturyugena kālasya
parisaṃkhyā yadā dvija
triyugena tadā viṣṇoḥ
kriyate kiṃ viśeṣaṇam

kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca
kaliś ceti caturyugam
yadā jagati vikhyātaṃ
tadā triyugatā kutaḥ

sādhu pṛṣṭo 'smi bhūpāla
bhavatā triyugāśritam
viśeṣaṇam anantasya
gadatas tan niśāmaya

kāṣṭhā pārthiva vijñeyā
nimeṣā daśa pañca ca
kāṣṭhātriṃśat kalā jñeyā
muhūrtaṃ tāvatīḥ kalāḥ

triṃśanmuhūrtā bhūpāla
tathāhorātram ucyate
tatsaṃkhyātair ahorātrair
māsaḥ pārthivasattama

ayanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ māsāḥ
ṣaṇ māsāś ca tathottaram
ayanadvitayākhyaś ca
kālaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ

dakṣiṇaṃ tv ayanaṃ rātrir
devānām uttaraṃ dinam
saṃvatsareṇa devānām
ahorātram ihocyate

śatatrayeṇa varṣāṇāṃ
ṣaṣṭyā ca pṛthivīpate
manuṣyasaṃkhyayā varṣaṃ
devānām api gaṇyate

iti divyena mānena
caturyugavikalpanām
kathyamānāṃ mayā rājan
yathāvac chrotum arhasi

catvāri tu sahasrāṇi
varṣāṇāṃ kṛtam ucyate
tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā
saṃdhyāṃśaś ca tathāvidhaḥ

tretā trīṇi sahasrāṇi
divyābdānāṃ nararṣabha
tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā
saṃdhyāṃśaś ca tathāvidhaḥ

dvāparaṃ dve sahasre tu
varṣāṇām abhidhīyate
tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā
saṃdhyāṃśaś ca tathāvidhaḥ

kaliḥ sahasram ekaṃ tu
divyābdānāṃ nararṣabha
tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā
saṃdhyāṃśaś ca tathāvidhaḥ

kṛtaṃ nāmayugaṃ pūrvaṃ
yatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
kṛtam eva ca kartavyaṃ
tasmin kāle nṛpepsitam

na tatra dharmāḥ sīdanti
na ca kṣīyanti vai prajāḥ
tataḥ kṛtayugaṃ nāma
guṇataḥ procyate yugam

devadānavagandharvā
yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ
nāsan kṛtayuge rājan
na tadā krayavikrayaḥ

na sāmayajurṛgvarṇāḥ
kriyā nāsīc ca mānavī
nābhisaṃdhāya ca phalaṃ
kaścid dharme pravartate

na tasmin yugasaṃsarge
vyādhayo nendriyakṣayaḥ
nāsūyā nāpi ruditaṃ
na darpo nāpi paiśunam

na vigrahaḥ kutas tandrī
na dveṣo nāpi dambhanam
na bhayaṃ nāpi saṃtāpo
na cerṣyā nāpi matsaraḥ

tataḥ paramakaṃ brahma
yā gatir yogināṃ parā
ātmā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ
śuklo nārāyaṇas tadā

tasminn ātmani lokānāṃ
sarvalokamaye 'cyute
svecchayā śauklyam āpanne
sarvaṃ bhavati nirmalam

brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ
śūdrāś ca kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ
kṛte yuge bhavantīha
svakarmaniratāḥ prajāḥ

svam āśramaṃ svam ācāraṃ
samyagjñānasamanvitam
jagad bhavati rājendra
satyaprāyaṃ taporatam

ekavedasamāyuktā
ekamantravidhikriyāḥ
pṛthagdharmās tv ekavedā
dharmam ekam anuvratāḥ

caturāśramayuktena
karmaṇā kālayoginā
akāmaphalasaṃyogāt
prāpnuvanti parāṃ gatim

ātmayogasamāyukto
dharmo 'yaṃ kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ
kṛte yuge catuṣpādaś
caturvarṇyasya śāśvataḥ

etat kṛtayugaṃ nāma
traiguṇyaparivarjitam
tretām api nibodha tvaṃ
yādṛgrūpaṃ pravartate

pādena hrasate dharmo
raktatāṃ yāti cācyutaḥ
satyapravṛttāś ca narāḥ
kriyādharmaparāyaṇāḥ

tato yajñāḥ pravartante
dharmāś ca vividhāḥ kriyāḥ
tretāyāṃ bhāvasaṃkalpāḥ
kriyādānaphalodayāḥ

pracaranti tato varṇās
tapodānaparāyaṇāḥ
svakarmasthāḥ kriyāvantaḥ
samatvād rajasānvitāḥ

dvāpare 'pi yuge dharmo
dvibhāgonaḥ pravartate
viṣṇuḥ pītatvam abhyeti
caturdhā veda eva ca

tato 'nye ca caturvedās
trivedāś ca tathāpare
dvivedāś caikavedāś ca
anṛcaś ca tathāpare

evaṃ śāstreṣu bhinneṣu
bahudhā nīyate kriyā
tapodānapravṛttā ca
rājasī bhavati prajā

alpāyuṣo narā vedaḥ
sumahāṃś ceti dustaraḥ
karoti bahudhā vedān
vyāsarūpī tadā hariḥ

sattvasya cāpy avijñānāt
sattve kaścid vyavasthitaḥ
sattvāt pracyavamānānāṃ
vyādhayo bahavo 'bhavan

kāmāś copadravāś caiva
tadā daivatakāritāḥ
yair ardyamānāḥ subhṛśaṃ
tapas tapyanti mānavāḥ

dhanakāmāḥ svargakāmā
yajñāṃs tanvanti cāpare
evaṃ dvāparam āsādya
prajāḥ kṣīyanty adharmataḥ

pādenaikena rājendra
dharmaḥ kaliyuge 'pi hi
tāmasaṃ yugam āsādya
kṛṣṇo bhavati keśavaḥ

vratācārāḥ praśāmyanti
dharmayajñakriyās tathā
ītayo vyādhayas tandrī
doṣāḥ krodhādayas tathā
upadravāś ca vardhante
manastāpāś ca saṃgatāḥ

yugeṣv āvartamāneṣu
loko vyāvartate punaḥ
loke kṣīṇe kṣayaṃ yānti
bhāvā lokapravartakāḥ
yugadvayakṛtān dharmān
prārthanā na ca kurvate

etat kaliyugaṃ bhūpa
yatra jāto 'si pārthiva
nātrāvatāraṃ kurute
kṛṣṇāṃśena svarūpiṇā

kṛtādiṣu jagat pāti
daityebhyo rūpadhṛd dhariḥ
kalau tv anyaṃ samāviśya
pūrvotpannaṃ bibharti tam

pratyagrarūpadhṛg devo
dṛśyate na kalau hariḥ
kṛtādiṣv eva tenaiṣa
triyugaḥ paripaṭhyate

kaler ante ca saṃprāpte
kalkinaṃ brahmavādinam
anupraviśya kurute
vāsudevo jagatsthitim

pūrvotpanneṣu bhūteṣu
teṣu teṣu kalau prabhuḥ
kṛtvā praveśaṃ kurute
yad abhipretam acyutaḥ

svecchāśukle jagac chuklaṃ
rakte raktaṃ ca jāyate
pīte ca pītatām asmin
kṛṣṇe cātrāsitaṃ nṛpa

eṣa eva jagaddevo
jagatsraṣṭā jagadguruḥ
yadrūpa eva devo 'yaṃ
tadrūpaṃ jāyate jagat

caturyugaṃ naḥ kathitaṃ
saṃkṣepād bhavatākhilam
kaliṃ vistarato brūhi
yatra jāto 'smi bhārgava

bhagavaty amale viṣṇau
krīḍayā kṛṣṇatāṃ gate
kimāhārāḥ kimācārā
bhaviṣyanti prajās tadā

brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ
śūdrāś ca dvija kīdṛśāḥ
bhaviṣyanti kalau prāpte
tan mamācakṣva vistarāt

tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge
tretāyāṃ yajña eva hi
pradhānaṃ dvāpare dānaṃ
satyam eva kalau yuge

kṛte yuge manaḥśuddhir
asty evāyatnatas tapaḥ
tapo niṣpādyate bhūpa
yogasaṃsādhanaṃ param

rāgādidoṣaduṣṭena
manasā yat tapo nṛpa
kriyate kleśanāśāya
tat tapo na vimuktaye

tretāyāṃ tu kriyāyajñān
manoyajñāṃs tato narāḥ
vitanvate sthūlataraḥ
panthā dharmasya sa prabho

dvāpare nātividvattā
yathā tretāyuge 'bhavat
tataḥ sthūlataraḥ panthā
dānātmā kriyate naraiḥ

na vidvattā na śuddhārtho
na śuddhir manasaḥ kalau
yato 'taḥ satyam evaikam
ekāntenopakārakam

yathā satyaṃ tathā kṣāntir
ahiṃsā ca kalau yuge
paropatāpād viratir
narāṇām upakārikā

tasmin ghore yuge prāpte
kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇatvam āgate
yādṛgrūpaṃ jagad idaṃ
bhavatīha śṛṇuṣva tat

rājāno brāhmaṇā vaiśyāḥ
śūdrāś ca manujeśvara
vyājadharmaparāś caiva
dharmavaitaṃsikā janāḥ

satyaṃ saṃkṣipyate loke
naraiḥ paṇḍitamānibhiḥ
satyahānyā tatas teṣāṃ
svalpam āyur bhaviṣyati

āyuṣaḥ prakṣayād vidyāṃ
na śakṣyanty upaśikṣitum
vidyāhīnān abuddhīṃs tāṃl
lobho 'py abhibhaviṣyati

lobhakrodhaparā mūḍhāḥ
kāmavaśyāś ca mānavāḥ
baddhavairā bhaviṣyanti
parasparavadhepsavaḥ

brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ
saṃkīryantaḥ parasparam
śūdratulyā bhaviṣyanti
tapaḥsatyavinākṛtāḥ

antyā madhyā bhaviṣyanti
madhyāś cāntāvasāyinaḥ
īdṛśo bhavitā lokaḥ
kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇatvam āgate

vastrāṇāṃ pravarā śāṇī
dhānyānāṃ koradūṣakaḥ
bhāryāmitrāś ca puruṣā
bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge

matsyāmiṣeṇa jīvanto
duhantaś cāpy ajāvikāḥ
goṣu naṣṭāsu puruṣā
bhaviṣyanti tadā nṛpa

sarittīreṣu kuddālair
vāpayiṣyanti cauṣadhīḥ
tāś cāpy alpaphalās teṣāṃ
bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye

aniṣkrāntās tu saṃbandhāḥ
svagotrāt puruṣarṣabha
aniṣkrāntāni śrāddhāni
bhaviṣyanti ca gehataḥ

na vratāni cariṣyanti
brāhmaṇā vedanindakāḥ
na yakṣyanti na hoṣyanti
hetuvādavikūlinaḥ

prāyaśaḥ kṛpaṇānāṃ ca
tathā bandhimatām api
vidhavānāṃ ca vittāni
hariṣyanti balānvitāḥ

anyāyopāttavitteṣu
kariṣyanti narāḥ spṛhām
veśyālāvaṇyabhāveṣu
spṛhāṃ yoṣit kariṣyati

kanyāṃ na yācitā kaścin
na ca kanyāprado naraḥ
kanyā varaś ca cchandena
gṛhīṣyanti parasparam

bhāryā na patiśuśrūṣāṃ
tadā kācit kariṣyati
narā devadvijāṃs tyaktvā
bhaviṣyanty anyatomukhāḥ

yajñabhāgabhujo devā
ye vedapaṭhitā dvijāḥ
brahmādyās tān parityajya
narāḥ kālabalātkṛtāḥ
hetuvādaparā devān
kariṣyanty aparāṃs tadā

ye yavānnā janapadā
godhūmānnās tathaiva ca
tān deśān saṃśrayiṣyanti
narāḥ kaliyuge nṛpa

na śrāddhaiś ca pitṝṃś cāpi
tarpayiṣyanti mānavāḥ
bahu maṃsyanti te snānaṃ
nāpi śaucaparā narāḥ

na viṣṇubhaktipravaṇaṃ
narāṇāṃ nṛpa mānasam
bhavitā tu yuge prāpte
kṛṣṇe kārṣṇyopalakṣite

vinindāṃ prathame pāde
kariṣyanti harer narāḥ
yugānte tu harer nāma
naiva kaścid gṛhīṣyati

dhanyās te puruṣavyāghra
pāpāmbhodhāv apāpinaḥ
ye nāmāpi kalau viṣṇor
gṛhīṣyanty akṣayātmanaḥ

dhyāyan hariṃ kṛtayuge
tretādvāparayor yajan
yad āpnoti kalau nāmnā
tad eva parikīrtayan

harir harati pāpāni
nāma bhaktyā yadīritam
vāsudeveti na janas
tad evoccārayiṣyati

bahupāṣaṇḍasaṃkīrṇe
jagaty asmin kalau yuge
kṛṣṇāyeti namo 'stv atra
sukṛtī yadi vakṣyati

hetuvādabalair mohaṃ
kuhakaiś ca jane tadā
pāṣaṇḍinaḥ kariṣyanti
cāturāśramyadūṣakāḥ

pāṣaṇḍabhūtam atyarthaṃ
jagad etad asatkṛtam
bhaviṣyati tadā bhūpa
vṛthāpravrajitotkaṭam
